title: Excel: Get and transform data with Copilot in Excel
description: Get your data ready, just by asking. Describe the data you need and how you want it prepared, and the new get data skill handles the rest. It can connect and transform your data, then load the results into your workbook using Power Query, giving you a query you can inspect, edit, and refresh without having to build it yourself. Depending on the data source, authentication may be required.

title: Power Pages: First Class Support for Connector APIs in Power Pages
description:
Native connectors support through Power Pages will allow organizations to securely connect their websites/portals directly to enterprise systems such as SQL, SAP, and Oracle, without building or maintaining custom integration layers.

This capability is especially valuable for regulated and enterprise customers such as banking and financial services, who need to surface data from systems hosted behind corporate firewalls. By leveraging the Power Platform on-premises data gateway and connector framework, customers can reduce integration complexity, lower operational costs, and accelerate delivery of secure digital experiences.

Customers benefit from consistent security, governance, and compliance with existing Power Platform policies, while gaining the flexibility to build server-side logic that can interact with on-premises data sources.

title: Dynamics 365 Finance: Expand localization in LATAM countries for Argentina
description:
With the release of Argentina, we are finalizing the LATAM expansion. Out-of-the-box localization is now available for 14 countries in the region through the cross-LATAM localization framework, in addition to Brazil and Mexico.

The country localization indicated below is provisional and may change prior to general availability. Additionally, not all of the following capabilities might be available for preview.

The Argentina-specific scope for this release includes:

  • Sales tax (VAT and provincial taxes): tax determination and calculation, import of taxpayer registers (padrones), and certificate of tax situation for customers.

  • Withholding tax (vendor payments): withholding tax determination and calculation.

  • Regulatory reporting: Argentina tax reports moved to Electronic Reporting (ER).

    • ARCA VAT reports required by IVA Simple, covering sales, purchases, imports, other fiscal debit and credit items, withholdings, and perceptions, to register VAT operations monthly and submit the VAT return through Portal IVA
    • SICORE: National Withholding and Perception Tax Transactions TXT/excel file
    • SIRE (SUSS): SUSS Withholdings (Retenciones de Seguridad Social) TXT/excel file.
    • SIFERE: Withholding tax (Retenciones) TXT/excel - Perceptions (Percepciones) TXT/excel - Bank Collections Recaudaciones Bancarias) TXT/excel - Customs Perceptions (Percepciones Aduaneras) TXT/excel
    • SIRCAR: Gross Income Tax Withholdings TXT /excel file. Gross Income Tax Perceptions TXT /excel file.
    • E-ARCIBA: Gross Income Tax Withholdings/Tax Collections (Perceptions) file.
    • ARBA Tax Collection Agents: IIBB Perceptions (Percepciones) TXT/excel file. IIBB Withholdings (Retenciones) TXT/excel file.

  • Electronic invoicing: Out of scope for the preview release

title: Dynamics 365 Sustainability: Restate previously calculated emissions
description:
Organizations can recalculate previously calculated emissions using a new restatement capability in Dynamics 365 Sustainability. Users can create a new calculation result while preserving the original result, helping maintain traceability between the original and restated emissions.

Users can identify the calculation being restated, capture the reason for the restatement, and retain the calculation history. This supports scenarios such as correcting errors, incorporating improved activity data or emission factors, changing methodologies, and reflecting organizational or structural changes.

title: Dynamics 365 Project Operations: Configure actions on task grid
description:
This feature extends Task Grid View Templates so administrators can configure both task columns and the visibility of supported task-grid actions in one place. Administrators can show or hide individual actions across task-grid views, the toolbar, row-level controls, and the task context menu.

Configurable actions include views such as Board, Timeline, Charts, Assignments, People, and Goals; toolbar commands such as Baseline, Conditional Formatting, and export; and task-management actions such as Indent, Outdent, Cut, Copy, Paste, Delete, and dependency management. Essential capabilities, including the Grid view and access to task details, remain available.

title: Dynamics 365 Finance: Optimized Customer data entities
description:
Dynamics 365 Finance introduces a set of optimized customer data entities that provide more focused options for integrating customer information. Instead of relying on a single broad customer entity, organizations can work with purpose-specific entities for core customer information, extended customer attributes, postal addresses, electronic contact information, and customer associations.

The optimized entities support both Data management import/export and OData integration scenarios, enabling organizations to build customer integrations around the specific data required for each business process.

title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): App Blocks
description: App Blocks enables M365 Copilot Chat users to turn their requests and data into rich, interactive experiences directly within the conversation, including calculators, dashboards, forms, planners, visualizations, simulations, comparison tools, and other interactive apps. It helps users move beyond static responses to explore data, adjust inputs, visualize outcomes, and simulate workflows in place, while supporting grounded scenarios where current information can be retrieved and then rendered into an interactive experience.

title: Dynamics 365 Commerce: Support trade counter sales in POS
description:
Trade Counter POS is a collection of capabilities for Dynamics 365 Commerce Point of Sale. Businesses can adopt the capabilities individually to support their trade counter operations rather than enable a single, all-or-nothing experience.

Counter associates can find customers, organizations, and products quickly. They can review customer history, credit terms, and contract pricing, and use product attributes to identify items that meet the customer's requirements.

Associates can build and manage large carts efficiently. Bulk add lets them enter multiple items and quantities, while quick add with partial search helps them add products without leaving the transaction. They can search transaction lines to locate items, select multiple lines to apply supported actions together, and filter lines with errors to focus on items that need attention. Keyboard shortcuts and an always-visible action panel help associates complete common tasks and update frequently used transaction fields with fewer navigation steps.

Associates can create orders for B2B organization accounts, capture the named buyer for auditing and accountability, and record order notes to communicate customer requirements. They can view margins and override prices within allowed discount authority and margin limits.

Associates can check inventory across the counter, attached warehouse, other branches, and central distribution center. They can use available-to-promise information to communicate fulfillment dates and create transfers to support fulfillment. Orders can be released from POS to the Warehouse Management app in Dynamics 365 Supply Chain Management, including priority release for rush orders. Warehouse workers use directed picking, scanning, and will-call staging to prepare items for pickup.

At the counter, associates can complete will-call pickup and partial fulfillment, charge purchases to the customer's account with a purchase order reference, and support B2B invoicing and credit management. They can also print A4 invoices from POS and use configurable A4 receipt layouts for business documents.

A typical workflow starts when an associate selects the business account and buyer, builds the order, and reviews pricing and availability. The associate then releases items for warehouse fulfillment. At pickup, the associate confirms the items being collected and completes the account purchase, while remaining items continue through fulfillment.

A Commerce administrator enables or disables the individual capabilities and performs the configuration required for the selected capabilities. Warehouse fulfillment uses the connected Dynamics 365 Supply Chain Management warehouse processes.

title: Excel: Edit with Copilot in Excel on iPhone
description: Edit with Copilot makes it easier to edit and transform your Excel workbooks on your phone using natural language. Copilot can continue working on your task even when you move away from the app, so you can come back when the work is ready. Chat mode also remains available when you want to ask questions and get insights without making changes to your workbook.

title: Microsoft Teams: Workflow to automatically add tag members to relevant channels
description: Associate channels with a tag so members are automatically added to those channels when they join the tag. This helps teams keep channel membership in sync with evolving groups, reduces manual management, and ensures members have access to the conversations and content most relevant to their role.

title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): SharePoint Site Builder
description: This feature enables users to easily create new SharePoint sites with Copilot. Users can review and confirm a clear site plan before Copilot builds the site.

title: Dynamics 365 Contact Center: Boost contact center efficiency with real-time streaming analytics
description:
Real-time streaming analytics is built into the new supervisor application. An advanced streaming engine keeps metrics up to date with near-instant updates, allowing supervisors to view the latest data without refreshing the dashboard.

Key capabilities include:

  • Continuous, streaming dashboards: Monitor mission-critical KPIs such as queue backlog, service level, abandon rate, and representative presence in near real time. Visual alerts highlight anomalies as they occur.
  • Full-screen wallboards: Display live metrics on high-resolution monitors across the contact center floor, providing teams with a shared, at-a-glance view of performance.
  • Drill-down analytics: Navigate from high-level summaries to detailed queue-level and representative-level views to analyze performance and identify issues.
  • Queue & Representative-level insight: Evaluate live indicators such as Queue backlog, Longest wait time, representative presence status and their available capacity, along with performance metrics like average speed to answer and conversations handled over time.**: Evaluate live indicators such as presence status, available capacity, and conversations handled over time.
  • Immediate corrective actions: Respond to performance changes in real time by moving representatives across queues, updating presence, skills and capacity profiles.
  • In-context conversation management: View conversation details and take action directly from the dashboard, including assigning or transferring conversations.
  • Self-service metrics: Monitor self-service effectiveness in real time with visibility into containment, escalation, and customer interaction trends.
  • Configurable metric thresholds: Configure custom thresholds for key metrics and automatically highlight At Risk and Critical conditions through color-coded indicators.

title: Outlook: Multiple Intune Accounts in Outlook for Android
description: Multiple MAM (Mobile Application Management) Intune Accounts will now be supported in Outlook for Android. Only one MDM (Mobile Device Management) account will be supported at a time per device.

title: PowerPoint: Clear view-only messaging
description: When you open a presentation you don't have permission to edit, PowerPoint now shows a clear "Viewing Only" message bar. It explains that the file is view-only, shows who created it, and tells you to contact the owner if you need more access.

title: Planner: Task History
description: Task History helps keep teams up to date on changes made to a task. View recent activity to see what changed, when it changed, and track progress over time.

title: Microsoft Teams: Hide Organizer name in Calendar View on Teams Panels
description: Admins can now choose whether the organizer name will show up in the Calendar View on Teams panels. Admins can toggle the "Show organizer name" setting ON or OFF in the Pro Management portal or on the panel device. Based on the selection, the organizer name will or will not be shown in the calendar view on the panel device. Available with Teams Rooms Pro and Teams Shared Space licenses.

title: Planner: Capacity view
description: Capacity view shows a timeline of who's working on what, so you can see how work is distributed across your team and spot overload or open capacity at a glance.

title: Outlook: Reply with a Template in Rules
description: You can now create a rule that automatically replies to incoming messages with a template you've set up. Set the conditions you care about and pick the template, and Outlook handles the response for you. It's a simple way to send consistent replies without typing the same thing over and over. #newoutlookforwindows

title: Microsoft Copilot Studio: Supercharge your workflows with computer use
description: Add resilient, AI-powered UI automation directly into your workflows with computer use tools. Makers can build reusable, goal-oriented automations that adapt dynamically to website or app changes, while admins maintain governance through access controls, hosted browser management, and environment-level permissions. Update: This roadmap item is no longer accurate and will be removed from the roadmap. We apologize for any inconvenience.

title: Microsoft 365: Companion apps - Copilot prompts in the Files app now available for Copilot Chat users
description: The Files companion app, part of the Microsoft 365 companion apps suite on the Windows taskbar, now surfaces AI-powered Copilot file prompts for Copilot Chat users. Previously available only to Microsoft 365 Copilot licensees, this update extends contextual file prompts to Microsoft 365 Copilot Chat users, enabling them to discover and interact with relevant files through intelligent suggestions. Users can find their most relevant files faster and take action on them directly from the Files app. Update: This roadmap item is no longer accurate and will be removed from the roadmap. We apologize for any inconvenience.

title: Planner: Conditional Coloring
description: Conditional Coloring highlight tasks based on selected criteria, making priorities, status, and important task details easier to spot.

title: Microsoft Copilot Studio: Invoke agents as workflow steps with the agent node
description: The agent node lets you embed reasoning directly into your workflow. This means fewer manual handoffs, faster processing times, and workflows that can handle nuanced decisions without additional development effort, helping teams automate more of their end-to-end processes and reduce operational overhead.

title: Microsoft Viva: Create and customize PBI reports
description: We are introducing a new feature for leaders and analysts of Viva Insights, where they can view a Power BI report, and edit time range, filters, attributes and change visuals as per their organizations' needs. They can then save the report for viewing later.

title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Structured Document Generation with Forms
description: Structured Document Generation with Forms enables organizations to create, manage, and generate standardized documents at scale with built-in governance and compliance in SharePoint. Business process owners can centrally build and maintain form-driven templates -- such as contracts, agreements, proposals, and HR documents -- ensuring content stays accurate and up to date. Users can then generate the right document every time by just filling out the form, without manual formatting, versioning issues, or compliance risk, simplifying high-volume, structured document workflows across the organization.

title: Microsoft Teams: Expanded Markdown support in Microsoft Teams
description: Microsoft Teams is expanding Markdown support in the compose box, giving you more ways to structure and format messages using familiar Markdown syntax. Create richer, more readable messages while staying in the Markdown authoring experience.

title: Microsoft Viva: Copilot Analytics - Identifiable Export metrics in the Copilot Dashboard
description: This enables users to export Identifiable row-level Copilot metrics from the Copilot Dashboard for reporting and deeper analysis. This capability can be tuned On by Admins in a tenant.

title: Microsoft Purview: Data Lifecycle Management– Hard delete capability for OneDrive and SharePoint through secure priority cleanup workflows
description: Data Lifecycle Management allows compliance admins to retain, review and delete content in M365 workloads. Deletion of content to adhere to compliance requirements, admins can set up Retention policies or labels. To help prevent inadvertent data loss, M365 retention labels policies and M365 retention policies do not hard delete content immediately and keeps the data in Recycle Bins for 93 days for ODSP. Hard delete itself is a very costly process as it opens Microsoft to heavy legal implications in case of any data loss incident that may occur due to a misconfigured policy or regression. Priority Cleanup feature allows users to bypass retention, and eDiscovery holds to help customers comply to changing legal/compliance requirements or manage data spillage scenarios. This feature requires the ability to hard delete specific files from the scoped locations.  Ability to select hard delete configuration for a Priority cleanup policy for OneDrive and SharePoint content and skip recycle bins.

title: Microsoft Viva: Import HRIS data in Viva Glint from Microsoft Admin Center
description: Customers will be able to use various connectors to HRIS tools to import HRIS data into Viva Glint from Microsoft Admin Center.

title: Microsoft Edge: Rewrite by Copilot in Edge is being upgraded to include enterprise data protection compliance standards
description: Rewrite by Copilot in Edge, which lets users edit typed text for tone, format, and length within an open page in Microsoft Edge, is being updated to include enterprise data protection for commercial customers. Once Rewrite is available, users signed in with a Microsoft Entra ID will have enterprise data protection when using the feature in Microsoft Edge. Updated March 20, 2026: We have paused release of this feature temporarily and will announce new release timelines soon. We apologize for any inconvenience.

title: Microsoft Viva: Search in Viva Connections on iOS and Android tablet
description: This adds a search entry point and a new tailored experience for Viva Connection users on iOS and Android tablets.
ai_summary: Viva Connections on iOS and Android tablets will now have a search feature for users. This change affects all users of Viva Connections on these devices.

title: Microsoft Teams: Change background while recording on phone
description: You can record a video clip with your phone camera and switch your background to any picture you want or make it blurry. With this feature, you can record yourself anywhere and share it with coworkers in your Teams chat or channel.
ai_summary: Teams users can now change their background while recording videos on their phones. This feature is relevant for anyone using Teams on mobile.

title: Microsoft Teams: Microsoft 365 admin centers –  Manage Teams apps that work on Outlook and Microsoft 365 App
description: Administrators using the Microsoft 365 admin center and Teams admin center who manage Teams apps that work on Outlook and the Microsoft 365 App will be able to apply their changes across all three clients (Teams, Outlook and Microsoft 365 App). Before this update, changes made through the Integrated Apps section in the Microsoft 365 admin center would only affect these apps on Outlook and the Microsoft 365 App; similarly, changes made in the Teams admin center would exclusively affect Teams. With this change, management of these apps will be unified across Teams, Outlook and Microsoft 365 App.
ai_summary: Admins can now manage Teams apps across Teams, Outlook, and the Microsoft 365 App from a unified interface. This change affects Microsoft 365 and Teams administrators.

title: Microsoft Teams: School Connection –  Providing access to parents via their phone number
description: The School Connection app in Microsoft Teams (mobile) empowers parents and guardians to engage, support, and monitor their student's learning at school. This release enables a parent/guardian to get access to their child’s profile in School Connection if they login to Teams (mobile) with their phone number and the school has registered that phone number as a parent/guardian contact. Additionally, a parent/guardian will easily get access to their child’s profile if the phone number or email address that is registered by the school is saved as a login information in their Microsoft account. Learn more about School Connection at the link below.
ai_summary: Parents can access their child's profile in the School Connection app via their phone number in Teams mobile. This change affects parents and guardians using Teams for school engagement.

title: Microsoft Defender for Office 365: False positive email release from Quarantine through threat explorer, email summary panel, advanced hunting, and custom detection email entity page take action
description: SecOps can now mange False positives and take move to inbox (i.e. release) quarantined messages from Threat explorer, advanced hunting, custom detection and Email entity page without the need to tab out to the Quarantine portal to take the action.
ai_summary: SecOps can release false positive emails from quarantine directly through various tools without accessing the Quarantine portal. This change impacts security operations teams.

title: Microsoft Teams: Latest meeting experiences with performance improvements on web for Safari and Firefox (for anonymous join only)
description: The latest Teams meeting experiences will be available for Teams on the web in Safari and Firefox browsers - including performance improvements, refreshed pre-join, updated meeting stage, and the updated meeting toolbar. (for anonymous join only)
ai_summary: Teams on the web will have improved meeting experiences for anonymous users on Safari and Firefox. This change affects anonymous users joining meetings through these browsers.

title: Microsoft Viva: Viva Engage - Topic Subscription notification
description: This feature allows users to subscribe to notifications for Viva Engage topics they follow. Users will receive a Viva Engage bell notification when a new post is tagged with a topic they are subscribed to or when the topic is added to an existing post.
ai_summary: Users can subscribe to notifications for topics in Viva Engage, receiving alerts for new posts. This feature affects all users engaged with topics in Viva Engage.

title: Microsoft Teams: EDU tenant type selection in policy wizard
description: Admins can now select tenant type for their institution from the policy wizard. This setting can be changed anytime from the wizard.
ai_summary: Microsoft Teams will allow admins to select their institution's tenant type from the policy wizard, which can be changed at any time. This affects IT admins managing policies.

title: Whiteboard: Existing Azure Board Migration
description: This feature will migrate boards that exist in your tenant's Azure storage to OneDrive for Business storage. More information will follow as we near release.
ai_summary: Whiteboard will migrate existing boards from Azure storage to OneDrive for Business storage. This affects users who utilize boards in their Azure environment.

title: Microsoft Teams: Inline preview of files shared
description: Now you can review a file shared in chat and channels in your flow of work. Select ‘preview’ and scroll through the file’s content without leaving the chat or channel.
ai_summary: Microsoft Teams will allow users to preview files shared in chats and channels without leaving the conversation. This change affects all users sharing and reviewing files.

title: Microsoft Teams: Forward messages with app cards
description: Messages containing app cards in chats and channels can now be forwarded. To use, navigate to the more actions menu of any message containing an app card, and select "Forward".
ai_summary: Microsoft Teams now allows users to forward messages that contain app cards in chats and channels. This change affects all Teams users.

title: Microsoft Teams: Customize the location of Teams notifications on web
description: You can now customize where your Teams notification appear on your screen when using Teams on web. Options include bottom right, top right, bottom left, and top left, allowing you to choose the most convenient and least intrusive location for a better experience and productivity.
ai_summary: Teams on the web now lets users customize the location of notifications on their screen. This feature impacts all web users of Teams.

title: Microsoft Teams: Together Mode New Flow
description:
After further review, this feature continues rolling out. We apologize for any inconvenience.
Together mode will get a new simplified flow which will take the user from the beginning to the end through the steps of setting up the scene, assigning the seats and applying for everyone in the call in a transparent and easy-to-understand way. The function itself does not change but there will be more transparency thanks to the icons on the meeting toolbar for an easy access for each next step in the familiar Together mode flow.
ai_summary: Together mode in Teams will have a new simplified flow for setting up scenes and assigning seats. This affects users who utilize Together mode during calls.

title: Microsoft Purview compliance portal: Insider Risk Management - Progressive alert scoring
description: With this new feature, user activities that could potentially result in data security incidents will be assessed more frequently within a 24-hour period compared with the current practice of once every 24 hours. Alert insights will now be updated every few hours with this increased frequency, providing designated analysts with timely alerts and continuously evolving insights. Microsoft Purview Insider Risk Management correlates various signals to identify potential malicious or inadvertent insider risks, such as IP theft, data leakage, and security violations. Insider Risk Management enables customers to create policies based on their own internal policies, governance, and organizational requirements. Built with privacy by design, users are pseudonymized by default, and role-based access controls and audit logs are in place to help ensure user-level privacy.
ai_summary: The Microsoft Purview compliance portal will now assess user activities for insider risks more frequently, providing timely alerts to analysts. This impacts compliance analysts.

title: Outlook: Prioritize my inbox by Copilot
description: Prioritize my inbox by Copilot marks high priority mails in your inbox and provides a short summary of the mail's importance in the message list and the reading pane. Mails can be sorted and filtered by Copilot's priority. In Web and New Outlook for Windows, you can also choose to have Copilot mark low priority mails. #newoutlookforwindows
ai_summary: Outlook's Copilot feature will now prioritize emails by marking high priority messages and summarizing their importance. This affects Outlook users.

title: Microsoft Teams: Copilot in Teams meetings responses can be exported to Word and Excel
description: Now, certain responses from Copilot in Teams meetings will have an option to ‘edit in’ Word or Excel. The ‘edit in’ option for Word will be available for Copilot responses that are long (more than 1300 characters) and will automatically open a Word document with the response written. The ‘edit in’ option for Excel will be available for Copilot responses that are formatted in a table, and will automatically open an Excel file with the formatted response added. Copilot responses can only be exported if the meeting policy for the meeting is set to allow copying or forwarding of meeting chat, live captions, transcript, and Copilot responses. The export capability will also inherit the sensitivity label of the meeting (sensitivity labels are available to Teams Premium users).
ai_summary: Responses from Copilot in Teams meetings can now be exported to Word or Excel for editing. This feature affects users who utilize Copilot in meetings.

title: Microsoft Teams: Teams Button Support on Multiple Connected Peripheral Devices
description: You can now use the Teams button across peripheral devices without having to manually select a specific device in the Teams devices settings. This ensures a more seamless experience navigating across multiple certified for Microsoft Teams personal peripheral USB devices (with a wire or a dongle) connected to the same host device (such as your laptop). For example, you can use the Teams button on headset A to bring up the meeting pre-join screen, then use the Teams button on headset B to join the meeting, and then use the Teams button on your connected speakerphone to raise hand in the meeting, etc.
ai_summary: Teams button support has been expanded to work seamlessly across multiple connected peripheral devices. This change affects users with certified Teams devices.

title: Microsoft Teams: Open file links preference to extend across M365 apps
description: When it comes to how links to cloud-hosted Word, Excel, or PowerPoint files should open, you may prefer they open in a browser, desktop apps, or directly in Teams. Now, your Teams file open preference will extend to across Microsoft 365 apps starting with classic Outlook, Word, Excel and PowerPoint. This makes the open file experience consistent on your Windows PC/device. If you prefer, you will still be able to choose your Teams file open preference separately.
ai_summary: Teams file open preferences will now extend to other Microsoft 365 apps, ensuring a consistent experience. This affects users of Outlook, Word, Excel, and PowerPoint.

title: Outlook: Additional features on the profile card in Outlook Mobile
description: Reachability panel, hybrid location, and pronouns (read only) will be available on the Outlook profile card in iOS and Android. Events panel will be replaced with the calendar in Outlook mobile.
ai_summary: Outlook Mobile will introduce additional features on the profile card, including reachability and hybrid location. This change affects mobile Outlook users.

title: Microsoft Teams: Opening Calls in a small window in Teams
description: Allowing users to open calls in a small window to reduce disruptions in Teams.
ai_summary: Microsoft Teams will allow users to open calls in a small window, minimizing disruptions during meetings. This change affects all Teams users.

title: Microsoft Teams: Ability to Stop Copilot while it is generating a response
description: Copilot in Teams will now have a 'stop' button after sending a prompt. This will allow the user to stop Copilot's response either before the response has started to generate, or even after the response is generating. The user may then start a new prompt if they wish.
ai_summary: Teams will introduce a 'stop' button for Copilot, enabling users to halt response generation at any point. This feature impacts users utilizing Copilot in Teams.

title: Microsoft Teams: Presenter Chat while screensharing
description: Enable presenters to more easily access the meeting chat while screensharing by adding an entry point in the presenter toolbar.
ai_summary: Presenters in Teams can now access meeting chat more easily while screensharing through a new entry point in the presenter toolbar. This change benefits presenters during meetings.

title: Microsoft Teams: App ratings will be available in the unfurled links
description: App ratings will appear on the unfurled links for shared apps and agents to allow users who rely on ratings to evaluate apps prior to installing.
ai_summary: App ratings will now be displayed on unfurled links for shared apps in Teams, helping users evaluate apps before installation. This change impacts all Teams users.

title: Microsoft Teams: Users can view app ratings before installing apps or agents
description: We have improved user options for sharing a link for a Teams app or a Microsoft 365 Copilot agent in a chat. Links to apps and agents will have a new preview card with user ratings for users to consider before installing apps or agents in Teams and clear actions like Add (which installs the app or agent) and View detail. A Microsoft 365 Copilot license is not required to share Copilot agent links but may be required to install and use the agent.
ai_summary: Users can view app ratings before installing apps or agents in Teams through a new preview card in shared links. This feature affects all Teams users.

title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Fix all spelling and grammar issues with Copilot
description: One-click solution to fix spelling and grammar errors in the document
ai_summary: Microsoft 365 Copilot will offer a one-click solution to fix spelling and grammar errors in documents. This feature impacts users of Microsoft 365 applications.

title: Microsoft Teams: External group chat policy enforcements for max two orgs
description: Facilitate creation and maintenance of external group chats with bilateral policy enforcement where members in the chat can belong to a maximum of two tenants.  Allow tenant admins to control bilateral chat policy and apply it to users and groups.
ai_summary: Teams will enforce policies for external group chats, limiting members to a maximum of two organizations. Tenant admins can control these policies, affecting users in external chats.

title: Microsoft Teams: Town hall usage reports in TAC will have all the relevant usage data related to town hall events in the tenant.
description: When Town hall was released, there were some columns/data related to each Town hall event that were missing in the TAC usage reports for IT Admins. Now all the relevant usage related data are added to the town hall usage reports available in the TAC portal for Admins.
ai_summary: Town hall usage reports in the TAC will now include all relevant data for events, providing IT admins with comprehensive insights. This change affects IT administrators managing town hall events.

title: Outlook: Create, Delete, Rename, and Move Folders
description: You will now be able to more easily create, delete, rename, and move folders on mobile. From your inbox, tap the Edit icon in the sidebar. Tap on any folder to create a subfolder, or rename, move, and delete that folder. You can also rearrange and nest your folders by dragging and dropping them.
ai_summary: Outlook on mobile now allows users to create, delete, rename, and move folders easily from the inbox. This change affects all mobile Outlook users.

title: Microsoft Teams: Copilot summary for transferred calls
description: When a call is forwarded/transferred to another colleague, users can prompt Copilot to automatically summarize the context, open questions, etc. for the call as a briefing for the receiving colleague. This feature ensures that the recipient is well-informed about the previous conversations related to the transferred call, enhancing their understanding and preparedness.
ai_summary: Microsoft Teams will enable users to use Copilot to summarize context for transferred calls, helping the receiving colleague understand prior discussions. This feature affects Teams users involved in call transfers.

title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Support for summarization of very long documents
description: Copilot in Word can summarize documents up to about 1,500,000 words or 3,000 pages. This summary will be available on top of the document.
ai_summary: Copilot in Word can now summarize very long documents, up to 1,500,000 words. This feature is useful for users working with extensive documents.

title: Microsoft Teams: Set New Ringtones in Teams Mobile
description: This feature allows you to customize and select different sounds for various types of calls, helping you better manage your alerts and distinguish between different incoming communications. For users with Microsoft Teams Phone, this also includes calls for forwarded and delegated calls.
ai_summary: Microsoft Teams mobile will allow users to set custom ringtones for different types of calls, improving alert management. This change affects all Teams mobile users.

title: Microsoft Teams: Configurable Keyboard Shortcuts
description: Set your own keyboard shortcuts to match your work preferences. Customize the keyboard shortcut for an action you frequently use by clicking on the ellipsis and selecting Keyboard shortcuts from the menu.
ai_summary: Microsoft Teams will allow users to configure their own keyboard shortcuts for frequently used actions, enhancing usability. This feature affects all Teams users.

title: Microsoft Teams: AI assistant for admins in the Pro Management portal
description: IT admins can optimize their time and resources by utilizing the Pro Management Portal AI assistant. It offers comprehensive answers to questions about Teams meeting spaces and management solutions and delivers data and insights specific to inventory in the organization’s environment. This feature is available with Teams Rooms Pro and does not require a Microsoft 365 Copilot license.
ai_summary: An AI assistant in the Teams Pro Management portal will help IT admins with questions about meeting spaces and management solutions. This feature is specifically for Teams Rooms Pro users.

title: Microsoft Teams: Presenter joins Townhalls via dial-in
description: Now, with a Public Switched Telephone Network (PSTN) code provided in the town hall share event dialog, organizers can share these codes with presenters. With these codes, presenters will join as an attendee and promoted to a presenter to join either the green room or the live session.
ai_summary: Presenters can now join town halls via a PSTN code, allowing them to participate as attendees before being promoted to presenter. This change affects town hall organizers and presenters in Teams.

title: Outlook: Add custom sounds for Mail Notifications, Reactions, and Calendar Reminders
description: In your Notification settings, you'll be able to add a custom sound for your mail notifications, mail reactions, and calendar notifications (aka reminders). #newoutlookforwindows
ai_summary: Outlook will allow users to add custom sounds for mail notifications, reactions, and calendar reminders. This feature affects all Outlook users on Windows.

title: Microsoft Purview compliance portal: Insider Risk Management - Policy tuning analysis for priority content-only policies
description: Policy tuning analysis provides admins with a real-time prediction of the number of users in a tenant that could potentially match a given set of policy conditions. With this update, policy tuning analysis will support insider risk policies that are scoped for priority content. Microsoft Purview Insider Risk Management correlates various signals to identify potential malicious or inadvertent insider risks such as IP theft, data leakage, and security violations. Insider Risk Management enables customers to create policies based on their internal policies, governance, and organizational requirements. Built with privacy by design, users are pseudonymized by default and role-based access controls and audit logs are in place to help ensure user-level privacy.
ai_summary: Microsoft Purview compliance portal will enhance insider risk management by providing real-time predictions for users matching policy conditions related to priority content. This change affects compliance admins managing insider risk policies.

title: Microsoft Teams: Usability and privacy improvements for live captions and live transcript in meetings
description: Introducing enhancements to live captions and live transcripts in Microsoft Teams to make meetings more intuitive, accessible, and privacy-focused. Live captions are now scrollable, allowing users to review past conversation with more flexibility and over a larger surface area. Next, copying captions is disabled by default to protect sensitive information and support compliance. Additionally, the live transcript panel won’t open automatically with features that trigger transcription—like recording, giving users greater control over their layout. Lastly, If transcription is enabled, users who attempt to open the live transcript panel will see a banner suggesting they switch to live captions for real-time comprehension. These updates streamline the experience while supporting accessibility and privacy.
ai_summary: Microsoft Teams will improve live captions and transcripts by making them scrollable and disabling copying by default for privacy. This update affects all Teams users participating in meetings.

title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Referenced sources are cited in drafted content
description: When drafting content that's based on referenced sources, Copilot includes citations in the text it generates, indicating references to information in the content.
ai_summary: Microsoft Copilot will now include citations for referenced sources in drafted content, ensuring proper attribution. This change impacts users creating content with Copilot.

title: Outlook: Contact Improvements on Outlook Mobile
description: On Outlook mobile we are improving the "Contacts" experience by showing additional profile information for your contacts, where applicable. Secondly, this improvement hides identical duplicate contacts.
ai_summary: Outlook mobile will enhance the contacts experience by displaying more profile information and hiding duplicate contacts. This update affects mobile Outlook users.

title: Outlook: Create a meeting from an email thread with Copilot
description: Copilot makes it fast and easy to schedule a meeting from an email thread. When you use the Schedule with Copilot option, Copilot analyzes the email and creates a meeting invitation for you, filling in a meeting title and agenda, and adding the email thread as an attachment. The people on the email thread are included as meeting attendees, and you can quickly review the invitation, add or change info, and then send it out.
ai_summary: Outlook will allow users to schedule meetings directly from email threads using Copilot, which will generate meeting invitations automatically. This feature affects users who manage meetings via Outlook.

title: Microsoft Teams: SQL-like commands in the search bar
description: Efficiently narrow down your search results by using SQL-like commands in the search bar. Users can quickly filter messages, files, or conversations with precise queries such as from:username, with:username or in:channel.
ai_summary: Microsoft Teams will introduce SQL-like commands in the search bar to help users filter messages and files more efficiently. This change affects all Teams users looking to refine their searches.

title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Referenced sources are cited in drafted content
description: When drafting content that's based on referenced sources, Copilot includes citations in the text it generates, indicating references to information in the content.
ai_summary: Microsoft Copilot will now include citations for referenced sources in drafted content, ensuring proper attribution. This change impacts users creating content with Copilot.

title: Microsoft Teams: Support for PowerPoint live within Cloud Video Interop (CVI)
description: This new functionality will provide CVI Partners with the ability to display still images when PowerPoint live content is being presented within a Microsoft Teams meeting. The PowerPoint presentation will then be displayed as video content, this will not include animations or embedded videos.
ai_summary: Microsoft Teams will support displaying still images during PowerPoint live presentations through Cloud Video Interop, enhancing presentation capabilities. This change affects Teams users presenting with PowerPoint.

title: Microsoft Viva: Viva Pulse - New Pulse customization options
description: Authors will have new options when starting surveys, including choosing to send without pre-defining an audience, and feedback can instead be gathered by sharing a link that people can access the survey and respond through, sending a survey without a specified end date, allowing for longer-term data collection and multiple responses from recipients over time, and collecting identified responses, where answers are attributed to the person who submitted them.
ai_summary: Microsoft Viva Pulse will offer new survey customization options, allowing authors to gather feedback without predefined audiences and collect identified responses. This update affects users creating and managing surveys in Viva Pulse.

title: Microsoft Teams: Select camera in pre-join and during meeting
description: Users can select an internal or external camera, or keep it turned off, before joining or during Teams meetings.
ai_summary: Microsoft Teams now allows users to select their camera before joining or during meetings, enhancing user control over video settings.

title: Outlook: Save an Event as a Draft on Android
description: You can save a meeting as a draft on your calendar if you aren't ready to send the meeting invites. When composing an event with at least one attendee added, select dismiss and then select Save as a Draft. The draft event will show on your calendar as [Draft] along with the title of the event.
ai_summary: Outlook on Android enables users to save meeting events as drafts, allowing them to finalize invites later.

title: Microsoft Teams: Decorate your background for GCC and GCC High environments (Premium)
description: Decorate your background is now available to customers in the GCC and GCC High environments. Decorate your background is a generative background effect in Teams that makes meetings more fun and personal by using AI to spruce up your meeting background. Blend your physical and digital spaces, enabling you to revamp what’s seen of your physical meeting space for each call. This technology allows for effortless room clean-ups, adding virtual plants, or festive decorations for special events. Decorate your background requires a Teams Premium license.
ai_summary: Microsoft Teams introduces a background decoration feature for GCC and GCC High environments, requiring a Teams Premium license.

title: Microsoft Clipchamp: Updated Clipchamp video start page
description: The Clipchamp start page new unified hub is a revamped video hub start page experience of a single video destination for creation, discovery & consumption.
ai_summary: Clipchamp has a new start page that serves as a unified hub for video creation, discovery, and consumption.

title: Microsoft Teams: Preview changes before sending content live in 'Manage what attendees see'
description: An enhancement to the 'Manage what attendees see' feature allows organizers and presenters to preview changes to what is going to be displayed on or off the screen before sending the changes live to attendees. This capability is only available for Town hall.
ai_summary: Microsoft Teams enhances the 'Manage what attendees see' feature, allowing organizers to preview changes before displaying them to attendees.

title: Outlook: Chat for Outlook iOS and Android
description:
On phone devices, users currently access Copilot Chat in Outlook Mobile via a tab at the bottom of their screen (or in Apps). Outlook is introducing a new Copilot Chat overlay experience, allowing users to chat with Copilot while continuing to interact with their email, calendar, and contacts. This overlay will be context-aware—understanding what the user is viewing—so users can ask Copilot about the content on their screen. 

Users with M365 Copilot licenses will also benefit from Copilot’s ability to  draw on Microsoft 365 Graph to provide richer, more personalized responses.
ai_summary: Outlook introduces a new Copilot Chat overlay for mobile, enabling users to interact with Copilot while managing emails and calendars.

title: Outlook: Grid keyboard navigation in calendar month view via arrow keys in new Outlook for Windows and Web
description: When focused on the calendar grid, you will be able to navigate the time slots on the calendar via left/right/up/down arrow keys in month view. #newoutlookforwindows
ai_summary: In the new Outlook for Windows and Web, users can navigate the calendar month view using arrow keys for easier scheduling.

title: Microsoft Teams: Channel Agent
description: Channel agent works alongside you and your team to help you manage projects. It can create status reports, send emails, schedule meetings, co-author documents, and answer questions. Channel agent understands context from meetings, chats, and files, and uses that knowledge to help you move work forward. It’s designed to save time, reduce manual effort, and make collaboration more intelligent.
ai_summary: Microsoft Teams introduces a Channel Agent that assists teams with project management tasks like creating reports and scheduling meetings. This feature is designed for all Teams users to enhance collaboration.

title: Microsoft Viva: Viva Learning - Notification Settings
description: Admins can now enable/disable all learning-related notifications from a centralized settings page.
ai_summary: Microsoft Viva allows admins to manage all learning-related notifications from a single settings page. This change affects administrators overseeing Viva Learning.

title: Outlook: Immersive Search
description: After completing a search in Outlook, a user will see a Copilot entry point that will take them to an LLM generated summary of their search query (emails, Teams messages and documents) within their Copilot side pane. They will be able to interact further with Copilot to dig deeper into these results and take action items accordingly.
ai_summary: Outlook introduces Immersive Search, providing a Copilot-generated summary of search results in the side pane. This feature impacts users who perform searches in Outlook.

title: Outlook: Automatic Draft Minimize
description: When users close a draft in progress, it automatically minimizes instead of closing completely. The minimized draft can now be quickly accessed via a button that appears in the message list.
ai_summary: Outlook will now minimize drafts instead of closing them when users exit. This feature allows users to quickly access minimized drafts from the message list.

title: Outlook: Calendar support for copying, cutting, and pasting events and appointments
description: Customers can now copy, cut, and paste meetings and appointments on their calendar in the new Outlook using CTRL+C, CTRL+X, and CTRL+V keyboard shortcuts. #newoutlookforwindows
ai_summary: Outlook now supports copying, cutting, and pasting calendar events using keyboard shortcuts. This feature is available in the new Outlook for Windows and affects calendar users.

title: Microsoft Teams: Customize the screen in Teams Town halls through ‘Manage what attendees see’ [Teams Premium]
description: The enhanced “Manage what attendees see” experience enables organizers to take their Town hall presentations to the next level. Organizers and presenters can apply layouts, backgrounds, theme colors, and name tags to deliver events that are polished, professional, and highly engaging. This feature is available to organizers with a Teams Premium license.
ai_summary: Teams Premium users can now customize attendee views in Town Hall meetings with enhanced layout options and themes. This feature is aimed at event organizers using Teams Premium.

title: Microsoft Teams: Raise hands in Town Hall
description: Currently in a Teams Town hall, attendees cannot raise their hands and share their microphone and camera as they can in a meeting. With this new update, town halls organized by users with Teams Premium will allow attendees to raise their hand like they would in a standard Teams meeting. The ability to raise a hand can signal to organizers and presenters, who can then bring attendees on screen to allow them to share their camera and microphone.
ai_summary: Teams Town Halls will now allow attendees to raise their hands, similar to standard meetings, enhancing interaction. This feature is available for Town Halls organized by Teams Premium users.

title: Microsoft Teams: App Deployment in Teams Admin Center
description: We're introducing a new admin setting that replaces the Installed apps section in app setup policies, enabling more streamlined per-app deployment control.  With controls to pre-install the app for : all users, specific users and groups, or no users.
ai_summary: Microsoft Teams will have a new admin setting for app deployment, allowing more control over which apps are pre-installed for users and groups. This affects Teams administrators.

title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Updates to OneDrive file browsing experience in the Microsoft 365 Copilot app on iPad and iPhone
description: Users on the Microsoft 365 Copilot app for iPad and iPhone devices will be directed to the standalone OneDrive app for file browsing and management. While users can still access their most recent files and search for OneDrive content within the Microsoft 365 Copilot app, advanced actions like folder navigation, permission settings, downloads, and deletions must be done in the OneDrive app.
ai_summary: Users of the Microsoft 365 Copilot app on iPad and iPhone will be directed to the OneDrive app for advanced file management tasks. This change affects Copilot app users on these devices.

title: Outlook: New Scheduling and Event Creation Experience
description: The Outlook and Teams calendars will receive an update to the scheduling and event creation experience. Additionally, new capabilities will be available in this new experience to help streamline and enhance scheduling using Copilot. #newoutlookforwindows
ai_summary: Outlook and Teams calendars will receive an update to enhance scheduling and event creation, including new capabilities with Copilot. This change affects all users of Outlook and Teams.

title: Microsoft Teams: Private channels increased limits and transition to group compliance
description: We are updating private channels to align with compliance model for all channels. After this change, compliance policies applied to the team (M365 Group) will apply to all channels in the team - across standard, private, and shared. Private channels will no longer need user level targeting of policies different from other channels, and private channel compliance messages will no longer be copied to user mailboxes, relying on a dedicated, internal mailbox per channel like shared channels. In addition, limits for private channels will be increased so each team can have more than 30 private channels, up to the 1000 total channel limit per team. Private channel member limits will increase from 250 to 5000. You will also be able to schedule meetings in private channels.
ai_summary: Private channels in Microsoft Teams will align with compliance policies for all channels, increasing limits and changing how compliance messages are handled. This affects Teams administrators and users of private channels.

title: Microsoft Viva: Viva Insights - Skills landscape report for organizations
description: A Power BI report that provides an overview of the skills distribution in the organization and supports users in identifying skill gaps and making informed decisions on workforce planning, resource allocation, and skilling initiatives.
ai_summary: Viva Insights will provide a Power BI report showing skill distribution in the organization to assist with workforce planning.

title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Press and hold Win + C or Copilot key to activate voice on the Microsoft 365 Copilot app
description: Press and hold Win + C keys, or the dedicated Copilot key for applicable devices, and the Microsoft 365 Copilot app will activate voice. With voice, talk to Copilot like a personal assistant - interrupting and redirecting at any time to prepare for the workday, create documents, understand topics, and search for information. This shortcut to activate voice means you don't have to switch between screens to talk with Copilot. Enterprise-grade security and compliance are built in, so conversations stay private while productivity soars.
ai_summary: Users can activate voice features in the Microsoft 365 Copilot app using the Win + C keys or a dedicated key for easier interaction.

title: Microsoft Teams: Unified Agent and App Availability Management Across Microsoft 365 and Teams Admin Center
description: Administrators using the Microsoft 365 admin center and Teams admin center who manage agents and apps that work across Teams, Outlook and the Microsoft 365 copilot will be able to apply their changes consistently across all these surfaces. Before this update, changes made through the Integrated Apps section in the Microsoft 365 admin center would only affect these apps on Outlook and the Microsoft 365 copilot; similarly, changes made in the Teams admin center would exclusively affect Teams. With this change, app and agent availability  will be unified across Teams, Outlook and Microsoft 365 copilot.
ai_summary: Administrators can now manage app and agent availability consistently across Teams, Outlook, and Microsoft 365 admin centers.

title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Work context suggestions in Copilot Chat ContextIQ menu
description: Copilot Chat will suggest prompts and work context you have access to as you type in the prompt, helping you find relevant information for your conversations.
ai_summary: Copilot Chat will suggest relevant prompts and work context as users type, improving the efficiency of information retrieval.

title: Microsoft Teams: Channel agent to 3P MCP tool orchestration in Teams channels
description: Agent-MCP Orchestration in Teams enables Channel agent to work with select third-party MCP servers, such as GitHub, Asana and  Atlassian (JIRA). This setup allows collaborative workflows that mirror real human teamwork. When a user asks Channel Agent a question, the agent can collaborate with other tools to gather information or complete tasks, transparently showing each step of its reasoning along the way.
ai_summary: Teams will enable Channel agents to collaborate with third-party tools like GitHub and JIRA for enhanced workflow integration.

title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Copilot Chat in Word, Excel, PowerPoint, OneNote, and Outlook for DoD
description: Easily access Copilot Chat from a side pane in Word, Excel, PowerPoint, OneNote, and Outlook. This is available for Copilot Chat users with a Microsoft 365 license and for Microsoft 365 Copilot licensed users.
ai_summary: Copilot Chat is now accessible from a side pane in Word, Excel, PowerPoint, OneNote, and Outlook for users with the appropriate Microsoft 365 licenses. This affects users of these applications.

title: Microsoft Teams: Enhancements to channel agents
description: Each channel can have a dedicated agent that draws on the channel’s knowledge to act as a domain expert for the team. New enhancements enable the agent to use files from the channel’s SharePoint when responding to queries, create ad hoc status reports configured through natural language, and generate new workback plans that can be added to Planner. In addition, new controls in Teams Admin Center allow admins to disable automatic agent creation.
ai_summary: Teams now allows each channel to have a dedicated agent that can use SharePoint files and create reports. Admins can control automatic agent creation through the Teams Admin Center, affecting Teams users and admins.

title: SharePoint: M365 Agent Access Insights for SharePoint and OneDrive sites
description: Rich insights on agents accessing content in SharePoint and OneDrive sites as part of SharePoint Advanced Management controls.
ai_summary: SharePoint and OneDrive now provide insights on agents accessing content, as part of SharePoint Advanced Management controls. This impacts admins managing these sites.

title: Microsoft Purview: Data Loss Prevention OCR Cost Estimator Support for MAC Endpoints
description: OCR Cost Estimator allows you to estimate the potential cost for using Optical Character Recognition. This means that you will no longer be required to set up an Azure Subscription for billing first and can accurately estimate the cost you would have incurred while using OCR. This will help you to identify the optimal configuration settings for OCR as per your requirements. Cost Estimator can be used for 30 days and will not scan images for sensitive content.
ai_summary: The Data Loss Prevention OCR Cost Estimator now supports MAC endpoints, allowing users to estimate OCR costs without needing an Azure Subscription. This impacts admins managing OCR settings.

title: Microsoft Teams: Select multiple messages to forward
description: You can now select up to five messages from a chat or channel and forward them together in one message—preserving both context and order.
ai_summary: Users can now select and forward up to five messages in Teams, maintaining context and order in the forwarded message.

title: Microsoft Teams: New Policy Setting to Require Explicit Consent for Recording and Transcription in Teams 1:1 Calls
description: We're expanding the capability to require explicit consent for recording and transcription to include 1:1 calls in Microsoft Teams. A new setting in the Teams Calling policy allows admins to enforce this requirement before recording or transcription can begin. When a user with the policy initiates recording, transcription, or both in a 1:1 call, the other participant is automatically muted, with their camera and content sharing turned off. The participant will see a prompt asking whether they consent to be included in the recording and transcription.
ai_summary: Microsoft Teams will require explicit consent for recording and transcription in 1:1 calls. Admins can enforce this policy, affecting all users who initiate such recordings.

title: Microsoft Teams: Migration Tool for Teams
description: Customers will now be able to migrate content seamlessly from Slack public and private channels to Teams shared, public, and private channels. A new first-party migration tool in the Microsoft Admin Center (MAC) will allow admins to review which Slack channels they wish to migrate, then perform content migration to Teams.
ai_summary: A new migration tool in the Microsoft Admin Center will allow admins to migrate content from Slack to Teams channels. This affects organizations transitioning to Teams.

title: Microsoft Teams: Troubleshoot meetings and calls with automatic issue identification and recommendations
description: Administrators can troubleshoot Teams meetings and calls in Teams admin center with ease with a streamlined flow, meeting quality issues, and detailed telemetry.
ai_summary: Admins can now troubleshoot Teams meetings and calls more easily with automatic issue identification and recommendations in the Teams admin center. This impacts IT administrators.

title: Microsoft Teams: Automatic removal of EXIF data from shared images
description: Teams will automatically remove hidden metadata (EXIF) from images shared in conversations. This privacy protection helps prevent sensitive information such as photo location and device details from being shared without your knowledge.
ai_summary: Teams will automatically remove EXIF data from shared images to enhance privacy. This change affects all users sharing images in Teams conversations.

title: Excel: Formula completion with Copilot in Excel
description: This feature leverages AI to autocomplete the user's formula upon typing the '=' sign. It provides context-based suggestions, streamlining the formula creation process by offering intelligent and relevant completions.
ai_summary: Excel will use AI to autocomplete formulas when users type the '=' sign, providing context-based suggestions. This feature affects all Excel users.

title: Microsoft Teams: Update user labels to show familiarity with external users
description: Trust Indicators are visual badges next to external users in Microsoft Teams that show a person’s trust level. They help you quickly see if someone is internal, external, a guest, or anonymous. This lets you collaborate confidently with users from external organizations and avoid sharing sensitive information with the wrong audience.
ai_summary: Microsoft Teams will display Trust Indicators next to external users, indicating their trust level to help users identify internal and external participants.

title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Copilot Search Helps You Discover People
description: Now Copilot Search can return matching people for your broader people search queries. Allowing you to discover, disambiguate, and explore known and new people to contact. Discover Whether you're looking for people with a specific skill like "Project leadership" or "Artificial Intelligence" Copilot Search can help you explore potential contacts through the People data source. Disambiguate When there are multiple people matching in exact name, email, or alias Copilot Search will help you disambiguate through a new carousel on the main results page alongside other relevant results.
ai_summary: Copilot Search in Microsoft 365 can now return people based on broader search queries, helping users discover and differentiate contacts more easily.

title: Microsoft Entra: App Deactivation
description: Admins or app owners can now safely pause an app’s access to Entra protected resources without deleting it or disrupting configuration. When deactivated, the app and its service principals globally (across tenants) can’t request new tokens and user sign ins are blocked, while existing tokens simply expire on their normal schedule. This makes it easy for admins to temporarily freeze suspicious or unused apps during investigations, bulk cleanup, or tenant hygiene work. This capability is now available in the Entra admin center (App registrations, Enterprise apps) and Microsoft Graph API.
ai_summary: Admins can now deactivate apps in Microsoft Entra without deleting them, blocking new token requests and user sign-ins. This impacts app owners and admins managing app access.

title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Word Agent
description: Word Agent helps you handle research, structure, and formatting so you can stay focused on your ideas. Use multi‑turn chat to refine your draft or open it in Word for full editing and collaboration. It’s designed for long‑form, information‑dense work—like strategic plans, policy documents, and technical papers—making it easier to turn complex material into clear, well‑written content. Available to Microsoft 365 users with or without a Microsoft 365 Copilot license.
ai_summary: Word Agent in Microsoft 365 helps users with research and formatting in Word, allowing for multi-turn chat to refine drafts. This affects all Microsoft 365 users.

title: Microsoft Purview compliance portal: eDiscovery - Generate keyword query language from natural language prompt in eDiscovery with Copilot for Security
description: Copilot for Security is embedded in eDiscovery to enable users to provide a search prompt in natural language and will translate into keyword query language to help expedite the start of an eDiscovery search.
ai_summary: Copilot for Security in the Microsoft Purview compliance portal will translate natural language prompts into keyword queries for eDiscovery. This affects users involved in compliance and eDiscovery.

title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Voice chats can reference Memory
description: While users are in M365 Copilot voice chat, Copilot can respond using existing memories already stored in user personalization settings. Users cannot modify/edit their memories from voice chats yet due to privacy considerations. All memories that can be used for Copilot responses in voice chat are visible and manageable by users in their Personalization settings.
ai_summary: In Copilot voice chats, users can receive responses based on their stored memories, though they cannot edit these memories during chats. This impacts users utilizing voice chat features.

title: Microsoft Teams: New SlimCore-based optimization for Microsoft Teams in VDI - support for Windows endpoints on Omnissa environments
description: This feature allows Windows endpoints to optimize Microsoft Teams in VDI environments with the new SlimCore-based media engine, providing an expanded feature set and multiple improvements in quality, reliability and performance.
ai_summary: Microsoft Teams will optimize performance in VDI environments for Windows endpoints using a new media engine, enhancing quality and reliability. This affects users in VDI setups.

title: Outlook: Play a Sound Rule
description: Users can set up Outlook rules to play a sound or show a desktop alert whenever an email that matches your chosen conditions arrives, whether it’s from a specific person, includes certain words, or meets any other rule criteria you define. These features help you stay alerted to the emails that matter most. #newoutlookforwindows
ai_summary: Outlook will allow users to set rules that play a sound or show alerts for specific incoming emails, helping them stay informed. This feature impacts users managing their email notifications.

title: Outlook: Rule to display desktop alert
description: Create rules that trigger a desktop alert when specific emails arrive. This makes it easier to stay on top of important messages without missing a beat. Look for the new "Display a Desktop Alert" action when setting up or editing your rules. #newoutlookforwindows
ai_summary: Users can create rules in Outlook to trigger desktop alerts for specific emails, enhancing their ability to monitor important messages. This change affects all Outlook users.

title: Microsoft Teams: Live meetings indicator for channels
description: Introducing a new indicator in channels to help users find meetings occurring live within the channel and join them.
ai_summary: Teams will introduce a live meetings indicator in channels, helping users identify and join ongoing meetings easily. This change affects all Teams users.

title: Microsoft Teams: New controls for quick views in the chat list
description: Positioned at the top of the chat and channels list, quick views give users fast access to mentions, followed threads, and more. Users can choose when and how quick views are displayed – selecting “always show,” “always hide,” or “show only when unread” – and can collapse the section at any time.
ai_summary: Microsoft Teams adds new quick view controls at the top of the chat list for easy access to mentions and followed threads, with customizable display options.

title: Microsoft Teams: Choose Your Enter Key Behavior in Teams Chat
description: Microsoft Teams now gives you control over how the Enter key works when composing messages. You can choose whether pressing Enter sends your message or starts a new line—making it easier to write longer messages without accidental sends.
ai_summary: Teams now allows users to choose how the Enter key functions when composing messages, either sending or starting a new line.

title: Microsoft Teams: Image viewer improvements enable scrolling and jumping to original message
description: Lightbox enhancements let users scroll through all previously shared images in a conversation, provide a clearer visual focus on the image being viewed, and add a header option that jumps directly to the original message where the image was posted.
ai_summary: Teams is improving the image viewer to allow users to scroll through shared images and jump to the original message. This change affects all Teams users.

title: Exchange: Exchange Online Moderation approval requests via Actionable Messages
description: The Exchange Online Moderation feature gives message moderators the ability to Approve or Reject sending a moderated message to its intended recipients via a special email message form that includes Approve and Reject buttons in the Outlook Desktop or Outlook on the web toolbar. However, the ability to approve or reject a moderated message currently isn't supported on Outlook for iOS, Outlook for Android, or Outlook for Mac. With this update to use Actionable Messages for moderation approval messages, moderators with mailboxes hosted in Exchange Online will now be able to approve or reject moderated messages via all the Microsoft email clients: from Outlook for Windows, Outlook for Mac, Outlook for iOS and Outlook for Android.
ai_summary: Exchange Online Moderation now supports Actionable Messages, allowing moderators to approve or reject messages directly from Outlook. This update does not apply to mobile or Mac versions.

title: Microsoft Teams: Activity in other accounts and organizations
description: Users can view and respond to activity across multiple tenants without switching accounts. You can triage notifications, reply to chats, and pin tenants to the left rail for quick access.
ai_summary: Users can now view and respond to notifications across multiple Teams accounts without switching. This feature enhances workflow for users managing multiple tenants.

title: Microsoft Teams: Channel Agent Updates
description: Updates include dynamic, channel‑aware welcome messages, greater flexibility in channel creation (with or without an agent), expanded agent permissions for member management, scheduling enhancements, and overall quality improvements.
ai_summary: Microsoft Teams will have updates for channel agents, including new welcome messages, flexible channel creation, and improved member management. This affects Teams users and administrators managing channel settings.

title: Microsoft Teams: Meeting Notes now available for instant meetings
description: Teams meeting Notes, powered by Loop, are now available for instant meetings that started via ‘Meet now’ from the calendar. Notes are Loop components in Teams meetings and chats that allow end users to co-create and collaborate on their meeting agenda, notes, and action items that can be co-authored and edited by everyone. Since Notes are Loop components, they stay in sync across all the places they have been shared. Once added, meeting notes can also be shared and edited in the Loop app in your web browser.
ai_summary: Teams meeting Notes, powered by Loop, are now available for instant meetings, allowing collaborative note-taking. This feature affects all users participating in Teams meetings.

title: Microsoft Teams: Spoken language detection is now automatic
description: Spoken language detection is now fully automatic. Teams will automatically detect each speaker’s spoken language and update it in real time as the conversation evolves. Manual spoken language selection will no longer be available. This applies to both live captions and transcripts when Interpreter is enabled or when multilingual speech recognition is turned on in meeting options, helping deliver more accurate language recognition and a more consistent multilingual meeting experience.
ai_summary: Microsoft Teams will automatically detect spoken languages during meetings, removing the need for manual selection. This change affects all Teams users utilizing live captions and transcripts.

title: Outlook: Draft emails using saved email snippets with Quick Parts for Outlook for Windows and web
description: Drafting emails is faster and easier with Quick Parts, now available for Outlook for Windows and web. Quick Parts are saved email snippets that can be reused when composing new messages, making it easy to assemble messages with reusable parts. #newoutlookforwindows
ai_summary: Outlook for Windows and web now supports Quick Parts, allowing users to save and reuse email snippets for faster message drafting. This feature benefits all Outlook users.

title: Outlook: Insert Graphic
description: When composing a message in the new Outlook for Windows and Outlook on the web, there will be a new Graphics button under the Insert ribbon tab. This opens a panel that will allow users to search and pick from a large selection of emoji, stock photos, and stickers, which are inserted into the message when selected. #newoutlookforwindows
ai_summary: A new Graphics button in Outlook for Windows and web will allow users to insert emojis, stock photos, and stickers into messages. This change affects all users composing messages.

title: Microsoft Teams: Attendee capacity packs for Teams events
description: Attendee capacity packs provide increased capacity limits for Teams events. Organizers can scale event attendance beyond base limits while maintaining a consistent Teams events experience.
ai_summary: Microsoft Teams will offer attendee capacity packs, enabling event organizers to increase attendance limits for Teams events. This change impacts event organizers.

title: Microsoft Teams: Streamlined Microsoft 365 Certified App Management in Teams Admin Center
description: This feature allows Microsoft 365 administrators to enable Microsoft 365 certified SaaS applications within their tenant through org-wide settings for third-party apps. Admins can choose to allow a subset of applications that have already been verified against industry security and compliance standards. This ensures organizations can confidently adopt apps while maintaining governance and reducing approval overhead.
ai_summary: Microsoft Teams will streamline the management of Microsoft 365 certified apps through the Teams Admin Center, allowing admins to enable verified third-party applications. This change affects Microsoft 365 administrators.

title: Microsoft Teams: Backup RTMP Support for Teams town halls
description: Teams town halls will soon provide support for a backup RTMP stream to keep a live broadcast running in the event of an interruption with the main stream.
ai_summary: Teams town halls will support a backup RTMP stream to maintain live broadcasts during interruptions. This change affects users hosting town hall events in Teams.

title: Planner: Task chat and mentions in basic plans
description: Task chat lets team members collaborate directly on tasks using rich text, formatting, and mentions - making it easier to discuss work and notify teammates on what needs attention. Updated April 23, 2026: We are still rolling out this feature. We apologize for any inconvenience.
ai_summary: Planner will introduce task chat and mentions in basic plans, enabling team members to collaborate directly on tasks. This change affects users who manage tasks within Planner.
