title: Microsoft Teams: Private channels increased limits and transition to group compliance
description: We are updating private channels to use a shared mailbox, similar to shared channels, instead of messages being stored in each user's mailbox. With this change, compliance policies set for the team's Microsoft 365 group will apply to private channels messages going forward. In addition, teams will support more than 30 private channels, up to the 1000 total channel limit for the team. Private channel member limits will increase from 250 to 5000. You will also be able to schedule meetings in private channels.
ai_summary: Private channels in Teams will transition to using a shared mailbox, increasing member limits and applying compliance policies. This affects Teams administrators and users managing private channels.

title: Outlook: Triage your inbox on-the-go with Copilot voice for Outlook mobile
description: Stay on top of your inbox with the new Copilot voice experience in the Outlook mobile app. Ask Copilot to summarize your recent unread emails and then take action like flagging, pinning, archiving, or marking as read – all without the hassle of navigating your inbox by hand. You can interrupt or redirect Copilot at any point in the conversation.
ai_summary: The Outlook mobile app will feature a Copilot voice experience to help users manage their inbox by summarizing unread emails and allowing actions like flagging or archiving. This change affects users of the Outlook mobile app.

title: Microsoft Teams: Consecutive interpretation in Interpreter
description: Consecutive interpretation enables turn-based interpretation for everyone in the meeting. Interpretation happens after each speaker finishes talking, creating a turn-based flow that supports interactive discussions across two languages.
ai_summary: Microsoft Teams will introduce consecutive interpretation, allowing turn-based interpretation during meetings for better interaction across languages. This change affects all Teams users participating in multilingual meetings.

title: Outlook: Draft, edit and format emails conversationally with Copilot in Outlook
description: In Outlook, Copilot now works side by side with users to draft, refine, and format emails conversationally, powered by the same agentic capabilities available in Word, Excel, and PowerPoint.
ai_summary: Outlook will enable users to draft, edit, and format emails conversationally with Copilot, enhancing email composition. This change affects Outlook users.

title: Microsoft Teams: Improved keyboard navigation and default line numbers in code blocks
description: Navigate code blocks more easily with improved keyboard controls and default line numbers. Set code language quickly and reference specific lines for improved collaboration and workflow.
ai_summary: Microsoft Teams will have improved keyboard navigation and default line numbers in code blocks, making it easier for users to collaborate on code. This change affects all Teams users working with code blocks.

title: Microsoft Teams: Miracast support for Teams Rooms on Windows devices
description: In addition to Teams Cast and HDMI ingest; you are able to share wirelessly using Miracast with Teams Rooms on Windows devices including touch boards. Available in Teams Rooms Pro.
ai_summary: Teams Rooms on Windows devices will support Miracast for wireless sharing, in addition to existing HDMI options.

title: Microsoft 365 admin center: Organizational Messages now supports Email messages
description: Organizational Messages now includes Email as a delivery channel, expanding beyond existing surfaces such as the Windows Taskbar, Windows Notifications, Windows Spotlight, and Teams Popovers.
ai_summary: Organizational Messages in the Microsoft 365 admin center now supports Email as a delivery channel, expanding communication options for admins. This affects how messages are delivered to users.

title: Microsoft Teams: Brand Impersonation Protection for Teams Calling
description: Identify if an external user is impersonating a brand commonly targeted by phishing attacks, during their initial contact with an enterprise user via Teams calling.
ai_summary: Teams calling will now include brand impersonation protection to identify potential phishing attempts from external users. This feature impacts enterprise users receiving calls via Teams.

title: Microsoft Teams: Enhanced issue detection in Teams Rooms on Windows and auto-remediation with Teams Rooms Pro Management.
description: Teams Rooms on Windows proactively monitors room audio, video, and display signals to detect issues in meeting spaces. Teams Rooms Pro Management automatically remediates common issues that can be resolved through software, configuration changes, or device resets during nightly maintenance. This ensures users have reliable, ready-to-use meeting rooms, while IT admins benefit from reduced manual troubleshooting and increased uptime. Available for Teams Rooms Pro-licensed rooms.
ai_summary: Teams Rooms on Windows will improve issue detection and auto-remediation for meeting spaces. This change benefits IT admins by reducing troubleshooting efforts and ensuring room readiness.

title: Microsoft Teams: Identify bots joining your Teams meetings
description: During Teams meetings, if there is an external 3P bot trying to join the meeting, organizers will be able to see a clear representation of the bots while they wait in the lobby. Organizers will be required to explicitly and separately admit these bots into the meeting, if really required. This approach will ensure that no one inadvertently accepts the external bots into the meeting ensuring that the organizers have full control over the presence of these bots.
ai_summary: Microsoft Teams will allow organizers to see and control external bots trying to join meetings, enhancing meeting security for organizers.

title: Outlook: Instantly Find Rules, Quick Steps, and More by Name
description: Managing your email automation in Outlook is now effortless with name search built into your key productivity tools. You can search within Rules, Conditional Formatting, Quick Steps, and Search Folders, filtering the list by name so you jump straight to the item you need. Whether you have dozens of rules or a growing library of quick steps, just type a few characters to narrow down results instantly. No more scrolling through long lists to find the right one, search puts you in control. Stay organized and make changes faster, right where you need them. #newoutlookforwindows
ai_summary: Outlook introduces a name search feature for managing email automation tools like Rules and Quick Steps, making it easier to find items. This change affects all Outlook users.

title: Microsoft Teams: Book future meetings directly from Teams panels
description: You can now make an upcoming meeting reservation from a Teams panel by browsing the calendar on the device and choosing any open time slot through midnight the next day. Add a guest during booking streamlining ad-hoc scheduling and coordination. Available with Teams Rooms Pro and Shared Device licenses.
ai_summary: Teams panels now allow users to book future meetings directly by selecting available time slots from the calendar. This feature is available for Teams Rooms Pro and Shared Device licenses.

title: SharePoint: Chat one-on-one with SharePoint agents in Teams
description: Users can chat one-on-one with a SharePoint agent directly within Teams chat.
ai_summary: Users can now chat one-on-one with SharePoint agents directly within Teams chat, enhancing support and communication.

title: Microsoft Teams: Sharing recap access
description: Recording and transcript owners can now grant recording and transcript access to specified people when copying or sharing recap link, and the specified people can access the recap without having to request access.
ai_summary: In Microsoft Teams, recording and transcript owners can grant access to specific people for recap links without requests. This change affects users who share recordings and transcripts.

title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Start writing, coding, and creating with Copilot in Pages
description: Use the tools menu in Copilot Chat to co-create content or code with Copilot in a Page and share with others when ready.
ai_summary: Microsoft Copilot will enable users to co-create content or code in Pages using the tools menu. This affects users working with Copilot in document creation.

title: Microsoft Teams: Minimized meeting window enhancements
description: We're improving the experience when the active meeting window is minimized. Users can now raise their hand and send reactions without restoring the full meeting window. They can also choose between two minimized views: an expanded view that shows up to 4 participant videos, or a compact view that does not display other participants' video.
ai_summary: Teams will enhance the minimized meeting window experience, allowing users to raise hands and send reactions without restoring the full window. This affects all Teams users during meetings.

title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Create a presentation with Copilot in PowerPoint directly from the PowerPoint Home
description: You can now create a presentation with Copilot in PowerPoint straight from the PowerPoint Home in file menu.
ai_summary: Users can create presentations directly from the PowerPoint Home using Copilot. This change affects all PowerPoint users.

title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Create a presentation with Copilot in PowerPoint directly from the PowerPoint Home
description: You can now create a presentation with Copilot in PowerPoint straight from the PowerPoint Home in file menu.
ai_summary: PowerPoint will allow users to create presentations directly from the Home menu using Copilot. This feature affects users who create presentations in PowerPoint.

title: Microsoft Teams: Quick Share for Images
description: Microsoft Teams extends Quick Share to images, making it fast and easy to share visual content across chats and channels. With access from hover, right click, overflow menus, and shared tabs, you can quickly copy links or share images while preserving existing permissions.
ai_summary: Microsoft Teams is adding Quick Share for images, allowing users to easily share visual content in chats and channels. This change affects all Teams users sharing images.

title: Microsoft Teams: Search in quick sharing experience
description: Microsoft Teams makes it easier to find and attach files by enabling search directly within the quick sharing experience. You can now locate cloud based files while attaching content, reducing friction when sharing files across chats and channels.
ai_summary: Microsoft Teams is enabling search within the quick sharing experience, allowing users to find and attach cloud files more easily. This affects all Teams users sharing files.

title: Microsoft Purview: Endpoint Data Loss Prevention - Enforce DLP protection upon new content before its saved
description: Monitor or protect file with unsaved sensitive content from being printed or being moved to USB or network share.
ai_summary: Microsoft Purview will enforce DLP protection on unsaved sensitive content, preventing it from being printed or moved. This impacts users handling sensitive information.

title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Updated chat-first design in the Microsoft 365 Copilot mobile app
description: We are introducing a refreshed chat-first design in the Microsoft 365 Copilot mobile app, bringing a cleaner, more intuitive interface to users. This update includes a modernized design language, streamlined navigation, and other improvements that make it easier and faster for users to start, continue, and manage chats on the mobile app.
ai_summary: The Microsoft 365 Copilot mobile app will receive a chat-first design update, improving user interface and navigation. This affects all mobile app users.

title: Microsoft Teams: Upload custom backgrounds for Teams events
description: Organizers and presenters who have access to production tools can now upload custom backgrounds in the "Manage what attendees see" experience for Teams events. This enhancement allows organizations to display their brand identity by replacing the default backgrounds with their own images, such as company logos, event-specific artwork, or themed visuals. Custom backgrounds appear behind presenters and content, giving attendees a polished viewing experience. This feature is available for Teams events organizers with a Teams Premium license. This feature is available on Teams for Windows desktop and Mac desktop.

title: Microsoft Teams: BYOD space peripheral health signals and reports in the Pro Management portal
description: Admins can proactively manage peripherals in bring your own device (BYOD) rooms and desks with reports in the Pro Management portal that now flag if devices are faulty, undetectable by a PC, missing, or moved. Reports in the Pro Management portal require a Teams Shared Devices license for the room, and reports for desks are in public preview.
ai_summary: Teams admins can now manage BYOD peripherals with new health reports in the Pro Management portal, flagging issues like faults or missing devices. A Teams Shared Devices license is required for room reports.

title: Outlook: Copilot in File Previewer for iOS
description: Access Copilot directly when previewing files in Outlook. Tap the Copilot button to get smart suggestions, summaries, and answers about your documents without leaving the previewer. Get quick help understanding attachments and files right when you need it.
ai_summary: Outlook will allow users to access Copilot directly while previewing files, providing smart suggestions and summaries. This change affects users who preview documents in Outlook.

title: Microsoft Viva: Viva Glint and Viva Insights Integration - Exclusion List for data sharing
description: Viva Glint admins will be able to manage an exclusion list in Viva Feature Access Management that prevents selected people and groups from being included in Viva Insights data shared with Viva Glint. This simplifies configuration and helps organizations apply consistent, privacy-conscious controls for the integration.
ai_summary: Viva Glint admins can now manage an exclusion list to prevent certain individuals from being included in data shared with Viva Insights, enhancing privacy controls. This affects Viva Glint administrators.

title: Outlook: ICS Preview experience
description: Users can now seamlessly import calendar events from ICS files & preview them before importing in three cases: when dragging ICS files directly into the calendar surface, uploading an ICS file ('Add calendar' flow) ICS file via email #newoutlookforwindows.
ai_summary: Outlook users can now import calendar events from ICS files and preview them before finalizing the import. This change affects users managing calendar events in Outlook.

title: Outlook: Multiselect in the New Outlook and Teams calendars
description: You can now select multiple appointments and meetings in the new Outlook for Windows and Teams calendars. Use Ctrl+click to select individual items, or Shift+click to quickly select a range events. Once selected, you can take common actions across all selected items. Click anywhere outside the selection to clear it. #newoutlookforwindows
ai_summary: The new Outlook for Windows and Teams calendars will allow users to select multiple appointments and meetings for bulk actions. This affects users managing calendars in these apps.

title: Microsoft Teams: Assign Open Shifts
description: Auto Assign Open Shifts is a Microsoft Teams Shifts feature that automatically fills unassigned (open) shifts for you. It lets managers automatically assign open shifts to available employees instead of doing it manually. The system considers factors like employee availability, approved time off, past scheduling patterns, and scheduling rules (e.g., max hours, rest time); and generates a draft schedule that you can review and adjust before publishing.

title: Microsoft Teams: Front-of-Room view control for Webinars & Structured Meetings in Teams Rooms on Android
description: When a Teams Rooms on Android is invited as a meeting presenter, the front-of-room display defaults to the attendee view. Presenters always have full control from the console, including green room and off-stage management, and can switch the front-of-room display to presenter view without impacting attendees.
ai_summary: Teams Rooms on Android will allow presenters to control the front-of-room display during webinars, enhancing presentation management. This change affects presenters in Teams meetings.

title: Microsoft Teams: Building level insights on the Pro Management portal recommended actions page
description: IT gets new building level insights on the recommended actions page in the Teams Rooms Pro Management portal.  This feature intelligently identifies buildings with high Teams Rooms utilization to help IT prioritize upgrades of bring your own device (BYOD) meeting spaces and ensure consistent, high-quality user experiences throughout their office buildings.  Available with a Teams Rooms Pro or Shared Space license.
ai_summary: Microsoft Teams will provide building level insights in the Pro Management portal to help IT prioritize upgrades for BYOD meeting spaces. This change affects IT administrators managing Teams Rooms Pro or Shared Space licenses.

title: Microsoft Teams: Attend Microsoft webinars and structured meetings from Teams Rooms on Android
description: You can join a Microsoft webinar and structured meeting from a Teams Room on Android and interact seamlessly during the event. Available for Teams Rooms Pro.
ai_summary: Teams Rooms on Android can now join Microsoft webinars and structured meetings, allowing interaction during events. This change affects users of Teams Rooms Pro.

title: Access: Design Access forms and reports without 22-inch size constraints
description: With the removal of the 22-inch limit, your apps can now take full advantage of today’s larger monitors. You can display more data, create flexible layouts, and deliver a better experience on wide and high-resolution screens.

title: Microsoft Teams: Scoped Search for SharePoint app in Teams (Viva Connections)
description: With this feature, users accessing search through the Teams search icon while within the SharePoint app in Teams (Viva Connections) will be able to receive search result scoped to SharePoint global search. Hitting enter on the search query will then open the SharePoint search page.

title: Microsoft Teams: Microsoft Teams: Secure Reliable Transport (SRT) Support for Teams town halls
description: Microsoft Teams will soon support Secure Reliable Transport (SRT) streaming in Teams town halls. SRT is a network protocol designed to deliver high-quality, low-latency video across the public internet.
ai_summary: Microsoft Teams will support Secure Reliable Transport (SRT) for streaming in town halls, improving video quality over the internet. This change affects users participating in Teams town halls.

title: Microsoft Teams: Improved request flows for apps and agents blocked by admins
description: We are improving how users request access to apps and agents blocked by admins in Teams by introducing a clear, guided, and end-to-end request experience. This work reduces end-user friction by driving clarity into the request process and notifying users when there's been an update to their request. In addition to enhancements in Teams, we've also improved the admin experience in Teams Admin Center, to simplify the process for admins to review requests and take action. Additionally, we're introducing a new capability to increase admin awareness of new requests, ensuring that user requests don't get stalled.

title: Microsoft Teams: Recently used emojis sync across devices
description: Recently used emojis and reactions sync across Teams on desktop and mobile, making it easier to express yourself wherever you work.
ai_summary: Microsoft Teams will sync recently used emojis and reactions across desktop and mobile devices, improving user expression. This change affects all Teams users.

title: Outlook: Variable number of message preview lines
description: Outlook for Windows and Outlook for Web will now allow users to modify how the preview text for emails show in the message list. The preview text can now take up 2 lines, 1 whole line, or 0 additional lines.

title: Microsoft Purview compliance portal: Endpoint Data Loss Prevention-Endpoint DLP support classification of Azure RMS protected Office documents
description: Endpoint DLP can now classify Office files stored in Windows devices that have Azure RMS protection applied.  Classification will be triggered when file is used in applications or when just-in-time classification is enabled.
ai_summary: Endpoint Data Loss Prevention (DLP) will now classify Azure RMS protected Office documents on Windows devices, enhancing data protection. This affects IT administrators managing DLP policies.

title: Microsoft Viva: New Post Creation Experience in Viva Enage
description: In Viva Engage, we've simplified how to create posts. The new post creation experience makes it easier and faster to share in Viva Engage with a cleaner, more intuitive publishing experience. It brings clearer layout, better accessibility, and smarter organization of tools—so you can focus on creating great posts without extra clicks or clutter.

title: Microsoft Teams: Breakout rooms up to 1,000 Attendees in Teams meetings
description: Organizers can now use breakout rooms in Teams meetings with up to 1,000 attendees, enabling more interactive sessions, smaller group discussions, and improved audience engagement without compromising scale or performance.
ai_summary: Microsoft Teams now supports breakout rooms for up to 1,000 attendees in meetings, facilitating larger group discussions and engagement. This change impacts meeting organizers and participants.

title: Microsoft Teams: Meeting toolbar redesigned
description: You can now customize the meeting toolbar by pinning, unpinning, and reordering controls to match how you work. Raise Hand is grouped under Reactions to reduce mis-clicks, and Leave is clearly separated on the right. It may feel different at first, but it’s designed to be faster and easier to use.
ai_summary: The meeting toolbar in Microsoft Teams has been redesigned for customization, improving user experience during meetings. This change affects all Teams users.

title: Microsoft Teams: Join Google Meet meetings in Teams Rooms on Windows
description: Organizations now have expanded meeting interoperability with two-way Direct Guest Join (DGJ) between Google Meet and Teams meetings.  Teams Rooms on Windows devices can join Google Meet meetings, and Google Meet devices can join Teams meetings. Users can join with one click through the calendar or by meeting ID. This capability is now available for both Commercial (Feb 2026) and Government cloud environments.

title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Updated Copilot Answers
description: Copilot Answers in Copilot Search (in the M365 Copilot App on web and desktop) will provide more concise responses and more prominently highlight the ability to continue in the conversation in Copilot chat on the right-hand sidebar.

title: Microsoft Teams: View and manage auto attendant shared voicemails directly in the Queues app
description: Calls to an Auto Attendant that are routed to voicemail will now appear directly within Queues app. This enables organizations to manage shared Auto Attendant voicemails in a centralized experience, making it easier for teams to track, triage, and respond to customer messages.

title: Microsoft Teams: Enhanced delegated calling with delegate call access restrictions and join notifications
description: Call delegation in Teams now includes new controls that give delegators greater privacy and control during active calls. Delegators can lock an ongoing call to prevent delegates from joining or resuming the call and can optionally enable warning tones that notify participants when a delegate joins or resumes a call.

title: Microsoft Teams: Unblock users to send message while file is uploading in the background
description: Large file sharing in Teams today introduces blocking behavior, forcing users to wait for uploads to complete and disrupting real-time collaboration. To improve productivity and reduce perceived latency, we are introducing asynchronous file uploads. This allows users to continue sending messages while the file uploads in the background, enabling a more seamless and uninterrupted collaboration experience.
ai_summary: Microsoft Teams is introducing asynchronous file uploads, allowing users to send messages while files are uploading in the background. This change improves collaboration for all Teams users sharing large files.

title: Microsoft Defender for Office 365: Localized Default Mark and Notify Email Template
description: Enabling localization for the default Mark and Notify email template used in admin review and automation flows for user reported messages. This ensures end users receive review outcome notifications in their preferred language, improving understanding, trust, and participation in email reporting within Microsoft Defender for Office 365.
ai_summary: Localized default email templates for Mark and Notify in Microsoft Defender for Office 365 will improve user notifications in their preferred language. This affects end users reporting messages.

title: Microsoft Teams: External presenters can access production controls for Teams events
description: Organizations can allow external presenters to manage Teams events by granting them access to production controls. Federated (B2B) and guest users can be specified in the "Who has control of production tools" setting, enabling trusted external presenters to run events and manage what attendees see. This feature supports organizations that work with third-party event producers and vendors.

title: Microsoft Teams: Entra passwordless resource account support for Teams Rooms on Windows and Android devices
description: Teams rooms on Windows and Android, Panels and Teams Phones now supports Entra Resource Accounts for secure, passwordless sign-in that separates device and user identities. IT admins can migrate to Entra accounts easily with the migration wizard, and track progress using a dashboard in the Pro Management portal.

title: Microsoft Teams: Enhanced live captions settings and right-side panel view
description:
We are improving the live captions experience in Microsoft Teams with new viewing layouts and streamlined configuration options. Users can now view live captions in a new right-side panel, in addition to the existing options of viewing them at the top or bottom of the screen, or popping them out into a separate window.
We are also making it easier to manage caption settings directly within the meeting. By clicking the existing gear icon in the live captions pane, users will see a consolidated menu to quickly configure spoken language, caption styles, and profanity filters without navigating to separate settings panels. Additionally, this menu includes a new toggle to turn on live captions by default for all meetings, as well as a new thumbs-up/thumbs-down feedback mechanism to easily share input on the captioning experience.

title: Microsoft Teams: Multilingual recap available with translation button
description: After meeting recap is automatically generated in the translation language chosen during the meeting, users can continue to change the language of the meeting recap after its generated.

title: Microsoft Teams: Expand presenter visibility in 'Manage what attendees see' for Teams events
description: Users will now be able to resize and expand the presenter panel in 'Manage what attendees see' options for Teams events. This feature helps make it easier to view, manage, and switch between presenters during events.

title: Microsoft Teams: Specify who has control of production tools in Teams meetings and events
description: A new meeting option for Teams meetings with presenters and events that enables organizers to designate 'Who has control of production tools' during the event. Users defined here will have access to the controls in 'Manage What Attendees See' and the ‘Green Room'.

title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Support for MCP Agents with Interactive UI Widgets in Government Clouds
description: Feature description: Model Context Protocol (MCP) based agents in Microsoft 365 Copilot Chat will now be able to surface rich, interactive UI widgets directly within chat. This enhancement enables developers to deliver more engaging and structured agent interactions. Users will experience these widgets when interacting with agents that implement them, and admins will continue to manage these agents through the Microsoft 365 Admin Center.

title: Microsoft Teams: Emoji shortcuts with autocomplete on mobile
description: Teams brings desktop-style emoji shortcuts to mobile (iOS and Android), allowing you to insert emojis by typing colon-based commands like :smile:. Real-time autocomplete suggestions help you quickly find the right emoji as you type, while support for custom emojis enables more personalized and expressive communication on the go.

title: Microsoft Teams: Modernized Gallery view in Teams Rooms on Android
description: The updated Gallery view in Teams Rooms on Android prioritizes video on the meeting stage, arranges participants in consistent aspect ratios, and minimizes movement of participant tiles on stage. Users can hide the room self-preview video and choose to see audio and video participants equally on stage, instead of prioritizing video participants. Admins can choose the default behavior using local device settings and the Pro Management portal.

title: Microsoft Teams: Interpreter agent support in Teams Rooms on Android
description: The Interpreter agent acts as a translator in Microsoft Teams meetings, allowing participants to listen to the meeting in their chosen language with real-time translation so speaking different languages isn’t a barrier to effective understanding and collaboration. It's now available in Teams Rooms on Android licensed for Teams Rooms Pro.

title: OneNote: Copilot Notebook in OneNote on Mac
description: Copilot Notebook, an AI-powered workspace for a project or topic built on reference materials, is coming to OneNote on Mac. Bring together your work context behind a project in one place.

title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Intelligent Summaries in Copilot Dashboard
description: Use intelligent summaries in Copilot Dashboard to quickly surface what’s working and where targeted attention can accelerate Copilot adoption. Intelligent summaries highlight key adoption trends to focus on areas of success. Suggested prompts enable deeper exploration of underlying trends and drivers.
ai_summary: Intelligent summaries in the Copilot Dashboard will highlight adoption trends and areas for improvement. This change affects admins monitoring Copilot usage.

title: Outlook: Print calendar events in new Outlook and Teams
description: Users will now have basic options for printing calendar events in #newoutlookforwindows and Teams calendar, including choosing whether to show all attendees or display a shortened list of up to 10 attendees via a checkbox.

title: Microsoft Viva: Viva Glint - Copilot admin configuration assistance
description: A Copilot-powered conversational assistant embedded in the Viva Glint admin experience that answers configuration and how-to questions and provides step-by-step guidance. Responses will include deep links to configuration pages streamlining navigation and discoverability. Only available for Viva Glint users with Admin permissions.

title: Microsoft Teams: Unified Agent and App Installation Management Across Microsoft 365 and Teams Admin Center
description: Administrators using the Microsoft 365 admin center and Teams admin center will be able to apply app and agent installation changes once and have them consistently enforced across Teams, Outlook, and Microsoft 365 Copilot. Previously, installation changes made in the Microsoft 365 admin center only applied to Outlook and Microsoft 365, while changes made in the Teams admin center only applied to Teams. With this update, app and agent installation is unified across all supported surfaces, enabling a more consistent and streamlined admin experience.

title: Microsoft Teams: Intelligent call recaps in Queues app
description: Spend less time catching up on call recordings to resolve customer issues faster. For recorded call queue calls, the Queues app now supports intelligent call recaps for recorded calls that includes AI-generated summary notes, key discussion points, and follow-up actions. Navigate to the call record in the Queues app and select the Recap tab to access.

title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Power BI integration in M365 Copilot
description: This release enables M365 Copilot to reason over Power BI enterprise data and returns grounded answers directly from Power BI reports and semantic models. Users can ask natural‑language questions and receive accurate answers.

title: Microsoft Teams: PowerPoint Live Light theme support
description: Presenting PowerPoint slides in Teams just got better. PowerPoint Live now supports light mode, giving presenters the option to present in light, dark, classic, or high contrast mode based on their preferences and system settings.

title: Microsoft Teams: Block all identified external bots automatically from joining your meetings
description: Extending the admin controls provided for managing external AI bots and regulating their access to your meetings, we are adding the option to automatically block all identified bots.

title: Microsoft Teams: Mandatory pre-meeting consent
description: We are providing a new configuration experience in Teams Admin Center where tenant admins can enable and customize an explicit consent message before joining any meeting hosted in their organization.

title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Updates to Memory and Personalization in Microsoft 365 Copilot
description: Copilot now uses chat history to provide more relevant, contextual responses. Updated settings make it easier to view and manage what Copilot remembers and your personalization preferences.
ai_summary: Copilot will use chat history for more relevant responses, with updated settings for managing memory and personalization preferences.

title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Domain exclusion for web grounding
description: This feature will allow admins to specify a limited set of sites to exclude from web grounding in M365 Copilot and Copilot Chat #copilotcontrolsystem
ai_summary: Admins can exclude specific websites from web grounding in M365 Copilot and Copilot Chat. This feature impacts IT admins managing Copilot settings.

title: Microsoft Teams: Town hall media optimization for VDI attendees
description:
What’s new
Teams now supports audio and video offloading for Town hall attendees in VDI environments that are using the new optimization. Media streams are offloaded directly to the user’s local device, improving performance and delivering a high definition viewing experience while reducing virtual desktop resource usage.
Who it applies to
•	Windows endpoints only using the new VDI optimization
•	Supported VDI platforms:
o	Azure Virtual Desktop and Windows 365
o	Citrix
o	Omnissa
o	Amazon WorkSpaces
What stays the same
All attendee interactivity features remain supported, including captions, DVR, reactions, streaming chat, and Q&A.
Additional details
First party and third party eCDNs are supported. When enabled, the attendee’s endpoint establishes a direct peer to peer connection using the local device network, avoiding virtual desktop double hop traffic.
Action required
No action is required if the new optimization for Microsoft Teams is already enabled.

title: Microsoft Teams: Collect information with list form in Workflows
description: Starts a workflow with a form to collect the information you need to run the rest of your workflow.

title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Enhanced personalization with memory in Copilot
description: Microsoft 365 Copilot will improve memory in Copilot by increasing the relevance and quality of Copilot responses based on previous communications. This AI-powered capability improves the relevance and quality of Copilot responses by learning from previous communications. These memories are private to the user.

title: Planner: Planner Agent chat in Basic Plans
description: Introducing built-in Planner Agent chat with natural language Q&A, smart task discovery, and in-plan task management.

title: Microsoft Teams: Clearer text highlighting in dark mode and high contrast mode
description: We've improved how highlighted text looks when composing messages in dark mode and high contrast mode, giving you a more consistent editing experience.

title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): New Rich Answer Cards
description: Surface new model-driven, dynamically placed Answer Cards across top 7 segments: weather, sports, finance, images, video, places and news for Entra & MSA users across all surfaces.

title: Microsoft Excel: Extending support for Insights Services to GCC-H and DoD sovereign clouds
description: GCC-H and DoD sovereign cloud customers will be able to use features in Excel run by Insights Services, including Analyze Data found on the Data tab.

title: OneNote: Suggested Artifact Creation in Copilot Notebooks
description: Copilot Notebooks in OneNote now suggests artifacts to create, such as Word documents, Excel workbooks, and PowerPoint presentations, based on Microsoft 365 knowledge and the content in your notebook. Select the suggestion and Copilot will generate the artifact.

title: Microsoft Teams: Temporarily pause all notifications
description: Users can now temporarily pause all notifications to minimize interruptions and stay focused on important work, meetings, or other priorities, without changing their existing notification settings.

title: Microsoft Teams: Report a Security Concern in Meetings
description: Microsoft Teams will enable meeting organizers and attendees to report suspicious, malicious, or potentially fraudulent activity directly from meetings. Users can submit reports during or after a meeting, helping organizations identify potential threats such as impersonation, phishing, scams, and other suspicious behavior. Reports are integrated with Microsoft security and administrative workflows to support investigation, remediation, and ongoing improvements to security protections.

title: Microsoft Teams: Teams Admin Center - Single pane for monitoring & troubleshooting for meetings and calls across the organisation
description: Administrators can monitor meeting and call health across the organization, uncover recurring patterns, and proactively troubleshoot issues impacting users in both active and completed meetings and calls.

title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Ask Copilot about highlighted response content
description: Highlight a sentence, paragraph, or table from the response and ask Copilot to work only on that selection. Get focused explanations, concise summaries, quick translations, or next steps for the exact passage you’re reviewing—no more over broad answers. Your selection is previewed in the prompt so you can edit before you send. It’s a faster, more controlled way to get help right where you’re working.

title: Microsoft Viva: Viva Engage: New left navigation controls — collapse, resize, increased favorites cap, and reorder favorites capabilities
description: We're introducing a set of left-navigation improvements in Viva Engage on the web that give people more control over their navigation pane. These are additive, user-driven changes — users can collapse the left nav, resize its width, favorite up to 50 communities, and drag to reorder their favorited communities. None of these changes alter which destinations appear in the navigation. These enhancements are applicable to all surfaces that have the Engage left navigation menu - Web, and the Engage app in Teams and Outlook.

title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Planner capabilities in Copilot chat (M365 Copilot)
description: We will support creating Planner tasks and plans querying Planner information in M365 Copilot chat, allowing users to manage their tasks and plans between Copilot and Planner seamlessly.

title: Microsoft Purview: Permissions audit log improvements
description: Improving permission checks when users access the Microsoft Purview portal. Enhanced audit logs will provide clearer visibility into role and scoped-role access decisions, helping administrators troubleshoot access issues and monitor authorization outcomes.

title: Microsoft Teams: Language selection by users in Teams Rooms on Android
description: Users can now choose their preferred meeting language in Teams Rooms on Android. Select from up to 69 languages using the language button on the console. The room system must restart after a language is selected.

title: Microsoft Teams: Local PTZ for Microsoft Teams Rooms on Windows
description: Microsoft Teams Rooms on Windows will provide native Pan-Tilt-Zoom (PTZ) controls for connected cameras that support this capability, whether the camera moves a physical lens or adjusts the image digitally. Controls are available when Teams Rooms can confirm the camera isn't independently framing the room.

title: Dynamics 365 Field Service: Streamline mobile work with an optimized Subgrid control
description:
Business Value

With a Subgrid optimized for mobile, frontline workers will experience click reduction and faster field workflows. Enhancements to the Subgrid control include top‑level Add New and Use/Complete all action buttons, bulk‑add functionality, barcode scanning, and inline editing to speed record management on the go.

Feature Details

Field Service Mobile is improving the existing Service Task View, Service View, and Product View Subgrid controls to provide a faster, touch-first way for technicians to work with common Field Service scenarios such as Work Order Products, Services, and Service Tasks.

  • Users can add multiple records in fewer steps using bulk add mutli-select functionality.
  • Users can mark all records as complete/used in one go, saving repetitive, individual clicks per record.
  • Frequently used fields for Subgrid records can be edited inline, reducing the need to open the full record form for common updates.
  • Barcode scanning helps users quickly find and select products instead of scrolling through a long list.

This experience keeps frontline workers in context by returning them directly to the grid after save, reducing navigation, scrolling, and form transitions — allowing them stay focused on their customer work.

title: Microsoft Teams: Malicious URL Protection for Teams Chat and Channels for Gov clouds
description: Microsoft Teams can now detect and warn users on malicious URLs sent in Teams chat and channels in Gov clouds, increasing protection against malware attacks for Gov clouds customers.

title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Copilot Chat can now better match search results from Scanned PDFs
description:
Copilot Chat can now better match search results from Scanned PDFs on Copilot users' files they are working on — content that was previously difficult to search and find.

This feature will work for new/updated user's working files on a go-forward basis.

title: Microsoft Purview: Endpoint Data Loss Prevention - Protect sensitive data over FTP and SFTP with Endpoint DLP
description: Endpoint DLP support for FTP and SFTP enables organizations to monitor and protect sensitive data transferred from managed endpoints using FTP and SFTP, helping prevent unauthorized data exfiltration while maintaining visibility and control.

title: Outlook: Right-click to customize the classic ribbon
description: You can now customize the classic ribbon in New Outlook for Windows and Outlook on the Web by right-clicking the ribbon and choosing which commands and groups appear on the Home and View tabs. #newoutlookforwindows

title: Microsoft Teams: Granular channel notification controls
description: Microsoft Teams introduces flexible presets for channel notifications, allowing you to choose between All new messages, @mentions and replies, or Mute. You can further customize alerts for unfollowed threads, tags, and channel or team mentions, as well as control banner notifications for the channel. This added flexibility enables you to set notifications to match to your work style and reduce unnecessary distractions.

title: Outlook: Choose to Show Unread or Total Count for Each Folder
description: You can now pick whether each folder in your folder pane shows the unread count or the total item count. Until now, Outlook only displayed unread counts, but sometimes you need to see how many items are in a folder overall. Just right-click any folder and choose whether to show the total or unread count. It gives you more control over how you keep track of your email without changing how anything else works. #newoutlookforwindows

title: Outlook: User-initiated Copilot insights in classic Outlook
description: Users can manually select text and ask Copilot to help provide relevant information.

title: SharePoint: Cross-post SharePoint News to Engage
description: This feature allows SharePoint News authors to distribute posts to an Engage community or storyline while preserving full fidelity rendering and a unified conversation experience. SharePoint News post will appear consistently in Engage across feeds, digests, Outlook, Teams, desktop, web and mobile apps. When distributed, the SharePoint News comments module is replaced with the richer Engage conversation module, ensuring a single, shared discussion thread across surfaces.

title: Microsoft 365: The Next Generation of File & Folder Sharing
description: We're now introducing the third generation of the Microsoft 365 sharing experience designed to make collaboration simpler, smarter, and more secure by default. At the heart of this update is the new hero link, a single, powerful link that controls access to your files. Whether you copy a link, share via email, or send the URL from your browser, you now have a seamless and consistent way to share and stay in control of your files.

title: Microsoft Teams: Centralized notification settings for channels
description: Centralized notification settings streamline channel notification setup and management. Available in Teams settings, users have a single place to review and adjust notifications for all visible channels, instead of managing each individually.

title: Dynamics 365 Project Operations: Import task - Public API support
description:
Public APIs for the Import tasks capability enable customers and partners to programmatically import tasks from one project into another. Organizations can call these APIs from custom applications, integrations, or automated workflows instead of requiring a user to initiate each import manually.

The APIs support repeatable project-creation and planning scenarios, such as populating new projects with tasks from templates or previously completed projects. Customers can incorporate task imports into their existing project provisioning and automation processes.

title: Dynamics 365 Sales: Choose the data sources AI-powered Data Enrichment uses, including CRM notes
description:
AI-powered Data Enrichment now lets admins choose which data sources the agent uses to enrich records. Outlook emails, Teams meetings, and the new CRM notes source each have their own control toggle, and the agent keeps running as long as at least one source is toggled on. Admins no longer need to connect every permission before they create the agent. With CRM notes, the agent extracts insights from manual notes added to supported records and uses them to enrich those records, with no tenant admin consent needed to use CRM notes. Only notes added by users with a Dynamics 365 Sales Premium license are used, and Dataverse search is needed only for emails and Teams meetings, since notes are already linked to their records.

These control toggles are available automatically. Admins can turn each source on or off in the Agent behavior section of the Data Enrichment settings. Outlook emails and Teams meetings stay off until their permissions are connected, and connecting a permission never turns a source on by itself. For organizations already using the agent, CRM notes is off by default and a banner lets admins know it's available. For new organizations, CRM notes is on by default.

title: Microsoft Teams: QR code protection in Teams messaging
description: Microsoft Teams will provide additional protection for QR codes shared by external users in messages. Images containing QR codes from external senders will be obscured by default and require users to reveal them before viewing or scanning. This helps reduce the risk of phishing and fraud by encouraging more deliberate interaction with QR code content.

title: Microsoft Teams: Admins can control profanity filtering in meeting transcripts
description: Teams administrators will be able to use a meeting policy to control whether profane words are masked in live transcription and saved meeting transcripts. Filtering remains on by default. When an organizer is assigned a policy that turns filtering off, profane words can appear without masking in both the live and saved transcript, while live captions continue to follow each participant's existing profanity setting.

title: Microsoft Copilot Studio: Conversational configuration of connectors in Copilot Studio
description: Configure the connectors your agent needs, with a simple in-chat sign-in instead of a full settings experience.

title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Integrate the Sales Development agent with Salesforce
description: Sales Development Agent now integrates with Salesforce, enabling organizations to use SDA with their existing Salesforce CRM. SDA can access leads, manage prospect records, log sales activities, and keep engagement actions—including qualification, disqualification, and ownership changes—connected to the CRM workflow. The integration uses Microsoft’s Salesforce Model Context Protocol (MCP) server to connect SDA with Salesforce.

title: Dynamics 365 Project Operations: Import tasks into a project from other projects
description:
Currently, to bring tasks from another project into a new project, you must manually enter the task details in the task grid or use schedule APIs. You can also use the Copy project feature to create a new project with the same tasks, but this feature has limitations:
​

  • You copy the entire project, including unwanted tasks and extra information.
  • You can't combine tasks from multiple projects into a new project.
    ​
    With this feature, you can select and import tasks from one or more existing projects into a new project, saving time and effort. You can choose the project and tasks to import while adhering to the task limits per project as specified in the public documentation.
    ​
    When this feature is enabled in the feature control settings, you can:
    ​
  • Select the Import Tasks button from the project ribbon.
  • Use the project picker to select the source project in the side pane.
  • See the grid populate with the tasks associated with that project after a project is selected.
  • Choose the tasks to be imported into the target project, and then select Add.
  • Know that imported tasks are automatically appended to the target project's Work Breakdown Structure (WBS).

title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Copilot in Forms - US Government clouds
description: Copilot in Forms is being enabled for Microsoft Forms in Government Cloud environments, bringing end-to-end AI assistance to forms, from creating a form, to refining and sending to analyzing results. This rollout includes key Copilot features such as: - Draft with Copilot - Distribution and monitoring - Copilot Insights - On-canvas Copilot features such as Rewrite question, Continue writing, Answer explanations, and more.

title: Microsoft Teams: Intelligent meeting recap available without saving transcript
description: Intelligent recap can now be generated without retaining a transcript after the meeting. Meeting organizers can choose this setting from the meeting options before the meeting, or organizers and eligible participants can enable it during the meeting. After the meeting, the AI Summary will be available, but other elements of the recap may not be available (Chapters, Topics, Mentions, Audio recap).

title: Microsoft Teams: Pop out calls into a new browser window
description: Microsoft Teams browser app users will be able to pop out calls into a simplified call window that stays available while they navigate away from, hide, or minimize the tab or progressive web app (PWA) hosting the call. This helps users multitask and collaborate more easily during calls.

title: Microsoft Purview: Data Loss Prevention – New Guided Experience to Diagnose and Resolve DLP Issues
description:
We’re introducing a new guided diagnostics experience to help users understand why their DLP policies may not be behaving as expected. This experience provides a clear summary of why a DLP action was taken on a document, including which policies were triggered, the order of evaluation, and detailed insights into which conditions evaluated as true or false.
For Microsoft 365 E5 customers, the experience also includes Copilot-powered insights and tailored recommendations to accelerate troubleshooting and policy optimization.

title: Excel: Excel canvas
description: A Copilot-generated canvas that turns workbook data into a polished, interactive view of key visualizations, metrics, and insights. As workbook data changes, it automatically updates to reflect the latest information. Users can modify the canvas by chatting with Copilot.

title: PowerApps: Building modern apps - Modernize model-driven apps with the header and navigation refresh feature
description:
The header and navigation refresh feature delivers a modern, intuitive, and efficient model app experience across the app shell, form pages, and view pages. This update improves visual clarity, reduces vertical space usage, and aligns with modern Microsoft 365 design patterns.

As the feature transitions to general availability (GA), the refreshed experience remains opt-in, allowing makers to control adoption and validate the experience at their own pace. Makers can switch between the classic and refreshed experience using the Header and navigation refresh app setting:

  • Auto (default): The new experience is off for apps, except those apps created using Plans.
  • Yes: Turns on the new header and navigation experience.
  • No: Keeps the classic header and navigation experience.

Key aspects include:

  • Modern app header: A simplified header layout with improved spacing and icons that align with modern Microsoft 365 design patterns and enhance brand coherence across apps.
  • Streamlined sitemap: A cleaner, more readable sitemap structure that helps you find what you need faster.
  • More working space on forms: The command bar is now the only element fixed at the top of the page — the summary area and form header scroll off with the rest of the form, giving users more room to work. When the form header scrolls out of view, a condensed sticky header attaches below the command bar so the record is always identifiable.
  • More responsive form header: The form header adapts more gracefully across window sizes and content densities.
  • Tighter spacing and margins: Targeted adjustments across the app improve consistency, readability, and overall page density.
  • New command ordering: Injected system commands like Show As and Show Chart now appear in the third position, after New and Delete.

Availability

Field Value
Release Channel Weekly
Version 2609.1
Applies to Model-driven apps
Feature Scope Users (enabled by admins or makers)

Business Value:

The refreshed header and navigation experience provides a cleaner, more efficient layout across the app shell, forms, and views. These updates help you work efficiently by increasing your working area on forms and views, reducing the time you spend navigating pages, and aligning the experience with the latest Microsoft 365 design patterns.

Enabled for:

Enabled by admins/makers/marketers for end users

title: Dynamics 365 Project Operations: Optimize Project Operations - Assign task level calendar for precise planning
description:
This feature provides an experience to change the task calendar on the Customizable task details pane. To enable this feature, from project parameters select Enable Customize Task Pane.

When enabled through feature control, this functionality lets you:

  • Set a task-level calendar on the Customizable task details pane.
  • Manage task-level calendars.
  • Schedule API support.

Business Value:

With project-level calendars, every task follows the same schedule, even when timing needs differ. That often means extra work and inaccurate plans. Task-level calendars change that. You can assign a unique calendar to each task, giving you control over working hours and timelines. This flexibility helps you build accurate schedules, reduce manual changes, and keep projects moving even when tasks vary. Combined with task-level schedule mode, you decide what the system adjusts, effort, duration, or units, while still setting custom hours for each task.

Enabled for:

Enabled by admins/makers/marketers for end users

title: Outlook: Send availability in Outlook mobile apps
description: We are bringing back send availability on both iOS and Android. iOS users will now also be able to access more of this feature via keyboard and voiceover.

title: Outlook: Duplicate events in Outlook mobile apps
description: We are adding the ability to duplicate an event. Simply go to the event details and select "duplicate event"

title: Microsoft Purview: Data Loss Prevention for Microsoft Cowork
description: Microsoft Purview Data Loss Prevention (DLP) is expanding to Microsoft Cowork, enabling data security admins to use a single policy across Microsoft 365 Copilot and Cowork. The integration helps protect sensitive AI interactions by preventing the use of labeled knowledge sources, blocking prompts that contain supported sensitive information types, and restricting sensitive prompts from being sent to Bing for web search.

title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Edit your document with Copilot in PowerPoint in Government Clouds
description: Copilot in PowerPoint helps you create, edit, and refine presentations through natural language—right inside your deck. Start a new presentation or build on an existing one by asking Copilot to generate slides, update content, improve layouts, and polish design, all while preserving your formatting, structure, and branding. Copilot can also connect to your brand kit to apply branded templates, insert brand-approved images, and check for brand compliance. Available to Microsoft 365 Copilot (Premium) users.

title: Microsoft Viva: Agent metrics for custom reporting in Insights analyst workbench
description: Unlock deeper insights into Copilot agent adoption with flexible, self-serve analytics. Insights global and partition analysts can access and combine granular agent usage metrics with agent and organizational attributes to uncover agent adoption trends, export and customize reporting, and drive more informed decisions, without relying on predefined dashboards.

title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Copilot in PowerPoint for Government clouds
description: Copilot in PowerPoint lets you create, edit, and refine presentations through natural conversation, directly in your presentation. You can start a new presentation or build on an existing one, asking Copilot to generate slides, update content, improve layouts, and polish design—while preserving formatting, structure, and branding. Copilot uses your files, meetings, emails, and more to help shape content and iterate quickly, and it connects to your brand kit so you can apply branded templates, insert brand approved images, and check for brand compliance. Available to Microsoft 365 Copilot–licensed users.

title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Edit with Copilot in Excel (Web, Win32, Mac) - GCC
description: Edit with Copilot lets you build and edit workbooks side by side with Copilot. When you're updating budgets, creating financial models, or analyzing data, Copilot uses Excel's most powerful tools like tables, charts, PivotTables, and formulas to help you get the job done.

title: Word: Legal plugins in Copilot
description: Legal plugins in Copilot provide purpose-built skills to help legal professionals summarize, draft, review, and redline legal documents. Available in Word and Cowork, these plugins can use work context from Microsoft 365 and connect to supported third-party legal sources.

title: Microsoft Purview: Data Lifecycle Management – Increase in expansion limit for auto expanding archive beyond 1.5TB
description: Previously, auto expanding archive mailbox expansion was supported only up to 1.5 TB, after which mailboxes would become inoperative. Archive mailboxes can now automatically expand beyond the 1.5 TB limit, ensuring uninterrupted retention and enabling scalable archive growth as storage thresholds are reached. This capability to expand archive beyond 1.5 TB will be available to customers with eligible E5 licenses.

title: Microsoft Teams: AI-powered notes for in-person meetings with Facilitator in Teams Rooms on Windows
description: In addition to capturing real-time notes and meeting outcomes during scheduled or hybrid meetings, the Facilitator agent assists you with notes, decisions and actions for in-person meetings in Teams Rooms on Windows. Simply invite Facilitator with one tap of the room console. Meeting notes appear on the front of room display or touch board, are available via meeting recap when shared, and deleted if no one selected. Rest assured no data remains in the room. Available with Teams Rooms Pro.

title: Microsoft Teams: Organize important resources in chats and channels
description: Microsoft Teams is introducing a new way to organize and access important resources in chats and channels. Users will be able to pin key content, including links, files, and messages, directly beneath the chat or channel header for quick access. Resources can also be organized into folders, making it easier to keep important information visible and discoverable in active conversations. This update provides a more consistent experience across chats and channels, helping users stay organized, quickly find key resources, and remain aligned on important information. Existing pinned messages will continue to be available within the new experience, alongside other shared resources, on Teams desktop and web.

title: Microsoft Purview: Information Protection-Auto-labeling per-policy coverage report
description: For each enforced auto-labeling policy, admins can view how files processed during enforcement correlate to the latest simulation run. The per-policy coverage report shows volumes of files that have been labeled or are not yet labeled, and whether those files were included in the last simulation snapshot. This helps admins understand enforcement progress for a specific policy against the data state captured during simulation, while also identifying files that were not found in the simulation snapshot but were processed during enforcement.

title: Microsoft Teams: Updated header and dashboard for chats and channels on mobile
description: You can now get oriented and take action faster when using Teams on mobile, with a redesigned header and lightweight dashboard that brings key channel details, people, and pinned content into one intuitive place. It creates a more predictable, familiar experience across desktop and mobile so you can move faster with less friction.

title: Microsoft Teams: Chat for organizers and presenters in structured meetings and webinars
description: Organizers, co-organizers, and presenters can chat privately in a separate chat from attendees. This chat is available to access before, during, and after the event.

title: Outlook: Copilot Chat pop-out for Outlook for Mac and iPad
description: Copilot Chat remains accessible within an Outlook app window but now can also be popped out to float over the main Outlook app window. Popping out Copilot Chat allows people to switch contexts or have more space for what they are working on in Outlook and control the space and form that Copilot Chat takes on screen. When you open Copilot chat and click the pop-out button, Copilot will open separately over the main Outlook window.

title: Microsoft Viva: Copilot assisted goal authoring with Context IQ grounding
description: When generating goals, users will be able to add more than one file from context IQ suggestions as references in their prompts to Copilot.
ai_summary: Users can now reference multiple files from Context IQ when generating goals with Copilot in Microsoft Viva. This feature enhances goal authoring capabilities.

title: OneDrive: Admins can configure a group policy to block specific folders from OneDrive Sync
description: In addition to being able to configure a group policy to exclude specific files or file extensions from Syncing with OneDrive, admins can now exclude folders as well. End-users will be able to see the excluded folders in the Sync configuration applied to them via their OneDrive Advanced Settings.
ai_summary: OneDrive admins can now block specific folders from syncing through group policy, in addition to excluding files or extensions. Users will see these exclusions in their OneDrive settings.

title: Microsoft Entra: Passkey authentication in brokered Microsoft apps on Android
description: Microsoft Entra ID users can now use a passkey to sign into Microsoft apps on Android devices where an authentication broker like Microsoft Authenticator or Microsoft Intune Company Portal is installed.
ai_summary: Microsoft Entra ID users can now sign into Microsoft apps on Android using passkeys when an authentication broker is installed. This change affects user authentication methods.

title: Microsoft Purview compliance portal: Information Protection - Sensitivity labels protection policy support for Microsoft Fabric
description: Your organization can now apply sensitivity labels in Microsoft Purview Information Protection to Microsoft Fabric workspaces. This new functionality will allow users to manually label Fabric items with their sensitivity level and then apply access control protections based upon the protection policies set by administrators.
ai_summary: Organizations can now apply sensitivity labels to Microsoft Fabric workspaces using Microsoft Purview Information Protection. This allows for better access control based on sensitivity levels.

title: Microsoft Stream: Seek bar thumbnails for Teams meeting recordings
description: This feature adds seek bar (preview) thumbnails to Microsoft Stream's video player. The thumbnails provide a preview of the video content when hovering over the player's seek bar at a certain timestamp. Currently, it will only be made available for Teams meeting recordings.
ai_summary: Microsoft Stream will now include seek bar thumbnails for Teams meeting recordings, providing users with a visual preview of video content at specific timestamps.

title: Microsoft Stream: Video reactions
description: This feature will allow users to add or remove reactions to specific points of a recorded video via Stream Web App and Embed. Viewers will be able to see how their colleagues feel about a video and show their support towards the video owner. These reactions will be present in the timeline to highlight the most important parts of the video and can be used for navigation. Also, owners of the video can see detailed analytics about when viewers are reacting to videos and have ability to disable the feature.  This feature was incorrectly updated to a status of rolling out upon preview availability.  We apologize for any inconvenience.
ai_summary: Users can now add reactions to specific points in recorded videos on Microsoft Stream, enhancing viewer engagement and providing analytics for video owners. This feature is optional and can be disabled.

title: Microsoft 365: Dedicated Backup Administrator Role for Microsoft 365 Backup
description: Use a dedicated Backup Administrator role to manage your M365 Backup administration tasks.
ai_summary: A new dedicated Backup Administrator role will be available for managing Microsoft 365 Backup tasks. This change affects administrators responsible for backup management.

title: OneDrive: Convert Copilot response into a Word file
description: Like a summary or FAQ that Copilot generated for you? Now, with one click, you can convert any Copilot response into a Word document. This feature requires a Microsoft Copilot for Microsoft 365 license and will be available to commercial customers on OneDrive Web.
ai_summary: OneDrive will enable users to convert Copilot responses into Word documents with one click, requiring a Microsoft Copilot license. This feature affects commercial users of OneDrive.

title: OneDrive: Create a presentation from a Word file
description: With Copilot, you can create the first draft of your presentation using a Word file in just a single click. This feature requires a Microsoft Copilot for Microsoft 365 license and will be available to commercial customers on OneDrive Web.
ai_summary: OneDrive will allow users to create a presentation draft from a Word file using Copilot with one click, requiring a Microsoft Copilot license. This feature is for commercial users of OneDrive.

title: Microsoft 365 admin center: Unified Google Workspace Migration
description: Offer Microsoft 365 customers a seamless experience for migrating Google Workspace workloads to M365. Through a unified portal page, you can initiate and monitor migration tasks for both Gmail and Google Drive. Additionally, if your Google Workspace tenant has fewer than 1,000 users, you'll benefit from the newly revamped Gmail migration flow, which simplifies the process and guides you through each step.
ai_summary: The Microsoft 365 admin center will provide a unified portal for migrating Google Workspace workloads to Microsoft 365, simplifying Gmail and Google Drive migrations. This affects administrators managing migrations.

title: Microsoft 365 admin center: Google Groups to M365 Modern Groups Migration Service
description: Google Groups to M365 Modern Groups Migration Service is a 1st party service for migrating Google groups with the M365 Admin center as a new feature, so that Google compete customers moving to M365 would have the ability to automatically create the groups, its members, member conversations and all permissions to M365 Groups without the need to recreate the groups which is the only solution for customers moving from Google.
ai_summary: A new service in the Microsoft 365 admin center will facilitate the migration of Google Groups to M365 Modern Groups, preserving group structures and permissions. This impacts administrators overseeing group migrations.

title: Microsoft 365 admin center: Google to Entra Identity Sync service
description: Google to Entra Identity Sync service is a cloud-2-cloud user Identity onboarding and one way synchronization tool from Google workspace to Entra ID. This will be available as part of the M365 Admin center for Google compete customers moving into M365 to create the identities in M365 farm and move Drive and Mail content into Onedrive and Exchange online
ai_summary: The Google to Entra Identity Sync service will enable one-way user identity synchronization from Google Workspace to Entra ID, available in the M365 Admin center. This affects administrators managing user identities.

title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Updated welcome screen for the Microsoft 365 app on Windows
description: The Microsoft 365 app welcome screen on Windows will be updated to display a welcome message and progress bar while the Microsoft 365 app loads.
ai_summary: The welcome screen for the Microsoft 365 app on Windows will be updated to show a welcome message and progress bar during loading. This affects all users of the Microsoft 365 app.

title: Microsoft Viva: List-based Forms card for Viva Connections Dashboard
description: This feature will allow operators to add a card for any form/survey created for data collection on the Viva Connections Dashboard for attention and quick action.
ai_summary: Viva Connections Dashboard will allow operators to add a card for forms or surveys for quick access and action. This feature is aimed at operators using the Viva Connections Dashboard.

title: Word: Draft on a selection and retain your existing formatting
description: Draft on a selection and retain your existing formatting so that your content is seamless and fits with your document.
ai_summary: Word will allow users to draft on selected text while retaining existing formatting, ensuring content consistency. This feature affects all Word users.

title: Microsoft 365: Updates to the Microsoft 365 app
description: The Microsoft 365 app name, icon, and UI will evolve to support future AI-first experiences. Key UI changes include reducing the top header and consolidating app-level tools and settings into the App toolbar on the left.
ai_summary: The Microsoft 365 app will have a new name, icon, and UI changes to support AI features. This affects all users of the Microsoft 365 app.

title: SharePoint: Additional support on SPAC to identify different types of Embedded containers and their principal owner
description: The update enables SharePoint Embedded Administrators (SPE Admins) to identify the different kind of containers (user, tenant, and group) and the principal owner associated with the container.
ai_summary: SharePoint Embedded Administrators can now identify different types of embedded containers and their principal owners. This change affects SharePoint administrators.

title: SharePoint: Modifications in the Embedded container type creation cmdlets in PowerShell
description: We’re introducing modifications in the container type creation cmdlets. The New-SPOContainerType cmdlet will only create a new container type. We are introducing the Add-SPOContainerTypeBilling cmdlet to add billing profile to the new container type.
ai_summary: PowerShell cmdlets for creating embedded container types in SharePoint are being modified. This impacts SharePoint administrators using PowerShell.

title: Windows 365: Concurrency assignment for Windows 365 Frontline in dedicated mode
description: Concurrency assignment in Windows 365 Frontline in dedicated mode refers to the number of active Cloud PCs that can be used simultaneously within the total number of licensed Cloud PC usage for Frontline. This allocation ensures that resources are optimized based on the specific needs of the organization and its users.
ai_summary: Windows 365 Frontline will allow for concurrency assignment, optimizing the use of Cloud PCs based on organizational needs. This affects organizations using Windows 365 Frontline.

title: Microsoft 365 admin center: New Feature access management UI in Admin Center
description: Through the new Feature Access management user interface, admins will be able to manage feature access settings directly in Microsoft 365 admin center. Feature access management allows admins to use access policies to manage which users can access specific features in Viva apps, so you can tailor your deployments to meet your local regulatory or business requirements. Previously, these policies could only be managed with Microsoft PowerShell cmdlets. After this rollout, admins can choose to use either Microsoft 365 admin center or PowerShell to manage feature access. Existing policies set for an organization will persist and can be managed in both places.
ai_summary: Admins can now manage feature access settings directly in the Microsoft 365 admin center instead of only using PowerShell. This affects all Microsoft 365 administrators.

title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Copilot extensibility – Developers can build custom engine agents with the Microsoft 365 Agents SDK
description: Developers can use the Microsoft 365 Agents SDK to create custom engine agents. These agents, built on their own AI stack, can be deployed to various platforms, including Microsoft 365 Copilot, Microsoft Teams, and other non-Microsoft channels.
ai_summary: Developers can create custom engine agents using the Microsoft 365 Agents SDK for deployment across various platforms. This change affects developers working with Microsoft 365.

title: Microsoft 365: Updated settings for the Microsoft 365 app on Windows
description: The Microsoft 365 app on Windows added settings to pin the app to the taskbar.
ai_summary: New settings in the Microsoft 365 app on Windows allow users to pin the app to the taskbar. This affects users of the Microsoft 365 app on Windows.

title: Planner: Smart backgrounds for basic plans
description: Get ready to customize your plans like never before! With smart backgrounds, you’ll be able to quickly spot the right plans. This feature was part of our legacy Planner experience, and we’re now enabling it for basic plans in the new Planner.
ai_summary: Smart backgrounds will be available for basic plans in Planner, enhancing customization options. This affects users of Planner.

title: Microsoft Clipchamp: Editor simplification and introduction of light mode
description: This change will simplify the Clipchamp editing experience and increase the space you have on the stage to make great videos. We're also introducing light mode as a new option for people to choose whether they view the Clipchamp editor in a Light or Dark scheme.
ai_summary: Clipchamp will have a simplified editing experience and a new light mode option for users. This affects users of Clipchamp.

title: Microsoft Purview compliance portal: Data Loss Prevention - New ChatGPT Enterprise connector to discover and bring prompts and responses into the scope of Purview features

title: Microsoft Purview: Communication Compliance- Alert improvements
description:
Communication Compliance is improving the capabilities and customization of policy alerts. Admins will be able to customize the alert frequency per policy as well as adjust the email alerts frequency and recipients within the policy creation wizard. 
Microsoft Purview Communication Compliance provides the tools to help organizations detect regulatory compliance violations (for example SEC or FINRA), such as sensitive or confidential information, harassing or threatening language, and sharing of adult content. Built with privacy by design, usernames are pseudonymized by default, role-based access controls are built in, investigators are opted in by an admin, and audit logs are in place to ensure user-level privacy.
