ai_summary: Communication Compliance will enhance alert customization, allowing admins to adjust alert frequency and recipients for policy alerts. This change affects compliance administrators.

title: Microsoft Intune: Recovery Lock management for macOS
description: This feature adds the ability to manage the password used to access the macOS recovery partition. Configuring a recovery OS password prevents users from booting company-owned devices into recovery mode, reinstalling macOS, and bypassing remote management.
ai_summary: Microsoft Intune adds management for the macOS recovery partition password, preventing users from bypassing remote management on company devices. This change affects IT admins managing macOS devices.

title: Microsoft Intune: Assignment filters support for Apple declarative device management (DDM)
description: Admins can use assignment filters when targeting Apple DDM policies.
ai_summary: Microsoft Intune will support assignment filters for Apple declarative device management policies, allowing more precise targeting. This affects IT admins managing Apple devices.

title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Edit a Page using Copilot Chat on Mobile
description: Mobile users can now use Copilot Chat to edit Pages.
ai_summary: Mobile users can now edit Pages using Copilot Chat in Microsoft 365. This feature impacts users who create and manage content on mobile devices.

title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): [Copilot Chat] Agent mode in Word enables conversational support to create, edit and refine document content from chat
description: Available for M365 users without a M365 Copilot license. From Chat, you can use natural language to generate and direct edits to new and existing documents, when in an Edit mode. In this mode, Copilot will ask clarifying questions if needed, and after making changes will recap actions take and recommended next steps. Changes to the document are supported with controls in the document canvas to review changes made.
ai_summary: Microsoft 365 Copilot Chat in Word will enable users to create and edit documents using natural language commands. This feature is available to M365 users without a Copilot license.

title: Exchange: Message Trace - Custom Retention
description: We will be introducing customizable retention options for Message Trace logs. Organizations will be able to choose from a predefined set of retention periods.
ai_summary: Exchange will introduce customizable retention options for Message Trace logs, allowing organizations to select retention periods. This affects Exchange administrators.

title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Suggested References in Copilot Notebooks
description: Users can now quickly enrich their Copilot Notebook with relevant Suggested References based on recent user work activity.
ai_summary: Copilot Notebooks will now suggest relevant references based on recent user activity, enhancing user productivity. This affects users of Copilot Notebooks.

title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Recommended Notebooks in Copilot Notebooks
description: Users can quickly create new Copilot Notebooks via Recommended Notebooks based on recent user work activity.
ai_summary: Users can create new Copilot Notebooks using Recommended Notebooks based on their recent work activity, streamlining the notebook creation process. This affects users of Copilot Notebooks.

title: Microsoft Entra: Conditional Access support for Entra ID Account Recovery
description: Microsoft Entra ID Account Recovery is an advanced authentication recovery mechanism that enables users to regain access to their organizational accounts when they've lost access to all registered authentication methods. This feature adds additional support for protecting the account recovery flow by enabling CA policies to be applied. Learn more
ai_summary: Microsoft Entra ID Account Recovery will support Conditional Access policies to enhance security during account recovery. This affects users needing to recover access to their accounts.

title: Microsoft Viva: SharePoint agent analytics on Viva Insights
description: Explore how your employees used key SharePoint agent features over a given time period and understand the ROI. #copilotcontrolsystem
ai_summary: Viva Insights will provide analytics on SharePoint agent usage, helping organizations assess the ROI of these features. This affects managers and administrators analyzing employee engagement.

title: Outlook: Sort by flag
description: We are adding support for sort by flag status, flag due date and flag start date.
ai_summary: Outlook will allow users to sort emails by flag status, due date, and start date. This affects all Outlook users looking to organize their flagged emails more effectively.

title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): When using Agent Mode in Word, you will be able to manually select which model to use
description: Agent Mode in Word lets you choose from multiple models, giving you flexibility to select the right model for your task.
ai_summary: In Word, Agent Mode will allow users to manually select which model to use for tasks. This affects users utilizing AI features in Word.

title: Microsoft 365: eSignature Smart Tagging for Electronically Signed Documents
description: Documents that have been electronically signed will now be automatically recognized and tagged as “Signed” upon upload to SharePoint. This enhancement also applies retroactively as existing e-signed files will be updated with the appropriate tags. To give users more visibility and control, we’re introducing two optional metadata columns for document libraries: Electronically Signed – Indicates whether a document has been eSigned. Signature Provider – Displays the service used for the eSignature. This feature is available exclusively to tenants with eSignature enabled, helping streamline compliance tracking and document management.
ai_summary: SharePoint will automatically tag electronically signed documents as 'Signed' upon upload, including retroactive updates for existing files. This feature is for tenants with eSignature enabled.

title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Catchup on important emails in Copilot Chat
description: Copilot Chat helps you stay on top of your inbox by highlighting important and actionable emails such as messages from your manager, leadership, top collaborators, or emails containing tasks when you use prompts like “What’s hot in my inbox?” or “What were the important emails from last week?”
ai_summary: Copilot Chat will highlight important emails in your inbox based on prompts, helping users prioritize messages. This affects users who utilize Copilot Chat.

title: Microsoft Edge: Protected Clipboard
description: Admins shouldn’t have to choose between locking down copy/paste and risking data leaks. Protected Clipboard offers a smarter way for keeping sensitive data safe without disrupting user workflows. Leveraging Purview DLP policies to define trusted boundaries across managed cloud apps. Data inside those admin defined boundaries can stay protected while external data can enter if needed. Granular control for admins. Seamless productivity for users.
ai_summary: Protected Clipboard in Microsoft Edge allows admins to define trusted boundaries for sensitive data, enhancing data security without disrupting user workflows. This impacts IT admins.

title: Microsoft Entra: ID Account Recovery
description: Microsoft Entra ID Account Recovery is an advanced authentication recovery mechanism that enables users to regain access to their organizational accounts when they've lost access to all registered authentication methods. Unlike traditional password reset capabilities, account recovery focuses on identity verification and trust re-establishment prior to replacement of authentication methods rather than simple credential recovery.
ai_summary: Microsoft Entra ID Account Recovery allows users to regain access to their accounts through identity verification when all authentication methods are lost. This affects users needing account recovery.

title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Support for refining query filters for Confluence Copilot connectors
description:
This feature enhances and standardizes query filtering across both Confluence Cloud and Confluence On-premises connectors.

For Confluence Cloud connector, it introduces simplified options to filter pages by page id, creation date/time and last update date/time, helping improve productivity and reduce human errors.

For Confluence On-premises connector, it adds support for advanced CQL-based filtering, enabling more complex and flexible filtering scenarios.
ai_summary: Microsoft Copilot enhances query filtering for Confluence connectors, simplifying options for Confluence Cloud and adding advanced filtering for On-premises. This affects users working with Confluence data.

title: Microsoft 365 Admin Center: Agent-Level Controls for Pay-as-you-go
description: This feature introduces admin controls for managing AI agents on a consumption basis within Microsoft 365 Copilot. Administrators can specify which users can access particular agents through pay-as-you-go, control which agents are available for metered consumption, and establish billing policy for each agent. Initially focusing on declarative agents in M365 Copilot Chat and SharePoint, this enhancement enables organizations to effectively manage AI consumption costs and scale intelligent capabilities according to business needs. #copilotcontrolsystem
ai_summary: The Microsoft 365 Admin Center introduces controls for managing AI agents on a pay-as-you-go basis, allowing admins to specify user access and billing policies. This impacts administrators managing AI consumption.

title: Microsoft Purview: Endpoint Data Loss Prevention- Logged-in user details on the Purview device onboarding page
description: This update introduces logged-in user details (user email) on the device onboarding page for Windows devices bringing it in line with the experience for MacOS devices. ​Admins can now see which user is currently signed in on a device, making It faster to confirm ownership and troubleshoot issues.
ai_summary: Microsoft Purview now displays logged-in user details on the device onboarding page for Windows, aligning with MacOS. This helps admins confirm user ownership and troubleshoot issues.

title: Microsoft Purview compliance portal: Custom permissions UI enhancements in Microsoft Purview Information Protection File Labeler
description: This feature borrows the familiar custom permissions menu in Office and replaces the existing custom permissions UI in the Microsoft Purview Information Protection File Labeler. The new menu enables viewer, restricted editor, editor and owner permissions to be assigned to multiple groups at the same time.
ai_summary: The Microsoft Purview compliance portal updates the custom permissions UI in the Information Protection File Labeler, allowing bulk permission assignments. This affects compliance administrators.

title: Microsoft Purview: Endpoint Data Loss Prevention- Source context based file protection for Endpoint
description: Protect file based on the website the file is downloaded or the app the file is created.
ai_summary: Microsoft Purview introduces source context-based file protection for Endpoint, allowing protection based on the source of the file. This impacts users managing file security.

title: Microsoft Viva: Copilot Analytics - Highlights on Copilot adoption from Viva Engage
description: Explore how Copilot is making a difference in your organization through Viva Engage posts that users have shared. The Copilot Dashboard showcases real-world success stories, user-shared excitement about new Copilot features, and vibrant community discussions. These examples offer a qualitative view into how Copilot is driving productivity and engagement across your tenant, directly in the Copilot Dashboard. #CopilotControlSystem
ai_summary: Viva Engage will provide insights on Copilot adoption through shared posts, showcasing success stories and community discussions. This affects users utilizing Copilot and Viva Engage.

title: Microsoft Intune: macOS Custom Compliance
description: This feature will enable users to use discovery script and json file to define compliance policy to specific organziational needs. The experience mirrors Windows and Linux custom compliance experience.
ai_summary: Microsoft Intune will enable macOS users to define custom compliance policies using discovery scripts and JSON files, similar to Windows and Linux. This change affects IT admins managing macOS devices.

title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Customize M365 Copilot for your organization with Copilot Tuning
description: Microsoft 365 Copilot Tuning is introducing new templates in Agent Builder, designed for tasks such as drafting complex documents, validating documents against guidelines, and editing to match a distinct writing style.  Users with Copilot Tuning enabled can further customize the template-based agents by tuning the context, tools, and underlying models with their organization’s proprietary data, processes, and standards. This empowers your teams with customized agents aligned to how your organization works.
ai_summary: Microsoft 365 Copilot Tuning will introduce new templates for customizing agents based on organizational needs. This feature is aimed at users with Copilot Tuning enabled.

title: Microsoft 365: New map-based room booking experience in Places Finder
description: We are enhancing the room booking experience in the new calendar experience across Outlook for Windows, Outlook for the web, and Teams by introducing a map view within Places Finder. This update replaces the existing side panel with a full screen, easier to use interface that helps people quickly find and book the right space.
ai_summary: A new map-based room booking experience will be added to Outlook and Teams, enhancing how users find and book spaces. This update affects users who book rooms through these applications.

title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Microsoft 365 Copilot Search Supports SharePoint Online Custom Properties Search
description: Discover and find people through Microsoft 365 Copilot Search based on your company's custom profile properties from SharePoint Online.
ai_summary: Microsoft 365 Copilot Search will now support searching for people based on custom profile properties from SharePoint Online. This change affects users who utilize Copilot Search in their organization.

title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): [Copilot Extensibility] Admins can govern and manage federated copilot connectors in Microsoft 365 admin center
description: Admins can govern and manage federated copilot connectors in Microsoft 365 admin center. #copilotcontrolsystem
ai_summary: Admins can now manage federated copilot connectors directly in the Microsoft 365 admin center. This update provides more control over Copilot integrations.

title: Microsoft Viva: Viva Learning - Custom user mapping for SuccessFactors integration
description: Admins can now specify the user mapping attributes in the LMS setup form.
ai_summary: Admins can now specify user mapping attributes for SuccessFactors integration in Viva Learning. This change affects administrators managing learning systems.

title: OneDrive: Microsoft 365 Copilot in OneDrive
description: We're excited to bring M365 Copilot in OneDrive, a new unified Copilot chat experience designed to make working with your files simpler, smarter, and more seamless across Microsoft 365.
ai_summary: OneDrive will integrate Microsoft 365 Copilot to enhance file management with a unified chat experience. This change affects all OneDrive users.

title: Microsoft Entra: Microsoft Security Copilot App Lifecycle Management Agent in Microsoft Entra
description:
Application Lifecycle Management Agent: This agent unifies the entire application lifecycle into one intelligent workflow—replacing multiple
disconnected admin tasks with a single, guided experience. It automatically discovers unmanaged private apps using Global Secure Access telemetry, recommends onboarding them to Microsoft Entra, and handles setup with automated naming, tagging, and least-privilege scoping. After onboarding, the agent continuously monitors app usage and permissions, flags unused high privileged apps and proactively notifies owners with clear next steps via Teams or email. Using the data the agent has gathered, it suggests a phased disablement plan that admins can customize to their risk prioritization preferences.
ai_summary: Microsoft Entra introduces a new Application Lifecycle Management Agent that streamlines app management tasks and monitors app usage. This impacts IT admins managing applications.

title: OneNote: Copilot Notebooks available in OneNote on Web
description: Users will now have access to their Copilot Notebooks on the web version of OneNote.
ai_summary: Copilot Notebooks will be accessible in the web version of OneNote, allowing users to utilize Copilot features online. This change affects OneNote users.

title: Microsoft 365 admin center: Copilot - Billing & usage: High-usage users
description: See a list of users with high Copilot pay-as-you-go usage (i.e., greater than 2000 credits). You can buy and assign Copilot licenses to the high-usage users directly on this page.
ai_summary: Admins can view high-usage users of Copilot and directly purchase and assign licenses from the Microsoft 365 admin center.

title: Microsoft Viva: Viva Pulse - Authoring with M365 Copilot
description: Viva Pulse authors can now work with M365 Copilot to add a question, rewrite a question, and create a survey from scratch to quickly create and send their surveys to their teams to collect feedback. M365 Copilot can seamlessly capture the author's needs to recommend survey questions that fit their unique scenario. #copilotcontrolsystem
ai_summary: Viva Pulse authors can now use M365 Copilot to create and edit surveys quickly. This feature impacts users involved in survey creation and feedback collection.

title: Microsoft 365 admin center: Copilot - Billing and usage - Standalone consumption of prepaid capacity pack credits
description: Use a prepaid capacity pack as the sole billing method for supported Copilot experiences. Admins can configure billing policies with prepaid capacity such that usage for users in the policy is deducted exclusively from prepaid capacity credits, with no pay as you go charges.
ai_summary: Admins can now use prepaid capacity packs as the sole billing method for Copilot experiences in the Microsoft 365 admin center. This impacts billing management for IT admins.

title: Microsoft Edge: Summarization, Translation, and Citation will soon be supported by Microsoft Copilot and Microsoft 365 Copilot Chat in our menus
description: Menus in Edge where the user has highlighted content in the browser will soon support a summarization, translation, and citation with Microsoft Copilot and Microsoft 365 Copilot Chat.
ai_summary: Microsoft Edge will soon support summarization, translation, and citation features through Copilot in highlighted content menus. This change affects users utilizing Edge for research.

title: Outlook: Grant mail delegate sharing permissions from the new Outlook
description: Delegate access for mailbox and folders can be granted from the new Outlook app. Users will be able to view the permissions granted for a mailboxes and folders. #newoutlookforwindows
ai_summary: The new Outlook app allows users to grant delegate access for mailboxes and folders directly. This change affects users managing shared mailbox access.

title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Local file support for Agent Mode in Excel
description: Extending support for modern Excel workbooks stored on your device to Agent Mode in Excel, giving users the flexibility to use multi-step editing capabilities with Copilot in Excel no matter whether files are stored locally or in the cloud.
ai_summary: Excel's Agent Mode will support local files, allowing users to edit modern workbooks stored on their devices with Copilot. This change affects users working with Excel files locally.

title: Outlook: Insert signature into calendar events
description: Users can manually insert a signature into a calendar event like they can in the classic outlook. #newoutlookforwindows
ai_summary: Outlook will allow users to manually insert a signature into calendar events, similar to the classic version. This change affects all Outlook users.

title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Copilot can edit your document by default in Word
description: The default chat experience with Copilot in Word now allows Copilot to directly edit your document. All changes made by Copilot are fully reviewable and reversible, and users can turn this experience off if needed.
ai_summary: Copilot in Word will now be able to edit documents by default, with all changes being reviewable and reversible. This affects all Word users utilizing Copilot.

title: Microsoft Viva: Viva Pulse - Capture targeted Copilot sentiment from power and novice users
description: Enable change leaders to quickly identify and auto-populate Microsoft 365 Copilot power users and novice users based on organizational attributes and aggregated Copilot usage data. Automatic audience targeting in Viva Pulse will empower change leaders to capture sentiment on Copilot use cases, verbatims, and learnings with insights into whether specific audiences need more training or whether certain pockets of the organization would benefit from receiving upgraded Copilot licenses.
ai_summary: Viva Pulse will now identify and target power and novice users of Microsoft 365 Copilot to capture sentiment and training needs. This change impacts change leaders and administrators overseeing Copilot adoption.

title: Microsoft Viva: Viva Pulse - Measure Copilot sentiment to change manage and scale Copilot adoption
description: Add new Viva Pulse survey templates for Copilot readiness, adoption, and business value, with built-in entry points and reporting surfaced directly in the Copilot Dashboard. All Copilot templates are fully customizable in Pulse, with the ability to add or edit questions using Copilot authoring and the question library. Organizations can also easily upload pilot group users into Pulse via CSV to target surveys at the right audiences from day one.
ai_summary: New survey templates for measuring Copilot readiness and adoption will be added to Viva Pulse, allowing organizations to customize and target surveys effectively. This affects administrators managing Copilot feedback.

title: Microsoft Defender for Office 365: Admins can hunt on calls in Microsoft Teams
description: Security admins with Defender for Office 365 Plan 2 can hunt on calls and meetings made inside Microsoft Teams for their organization
ai_summary: Security admins using Defender for Office 365 Plan 2 can now search for calls and meetings within Microsoft Teams for their organization.

title: Microsoft Purview compliance portal: Data Lifecycle Management - Bulk replacement or removal of a retention label
description: Admins can perform a bulk replacement or removal of a retention label using the Purview compliance portal. They can perform the action across the entire tenant or targeted to specific content using KQL and static or adaptive scopes.
ai_summary: Admins can now bulk replace or remove retention labels in the Purview compliance portal across the tenant or specific content. This change impacts compliance and data management roles.

title: Microsoft Purview Compliance Portal: Service health dashboard
description: As a Microsoft Purview user, you'll be able to view outages, service issues, and advisories that might impact your services. This new dashboard will combine the services and solutions health of Purview, Microsoft 365 services, and Azure Cloud Services in one central place in the Purview portal, eliminating the need to go to several places to find this information.
ai_summary: Microsoft Purview users will gain access to a service health dashboard that consolidates outages and service issues across Purview, Microsoft 365, and Azure. This change benefits all Purview users.

title: SharePoint: Plan and Create Pages with AI
description: This feature allows you to edit new and existing pages with an AI chat pane. Now, with just prompts, you can add webparts, grounding documents, and refine the visuals and text on your page.
ai_summary: SharePoint will introduce an AI chat pane for editing pages, allowing users to enhance content easily. This affects SharePoint users creating or editing pages.

title: Windows 365: Frontline in Shared mode  availability for Switzerland North, Switzerland West, Norway East, Norway East, Norway West, UAE central, UAE north
description: Windows 365 Frontline in Shared mode availability for Switzerland West, Norway West, UAE central
ai_summary: Windows 365 Frontline in Shared mode will be available in Switzerland North, Switzerland West, Norway East, and UAE Central. This change affects frontline workers in these regions.

title: Windows 365: Frontline in Shared mode availability for Germany West Central, Korea Central, Korea South
description: Windows 365 Frontline in Shared Mode is expanding to Korea Central, helping frontline workers in these regions to securely share Cloud PCs across shifts.
ai_summary: Windows 365 Frontline in Shared mode will expand to Germany West Central and Korea regions, enabling secure sharing of Cloud PCs for frontline workers. This change impacts users in these areas.

title: Microsoft 365 Admin Center: M365 Copilot - Billing and usage - Usage insights
description: As you enable M365 Copilot Chat pay-as-you-go billing, AI administrators can view usage insights to inform agent management decisions. This feature displays the cost and number of messages in total and per agent. Cost and usage details can be filtered by billing policy and date range.
ai_summary: In the Microsoft 365 Admin Center, AI administrators can view usage insights for M365 Copilot Chat billing, including costs and message counts. This aids in agent management decisions.

title: Microsoft Purview: Data Loss Prevention - Unmanaged cloud app discovery and protection with Microsoft Purview and Palo Alto Prisma Access
description: Microsoft Purview network data security now integrates with Palo Alto Prisma Access, extending discovery and protection to network traffic. With this integration, new and existing Palo Alto Prisma Access customers can configure Microsoft Purview collection and data loss prevention policies to discover and protect sensitive data shared with unmanaged cloud apps via HTTP/HTTPS, using the same classifiers, sensitive information types, and sensitivity labels used in other Purview policies. This integration further enriches Purview Data Security Posture Management (DSPM), Insider Risk Management (IRM), enables data security & compliance for AI interactions, and more.
ai_summary: Microsoft Purview will integrate with Palo Alto Prisma Access for unmanaged cloud app discovery and protection, enhancing data security. This affects users of both Purview and Prisma Access.

title: Outlook: Font Improvements in Outlook for Android
description: Now when composing emails, users can change the font color and add highlight color to their text. Additionally, users will now have easy access to recently used fonts in the font list.
ai_summary: Outlook for Android will allow users to change font colors and highlight text while composing emails, improving formatting options. This affects Outlook mobile users.

title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Create interactive visuals in Copilot Pages
description: Create an interactive report, visualization, or dashboard using Copilot Pages. Copilot uses web data and the latest LLM models and can also ground responses in your Work data.
ai_summary: Microsoft Copilot can now create interactive reports and dashboards using web data and organizational data. This change affects users utilizing Copilot Pages for data visualization.

title: Microsoft 365 Admin Center: Usage reports - Message consumption for Pay-as-you-go experiences in Copilot Chat.
description: A new report to help IT admins manage costs for billed messages that are Pay-as-you-go enabled for Copilot Chat. Reporting includes drill down of billed messages per user, per billing policy, per agent-level and agent-user level pair. #copilotcontrolsystem
ai_summary: A new report will help IT admins track costs for billed messages in Copilot Chat, providing detailed usage data per user and agent. This impacts cost management for IT admins.

title: SharePoint: Entra B2B integration for external sharing in OneDrive & SharePoint
description: OneDrive and SharePoint will use Microsoft Entra B2B as the invitation and authentication method for external users, replacing the legacy SharePoint One Time Passcode (SPO OTP) experience. External sharing will automatically create B2B guest accounts in your directory, delivering consistent external collaboration across Microsoft 365, stronger guest identity management, and modern security aligned with Microsoft Entra standards.
ai_summary: OneDrive and SharePoint will use Microsoft Entra B2B for external sharing, replacing the old One Time Passcode method. This change affects administrators managing external collaboration.

title: Microsoft Purview Compliance Portal: Information Protection - Admin unit scoping in Content Explorer and Data Explorer
description: This feature introduces Admin Unit scoping to both Content Explorer and Data Explorer, enabling more granular visibility and control over M365 data. It ensures that data exploration respects organizational boundaries defined by Admin Units, enhancing compliance and governance.
ai_summary: The Microsoft Purview Compliance Portal will introduce Admin Unit scoping in Content Explorer and Data Explorer for better data control. This change affects compliance and governance roles.

title: Outlook: View, edit & share Copilot Pages with Outlook for Android
description: Users can now view, edit and share Copilot Pages with Outlook for Android, making it easier to continue working with Copilot and colleagues while on the go.
ai_summary: Outlook for Android will now support viewing, editing, and sharing Copilot Pages. This change benefits users needing mobile access to Copilot features.

title: Microsoft Purview compliance portal: Data Loss Prevention – Restrict access action support for sematic models and lakehouses in Fabric
description: Your organization can now control who can access your data depending on the sensitive information detected in Fabric semantic models and lakehouses. DLP restrict access action allows you to block access to guest users or all users depending on what labels or sensitive information types matches your semantic models or lakehouses. This is in addition to the ability already supported by DLP policies to audit and notify users via Policy Tips based on sensitive content within Fabric semantic models and lakehouses.
ai_summary: Organizations can now restrict access to sensitive data in Fabric semantic models and lakehouses using Data Loss Prevention (DLP) policies. This allows blocking access based on detected sensitive information.

title: PowerPoint: Create and Edit images with the model of your choice
description: You can now choose your preferred image model including OpenAI’s GPT Image, Flux, or Auto for smart, dynamic selection when creating or editing images with Copilot in PowerPoint, or when generating a new presentation or page.
ai_summary: PowerPoint users can select their preferred image model for creating and editing images with Copilot, including options like OpenAI’s GPT Image. This enhances image generation capabilities.

title: Outlook: Multiple Intune Accounts for Outlook on iOS
description: Multiple MAM (Mobile Application Management) Intune Accounts will now be supported in Outlook for iOS. Only one MDM (mobile device management) account will be supported at a time per device.
ai_summary: Outlook on iOS will support multiple Intune accounts for Mobile Application Management, though only one mobile device management account can be active at a time. This change impacts users with multiple accounts.

title: SharePoint: Lists as a knowledge source for agents in SharePoint and OneDrive
description: We’re introducing support for Microsoft Lists as a knowledge source for custom agents in SharePoint and OneDrive. These custom agents can now ground responses in a list stored on a SharePoint site or your OneDrive.
ai_summary: SharePoint and OneDrive will support Microsoft Lists as a knowledge source for custom agents, enabling these agents to provide responses based on list data. This impacts users creating custom agents.

title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Discover graph connector prompts in the Prompt Gallery when using Copilot Chat
description: Popular graph connector prompts will now be available in the Prompt Gallery for use in Copilot Chat.
ai_summary: Copilot Chat will now include popular graph connector prompts in the Prompt Gallery for easier access. This affects users utilizing Copilot Chat.

title: Microsoft Purview compliance portal: Data Lifecycle Management - Bulk replacement or removal of a retention label
description: Admins can perform a bulk replacement or removal of a retention label using the Purview compliance portal. They can perform the action across the entire tenant or targeted to specific content using KQL and static or adaptive scopes.
ai_summary: Admins can now bulk replace or remove retention labels in the Microsoft Purview compliance portal, affecting all or specific content using KQL. This change impacts compliance management for all admins.

title: Microsoft Purview compliance portal: Endpoint Data Loss Prevention - Optical Character Recognition (OCR) on Mac Endpoints
description: Purview policies like Data loss prevention (DLP) auto labelling can scan for sensitive content in most of the textual files, but images are not supported for content scanning today on Mac endpoint devices. We are adding OCR support on Mac endpoints to detect sensitive content in images and apply policies to protect these images.
ai_summary: Microsoft Purview will add Optical Character Recognition (OCR) support for detecting sensitive content in images on Mac endpoints. This change impacts compliance admins managing data protection.

title: Outlook: Show teammates' calendars in the left navigation pane
description: Users can now see their teammates' calendars (including peers, direct reports, and managers) automatically displayed in the left navigation pane of the new outlook. #newoutlookforwindows
ai_summary: Outlook will display teammates' calendars in the left navigation pane, making it easier for users to view their colleagues' schedules.

title: Outlook: Upgraded Video and Audio Player for iOS
description: Preview videos and audio files with an improved player directly in the Outlook iOS mobile app. The enhanced player provides updated controls and a smoother playback experience.
ai_summary: The Outlook iOS app will have an upgraded video and audio player for better playback and controls.

title: Windows 365: Windows 365 Link  - Market Expansion
description: Windows 365 Link will be available for sale in Norway
ai_summary: Windows 365 Link will be available for sale in Norway.

title: Microsoft Purview compliance portal: eDiscovery (Premium) - CMK (Customer Managed Keys) encryption support for data at-rest in Review sets
description: This release of eDiscovery features the implementation of customer-managed key (CMK) options, allowing users to manage their own encryption keys for the data stored in eDiscovery review sets in addition to the default, strong Microsoft-managed encryption already in place.
ai_summary: eDiscovery in Microsoft Purview now supports customer-managed keys for data encryption in review sets. This change affects compliance and legal teams managing sensitive data.

title: PowerPoint: Create and Edit images with the model of your choice
description: You can now choose your preferred image model including OpenAI’s GPT Image, Flux, or Auto for smart, dynamic selection when creating or editing images with Copilot in PowerPoint, or when generating a new presentation or page.
ai_summary: PowerPoint users can now select their preferred image model, such as OpenAI’s GPT Image, for creating and editing images with Copilot. This change affects users working with presentations.

title: Microsoft Viva: Engage Event Analytics
description: New analytics experiences available that complement the new Viva Engage Events.
ai_summary: New analytics features are being added to Microsoft Viva Engage Events to enhance user insights. This affects users utilizing Viva for event management.

title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): See a summary from Copilot of the latest changes and comments in the Word, Excel, and PowerPoint backstage view.
description: Use Copilot in the backstage view, accessible from the tile tab or start menu, to see a summary of the latest changes and comments made to your Word, Excel, and PowerPoint files before opening them.
ai_summary: Copilot will provide a summary of recent changes and comments in Word, Excel, and PowerPoint files in the backstage view before opening them.

title: Microsoft Viva: [Engage] More for you feed when opening posts
description: When viewing Engage notifications from the Teams Activity app, users will also see other trending posts in their organization.
ai_summary: In Microsoft Teams, users will see additional trending posts in the Engage notifications, enhancing visibility of organizational content.

title: OneDrive: Improved Shared file experience on iPhone and iPad
description: The OneDrive Shared view on iPhone and iPad now features a streamlined two-tab layout. The "With you" tab shows files others have shared with you, while the "By you" tab displays files you've shared. Quickly find shared content with new sorting options and file type filters, plus see recent sharing and editing activity at a glance.
ai_summary: OneDrive on iPhone and iPad will have an improved shared file experience with a new two-tab layout for easier access to shared files. This change affects users accessing shared content on mobile devices.

title: Microsoft 365: Information Barriers (IB) upgrading from IB v1 to IB v2 with new capabilities
description: Information Barriers (IB) V2 brings new capabilities including larger segment scale support, multi-segment support, and flexible people discoverability etc. Existing IB v1 tenants require an upgrade to IB v2 to take advantage of these new capabilities. This roadmap item is intended only for all IB v1 customers. All other customers will get IB v2 capabilities when they enable IB in their tenants. IB v2 upgrade will be opt-in.
ai_summary: Information Barriers (IB) is upgrading from v1 to v2, offering new capabilities. This change affects existing IB v1 customers who need to opt-in for the upgrade.

title: OneDrive: Improved finding and browsing document libraries on iPhone and iPad
description: OneDrive now makes it easier to find and access your SharePoint document libraries on your iPhone and iPad. Search for libraries by name, browse an updated Libraries view with recent and alphabetical sorting, and navigate directly to the site's default document library for ease of access. Whether you're on the go or working remotely, you can quickly locate and open organizational content that matters to you.
ai_summary: OneDrive improves access to SharePoint document libraries on iPhone and iPad, allowing users to search and browse libraries more easily. This change affects mobile users accessing organizational content.

title: Outlook: Save calendar events as .ics
description: Users can now save calendar events as .ics in #newoutlookforwindows
ai_summary: Outlook users can now save calendar events as .ics files, facilitating easier sharing and management of events. This impacts users managing calendar events in Outlook.

title: SharePoint: AI in SharePoint can generate code to translate your intent into reliable workflows
description: AI in SharePoint can now generate code which allows it to take what you ask and build the behind-the-scenes instructions or "helper programs" needed to actually do the work, like generating reports.
ai_summary: AI in SharePoint can now generate code to automate workflows based on user requests. This change affects SharePoint users and developers.

title: Outlook: Multiselect events on calendar surface
description: Users can now multi-select events on calendar surface and perform bulk operations like open, copy -paste, delete & categorize in #newoutlookforwindows, similar to classic Outlook.
ai_summary: Outlook now supports multi-selecting calendar events for bulk actions like open, copy-paste, delete, and categorize. This change affects users of the new Outlook for Windows.

title: OneDrive: Sync Support for up to 1 million items on Windows
description: OneDrive Sync supports syncing up to 1 million items on Windows devices, helping teams manage large document libraries and shared content at scale without compromising access across devices. This preview requires the Insiders ring and that devices meet minimum hardware and configuration requirements. Devices that don't meet these requirements continue to sync at the existing 300,000-item supported limit with no disruption.
ai_summary: OneDrive Sync will support syncing up to 1 million items on Windows, enhancing management of large libraries. This affects users on devices meeting the new requirements.

title: SharePoint: File Actions in SharePoint
description: With AI in SharePoint, you can find, analyze, and organize files all from chat. SharePoint understands complex requests like "rename these files by date" or "move old reports to an archive folder." It analyzes your library, suggests a plan, and executes it with your approval, saving you time and effort.
ai_summary: SharePoint will enable AI-driven file actions, allowing users to manage files through chat commands. This feature impacts users who frequently organize and analyze files in SharePoint.

title: Microsoft Agent 365: Registry sync
description: Connect to external AI platforms to discover agents created outside Microsoft and automatically sync them into the Agent 365 registry for more complete agent visibility and governance.
ai_summary: Microsoft Agent 365 will allow syncing of external AI agents into its registry for better visibility and governance. This feature impacts administrators managing AI agents.

title: SharePoint: Admin Center - Data Access Governance - Permission report for a given group
description: A single group with broad membership or a special group for vendors etc. - can expose sensitive content to unintended recipients. With this new report, SharePoint admins can now see every site a group can access and the extent of that access.
ai_summary: SharePoint admins can now generate a report showing all sites a specific group can access and the level of access, helping to manage sensitive content exposure. This change affects SharePoint administrators.

title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Additional meeting results in Copilot responses
description: Today, Copilot can show up to 25 meeting results, which can limit visibility in larger calendars. We’re expanding this limit so you can see more relevant meetings at once making it easier to find, review, and act on the full context you need.
ai_summary: Microsoft Copilot will now display more than 25 meeting results, improving visibility for users with larger calendars. This change affects users utilizing Copilot for meeting management.

title: SharePoint: Power Automate trigger and action for forms in SharePoint
description:
We are introducing new Power Automate integration capabilities for forms in SharePoint, enabling customers to create automated workflows based on responses collected using list forms, file upload forms, and document generation forms. 
With this update, a new trigger and action are now available in Power Automate:
Trigger: When a form is submitted
This operation triggers a flow when a list form, document generation form, or file upload form is submitted. Customers can use this trigger to initiate automated workflows such as approvals, notifications, or routing based on form submission events.

Action: Get form metadata

This action retrieves the metadata of a form, which includes the form ID, title, link, form type, output format, and the form questions used to collect information. This enables Power Automate flows to dynamically read form schema before executing downstream automation logic.
Disclaimer: Document generation forms are part of AI in SharePoint Public Preview. Access to DocGen Forms capabilities may be limited to customers enrolled in the preview program. List forms and file upload forms are not part of the AI in SharePoint preview.
ai_summary: SharePoint will introduce new Power Automate triggers and actions for forms, allowing automated workflows based on form submissions. This change affects users who create and manage forms in SharePoint.

title: Universal Print: Scan with Universal Print
description: I can scan documents using my regular scanning capable multi-functional-printer and will get an email notification that my scan is ready to download.
ai_summary: Universal Print will enable users to scan documents using multi-functional printers and receive email notifications when scans are ready. This affects users of Universal Print.

title: Outlook: Export to PDF (preserving sensitivity labels)
description: Ability to create PDFs from email messages and preserve Sensitivity labels. This feature is accessible from File -> Open & Export -> Create PDF.

title: Microsoft Purview: Insider Risk Management – Pay-as-you-go model for Other Generative AI apps indicators
description: Other AI apps will move to pay-as-you-go model. Microsoft Copilot experiences indicators can still be used for free even without subscription. To continue using Other AI apps indicators, please link an Azure subscription to Microsoft Purview to enable billing. Insider Risk Management indicators transitioning to a pay-as-you-go pricing model: “Entering risky prompt in Other AI apps”. This indicator is present in Policy indicators-> Generative AI apps -> Other AI apps Microsoft Purview Insider Risk Management correlates various signals to identify potential malicious or inadvertent insider risks, such as IP theft, data leakage, and security violations. Insider Risk Management enables customers to create policies to manage security and compliance. Built with privacy by design, users are pseudonymized by default, and role-based access controls and audit logs are in place to help ensure user-level privacy. ​
ai_summary: Microsoft Purview will transition to a pay-as-you-go model for indicators related to Other Generative AI apps, affecting billing for users of these apps.

title: Microsoft Viva: Viva Glint - Self service for historical imports
description: This feature will introduce an alternative solution to the existing Advanced Configurations feature that allows an Admin to perform historical imports into the Viva Glint platform. This alternate reduces the number of needed files and offers a simplified user experience to bring historical data into Viva Glint.
ai_summary: Admins can now perform historical imports into the Viva Glint platform with a simplified process, reducing the number of required files.

title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Dynamic Tool Discovery for Declarative Agents and Federated Copilot Connectors
description: We're introducing dynamic tool discovery for declarative agents in Microsoft 365 Copilot. Developers can now add, update, or retire tools on their MCP servers without republishing the agent - so end users get the latest agent capabilities immediately, with no deployment cycle in between. Support for federated Copilot connectors will be a fast follow to declarative agents at a later stage. Dynamic tool discovery is backed by Microsoft's enterprise RAI and security protections, and customers retain full control over agent deployment and availability to users and groups.

title: Microsoft Copilot Studio: Invoke agents as workflow steps with the agent node
description: Add an agent node to your workflow to reason over data, call tools, and return a response, all within a single step. The agent node lets you embed reasoning directly into your workflow. This means fewer manual handoffs, faster processing times, and workflows that can handle nuanced decisions without additional development effort, helping teams automate more of their end-to-end processes and reduce operational overhead.

title: Microsoft Copilot Studio: Use MCP-compliant tools in agent workflows
description: Integrate proprietary systems, dynamic knowledge sources, and custom actions into your agentic workflows with MCP support, accelerating extensibility while preserving workflow reliability. This integration improves reuse across agents and workflows, reduces duplication of integrations, and embraces an emerging open and extensible agent ecosystem.

title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Copilot People Connectors introduces people data ingestions with differentiated access control
description: Copilot People Connector now supports importing people data with access controls into Microsoft 365. This release enables organizations to bring people data from external systems into Microsoft 365 along with associated access control lists (ACLs), ensuring Copilot respects existing permissions defined in source systems. The imported data can be scoped to specific individuals and groups, allowing Copilot to reason over people data while honoring access restrictions.

title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Work IQ APIs: Researcher Agent Access
description: Allows developers to invoke the Researcher agent through the Work IQ endpoint to perform multi‑step analysis, deep reasoning, and synthesis across enterprise content as part of agentic workflows.

title: Outlook: Calendar mini-month non-consecutive date selection updates
description: You can now use Shift+Click or CTRL+Click to select non-consecutive dates in the calendar mini-month. This will allow you to easily view and take action on the dates you care about. #newoutlookforwindows
ai_summary: Outlook now allows Shift+Click or CTRL+Click to select non-consecutive dates in the calendar mini-month, improving date management. This affects Outlook users.

title: Outlook: Calendar Conditional Formatting in New Outlook
description: Users can now apply basic conditional formatting rules to the calendar in new Outlook, allowing events and appointments to be color-coded based on sender, location, attendees, and more. #newoutlookforwindows
ai_summary: Users can apply basic conditional formatting rules to their calendar in the new Outlook, enabling color-coding of events based on various criteria. This affects all users of the new Outlook.

title: Outlook: Navigate Your Favorite Folders Without Expanding the Folder Pane
description: You can now quickly switch between your favorite folders without opening the full folder pane. When the pane is collapsed, your favorite folders appear as a vertical list, giving you one-click access to the folders you use most. Each folder shows unread or total counts so you always know what needs attention. Right-click any favorite for the same options you're used to, and your selections stay put across sessions. It's a familiar experience for anyone who loved favorites in classic Outlook, now built right into the new Outlook. #newoutlookforwindows

title: Outlook: Calendar support in Online Archive
description: Add calendar support in Online Archive.
ai_summary: Outlook will now support calendar functionality in Online Archive, enhancing user experience for those accessing archived calendar data.

title: Microsoft Purview: Insider Risk Management - Unified alert queue
description: We’re introducing a new unified alert triage experience in Insider Risk Management that brings agent‑driven insights directly into the standard Alerts queue. With this update, analysts can view agent categorizations alongside traditional alert filters and columns in a single, consolidated workflow. The updated alert details panel, enables faster investigation and action from the alerts list page by embedding agent insights directly into the alert experience. To support customer transition, the existing alert and agent triage experience will remain available for 60 days and can be accessed via the Alerts tabs under Users in the left navigation. Microsoft Purview Insider Risk Management correlates various signals to identify potential malicious or inadvertent insider risks, such as IP theft, data leakage, and security violations. Insider Risk Management enables customers to create policies based on their own internal policies, governance, and organizational requirements. Built with privacy by design, users are pseudonymized by default, and role-based access controls and audit logs are in place to help ensure user-level privacy.

title: Outlook: All Accounts view (Unified Inbox) brings your email into a single inbox view
description: The All-Accounts view, also known as Unified Inbox, lets you see emails from multiple accounts in a single inbox view in the new Outlook for Windows, without merging your mailboxes.   Each account's inbox stays separate; the view brings them together so you can triage in one place.  Users can read, delete, move, archive, and mark messages across accounts without switching between mailboxes.   The experience integrates with Copilot for AI-assisted email workflows and supports Immersive Search for finding messages across your primary account.   Advanced scenarios such as cross-account search and shared mailbox support will follow in later releases.

title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): MCP-Based Agent Enablement for U.S. Government Clouds
description: We’re introducing support for Model Context Protocol (MCP)-based agents in Microsoft 365 Copilot . This update enables developers to build Copilot agents using MCP servers and allows users to interact with these agents using familiar experiences. This change supports extensibility and improves agent capabilities for organizations.

title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Copilot Shortcuts for Pages on Mobile
description: Mobile users can utilize Copilot Shortcuts with suggested prompts to edit a Page.
ai_summary: Mobile users will gain access to Copilot Shortcuts for suggested prompts to edit Pages, enhancing mobile productivity. This change affects mobile users of Microsoft 365.

title: Microsoft 365 app: Add Search results as references to your Copilot Notebooks in the M365 Copilot app
description: Users can quickly add a Search result as a reference to a Copilot Notebook within the M365 Copilot app.
ai_summary: The Microsoft 365 app will allow users to add search results as references in Copilot Notebooks. This change impacts users utilizing the Copilot app for documentation.

title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Copilot suggested rename
description:
Copilot Suggested Rename is an AI-powered OneDrive feature that automatically recommends clear, descriptive file names based on a file’s content—helping users organize and find their files more easily with minimal effort. What the feature does:
- Analyzes the content of a file to generate context-aware filename suggestions
- Presents 3 recommended names directly within the rename dialog
- Allows users to pick a suggestion with a single click
Where it shows up:
- Within the rename dialog for supported files
-  Within the post-upload toast notification when a single supported file is uploaded
Supported file types:
- Microsoft Office documents
Word (DOCX)
PowerPoint (PPTX)
Excel (XLSX)
- Other document formats
PDF
Markdown (MD)
- Images

title: Outlook: Sort improvements to the message list
description: When sorting on Outlook for Web or Outlook for Windows, if the Sort By field is not one of From, Subject, or Date Received, we will now show an additional column for the Sort By value (e.g., Size). We will also support sorting by Flag Due Date.

title: Outlook: Mail Merge (Advanced) on Outlook on the Web and new Outlook for Windows
description: Mail Merge (Basic) will be improved upon to allow fields to be replaced by values per email address. When Mail Merge (Advanced) is launched, not only will every recipient receive their own email with only their email address in the recipients list, but the emails can further be personalized to include content such as their name. #newoutlookforwindows
ai_summary: Outlook will enhance Mail Merge to allow personalized emails for each recipient, improving the feature in Outlook on the Web and new Outlook for Windows. This affects users who utilize Mail Merge.

title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Multiple Voice Styles in M365 Copilot voice chats
description: Users can select from multiple voice style options for their voice experience in M365 Copilot.

title: SharePoint: Agent Access Insights heatmap for SharePoint and OneDrive sites
description: Provides a visual heatmap of agent activity to help admins quickly detect patterns, hotspots, and unusual access behavior.

title: Microsoft 365 admin center: Notifications for organizational data processing status
description: With this feature, organizational data source admins receive email notifications when data processing through one of their configured connectors completes successfully or requires attention. Notifications are enabled by default with the option to unsubscribe.

title: SharePoint: Create Word, Excel, and PowerPoint files with AI
description: You can ask AI in SharePoint to create a Word, Excel or PowerPoint file based on the information you've gathered within SharePoint
ai_summary: SharePoint users can now use AI to create Word, Excel, and PowerPoint files based on gathered information. This affects all SharePoint users.

title: Microsoft Purview: Data Security Triage Agent - Sensitive Data Remediation through Microsoft Teams
description: The Data Security Triage Agent in Data Loss Prevention now offers a new sensitive data remediation function, which empowers organizations to proactively identify and remediate sensitive information—such as Social Security Numbers, passwords, and credit card data—across thousands of files stored in SharePoint or OneDrive locations, dramatically increasing the percentage of remediated files with sensitive information, resulting in reduced compliance risk. Seamlessly integrated with Microsoft Purview, this new agent function automatically detects file(s) with a Data Loss Prevention (DLP) policy match “Needs Attention” alerts and pushes a remediation notification to the end user who last modified the file guiding them to remove sensitive data through targeted Microsoft Teams messages. Its’ closed-loop workflow ensures that remediation progress is tracked and confirmed, giving admins real-time visibility and control via the Data Security Posture Management dashboard. By streamlining sensitive data cleanup and automating user engagement, this agent helps organizations achieve their remediation goals at scale. Let the Data Security Triage Agent handle the heavy lifting of pushing remediation requests directly to the end user, so Purview admins don't have to!

title: Microsoft Viva: Viva Glint - Remove bulk users from closed survey
description: This feature enhancement will enable Viva Glint Admins to remove survey participants from closed surveys in bulk.
ai_summary: Viva Glint Admins can now remove multiple users from closed surveys in bulk. This change simplifies survey management for administrators.

title: OneDrive: Collaborate on Markdown files with co-authoring and autosave
description: We’re bringing co-authoring and autosave to Markdown files in OneDrive and SharePoint, making it easier for teams to collaborate on Markdown content directly in Microsoft 365. Multiple users will be able to edit the same Markdown file together in the web experience, with changes saved automatically, reducing the risk of lost work and removing the need to manually manage versions.

title: Outlook: S/MIME support for Shared Mailboxes and Delegate Mailboxes in New Outlook for Windows
description: New Outlook for Windows will extend S/MIME support to shared mailboxes and delegate mailboxes associated with a user's primary account. Users will be able to sign, encrypt, decrypt, and reply to S/MIME-protected messages while working from shared and delegated mailboxes. #newoutlookforwindows

title: Excel: Summarize text columns with Copilot
description: Copilot can analyze columns of text to generate related categories or tags. For example, Copilot will find the main themes in survey responses from open-ended questions.

title: Outlook: Export support for data files in Mac Outlook
description: This feature adds support for exporting PST files into Outlook for Mac.

title: Microsoft Purview compliance portal: Insider Risk Management - Microsoft Fabric risk indicators in Insider Risk Management
description:
With this update, Insider Risk Management extends its risk detection capabilities to Microsoft Fabric products by offering ready-to-use risk indicators based on activities that may lead to a data security incident in Power BI. Organizations can use these new indicators in data theft and data leaks policies.  

Microsoft Purview Insider Risk Management correlates various signals to identify potential malicious or inadvertent insider risks such as IP theft, data leakage, and security violations. Insider Risk Management enables customers to create policies based on their own internal policies, governance, and organizational requirements. Built with privacy by design, users are pseudonymized by default, and role-based access controls and audit logs are in place to help ensure user-level privacy.
ai_summary: Insider Risk Management in Microsoft Purview will now include risk indicators for Microsoft Fabric products, aiding in data security incident detection. This affects organizations using Power BI.

title: SharePoint: Inline comments and notifications for Markdown files
description: We’re adding inline commenting support for Markdown files in OneDrive and SharePoint, making it easier for teams to review, discuss, and collaborate on Markdown content directly in Microsoft 365. Users will be able to leave comments on specific parts of a Markdown file and receive notifications when they are mentioned or when there is activity that needs their attention.

title: Outlook: Block External Images Settings Update
description: Outlook on the web and the new Outlook for Windows now support will support new settings for loading external images. New settings will allow customers to block all external content, or to load all content by default if the customer admin allows. Existing default behavior will not be changed (load external content only for safe senders).

title: Microsoft Purview: Data Loss Prevention – Inline DLP for Prompts for Microsoft Foundry apps and agents
description: With Purview enabled in Microsoft Foundry, Purview admins can setup inline DLP policies to prompts on Foundry built apps and agents to ensure data loss prevention of sensitive data.
ai_summary: Purview enables inline DLP policies for prompts in Microsoft Foundry apps, helping admins protect sensitive data. This change affects Purview admins managing data loss prevention.

title: OneDrive: Find document libraries in OneDrive search results
description: We’re making it easier for users to find document libraries directly from OneDrive search results. When users search in OneDrive, relevant SharePoint document libraries may appear alongside files and folders, helping users quickly get back to shared team content without needing to navigate across multiple sites.

title: Microsoft Purview compliance portal: Data Lifecycle Management - Introduction of secure workflow to bypass legal holds and retention policies in Exchange
description: The first release of Priority cleanup enables admins to create a recurring exception to delete items under a broader retention policy and/or legal hold on Exchange workload. Creating a Priority cleanup will require a separate security role, multiple approvers, and will have a complete audit trail
ai_summary: Exchange admins can now create a recurring exception to delete items under legal holds and retention policies using a secure workflow. This requires a separate security role and multiple approvers.

title: Outlook: Bulk Opening/Closing calendar groups in the left nav
description: Users can now bulk select/deselect all calendars within a group on left rail in calendar in #newoutlookforwindows, similar to classic Outlook.
ai_summary: Outlook allows users to bulk select or deselect all calendars within a group in the left navigation. This feature is for users of the new Outlook for Windows.

title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Enhanced M365 Copilot Memory - Copilot is now personalized with work data
description: Copilot now uses M365 activity to provide more relevant, contextual responses. Updated settings make it easier to view and manage what Copilot remembers and your personalization preferences.

title: OneDrive: Find your group sites faster with the new My Sites tab in OneDrive for iOS
description: The new My Sites tab in the OneDrive iOS app gives you one place to find every group-connected SharePoint site you own or belong to. Instead of relying on recent files or search, you can browse a complete list of your sites and jump straight to their default document libraries — right from your iPhone or iPad. It's especially handy when you don't remember a site's name, haven't opened it recently, or were just added as a member of a new site, so you spend less time hunting and more time working with your team's content.

title: Microsoft Intune: Intune Suite - Unattended Remote Help for Windows - Remote Sign-in
description: Remotely access devices over the cloud without requiring end user involvement by signing in with credentials.
ai_summary: Microsoft Intune allows remote access to devices without user involvement by signing in with credentials. This change affects IT admins managing device support.

title: Microsoft Purview: Information Protection-Azure AI Search honors Purview labels and policies
description: Azure AI Search now ingests Microsoft Purview sensitivity labels and enforces corresponding protection policies through built-in indexers (SharePoint, OneLake, Azure Blob, ADLS Gen2). This enables secure, policy-aligned search over enterprise data, enabling agentic RAG scenarios where only authorized documents are returned or sent to LLMs, preventing data oversharing and aligning with enterprise data protection standards.
ai_summary: Azure AI Search will now respect Microsoft Purview sensitivity labels and enforce protection policies, ensuring secure search over enterprise data. This change affects users utilizing Azure AI Search.

title: Microsoft Purview compliance portal: Communication Compliance - Ability to set a retention period for a policy
description: Introducing the ability to define how long content captured by a Communication Compliance policy is retained. Microsoft Purview Communication Compliance provides the tools to help organizations detect regulatory compliance violations (e.g. SEC or FINRA), such as sensitive or confidential information, harassing or threatening language, and sharing of adult content. Built with privacy by design, usernames are pseudonymized by default, role-based access controls are built in, investigators are opted in by an admin, and audit logs are in place to help ensure user-level privacy.
ai_summary: Admins can now set retention periods for content captured by Communication Compliance policies in the Microsoft Purview compliance portal.

title: SharePoint: Neutral-themed SharePoint UI in Page Editing and Property Panes
description: Coming soon for SharePoint: Neutral-themed SharePoint UI will be expanded to page editing and property pane experiences. This update is part of the SharePoint visual refresh and applies our new design language across the SharePoint page editing surfaces, helping create a more consistent, accessible, and modern editing experience.

title: Universal Print: Badge API
description: Admins can map employee badge credentials (card or NFC) to user identities in Universal Print, enabling users to release secure print jobs at compatible printers with a simple tap—no app, PIN, or sign-in required at the device. This enhances existing badge-based release with a standardized, cloud-based identity mapping model integrated with Microsoft 365.

title: Microsoft Copilot Studio: Enforce safe sharing by detecting credential oversharing
description: This feature helps organizations reduce security risk by preventing agents and flows from being shared when they rely on unsafe identities, such as maker credentials. By detecting identity oversharing early and enforcing safe‑sharing policies at publish and share time, customers can avoid identity leakage, privilege escalation, and unintended access - while still allowing makers to build and iterate safely within approved guardrails.

title: Microsoft Entra: Upcoming changes to federatedTokenValidationPolicy default settings
description: The federatedTokenValidationPolicy is a resource type in Microsoft Graph (beta) that governs the validation of federated authentication tokens and allows customers to configure a rule to block logins where internalDomainFederation does not match UPN domain. The feature by default requires manual configuration in the tenant to prohibit cross-domain logins. To strengthen security with cross-domain sign-in we will change the default rule for federatedTokenValidationPolicy to block logins where internalDomainFederation does not match UPN domain. This internalDomainFederation object is typically created automatically during federation setup with AD federation server or other IdPs.

title: Planner: Local Custom Fields/Columns
description: Custom Fields let you tailor your plans to match the way your team works. Add Text, Number, Date, Yes/No, and Choice fields to capture the information that matters most. View and update custom fields across Board, Grid, and Task details, with support for sorting, filtering, grouping, and bulk editing to keep your work organized and easy to manage.

title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Improved content freshness using Copilot connectors with webhooks-led notifications
description: Copilot connectors will offer improved content freshness with more frequent sync of updates using webhook event notifications. The following connectors are in scope - Azure DevOps, Jira cloud, Confluence cloud, Trello, Asana, Bitbucket, GitHub and Gitlab.
ai_summary: Copilot connectors will improve content freshness by syncing updates more frequently through webhook notifications for various platforms like Azure DevOps and Jira. This affects users relying on these integrations.

title: Outlook: Improvements to Save Contacts on iPhone and iPad
description: Outlook contacts become available system-wide (caller ID, Phone, Messages, Siri) using Apple's Contact Provider framework — without full address-book access or copying contacts onto your device.

title: Microsoft Copilot Studio: Block the use of maker-provided credentials for authentication
description:
By blocking the use of maker's credentials by AI agents, admins can increase the security and compliance of agents in their organizations:
- Prevent unauthorized access to sensitive systems or data that the maker's credentials might have access to.
- Help organizations comply with data protection regulations (such as GDPR or HIPAA) by ensuring only authorized identities are used for data access.
- Enable IT and security teams to enforce organizational policies around identity and access management.
- Increase trust among stakeholders and IT departments, making it easier to adopt AI agents at scale.

title: Outlook: Notification when not responding to most recent message of email thread
description: When replying to an email conversation and the message being replied to is not the latest in the conversation, Outlook for Windows and web will now display a notification indicating this. With this change, users can now be more confident that they are responding to the right message in an email conversation. #newoutlookforwindows

title: Microsoft Purview: Data Loss Prevention - Endpoint DLP now detects sensitivity labels on files inside archives
description: Endpoint Data Loss Prevention (DLP) is changing the way archive files, such as  .zip  and similar container formats, are classified and enforced. This update  improves detection accuracy and gives administrators finer control over how content within archives is protected.

title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): [Copilot Extensibility] [Search UX] Enable customization of icon & name for data sources in Search (& chat)
description: Enable customization of icon & name for data sources in Search (& chat).
ai_summary: Users can customize the icon and name for data sources in Search and chat within Microsoft 365 Copilot.

title: Microsoft Copilot Studio: Use SharePoint lists as a knowledge source
description: Unlock the full value of your structured data by bringing SharePoint lists directly into your Microsoft Copilot Studio agents. With native support, customers can ground AI responses in up-to-date, business-critical data—such as tasks, inventory, customers, or operations—without manual data movement or complex integrations. This enables more accurate, context-aware copilots that reflect how your business runs, helping teams make faster decisions, reduce errors, and automate workflows with confidence.

title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Link meetings to CRM records automatically with AI
description: This feature saves you time by automatically connecting your meetings to the correct CRM records. You have the right deal insights at your fingertips when preparing for customer conversations, so you can focus less on updating records and more on selling with confidence and context.

title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Engage customers across multiple channels (web, voice, SMS & email)
description: A multi‑channel outreach capability, spanning web chat, voice, SMS, and email, is critical for meeting customers in the channel they naturally prefer and increasing the likelihood of timely engagement. By activating the agent across multiple surfaces, we ensure continuity of conversations, reduce drop‑off when a single channel fails, and support the FY27 goal of always‑on, end‑to‑end engagement from initial intent to close. This creates higher response rates, faster qualification, and a more seamless handoff to sales motions.

title: Viva Engage: My Team audiences and flexible targeting for leader communications
description: We’re introducing more flexible and precise targeting capabilities in Viva Engage, starting with Storyline Announcements. This new feature allows leaders and their delegates to define a custom audience at the time of posting, without relying on pre-configured Leader Audiences. Audiences can be built, and saved for reuse, using organizational attributes such as department, job title, or country, existing groups like M365 Groups, distribution lists, or security groups, and even individual users by name. This flexibility enables more relevant communication, helping leaders reach the right people with the right message. Notifications and delivery channels, including Teams and email, will continue to follow existing Storyline Announcement behavior, ensuring a seamless experience for recipients. This feature is designed to help leaders tailor communications to specific departments, locations, or groups, enhancing engagement and relevance across the organization.
ai_summary: Viva Engage is adding flexible targeting for Storyline Announcements, allowing leaders to define custom audiences based on various organizational attributes. This change affects communication strategies for leaders and their delegates.

title: Microsoft 365: Create full-workload backup policies for Microsoft 365 Backup
description: Automatically backup all Exchange or OneDrive users and/or SharePoint sites in the tenant and have the tool automatically add new users/sites to the backup policy.
ai_summary: Microsoft 365 Backup will allow the creation of full-workload backup policies for Exchange, OneDrive, and SharePoint, automatically including new users and sites. This affects administrators managing backup policies.

title: Microsoft Purview: Insider Risk Management - DS Triage Agent for IRM available in Defender
description:
We’re introducing support for Insider Risk Management (IRM) alert agent summaries within Microsoft Defender, enabling investigators to access key triage insights directly in the Defender alert queue.
When the IRM Triage Agent is active, IRM alerts surfaced in Microsoft Defender will now include the agent summary—such as agent categorization, investigation summary, identified risk patterns, and relevant user details—helping analysts quickly assess alert severity without leaving their existing Defender workflows.
For deeper analysis, investigators can access the full IRM investigation experience within the Microsoft Purview portal.
Microsoft Purview Insider Risk Management correlates various signals to identify potential malicious or inadvertent insider risks, such as IP theft, data leakage, and security violations. Insider Risk Management enables customers to create policies based on their own internal policies, governance, and organizational requirements. Built with privacy by design, users are pseudonymized by default, and role-based access controls and audit logs are in place to help ensure user-level privacy.

title: SharePoint: Create new workflows with Copilot in SharePoint
description: Describe a workflow intent such as "when files are set to status = Complete, post a message in my Teams chat" and Copilot in SharePoint will assemble the necessary triggers, conditions, and actions to setup your workflow. You can come back to Copilot in SharePoint at any time to make changes or click "Workflows" from the command bar to see your live workflow.

title: Microsoft 365 app: New Copilot Notebooks design in the Microsoft 365 Copilot App (Android)
description: Copilot Notebooks in the Microsoft 365 Copilot app (Android) now lets users organize related chats, output creations, and references into a persistent AI workspace. Copilot uses the Notebook's accumulated context to ground responses, so work continues across sessions instead of starting over each time.

title: Thumbnail view for PDFs is available in OneDrive and SharePoint on the web
description:
We are improving PDF navigation in OneDrive and SharePoint on the web by adding a thumbnail view in the PDF viewer. Users will be able to open a thumbnail panel to visually browse pages in a PDF and jump directly to a selected page.
This update helps users navigate long PDFs more quickly, especially when they need to find a visual section, page layout, chart, image, or form page without scrolling page by page.
