title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Improved content freshness using Copilot connectors with webhooks-led notifications
description: Copilot connectors will offer improved content freshness with more frequent sync of updates using webhook event notifications. The following connectors are in scope - Azure DevOps, Jira cloud, Confluence cloud, Trello, Asana, Bitbucket, GitHub and Gitlab.
ai_summary: Copilot connectors will improve content freshness by syncing updates more frequently through webhook notifications for various platforms like Azure DevOps and Jira. This affects users relying on these integrations.

title: Microsoft Copilot Studio: Enable express mode for flows invoked by an agent or app
description: Express mode ensures agents and apps receive timely and reliable responses by dramatically accelerating flow run times. This reduces flow failures, improves user experience, and eliminates costly interruptions caused by timeout issues. Organizations benefit from more dependable automations, higher adoption, and smoother operational workflows.

title: Microsoft Purview: Insider Risk Management- Insider risk management for agents
description:
As AI agents become deeply embedded in enterprise ecosystems, they are evolving beyond simple tools or workflows into a digital workforce. These agents can interpret intent, access and manipulate enterprise data, execute actions and even make real-time decisions. In many ways, they operate like human insiders only with machine-speed data processing capabilities. 

To govern and protect these agents effectively, Microsoft Purview Insider Risk Management is being expanded to agents, with specific indicators and insider risk score built for agents based on agentic activities. 

Microsoft Purview Insider Risk Management correlates various signals to identify potential malicious or inadvertent insider risks, such as IP theft, data leakage, and security violations. Insider Risk Management enables customers to create policies based on their own internal policies, governance, and organizational requirements. Built with privacy by design, users are pseudonymized by default, and role-based access controls and audit logs are in place to help ensure user-level privacy.
ai_summary: Microsoft Purview will expand Insider Risk Management to include AI agents, allowing for monitoring and risk scoring based on their activities. This change affects organizations using AI agents.

title: Microsoft Purview: Information Protection- New Summary Metrics in Content Explorer for Unscanned Files and Classification History Details
description:
Enhance Content Explorer by introducing new summary metrics that provide better visibility into scanning and classification activities. This update will include:
1. Unscanned Files Summary
Displays the count and percentage of files that have not been scanned for classification, helping admins identify gaps and take corrective action.
2. Classification History Insights
Shows trends and details of classification changes over time, helping admins to discover the stale data in their organization
ai_summary: Content Explorer in Microsoft Purview will feature new summary metrics for unscanned files and classification history. This update helps admins monitor scanning and classification activities.

title: SharePoint: Enterprise store plugins in Copilot in SharePoint
description:
Copilot in SharePoint now supports plugins from your enterprise store. A plugin can bundle skills, MCP servers, and other capabilities that extend what Copilot can do. Any plugin made available to your organization, whether installed tenant-wide by an admin or added by you, works directly in Copilot in SharePoint, all governed by your M365 admin.

For example, your organization can publish a company-wide accessibility plugin once and have it work consistently across all agentic products, including Copilot in SharePoint, so everyone gets the same accessible experience wherever they work.

title: SharePoint: Personal Skills in Copilot in SharePoint
description: Create your own personal skills in Copilot in SharePoint and use them anywhere you work. Personal skills travel with you across SharePoint sites and OneDrive—so a skill like document generation works everywhere without recreating it per site. You own your skills, saved as a markdown file in your OneDrive.

title: Microsoft Purview: Endpoint Data Loss Prevention: Add control to include or exclude Default file paths exclusions for Windows
description: Previously customers would have system files either included or excluded manually configured. With this feature there is now a capability to provide this by default and have the option of including or excluding those paths. This list is managed by Microsoft to ensure accuracy and ease of management.
ai_summary: Microsoft Purview will add a control for Endpoint Data Loss Prevention to include or exclude default file path exclusions for Windows, simplifying management for admins. This impacts IT administrators managing data loss prevention settings.

title: Microsoft Viva: Viva Glint - Copilot assisted commenting in Glint survey taking
description: Viva Glint survey takers will be able to use a streamlined version of Microsoft Copilot in the Glint survey taking experience to help them rewrite their comments, helping survey takers feel more confident about the feedback they’re providing. By increasing perceived security through reducing identifiable writing patterns and minimizing the effort required to refine feedback, this experience can encourage greater participation, longer responses, and more candid comments, which can drive higher engagement and richer insights from surveys.
ai_summary: Viva Glint survey takers can now use Microsoft Copilot to assist with commenting, enhancing feedback quality and participation. This change affects users participating in Glint surveys.

title: Microsoft Purview: Data Lifecycle Management - Power Automate integration with records management
description: Initiate a Power Automate workflow when the item reaches the end of its retention period. For example, execute a complex disposition approval process or move the file to an archive.
ai_summary: Microsoft Purview will integrate Power Automate with records management to initiate workflows when items reach their retention period. This affects administrators managing data retention.

title: Microsoft Purview: Purview Information Protection | Classifier Simulation Mode (Health Monitoring)
description:
Microsoft Purview introduces the Classifier Simulation Mode, the first phase of the broader Classifier Health Monitoring Platform. 
 
This capability enables you to test, analyze, and optimize custom classifiers on production data before publishing them, hence offering a reliable means of verifying the effectiveness of classifiers before committing them to live environments.  

Custom classifiers are powerful tools but can sometimes include inefficient regex patterns or overly broad logic, leading to Noisy classifier due to high matches, False positives and High scanning latency 

Simulation Mode mitigates these risks by allowing you to validate classifier quality and performance before publishing, helping ensure healthy, performant, and more precise classification outcomes.
ai_summary: Microsoft Purview introduces Classifier Simulation Mode for testing custom classifiers. This feature is for admins managing data classification.

title: Microsoft Viva: Copilot Analytics - Agent 365 Dashboard in Insights
description: Customers can now access their Agent 365 data through the Agent Dashboard in Copilot Analytics (Insights), enabling leaders to understand activity across all agents registered through Agent 365. Customers with Agent 365 and Copilot will now see the Agent 365 Dashboard with the ability to view historical data in Agent Dashboard.

title: Microsoft Purview: Data Loss Prevention - AI Powered Data Loss Prevention Policy Optimizer
description: DLP Policy Optimizer uses AI to analyze your organization’s DLP policies, rule structure, and activity signals to identify optimization opportunities that are difficult to detect manually. It highlights overlapping rules, redundant conditions, misconfigurations, and sources of excessive noise, and presents prioritized recommendations with supporting evidence and suggested actions. This enables you to reduce false positives and alert noise, improve policy precision, and simplify policy management with confidence.

title: Microsoft Viva: Engage: Detect moderated themes in images
description: Engages theme moderation feature is a powerful AI tool to monitor and moderate content. With this update, images can now match to themes, just like text.
ai_summary: Viva Engage will now detect moderated themes in images, enhancing content moderation capabilities. This change affects users utilizing Viva Engage for content management.

title: Microsoft Purview compliance portal: Data Loss Prevention - Trigger Power automate workflows as outcome of DLP rule match
description: This introduces a new DLP rule action to trigger custom Power automate workflows when a DLP rule is violated.
ai_summary: Microsoft Purview compliance portal will allow DLP rules to trigger custom Power Automate workflows when violations occur. This affects compliance administrators managing data loss prevention policies.

title: OneDrive: Block screen capture for sensitivity-labeled PDFs in the OneDrive and SharePoint web viewer
description: The OneDrive and SharePoint web PDF viewer will block screen capture in Microsoft Edge when users open PDFs whose sensitivity (MIP) label without Copy (EXTRACT) permission.

title: Microsoft Viva: Copilot Analytics - Agent 365 dashboard for managers
description: Managers in organizations can now access their Agent 365 data through the Agent Dashboard in Copilot Analytics (Insights), enabling them to understand activity across all agents registered through Agent 365. Customers with Agent 365 and Copilot will now see the Agent 365 Dashboard with the ability to view historical data in Agent Dashboard.

title: Outlook: All Day events to show up more clearly in the Mail module Calendar Preview
description: We're making it easier to tell when receiving meeting invites that conflict with scheduled Out of Office time or Busy All Day events, on Outlook Web and Outlook for Windows.

title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Use Agent 365 agents within Microsoft 365 Copilot Chat and Declarative Agents
description: Agents that are published to Agents 365 are already managed in the Microsoft 365 Admin Center. If the agent implements the Agent2Agent protocol, it can be used as a connected agent for the agents that users build in Agent Builder or Copilot Studio.

title: Microsoft Copilot Studio: Share Autonomous Agents to End Users (Run-Only)
description: Previously, autonomous agents could only be used and managed by makers, limiting their reach to the people who needed them. Run-only sharing enables makers to securely share autonomous agents with end users, allowing users to benefit from agent-driven automation without requiring edit permissions or ownership. This extends autonomous agent capabilities to a broader audience while maintaining governance and control.

title: SharePoint: Flexible Section Authoring Improvements
description: We've enhanced Flexible Sections in SharePoint Pages to make page layout creation more intuitive and predictable. Authors can now use visual column layout guides that mirror familiar sections, keep gridlines and layout guides visible while editing, and convert existing sections into Flexible Sections with a single click while preserving content placement. These improvements help authors create richer page designs with greater confidence and consistency across desktop, mobile, and email experiences.

title: Microsoft Purview: Data Loss Prevention to restrict processing external emails in Microsoft 365 Copilot and Copilot Chat
description: We are expanding Microsoft Purview DLP for Microsoft 365 Copilot and Copilot Chat to safeguard risks from external emails. This real-time control helps organizations mitigate data risks by preventing Microsoft 365 Copilot and Chat from processing emails from senders external to your organization.

title: Microsoft Viva: Campaigns in SharePoint
description: Campaigns in SharePoint (site campaigns) is a new capability that brings Viva Amplify’ s campaign management natively into SharePoint. Corporate communications teams now have a unified place to create, distribute, and measure their news without leaving the platform where their news content already lives. This feature applies only to Amplify users as of now. This is a complementary way to create lighter weight campaigns inside a SharePoint site as a way to organize your SharePoint news posts and benefit from campaign analytics directly from SharePoint.

title: Microsoft Purview: Data Lifecycle Management - Graph API Support for Archive Mailboxes
description: Access to Archive mailboxes (Main + Auxiliary) through Microsoft Graph. The goal is to give users a single, seamless Archive view, even though Archive data may physically reside across multiple auxiliary mailboxes with EWS Graph APIs getting deprecated by OCT 2026.

title: Microsoft Purview: Information Protection – AI-powered intent for classifiers
description: AI-powered intent for classifiers: Microsoft Purview Information Protection will generate a human-readable semantic intent for custom Sensitive Information Types (SITs), helping customers better understand what their classifiers detect and refine them for higher accuracy and fewer false positives.
ai_summary: Microsoft Purview will generate human-readable semantic intents for custom Sensitive Information Types, aiding administrators in refining classifiers. This change impacts compliance and data protection roles.

title: Microsoft Purview: Data Loss Prevention - DLP Policy Change Insights with Security Copilot
description: Introduce an AI-powered capability leveraging Microsoft Security Copilot to automatically generate natural language explanations of changes made to DLP policies after each update within Microsoft Purview. This feature will analyze policy version deltas (pre-update vs. post-update) and produce a structured, human-readable summary that clearly explains: What changed Where the change occurred (rule, condition, action, location, etc.) The impact of the change The potential enforcement implications The goal is to eliminate manual policy diff analysis, reduce configuration ambiguity, and improve governance transparency for compliance and security administrators.
ai_summary: Microsoft Purview will introduce AI-generated summaries of changes made to Data Loss Prevention policies, improving clarity for administrators. This change affects IT admins managing DLP policies.

title: Microsoft CoPilot (Microsoft 365):  Makers can build DA's with Flexible layouts and rich UX components
description: Flexible layouts and rich UX components will enable makers to build highly expressive agents, ultimately driving increased user engagement and virality.
ai_summary: Microsoft 365 CoPilot will enable makers to create digital agents with flexible layouts and rich user experience components. This impacts developers and content creators.

title: OneDrive: Upcoming change to shared folder experience in Microsoft OneDrive
description: With this feature update, when a user clicks a link to a shared folder from Teams chat, channels, email, or other places, they will navigate to the shared folder within the People view of their own OneDrive. This new view, organized by people, will show and allow access to all the files and folders that have been shared with the user.
ai_summary: OneDrive will change how users access shared folders, directing them to a People view that organizes shared files. This affects all OneDrive users accessing shared content.

title: SharePoint: Viva Connections multi-home site management moving to SharePoint admin center
description: Viva Connections multi-home site management is moving from the Microsoft 365 admin center (MAC) to the SharePoint Admin Center (SPAC). Administrators will be able to create and manage multiple Home sites, configure audience targeting, manage home site priority order, and remove Home sites directly from SPAC. Existing entry points in the Microsoft 365 admin center will direct administrators to the new SPAC experience. As part of this update, legacy Viva Connections (VC) instances and draft/enabled management concepts are being deprecated as Viva Connections administration is consolidated into SharePoint Home site management. Existing VC experiences will be upgraded to full Home sites.

title: Microsoft Purview: Adaptive Scope evaluation control with recipient and site owner lifecycle status
description: Microsoft Purview Adaptive Scopes will provide administrators with explicit control over lifecycle-state evaluation for recipients and site owners, helping ensure policy targeting and scope membership remain aligned with organizational requirements.

title: Outlook: Insert Signature Image from OneDrive
description: Users can now insert images into their email signature directly from OneDrive, in addition to the device photo library.

title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Copilot memory in Researcher
description: Copilot memory within Researcher brings forward relevant context from your past interactions—helping ground insights, personalize outputs, and reduce repetitive setup as you explore complex topics.

title: Outlook: Copilot now provides concise summaries with Outlook search results
description: Get answers to queries quickly with Copilot's concise AI summaries at the top of Outlook search results. Users can dig deeper by opening Copilot chat directly from the Copilot summary card.
ai_summary: Outlook now features Copilot providing concise summaries at the top of search results, allowing users to quickly find answers. This change affects all Outlook users who utilize the search function.

title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Critique in Researcher
description: Responses are generated by GPT and Claude working together, with GPT drafting an initial response and Claude reviewing for increased response accuracy, completeness, and citation integrity.
ai_summary: Microsoft Copilot will generate responses in Researcher using GPT for drafting and Claude for reviewing, improving accuracy and citation integrity.

title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Researcher Council
description: Council in Researcher runs multiple leading AI models from different providers in parallel in one place, so you can quickly compare outputs and see consensus vs. conflict) to make high-stakes decisions with greater confidence—without switching tools.
ai_summary: The Researcher Council will allow users to compare outputs from multiple AI models simultaneously, aiding in decision-making.

title: OneDrive: Improved OneDrive experience in iOS Files app
description: OneDrive is updating its integration with the iOS Files app to use Apple's Replicated File Provider API. This update provides end-user improvements such as better upload progress. As part of the change, read-only Shared and Libraries locations will no longer appear in the Files app integration. Users can use Add to OneDrive for shared content and libraries they need to access, including write access where permitted.

title: Outlook: Enhanced user interface updates for iPhone and iPad
description: People using Outlook for iOS on iPhone and iPad will see refreshed interface elements aligned with the latest Liquid Glass iOS visual experience, including modernized app chrome, navigation, and use of screen space. It will be enabled by default with no administrator action required.

title: Microsoft 365 app: Microsoft Places Support to GCCH and DoD
description: "Microsoft Places is an AI-powered workplace app for flexible work. Places helps organizations reimagine flexible work with AI, enables employees to connect more easily in person so that they can make the most of in-office days.
ai_summary: Microsoft Places will now be available for Government Community Cloud (GCCH) and Department of Defense (DoD) users, enhancing flexible work capabilities. This change affects organizations using these specific environments.

title: Outlook: Language support for Summarize in Classic Outlook
description: When the content language and the Outlook language do not match, you will be able to select a different language to view summarize Copilot responses.

title: Outlook: Microsoft Purview Label Inheritance from Email Attachments
description: When composing an email in Outlook for Mac, Microsoft Purview sensitivity labels can be automatically applied or recommended based on the sensitivity labels of attached files. This helps users consistently protect sensitive information, reduces manual labeling effort, and supports organizational compliance requirements by aligning email protection with the sensitivity of attached content.

title: Outlook: Purview Label Inheritance from Email Attachment for iOS and Android
description: Outlook for iOS and Android will support Microsoft Purview sensitivity label inheritance from attachments. When users attach files with sensitivity labels, Outlook can automatically apply or recommend an email sensitivity label based on organizational policy settings. This helps organizations maintain consistent data classification and protection while reducing manual labeling effort.

title: OneDrive: Anchored comments in the PDF viewer
description: Microsoft is adding anchored comments to the PDF viewer in OneDrive and SharePoint on the web. Users can attach a comment to a specific spot on a page, to selected text, and collaborate through replies and @mentions — bringing PDF review to parity with commenting in Office documents. This feature will be on by default and requires no admin action.

title: OneDrive: Uninstall OneDrive Photos without affecting file sync
description: OneDrive is giving people more control over their Windows experience by allowing them to uninstall the OneDrive Photos experience independently. Removing the Photos experience does not uninstall the OneDrive app, interrupt file sync, or delete photos and files. This provides a clear removal option for people who prefer to manage their photos with another app.

title: OneDrive: Manage access to the OneDrive Photos Desktop experience
description: OneDrive is adding administrative controls for the Photos experience on Windows. Organizations can manage whether users sign in with personal Microsoft accounts. These controls help IT teams align OneDrive Photos with their access, data governance, and device-management requirements.

title: Microsoft Copilot Studio: SQL server Support in Microsoft Copilot Studio
description: The Azure SQL Knowledge Source capability extends the range of enterprise data sources that makers can leverage when building agents in Copilot Studio. This enables organizations to bring business-critical information stored in Azure SQL into their agent experiences using the same knowledge-centric approach that customers already use across other supported knowledge sources. Azure SQL knowledge support represents another step toward a unified knowledge platform strategy, where customers can connect enterprise data sources through a common knowledge framework and leverage those sources consistently across agent experiences. It also strengthens the story for organizations seeking to build grounded, enterprise-ready AI solutions using existing Microsoft data assets.

title: Microsoft Edge: Enhanced Security Mode Plus
description: Enhanced Security Mode Plus adds optional, admin-configurable protections on top of Enhanced Security Mode to further reduce browser attack surface. Admins can configure preset or custom modes to restrict selected network protocols and compression behavior, hardware-access web APIs, WebGL, and external protocol launches when Enhanced Security Mode is enabled.

title: Microsoft Copilot Studio: Dataverse integration on Copilot Studio
description: We are enabling Microsoft Dataverse as a native knowledge source in Copilot Studio, expanding the platform’s ability to ground AI agents in structured enterprise data. This enhancement allows organizations to leverage business-critical information stored in Dataverse—including records, customer data, operational data, and business application content—as a trusted knowledge source for agent experiences.

title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Add Agents and Skills from the Plus menu
description: Users will be able to insert Agents and Skills in prompts for specialized tasks. They can add them from the Agents and Skills tab after selecting 'Add work content' from the plus (+) menu. Users can also access Agents and Skills by typing / and @ in their prompt.

title: SharePoint: HTML pages
description: Create HTML with Copilot in SharePoint or upload your own HTML from another source. Once stored in the pages library, you can render HTML as a page in SharePoint, make additional edits, and share with your audience. HTML gives you new ways to present your content beautifully alongside our existing ASPX pages.

title: OneNote: New Copilot Notebooks design in the Microsoft 365 Copilot app (DoD, GCC, GCC High)
description: The new Copilot Notebooks design in the Microsoft 365 Copilot app for DoD, GCC, and GCC High clouds now lets users organize related chats, output creations, and references into a persistent AI workspace. Copilot uses the Notebook's accumulated context to ground responses, so work continues across sessions instead of starting over each time. While this is the quicker, light-weight Notebooks experience, you can still find the workspace-forward experience in OneNote.

title: Microsoft Entra: Windows Hello for Business and macOS Platform Single Sign-on can now be used as a second factor for MFA
description: Windows Hello for Business (WHfB) and macOS Platform SSO (macOS PSSO) can now satisfy multifactor authentication as a standalone second factor. Previously, these methods only counted as MFA during primary sign-in, and users needed a separate passkey to complete step-up prompts, Authentication Strength policies, and sign-in frequency checks. With this change, WHfB and macOS PSSO work on their own for those scenarios, so more of your users can rely on strong, phishing-resistant sign-in without registering an extra method. What you need to know: Users who have only WHfB or macOS PSSO are now treated as MFA-capable and will no longer be automatically prompted to register another method. Because WHfB and macOS PSSO are tied to a specific device, we recommend having users register a portable method, such as a passkey or Microsoft Authenticator, during onboarding so they can complete MFA from any device.

title: Microsoft Purview: Data Loss Prevention - Count of Labelled Documents Condition
description: This release introduces a new condition for Exchange Online policies: “Count of labeled documents is greater than.”  This condition evaluates the number of attachments in an email message that carry a matching sensitivity label. When the count exceeds a defined threshold, the DLP rule is triggered, and configured actions are applied. This capability enables detection of high-volume data exfiltration scenarios, where multiple sensitive files—individually low-risk—collectively represent a significant compliance or security risk. Existing conditions evaluate file content, but do not provide controls based on the volume of labeled attachments.

title: Microsoft Purview: Data Loss Prevention - Reusable Global List for Exchange Online
description: Reusable Lists centralize management of keywords, domains, and email addresses, eliminating duplication across rules and reducing the effort required to maintain large policies.

title: Microsoft Edge: Vertical Tabs update
description: Microsoft Edge is updating its vertical tab implementation and architecture. Edge is reimplementing capabilities across pane, layout, controls, tab behavior, visual treatments, & embedder customizations. No admin action is required.

title: Microsoft Purview: Endpoint Data Loss Prevention - Policy Sync & Device Health AI-Powered Investigation
description: AI-powered visibility into DLP policy deployment across devices, helping admins track sync progress and understand enforcement coverage. They proactively identify impacted devices, explain root causes of sync failures, and guide admins with recommended actions to quickly diagnose and resolve issues.

title: Microsoft Purview: Data Loss Prevention – Reduce policy sync status SLA on the Purview UI from 2 hours to 30 mins
description: Admin should be able to see the Endpoint DLP policy sync status on the Purview portal within 30 mins.
ai_summary: The sync status for Endpoint DLP policies in Microsoft Purview will be reduced from 2 hours to 30 minutes. This change improves visibility for admins managing DLP policies.

title: Microsoft Purview: eDiscovery - Advanced Review Set Explorer
description: The Advanced Review Set Explorer empowers reviewers to harness the power of real-time big data analytics on their review set data. This tool enhances data analysis by offering insights such as identifying top item types, spotting patterns, and trends within the review set. Reviewers can utilize powerful Kusto query constructs like complex filtering, pattern-based text extraction, and data format parsing to analyze and find key information specific to their case or organization. The results can then be visualized using various flexible charting solutions, providing a comprehensive understanding of the data's story.

title: Microsoft Purview compliance portal: eDiscovery - Advanced Review Set Explorer
description: The Advanced Review Set Explorer empowers reviewers to harness the power of real-time big data analytics on their review set data leveraging. This tool enhances data analysis by offering insights such as identifying top item types, spotting patterns, and trends within the review set. Reviewers can utilize powerful Kusto query constructs like complex filtering, pattern-based text extraction, and data format parsing to analyze and find key information specific to their case or organization. The results can then be visualized using various flexible charting solutions, providing a comprehensive understanding of the data's story.
ai_summary: The Advanced Review Set Explorer in Microsoft Purview compliance portal enhances eDiscovery by providing real-time analytics and visualization tools for data review.

title: Outlook: Change the organizer of a meeting
description: Transfer ownership of a meeting or recurring meeting series to another person in your organization. The new organizer must accept the transfer before it is completed. This helps maintain continuity for long-running meetings while preserving the existing event for attendees. Available in Outlook for Windows and web and Teams calendar.

title: Planner: Private tasks now stored in your private plan
description: Private tasks created in Planner and Planner-powered experiences are stored in the user’s private plan, providing a single place for tasks visible only to that user. Private tasks cannot be shared or assigned to others, and existing tasks continue to work and appear alongside them.

title: Microsoft Purview: eDiscovery- Select user-owned SharePoint embedded container as a data source
description: eDiscovery users will be able to view and select SharePoint Embedded content containers owned or created by a selected person. These containers store content from apps such as Microsoft Loop, Copilot Pages, and Copilot Notebooks.

title: OneDrive: Improved capabilities for files with Copilot in OneDrive Web
description: With improved Copilot file skills in OneDrive, you can go from files to finished work directly from chat. Copilot helps you find the right content, analyze files and data, create polished outputs like summaries, dashboards, and presentations, and collaborate by saving or sharing the results from OneDrive.

title: Microsoft Purview: eDiscovery - CMK (Customer managed key) for eDiscovery direct export
description: This release of eDiscovery features the implementation of customer-managed key (CMK) options, allowing users to manage their own encryption keys for the data included in the direct export workflow in eDiscovery, adding to the Microsoft-managed encryption already in place.

title: Microsoft Purview: Data Loss Prevention - Data Security Triage Agent summaries and categorizations for DLP alerts will be made available in DLP Alerts in Microsoft Defender XDR
description: Data Security Triage Agent summaries and categorizations for DLP alerts will be made available in DLP Alerts in Microsoft Defender XDR.
ai_summary: Data Security Triage Agent summaries and categorizations for DLP alerts will be available in Microsoft Defender XDR's DLP Alerts.

title: Microsoft Purview: eDiscovery- CMK (Customer managed key) for eDiscovery direct export
description: This release of eDiscovery features the implementation of customer-managed key (CMK) options, allowing users to manage their own encryption keys for the data included in the direct export workflow in eDiscovery, adding to the Microsoft-managed encryption already in place.
ai_summary: eDiscovery will allow users to manage their own encryption keys for direct export workflows, enhancing data control. This affects users involved in eDiscovery processes.

title: Microsoft Purview compliance portal:  eDiscovery (Premium) – Hold reports (U.S. Government clouds)
description: Out-of-the-box reports that contain information about all legal holds associated with eDiscovery cases in the Microsoft Purview compliance portal. Sort and filter your view based on various criteria and download the aggregated information for further analysis.
ai_summary: The Microsoft Purview compliance portal will provide out-of-the-box hold reports for eDiscovery cases in U.S. Government clouds, allowing sorting and filtering of legal hold information. This affects compliance officers and legal teams.

title: Microsoft Purview compliance portal:  eDiscovery (Premium) – Hold reports
description: Out-of-the-box reports that contain information about all legal holds associated with eDiscovery cases in the Microsoft Purview compliance portal. Sort and filter your view based on various criteria and download the aggregated information for further analysis. Note: The status and release month has been updated to reflect the current state. We apologize for any inconvenience this may cause.
ai_summary: The Microsoft Purview compliance portal will offer eDiscovery hold reports, enabling users to sort, filter, and download legal hold information. This impacts compliance officers and legal teams.

title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Federated Copilot Connectors in Microsoft 365 Copilot
description: Federated Copilot connectors enable users to securely connect Microsoft Copilot to their favorite third party sources, retrieving data in real-time using the Model Context Protocol (MCP). Federated Copilot connectors do not store or index customer data in Microsoft - access happens in real time using the user’s own identity, while administrators retain full governance and control through the Microsoft 365 Admin Center. With GA, federated Copilot connectors will be supported across Researcher agent and Microsoft 365 Chat, allowing users to bring data into their workflows.

title: Microsoft Teams: Enhanced Copilot chat summary
description: Missed many messages? Copilot will automatically generate a summary of the new messages in a chat conversation, so you can catch up quickly without reading every message.
ai_summary: Copilot in Microsoft Teams will automatically generate summaries of new messages in chat conversations. This feature helps users catch up quickly without reading all messages.

title: Microsoft Copilot Studio: Improvements to agent evaluations experience
description: Microsoft Copilot Studio is enhancing the Evaluations experience to help makers better understand agent quality and behavior. New capabilities include richer evaluation explanations, agent reasoning traces, cited knowledge sources, evaluation run comparison, support for larger datasets, customizable test generation, and dataset generation from knowledge sources. These improvements help makers identify quality issues more quickly, understand why evaluations succeed or fail, compare results across runs, and create higher quality evaluation datasets with less manual effort. Additional validation and guidance will help makers resolve configuration issues before running evaluations.

title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Code Blocks in M365 Copilot
description: M365 Copilot now supports code blocks, which lets you preview code, charts, diagrams, and more directly inline while using Chat. Previously, users could preview code side-by-side in a code canvas.

title: Planner: Save AI-generated filters in Planner Agent chat
description: Save AI-filters generated by the Planner Agent for future use on your plans.

title: Microsoft Purview: Data Lifecycle Management – Hard delete capability for OneDrive and SharePoint through secure priority cleanup workflows
description: Data Lifecycle Management allows compliance admins to retain, review and delete content in M365 workloads. Deletion of content to adhere to compliance requirements, admins can set up Retention policies or labels. To help prevent inadvertent data loss, M365 retention labels policies and M365 retention policies do not hard delete content immediately and keeps the data in Recycle Bins for 93 days for ODSP. Hard delete itself is a very costly process as it opens Microsoft to heavy legal implications in case of any data loss incident that may occur due to a misconfigured policy or regression. Priority Cleanup feature allows users to bypass retention, and eDiscovery holds to help customers comply to changing legal/compliance requirements or manage data spillage scenarios. This feature requires the ability to hard delete specific files from the scoped locations.  Ability to select hard delete configuration for a Priority cleanup policy for OneDrive and SharePoint content and skip recycle bins.

title: Microsoft Purview: Data Security Triage Agent in Data Loss Prevention - Reasoning Trace and Confidence Score for agent-triaged alerts
description: This feature introduces confidence scoring and reasoning trace explainability into the Data Security Triage Agent in DLP, addressing a critical trust gap reported across multiple customers. Today, without transparency into why the agent makes a decision or how confident it is, analysts are forced to fall back to manual review — completely negating the automation value. The feature will surface a reasoning trace alongside each agent decision and a confidence score, giving analysts a clear signal of how reliable the agent's output is. This provides SOC teams with an auditable, explainable output they can validate rather than blindly trust, enabling them to progressively increase reliance on automation over time.
ai_summary: The Data Security Triage Agent in Microsoft Purview will now provide confidence scores and reasoning traces for alerts, improving transparency for analysts. This change affects security operations teams using DLP.

title: Outlook: Purview Data Loss Prevention support for Calendar Events in Outlook for Mac
description: Outlook for Mac will support Microsoft Purview Data Loss Prevention (DLP) policies for calendar events. Organizations can detect and help prevent the sharing of sensitive information in meeting subjects, descriptions, and invite content through policy tips, user remediation, and policy enforcement. This provides consistent compliance protection across email and calendar experiences on Mac devices.

title: Microsoft Viva: Viva Glint – Enhanced multiple-choice questions with up to 500 options
description: Viva Glint administrators will be able to create multiple-choice questions with up to 500 options and upload options using a CSV file. For questions containing more than 50 options, survey takers can search and filter the available responses, making longer lists faster and easier to navigate. Reporting will support the expanded option set.

title: Microsoft Viva: Viva Glint – In-product access to feature announcements
description: Viva Glint service administrators will see a new announcement icon in the product header that links directly to the Viva Glint Tech Community blog. This makes it easier to discover product news, feature announcements, and best practices.

title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365) Writing Blocks in M365 Copilot
description: M365 Copilot now supports Writing blocks. Edit drafts, memos, emails, and more inline while using Chat for easy editing and iteration.

title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Self-serve sync connectors
description: Self-serve sync connectors enable users to securely connect their own external data sources, such as Jira and Confluence Cloud, to Microsoft 365 Copilot. Using their own credentials and permissions, users can synchronize content they already have access to, making it discoverable in Copilot Chat and Microsoft Search. Administrators maintain oversight through tenant-level controls, including staged rollout, visibility management, and connector disablement.

title: Microsoft Edge: Import Google account data anytime from Settings
description: Microsoft Edge now lets users import their Google account data - including passwords, bookmarks, history, and autofill data - directly from Edge Settings, at any time after setup. Previously, users had no way to import this data from a Google account outside the first-run experience. With this update, the import flow is unified into a single, streamlined entry point in Settings that combines import from Google Chrome import and Google account.

title: Microsoft 365: PAYGO consumption-based meter for your extra SharePoint storage needs
description: Use the new PAYGO consumption-based meter to pay for your extra SharePoint storage needs. This reduces the operational overhead associated with purchasing extra storage packs and more seamlessly integrates with Microsoft 365 Archive.
ai_summary: A new PAYGO consumption-based meter for SharePoint storage will allow organizations to pay for extra storage as needed, simplifying the purchasing process. This change affects administrators managing SharePoint storage.

title: Microsoft Purview: Data Lifecycle Management – Retention for Copilot Memory
description: Configure retention for Microsoft 365 Copilot memory to help preserve historical versions of memory items for security, compliance, and investigation scenarios. Copilot memory includes saved memories and details inferred from chat history that enable more personalized and context-aware Copilot experiences. Copilot memory items are stored in a hidden folder in the user’s Exchange mailbox. This capability will enable retention and versioning support for inactive memory items so that administrators can maintain visibility into memory changes while active memory continues to be managed by the Copilot experience.

title: Outlook: Purview DLP Wait-on-Send Support for Mac
description: Outlook for Mac will support Microsoft Purview Data Loss Prevention (DLP) wait-on-send policies. Organizations can require a DLP evaluation before an email is sent and configure how long users must wait for policy evaluation to complete. This helps ensure sensitive information is inspected against organizational policies before messages leave the organization while providing administrators with flexible control over the user experience.

title: Outlook: Purview DLP Wait-on-Send Support for Outlook mobile apps
description: Outlook for iOS and Android will support Microsoft Purview Data Loss Prevention (DLP) wait-on-send policies. Organizations can require a DLP evaluation before an email is sent and configure how long users must wait for policy evaluation to complete. This helps ensure sensitive information is inspected against organizational policies before messages leave the organization while providing administrators with flexible control over the user experience.

title: Outlook: Purview Data Loss Prevention support for Calendar Events in Outlook mobile apps
description: Outlook for iOS and Android will support Microsoft Purview Data Loss Prevention (DLP) policies for calendar events. Organizations can detect and help prevent the sharing of sensitive information in meeting subjects, descriptions, and invite content through policy tips, user remediation, and policy enforcement. This provides consistent compliance protection across email and calendar experiences on mobile devices.

title: Outlook: Manage Multiple Inbox Rules at Once
description: You will soon be able to manage multiple inbox rules at the same time. Select every rule or choose only the ones you want to update. You can then delete, enable, or disable the selected rules in one action. This makes it faster and easier to keep your rules organized. #newoutlookforwindows

title: Planner: Connected Plans
description: Connected Plans let teams link related plans together to organize work across projects and initiatives. Navigate between connected plans and make related work easier to find and manage.

title: Microsoft Purview: Data Loss Prevention - Reduce policy sync status SLA on the Purview UI from 2 hours to 30 mins
description: Policy updates in Microsoft Purview now sync faster, reducing wait times from up to 2 hours to just 30 minutes, so your protections stay up to date and take effect more quickly across your organization.

title: Outlook: 1-year and 2-year options for email sync window (Offline settings)
description: In the new Outlook for Windows, users can choose to save 1 year or 2 years of email on their device for offline access. This expands the existing offline settings and allows users to access more email when they are not connected to the internet. The new options are available under Settings > General > Offline > Days of email to save, giving users greater flexibility based on their storage and offline needs."
ai_summary: Outlook for Windows now allows users to choose to save 1 or 2 years of email for offline access, enhancing flexibility for users based on their storage needs. This change affects Outlook users.

title: Planner: Track task progress with the Completion (%) field
description: The new Completion (%) column in Microsoft Planner provides a more precise view of task progress. Users can view and update completion as a percentage, helping teams communicate incremental progress and quickly understand how far work has advanced.

title: Microsoft Purview: Compliance Manager - AI Powered Regulatory Templates
description: This feature in Purview Compliance Manager shall enable customers to convert complex regulations from PDF documents to actionable controls and actions in multi cloud environment. Customers can use the converted regulatory templates to create assessments and identify compliance gaps, understand and implement controls to improve their compliance posture.
ai_summary: Purview Compliance Manager will offer AI-powered regulatory templates to convert complex regulations into actionable controls. This affects compliance teams working across multi-cloud environments.

title: Microsoft Defender for Office 365: Full Submissions experience in GCC
description: This is item is no longer accurate and we are removing it from the roadmap, we apologize for any inconvenience.

title: Outlook: Offline settings "Days of email to save" admin policy
description: Tenant admins will be able to define the default value for "Days of email to save" in Offline settings and designate whether end users can change the setting. This policy will set and enforce the "Days of email to save" setting found under Settings > General > Offline. #newoutlookforwindows

title: Microsoft 365 admin center: Data Quality Report for Profile Data
description: Microsoft 365 Organizational Data Services is introducing a new data quality report that helps administrators assess the coverage and health of people data used across Microsoft 365 experiences. High-quality people data enables users to more effectively discover and learn about colleagues through experiences such as the People Card, Org Explorer, Microsoft 365 Copilot, and Microsoft 365 Cowork. The new report provides organizational data administrators, People Administrators, and AI Administrators with visibility into the completeness and quality of people attributes available in Microsoft 365. Administrators can use these insights to identify data gaps, improve attribute coverage, and help ensure users and AI-powered experiences have access to accurate organizational information. Key benefits: - Monitor the health and completeness of people profile attributes across the organization. - Identify missing or incomplete organizational data that may impact user and AI experiences. - Improve discoverability and organizational understanding in People Card and Org Explorer. - Help increase the effectiveness of Microsoft 365 Copilot and Microsoft 365 Cowork by improving the quality of underlying people data. This feature is available to Organizational Data Administrators, People Administrators, and AI Administrators through Microsoft 365 Organizational Data Services.

title: Microsoft Purview: Data Loss Prevention- Adaptive Scopes for DLP for SharePoint
description: Adaptive Scope for SharePoint is a dynamic scoping capability in Microsoft Purview DLP that allows administrators to automatically target DLP policies to the right sites based on attributes such as site URL, site name, or custom site metadata. Unlike static scoping, which requires manually listing sites and maintaining them over time, adaptive scopes continuously evaluate site properties and auto‑include or exclude locations as they evolve. This enables scalable policy deployment, eliminates the 100‑site static policy limit, and delivers granular, and automated targeting.
ai_summary: Microsoft Purview's Data Loss Prevention will introduce adaptive scopes for SharePoint, allowing dynamic targeting of DLP policies based on site attributes.

title: Microsoft Copilot Studio: Agent Sharing amongst makers
description: Enables sharing of agents with other makers in the new GHCP harness. Makers can grant other makers Agent Viewer (view analytics/evaluations only) or Editor (view, edit, configure, share, publish) access to an agent, with auto-assigned security roles.

title: Universal Print: audit logging
description: I can access Universal Print audit records of key administrator and user activities, such as print job submissions, configuration changes, and printer registrations. Audit records will be available in Microsoft Purview’s Unified Audit Log for compliance and long-term record-keeping.
ai_summary: Universal Print will provide audit logging for key activities like print job submissions and configuration changes, accessible via Microsoft Purview’s Unified Audit Log. This affects administrators managing print services.

title: Universal Print: Logs and alerts
description: With a new Azure Monitor integration, Universal Print customers can send detailed diagnostic logs to a Log Analytics workspace to conduct troubleshooting and configure custom alerts.
ai_summary: Universal Print will integrate with Azure Monitor, allowing customers to send diagnostic logs to a Log Analytics workspace for troubleshooting and set up custom alerts. This change affects Universal Print users.

title: SharePoint: Site Skills in Copilot in SharePoint
description: The feature introduces enhanced Site Skills management capabilities, including skill editing, version control, publishing, restoration, and cross-site duplication, enabling organizations to govern and reuse skills more effectively across SharePoint sites.

title: Microsoft Viva: Viva Glint - New Survey Owner role provides access to survey results
description: When a new program is being set up in Glint, there is now an option to designate Survey Owners. Those added as Survey Owners will be able to view and manage certain aspects of the program, as well as see the results when a survey in the program closes.

title: Microsoft Copilot Studio: Streamlining experiences from Copilot Studio Agents in Microsoft 365 Copilot
description: This update is meant to bridge the experience of using Copilot Studio agents in M365 Copilot with the Copilot Chat experience. With these updates, agent responses in Copilot Chat will look (similar formatting, compressed chain of thought), feel (smoother streaming, resume/retry and voice dictation) and behave (deliver clickable citations and tool execution traces) very similarly to Copilot Chat responses themselves.

title: Microsoft Copilot Studio: Enabling makers to require human approval for tool calls
description: Copilot Studio now let’s makers require human approval before an agent runs specific tools. With a per-tool, per-agent toggle, any gated tool call pauses and shows an approval request describing what the agent intends to do, so a person can approve, approve for the session, or deny before the action runs. This gives organizations a deterministic guardrail for high-stakes or sensitive operations like sending emails, closing tickets, or processing payments, independent of the agent's instructions. Approval requests appear inline in the channel where the agent is deployed, including Microsoft Teams and Microsoft 365 Copilot.

title: Microsoft 365: Organizational Data Service is now available in GCC-High
description: We’re excited to announce that Microsoft 365 Organizational Data Service is now available in the GCC-High (GCC-H) environment! Microsoft 365 Organizational Data Service enables rapid ingestion of organizational/HR data through connectors from multiple HRIS systems using a single unified ingestion point. This service also provides organizational data for use across Microsoft Copilot and Microsoft 365 apps to power various features with robust data quality framework that detects, communicates, and provides solutions for data quality issues before data is used.

title: Microsoft Viva: Viva Insights and Copilot Analytics in GCC-High
description: Microsoft Viva Insights and Copilot Analytics are coming to Microsoft 365 Government Community Cloud High (GCC High), providing eligible organizations with privacy-protected, role-based analytics experiences to help them understand Microsoft 365 Copilot adoption, usage, and impact. Viva Insights also provides data-driven behavioral insights into how employees collaborate, helping organizations improve productivity and wellbeing within the GCC High environment.

title: SharePoint: PowerShell support for brand fonts deletion
description: Microsoft SharePoint is introducing PowerShell support for deleting brand font files from the Brand Fonts library used by the SharePoint Brand Center. With the new Remove-SPOFontFile cmdlet, SharePoint administrators can remove brand font files that are no longer approved, licensed, or needed across their organization in SharePoint.

title: Microsoft Purview: Data Loss Prevention – Default Protection Controls for Exchange Online in the event of classification failure
description: Default protection controls for Exchange Online is available in public preview. This release gives administrators fine-grained control to create DLP policies based on specific classification or text extraction failure types — such as timeout, throttling and other scan errors — rather than one blanket policy for all failure conditions.

title: Microsoft Entra: Enhanced Security Accounts Manager (sAM) Account Name support for Microsoft Entra Domain Services
description: Enhanced support for synchronizing the Security Accounts Manager account name (sAMAccountName) with Microsoft Entra Domain Services is now in Public Preview. This feature allows sAMAccountName to be populated from the onPremisesSamAccountName attribute in Microsoft Entra ID. Existing managed domains can enable the new synchronization behavior, while it is enabled by default for new managed domains. When enabled, existing hybrid users are updated during synchronization; cloud-only users without an onPremisesSamAccountName value continue to use mailNickname-based generation. The feature is available for Enterprise and Premium SKUs.

title: Microsoft Defender for Identity: Unified identity timeline on the Identity page
description: The updated identity timeline provides security teams with a single chronological view of activity and alerts associated with an identity and its linked accounts. It normalizes activity from integrated Microsoft security products, including Microsoft Entra sign-ins, Microsoft Graph audit events, SaaS and cloud activity, and device logons. New fields and filters include Source table, Session ID, and Unique token identifier, with expanded Conditional Access and event context.

title: Microsoft 365: Entra ID Backup & Recovery
description: Enable extended 30-day backup and recovery for a tenant's Entra objects via the Microsoft 365 Backup native app or M365 Backup Storage platform APIs. This capability allows customers and ISV apps to do a point in time restore of Entra objects to a last known good state to a rolling historical 30-day point. Advanced recovery features are currently limited to the Entra admin portal, but some user recovery actions will be possible via the M365 Backup native app UX in the M365 Admin center. Note that the existing 7-day recovery that comes with a customer's P1 & P2 licenses is already generally available and is independent of this roadmap item.

title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Generate documents using forms in SharePoint with Power Automate
description:
We are introducing a new Power Automate action that enables automated document generation using document generation (DocGen) forms in SharePoint. 
Generate document from form (Preview) allows customers to create documents from a template by mapping data inputs to predefined template fields.
Documents are generated as part of an automated flow and stored in SharePoint.
This capability supports scenarios such as creating contracts, invoices, letters, or reports using structured templates and form-driven inputs.
The action works by mapping input data to template fields and returns the generated document along with file metadata such as location and status.
ai_summary: Power Automate will allow users to generate documents from SharePoint forms automatically. This feature is useful for creating structured documents like contracts and reports, impacting users who manage document workflows.

title: Outlook: Share Word, Excel, and PowerPoint local files via the new Outlook for Windows
description: When working in an open Word, Excel, or PowerPoint file, users will now be able to send a copy of the locally stored file by email through the new Outlook for Windows.  #newoutlookforwindows
ai_summary: In the new Outlook for Windows, users can now send copies of locally stored Word, Excel, and PowerPoint files via email. This feature impacts users who frequently share documents.

title: Microsoft Places: Microsoft Places Support to GCC cloud
description: Microsoft Places features will now be available in GCC cloud
ai_summary: Microsoft Places features will now be accessible in the GCC cloud.

title: Microsoft Copilot Studio: Deliver rich interactive app experiences in Copilot Studio agents
description: Copilot Studio agents can now render rich, interactive UI inline using MCP Apps, an extension of the Model Context Protocol. When an agent calls a UI-enabled tool from a compatible MCP server, interactive experiences like sortable tables and drilldowns render directly in the conversation. Users can now explore and act on data without leaving the chat or switching tools. A plain-text fallback keeps the agent working on surfaces that can't render the UI, and makers get this simply by connecting a compliant MCP server.

title: Microsoft Copilot Studio: Introducing an App- and Intent-First Agent Creation Experience
description: Copilot Studio is evolving to an app-first agent creation experience. Makers start with the application their agent will work with and configure the capabilities it needs. This update brings tools and knowledge into a more unified experience, simplifying how agents are created and configured.

title: Microsoft Teams: Copilot Chat for chats, channels, calls, and meetings in GCC, GCC High, and DoD
description: Copilot Chat will soon be available across chats, channels, calls, and meetings, helping users stay informed and catch up quickly.

title: Microsoft Purview compliance portal: Scanner data export for custom reporting
description: Learn about the state of your scanned repositories and create custom reports with the information protection scanner. Labeling, classification and protection actions on scanned files are stored in SQL tables that form a foundation to feed into custom reports.
ai_summary: The Microsoft Purview compliance portal now allows for custom reporting using data from the information protection scanner. This change impacts compliance officers and admins needing detailed reports.

title: Microsoft Purview: Auto-labeling scalability, policy management, and reporting enhancements
description: Microsoft Purview is improving auto-labeling capabilities to help organizations manage and validate labeling policies at enterprise scale. These enhancements expand support for larger SharePoint scopes, improve policy management flexibility, and provide richer visibility into auto-labeling activity.

title: Microsoft Teams: Automatic recording and transcription choices align with admin policies
description: Meeting organizers will only see automatic recording and transcription choices in Meeting Options that are allowed by their organization's existing meeting policies. A new Record only choice lets organizers automatically start recording without starting transcription. Depending on the organizer's policies, available choices can include Record and transcribe, Transcribe only, Record only, and Off. When both recording and transcription are disabled by policy, the automatic setting is not shown.

title: Dynamics 365 Finance: Support requirements of tax reform in Brazil in 2027
description: Microsoft plans to introduce additional Globalization Studio capabilities to help support Brazil tax reform requirements, including the new IS tax type, tax assessment capabilities for reformed taxes, expanded fiscal note functionality for additional business scenarios, enhanced tax posting processes, and further updates to CNPJ-related processes. Additional capabilities will continue to be introduced as future phases of Brazil's tax reform are implemented.

title: Microsoft 365: Teams Channel Backup
description: A backup and recovery feature that lets you recover team & channel data (like files, messages exchanged over channels) in Microsoft Teams to a previously known good state after accidental changes or security compromises. Supported items include Team, Channels (Standard, Private, Public) and underlying data. Retention period supported is 30 days.

title: Planner: Add times to task start, finish, and due dates
description: Add specific times to task start, finish, and due dates. Define a plan’s time zone and working hours to automatically provide default task times and choose whether to view times in the plan’s time zone or your local time zone. This helps distributed teams coordinate effectively across time zones and keep deadlines clear.

title: Outlook: Categorize Emails by Dragging Them onto a Favorite Category
description: You can now add a category to your Favorites and then drag emails right onto it to apply that category. No need to open menus or right-click each message. Just pin the category you use most to Favorites, then drop your emails on it to tag them in one quick motion. It's a faster, more visual way to keep your inbox sorted the way you like. #newoutlookforwindows

title: Microsoft Purview: Data Lifecycle Management - DLM Meter Change
description: Data Lifecycle Management (DLM) billing will be based on the volume of data retained. For example, any number of non‑Microsoft 365 generative AI prompts and responses that collectively amount to 1 GB of retained data will be billed at $0.25 per GB per month (equivalent to ~$0.0082 per GB per day). In the updated model, DLM is billed based on the total volume of text messages managed by a DLM policy. Each non‑Microsoft 365 generative AI prompt and response is treated as an individual text message and is retained and deleted according to the configured Microsoft Purview retention settings. Billing is calculated on the managed text messages in storage, at a rate equivalent to $6 per one million text messages per month. Customer impact Customers will need to migrate from the legacy meter to the new meter. Based on current analysis, the overall cost impact is expected to be cost‑neutral or lower for customers under the new billing model.

title: Microsoft Edge: Allow M365 authentication popups in work profiles
description: When users are signed in with a work account, some Microsoft 365 sites (for example, microsoft.com, cloud.microsoft, and microsoft365.com) may open authentication pop-up windows to Microsoft sign-in endpoints such as login.microsoftonline.com, login.live.com, or login.microsoft.com. These pop-ups are required to complete sign-in. Microsoft Edge now allows authentication pop-up windows from Microsoft first party services by default. Admins can control availability to this feature using the M365AuthPopupsInWorkEnabled policy.

title: Microsoft Viva: Copilot Analytics - Export metrics in the Copilot Dashboard at Day Level
description: This feature enables users to export fresher row-level Copilot metrics from the Copilot Dashboard for reporting and deeper analysis at day level. #copilotcontrolsystem

title: Microsoft Purview compliance portal: Data Lifecycle Management - Introduction of secure workflow to bypass legal holds and retention policies
description: The first release of Priority cleanup enables admins to create a recurring exception to delete items under a broader retention policy and/or legal hold on Exchange workload. Creating a Priority cleanup will require a separate security role, multiple approvers, and will have a complete audit trail.

title: SharePoint: Changes to the FAQ web part authoring experience
description: The SharePoint FAQ web part will provide a standard, non-AI experience for manually creating, editing, and managing FAQs. The AI-assisted FAQ creation and import will move to the Copilot in SharePoint authoring experience, where authors can use natural-language prompts and selected grounding sources to generate FAQ content that is saved to the compatible FAQ web part. Existing FAQ web parts and their content will continue to render without migration.

title: Outlook: Inline chat for email drafting
description: Instead of opening Copilot Chat every time you want to use Copilot to draft a message, this change introduces an inline chat component that streamlines the process and lets you interact with Copilot without opening the sidebar.

title: Microsoft Teams: Breakout room support on Teams Rooms on Android
description: With breakout room support, Teams Rooms on Android can be added to a breakout room and moved in and out of the main room making it easy for breakout session coordination.

title: Planner: My Tasks redesign
description: A redesigned My Tasks experience that brings your tasks into one place, making it easier to capture work, prioritize what matters, and stay focused.

title: Microsoft Teams: Call quality feedback surveys for Teams Rooms on Android
description: Users can now rate the quality of their calls and meetings and provide additional feedback on calling, video, and screen-sharing experiences to help organizations ensure consistent, high-quality experiences.

title: Microsoft Teams: Advanced Collaboration Analytics for GCC
description: Advanced Collaboration Analytics for GGC provides Teams admins with insights into external collaboration patterns - covering teams, federated domains, channels, guests, and internal users - along with recommended actions to enhance security for external collaboration.

title: Data Loss Prevention- DLP Policy Change Insights with Security Copilot
description:
Copilot for Security in DLP can summarize DLP policies. This enhancement enables DLP admins to gain insights on coverage of policies viz. location, classifiers and notifications, and more.

DLP admins can get these insights on all the policies or on few selected policies. They will be able to use prompts to gain deeper level view of how a policy is configured for their digital landscape. This helps them align their data posture on a regular basis and make corrections to policy posture as needed. #copilotcontrolsystem

title: Microsoft Purview: Endpoint Data Loss Prevention-Archive File Classification Behavior Change for Windows Endpoints
description: We are updating archive file classification behavior on Windows endpoints to align with cloud workloads. This change improves consistency, reduces noise in event reporting, and enhances performance when processing archive files.

title: Word: Copilot edit mode is available to users in Office 365 GCC
description: Edit with Copilot in Word is now available to users in Office 365 GCC, enabling government customers to work with Copilot as a co-creator directly in your document to create, refine, and transform documents more efficiently.

title: Microsoft Teams: Coordinated meetings support on Teams Rooms on Android
description: Teams Rooms on Android now supports coordinated meetings, enabling paired Teams Rooms on Android devices and Android-based touch boards to work together in the same hybrid meeting experience. This feature enables coordinated join and leave, and collaboration across front-of-room displays and touch boards. This creates more immersive and flexible meeting spaces for both in-room and remote participants.

title: Microsoft Teams: Teams events attendance and engagement report policy
description: Teams events will soon have a separate attendance and engagement report policy from the "CsTeamsMeetingPolicy" attendance and engagement report policy. This will permit admins to allow Teams events organizers to access attendance and engagement reports, while restricting access to Teams meeting attendance and engagement reports.

title: Access: Cascading combo and list boxes with LinkMasterFields/LinkChildFields
description: Combo boxes and list boxes now support LinkMasterFields/LinkChildFields properties, enabling cascading dropdowns (e.g., Country filters City) without writing VBA code.

title: Outlook: New Cloud Policy controls
description: We’re introducing Cloud Policy service support for Outlook on the web and new Outlook for Windows. Admins can set default values for supported Outlook settings and choose whether users can change them, providing consistent cloud-based control across their organization

title: Microsoft Purview: Endpoint Data Loss Prevention – Ability to protect files stored in the excluded folders in Windows
description: Endpoint DLP now extends protection to files stored in commonly excluded Windows folders, including Temp and AppData. This helps improve coverage by detecting and protecting sensitive data in these locations.

title: Microsoft Purview: Endpoint Data Loss Prevention - Allow customer to scope JIT Audit to specific user or user group
description: Enable customers to include or exclude users/user groups from Just‑In‑Time (JIT) Audit, ensuring audits are generated only for the selected users or groups.

title: Outlook: Spell check before sending emails in new Outlook
description: If you don’t want to check spelling manually for every message—or you’re worried you might forget!—you can set Outlook to check spelling for you every time before sending emails.

title: Dynamics 365 Project Operations: Optimize, discover and manage features from one place
description:
A single place in Project Operations where administrators and end users can discover the core features relevant to them in lite or resource/non-stocked deployments.

**For administrators: **

  • Browse features by status: New, Available, Enabled, or Coming soon.
  • Filter and search by product area.
  • Review benefits, impact, dependencies, availability timing, and guidance.
  • Check whether a feature is optional or automatically enabled and whether it can be reversed.
  • Receive advance notice of upcoming features through notifications and a banner.

**For end users: **

  • View newly available and enabled features.
  • Access task-level guidance through Learn more.
  • Receive notifications on features newly available in the product

title: Microsoft Copilot Studio: Cost visibility in Monitor tab
description: Now makers will have clear visibility into their consumption costs directly within Monitor tab at both a per-agent level and an estimated breakdown of those costs across the agents lifecylce. This will allow makers to see costs distributed across activities such as authoring, testing, evaluations, and production usage, helping connect overall consumption to specific actions and experiences.

title: Microsoft Copilot Studio: Cost visibility in Agent Evaluations
description: Now makers will have clear visibility into their consumption costs directly associated with their evaluations, including a breakdown of usage for eval generation, test runs and model grading/judgement. Makers can see the costs as they test, iterate, and review conversations, making usage transparent throughout the development lifecycle.

title: Microsoft Copilot Studio: Cost visibility in Preview Chat and History
description: Now makers will have clear visibility into their consumption costs directly within preview tab and agent history for their preview/testing usage as well as all every historical run. Makers can see the costs as they test, iterate, and review conversations, making usage costs transparent throughout the development experience.

title: PowerPoint:  Async Notifications for PowerPoint Agent (Web)
description: Enable users to leave PowerPoint, switch devices, go offline, or end their workday while remaining confident that Copilot will notify them when work is complete or requires attention.

title: PowerPoint: Async Notifications for PowerPoint Agent (Windows Desktop)
description: Enable users to leave PowerPoint, switch devices, go offline, or end their workday while remaining confident that Copilot will notify them when work is complete or requires attention.

title: Microsoft Teams: Two presenters can share their screens or windows simultaneously in meetings
description: Two presenters can share a screen or window at the same time in a Teams meeting. Participants can see both shared content streams simultaneously, making it easier to compare and discuss content from different presenters.

title: SharePoint: New Mobile Experience on iOS and Android
description: The SharePoint mobile app for iOS and Android is redesigned around the personalized SharePoint Discover experience, bringing your most relevant files, sites, people, and news together in one place, with improved site browsing, in-app file previews, refreshed news and search, dark mode, and better performance.

title: Dynamics 365 Field Service: Automatically complete Project Tasks when field work is finished
description:
Keep project plans aligned with field execution by automatically completing a linked Project Task when its Work Order is completed.

When project work is carried out through Field Service, the Work Order often represents the execution of a specific Project Task. With this capability, organizations can configure Work Order Types so that completing the Work Order also completes the associated Project Task.

title: Dynamics 365 Field Service: Bring project material plans into field execution
description:
When the Field Service and Project Operations integration is enabled, material estimates created in a project plan can now create connected Work Order Products on the related Field Service work order. This allows project-planned materials to flow into Field Service without requiring project and field teams to recreate material lines, keeping both teams aligned on the same material plan.

As before, Work Order Products can create material estimates when materials are added from Field Service during execution. Supported changes remain synchronized across the project task, work order, and material line, allowing material planning to begin from either Project Operations or Field Service while keeping planning and execution aligned.

title: Microsoft Purview: Data Loss Prevention-Expanded inline protection for unmanaged apps in Edge for Business
description: Microsoft Purview collection and data loss prevention (DLP) policies will support browser inline protection for a significantly broader set of unmanaged generative AI apps in Edge for Business. Admins can use existing Purview policy experiences to detect and protect sensitive data shared through supported browser activities, helping extend consistent data security controls across more destinations.

title: Microsoft Teams: Ask Copilot from Search on Mobile
description: Get answers without leaving search. As you type in the Teams search bar, you'll see an option to ask Copilot alongside search results. You can also select Ask Copilot from the search results page to turn your query into a Copilot conversation, helping you quickly find information, get answers, and ask follow-up questions in context.

title: Microsoft Teams: Report suspicious guest invitations
description: Microsoft Teams will enable users to report suspicious guest invitations directly from Teams. When users receive an unexpected or potentially malicious guest invitation, they can report it to their IT admin for review, helping identify and mitigate phishing and other abuse through guest invitations.

title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Power BI reports as references in Copilot Notebooks
description: Copilot Notebooks now lets users add Power BI reports as references, bringing report data directly into their notebooks alongside files. Copilot uses this information to help generate more relevant summaries, presentations, and briefs grounded in the organization's data.

title: Microsoft Purview: Data Loss Prevention - User Based Aggregation of DLP Alerts
description: Enable aggregation of DLP alerts based on common entities user even when multiple rules are matched. This feature should consolidate related alert events into a single alert object to: Reduce alert noise, simplify investigation workflows, enhance contextual understanding of violations.

title: Microsoft Edge: Improved website compatibility with site troubleshooting controls
description: Microsoft Edge is introducing improvements to help users quickly resolve website issues directly from the browser. When a site is not functioning as expected, users may be guided to relevant troubleshooting options such as adjusting tracking prevention settings (e.g., Strict mode) and reviewing site-specific configurations.
