title: OneNote: Summary and Q&A in OneNote Mobile with Copilot (Android)
description: With this new Summary feature in OneNote mobile, you can create a short and fluent summary of your longer pages which will help to consume relevant information faster. With the Question and Answer at your fingertips, you can get real-time answers to your queries directly within your notes, enhancing your ability to access and utilize information quickly and effectively.

title: Dynamics 365 Finance and Operations cross-app: Migrate finance and operations environments from Lifecycle Services to Power Platform admin center
description: The self-service environment migration feature moves management of an existing finance and operations apps environment from Microsoft Dynamics Lifecycle Services to the Microsoft Power Platform admin center.
products: Microsoft Power Platform governance and administration

title: Microsoft Purview: Data Lifecycle Management – Ensure regulatory compliance by deleting inactive OneDrives and mailboxes for departing employees
description: Enables admins to delete both content and containers for departed users at scale thereby keeping your tenant compliant without any manual effort.

title: Microsoft Entra ID: Passkey support for B2B users
description: B2B users, including internal guest users and external users, will be able to register and sign in with passkeys issued by a resource tenant to meet that tenant's multifactor authentication (MFA) requirements. Today, passkeys are supported for member users in their home tenant. With this update, B2B users can register a resource tenant passkey from the resource tenant's My Security Info page, or in-line during a proof-up prompt or passkey registration campaign, and then use it to satisfy the resource tenant's MFA requirements. This change is on by default. B2B users already in scope for passkeys in your Authentication methods policy will be enabled automatically. No action is required to turn it on. If you want to review or adjust who's affected, update your Authentication methods policy, passkey registration campaign, Conditional Access policies, and user scoping before rollout.

title: Microsoft Edge: Updated performance information in tab hover cards
description: Microsoft Edge is updating tab hover cards to provide clearer information about tab memory usage and memory savings when inactive tabs are discarded. Users will also have separate settings for tab-preview images and memory-usage information.

title: Microsoft Teams: Onboarding workflow for new team members
description: Help people get started faster by automatically connecting new team members to relevant channels when they join a team. Improve engagement, accelerate onboarding, and make it easier to discover important information from day one.

title: Outlook: Draft, edit and format emails conversationally with Copilot in Outlook
description: In Outlook, Copilot now works side by side with users to draft, refine, and format emails conversationally, powered by the same agentic capabilities available in Word, Excel, and PowerPoint.

title: Dynamics 365 Commerce: Add items to a transaction from the numpad
description:
How it works

​
Quick add reuses the existing numpad on the transaction screen, so there is no new input control to learn and no additional space consumed in the transaction grid.
​

  1. The associate enters a full or partial item number on the numpad.
  2. On an exact match, the item is added directly to the transaction.
  3. On a partial match, instead of navigating to the search results page, an inline dialog opens on the transaction screen listing the matching products.
  4. The associate adds an item directly from that inline list using Add to sale.
    ​
    If a selected product requires variant selection such as size or color, the variant selection dialog is invoked inline before the item is added. Quick add is optimized for fast, SKU-based matching and is intentionally distinct from global search, which remains the tool for exploration and rich product discovery.
    ​

Inline result experience

​

  • Partial matches are shown as a list on the transaction screen, each row offering an Add to sale action.
  • Results do not navigate to the product page by default, keeping the associate in context.

​

Platform behavior

​

  • Desktop and mobile behave consistently: exact matches add directly, partial matches show inline results.
  • On mobile, the full-screen numpad follows the same logic.
    ​

Entry point

​
Quick add is triggered from the existing numpad on the transaction screen. There is no separate text input field, avoiding redundancy with global search and preserving screen space.
​

Enabling the feature

​

  • Application: Store Commerce (Point of Sale).
  • Quick add builds on the numpad entry experience already present on the transaction screen.
    ​

Dependencies

​

  • Reuses the inline variant selector common control, shared with the Bulk add experience.
  • Quick add and Bulk add are companion features; Bulk add covers pasting a full list of items, while Quick add covers fast single-item entry from the numpad.
    ​

title: Dynamics 365 Field Service: Automate optimizations with Scheduling Operations Agent
description:
This release expands the optimization capabilities of the Scheduling Operations Agent to include the ability to create recurring optimizations on a schedule. The agent considers the availability of the resources, their current schedules, and unscheduled requirements. It suggests a schedule that honors configured constraints and optimizes it according to the selected goal. The agent automatically runs optimizations and applies the results on the configured schedule.

New capabilities include:

  • Configure optimization plans to run on a recurrence schedule.
  • Add and weight additional objectives to optimization goals.

These capabilities build on the existing public preview of the Scheduling Operations Agent and are automatically enabled for all organizations that have the agent enabled. Learn more at Scheduling Operations Agent overview.

title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Chat: Access to UBB models via the model selector
description: Users will be able to access models that require usage-based billing (UBB) from the model selector in Chat. Tenant admins will need to allocate credits so that users can interact with these models. If users consume their allotted credits, they will be able to request credits from their tenant admins.

title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Use Dataverse Business Skills in Sales Agent
description:
Business Skills are natural language instructions authored and stored in Microsoft Dataverse that teach Sales Agent how work gets done within a specific organization. Business Skills enable organizations to create natural language instructions for Sales Agent to follow, which represent their business processes, policies, and business knowledge. Business skills can represent common sales workflows such as lead qualification, pipeline reviews, account planning, opportunity scoring, account brief creation, or organization-specific sales methodologies. Sales Agent uses the instructions in Business Skills to deliver responses that align with the customer's business processes and guidance.

Sellers can interact with Sales agent using natural language and receive responses that are guided by their organization's Business Skills, following admin defined sales processes, applying company specific guidance, and surface insights that reflect how the organization operations.

Administrators enable the required Dataverse capabilities, create and manage Business skills within Dataverse, and control Business skill access. Business skills can be authored using natural language instructions and associated with the organization's CRM environment.

title: Microsoft Edge: Commercial Journeys - AI-powered task completion for Microsoft 365 Copilot users
description: Commercial Journeys helps information workers stay on top of their most important work when browsing in Microsoft Edge. Powered by AI, it proactively surfaces unfinished, new, and recurring tasks on the Copilot new tab page- with context-rich cards that explain why each task matters now. One click opens a guided execution flow that delivers ready-to-use outputs (emails, documents, presentations, and more), so users can complete their unfinished work faster with higher quality. This feature will be available to users with a Microsoft 365 Copilot Premium license in Edge.

title: Microsoft Teams: Start side conversations during meetings
description: Keep collaboration moving without disrupting the main discussion. Start and continue one-to-one or small-group conversations directly from a meeting to ask questions, coordinate next steps, share information, and collaborate in parallel while staying engaged in the conversation, reducing context switching and helping teams stay focused and productive.

title: Microsoft Edge: Improvements to site permissions user interfaces
description: To better align with user expectations, site permissions are changing to look and work both in context on a website that is requesting permissions and when navigating to permissions from Settings. On a website that is requesting permissions, there are changes to the Omnibox and the Page Info dialog and permissions will be easier to see and modify in Settings.

title: SharePoint: Advanced Management - Inactive files policy
description: SharePoint administrators can use the Inactive files policy in SharePoint Advanced Management to automatically archive files based on when they were last accessed. The public preview is available through PowerShell only. Admins can set an inactivity threshold from 6 to 48 months, scope policies to all SharePoint sites or selected sites, include or exclude file types and sites, and use What-If mode to review impact before activation. Eligible files move to the Microsoft 365 Archive cold-storage tier while remaining in place and retaining their metadata, permissions, compliance, and searchability. Microsoft 365 Archive and pay-as-you-go billing must be enabled.

title: OneDrive: Presentation mode for PDFs in the iOS app on iPad
description: Microsoft OneDrive is introducing presentation mode in the OneDrive iOS app for users on iPad devices. Users select a new Presentation button in the PDF viewer to enter a focused, view-only experience that prevents free gesture scrolling between pages, reducing accidental page changes while presenting without moving the file to another app. The feature is not available on iPhone.

title: Microsoft Teams: Intelligent call delegation
description: Incoming Teams calls don't wait for a break in your day. Intelligent call delegation provides AI-powered calling assistance so you can focus on the conversations that matter most. It answers calls and gathers context, helping you decide whether to pick up and engage the caller. It can also schedule follow-up appointments through an integration with Microsoft Bookings so you can reconnect with callers at a more convenient time.

title: Microsoft Teams: Add alternate text to images shared from OneDrive and SharePoint
description: Improve accessibility by adding alternate text to images shared in Teams from OneDrive and SharePoint, helping users better understand visual content

title: Microsoft Teams: Connect Teams meeting to existing Planner Plans
description: Teams meetings automatically create a corresponding Planner plan to capture meeting tasks. However, when teams use meetings as their primary collaboration surface for long-running initiatives, tasks from the same project can become scattered across multiple auto-generated plans. With this capability, users can now connect Teams meetings to existing Planner plans, so all related tasks across meetings can be tracked in one place.

title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): [Copilot Extensibility] Users in GCC-H will be able to use custom engine agents
description: Users in GCC-H will be able to use custom engine agents.

title: Microsoft Edge: PDF Viewer Performance Improvement and Minor Visual Updates
description:
The PDF Viewer in Microsoft Edge is enhancing responsiveness and introducing a series of subtle visual upgrades aimed at improving overall usability and utility. This migration ensures UI coherence with the rest of the browser while maintaining the same user experience.
The update focuses on improving underlying performance, consistency in design elements, and a smoother interaction without altering any existing workflows for users.

title: Microsoft Viva: Copilot Analytics - Agent Dashboard.
description: Viva Insights is creating an Agent Dashboard, designed to be a central place for leaders, delegates and analysts to understand how your organization is adopting agents. #copilotcontrolsystem

title: Microsoft Purview compliance portal: Cloud Attachments preservation for users on hold
description: Enables cloud attachment preservation for users put on infinite hold so that file versions shared are preserved across any OneDrive or SharePoint site. This is a new capability which is different from the existing capability of applying label to cloud attachments and links present in OneDrive and SharePoint and shared in Exchange, Teams, Viva Engage and Copilot

title: Microsoft Edge: Adding support for viewing Sensitivity labels applied to a Microsoft Information Protection (MIP) Protected PDF
description: Enterprise customers can view sensitivity labels applied to MIP protected PDF to be well informed of the data classification to enable them to handle such sensitive documents. This change will be available in the new PDF viewer on Microsoft Edge.

title: Microsoft Purview: Data Lifecycle Management-Increase in expansion limit for auto-expanding archive beyond 1.5 TB
description: Previously, auto-expanding archive mailbox expansion was supported only up to 1.5 TB, after which mailboxes would become inoperative. Archive mailboxes can now automatically expand beyond the 1.5 TB limit, ensuring uninterrupted retention and enabling scalable archive growth as storage thresholds are reached. This capability to expand archives beyond 1.5 TB will be available to customers with eligible E5 licenses.

title: Microsoft Purview:  Permissions audit log improvements
description: Improving permission checks when users access the Microsoft Purview portal. Enhanced audit logs will provide clearer visibility into role and scoped-role access decisions, helping administrators troubleshoot access issues and monitor authorization outcomes.

title: Power Automate: Build and visualize desktop flows using Flowchart mode
description: Flowchart mode introduces a new visual authoring experience in Power Automate for desktop that allows makers to create, view, and edit desktop flows using a flowchart representation. Actions are displayed as connected nodes and execution paths are represented visually, making it easier to understand, build, and maintain complex automations that include conditions, loops, and branching logic. Makers can create new flows directly in Flowchart mode or switch existing flows between Sequence mode and Flowchart mode.

title: Dynamics 365 Field Service: Improve mobile offline reliability across network conditions
description:
Business value

Field service work often happens in environments where network quality changes throughout the day. Technicians may move between connected, low-connectivity, intermittent, and offline conditions while still needing the mobile app to remain dependable.

Mobile offline is being improved to better detect and respond to changing network conditions. More adaptive sync behavior can help reduce disruptions, avoid unnecessary retries, and improve reliability when users move across different connectivity states.

Feature detail

This update improves how mobile offline detects and responds to weak, intermittent, or limited connectivity. Sync behavior will become more adaptive so the app can better determine when to sync, when to pause, and when to reduce unnecessary work.

The capability is intended to help Field Service Mobile provide a more dependable offline experience in real-world field environments. It focuses on sync behavior and connectivity response, while administrators and makers remain responsible for designing offline profiles that match field usage, data volume, and business requirements.

title: Dynamics 365 Field Service: Enhance mobile offline up-sync
description:
Business value

Technicians often complete work in the field while connectivity is limited or intermittent. When offline changes still need to sync, users and back-office teams can be uncertain whether work details, status updates, and other field changes have reached business systems.

Mobile offline up-sync is being enhanced so changes captured in the field can continue syncing more reliably. This helps frontline users gain confidence that completed work will be submitted without repeatedly checking the app or following up manually.

Feature detail

This update improves mobile offline up-sync for changes created while technicians work in Field Service Mobile. It includes support for background up-sync and user notifications when pending changes still need to sync.

When changes remain pending, the mobile experience can help users understand that additional sync work is still required. The capability is intended to reduce uncertainty around offline changes and help field updates reach Dataverse more reliably as connectivity becomes available.

title: Dynamics 365 Field Service: Modernize the mobile offline foundation
description:
Business value

Field service organizations often depend on mobile offline so technicians can keep working when connectivity is limited or unavailable. As offline profiles grow larger and apps include more related data, first sync, resource loading, and repeated sync work can affect technician productivity and confidence in the mobile experience.

Power Apps mobile offline is being updated with a more native foundation for data access and sync orchestration. This foundation is intended to improve responsiveness, reduce repeated sync work, and better support complex Field Service Mobile apps that use larger offline profiles and richer related data.

Feature detail

This update modernizes the mobile offline foundation used by Power Apps mobile and Field Service Mobile. It includes native sync processing, improved handling of related rows during first sync, and optimizations for app resource and custom file loading.

The updated foundation is designed to strengthen offline data access and sync orchestration while preserving the mobile offline app experience customers already use. Administrators and makers should continue to review offline profile design, table relationships, data volume, and file usage to align mobile offline configuration with field usage patterns.

title: Dynamics 365 Customer Service: Quality evaluation supports custom Case-like records evaluation
description: Quality evaluation now supports on-demand evaluations for case-like custom entities in public preview. Organizations can extend evaluation capabilities beyond the standard case entity to supported custom Dataverse entities that follow a case-like service workflow. This enables teams to evaluate additional business records using the quality evaluation framework, while giving admins flexibility to configure evaluation entry points for their custom scenarios.

title: Dynamics 365 Field Service: Capture project expenses directly from Field Service Work Orders
description: Technicians can create, update, and submit project-related expenses directly from a Work Order in Field Service web and mobile when the Field Service and Project Operations integration is enabled. Expenses remain connected to the related project and follow the standard Project Operations approval process, helping teams capture field costs with less context switching and better financial traceability.

title: Microsoft Purview: Data Loss Prevention-Upgraded inline protection for Microsoft Entra-managed apps in Edge for Business
description: Microsoft Purview is upgrading inline data protection for Microsoft Entra-managed apps in Edge for Business. The experience integrates with a Microsoft Entra Conditional Access grant control and simplifies configuration while removing current Purview policy restrictions. Admins can now use expanded conditions and condition combinations, multiple activities per rule, simulation mode, configurable alerts and notifications, and rule match activities are visible in activity explorer.

title: Planner: AI-generated Status Reports in Planner Agent
description: AI-powered Status Report in Planner Agent turns your plan data into a polished, stakeholder-ready update in minutes. Just ask Planner Agent for a status report and it pulls your task data and transforms it into a clear narrative covering overall status, progress, risks, and what's next. You can easily customize the report to your needs by specifying the audience, tone, length, and sections you want.

title: Microsoft Purview: Data Loss Prevention - Collection and DLP Policies for Intune-Policy Managed Apps
description: We are introducing a new integrated Microsoft Purview Data Loss Prevention (DLP) capability for Intune Mobile Application Management (MAM)-protected mobile apps, enabling organizations to apply content‑aware protection policies to sensitive data on mobile devices. This integration ensures that clipboard actions in managed mobile apps are evaluated against Purview DLP policies before sharing is allowed, helping reduce data leakage, insider risk, and exposure to advanced threats across mobile workflows. Additionally, Microsoft Purview Collection policies can be used to govern how sensitive data is being handled in mobile apps.

title: Microsoft 365: Pay-as-you-go storage for OneDrive
description: New pay-as-you-go, consumption-based meter for additional OneDrive storage. Control which OneDrive accounts can grow beyond their licensed storage limits and give selected users more space as needed.

title: Microsoft Purview compliance portal: Optical character recognition (OCR) support for SharePoint Online and OneDrive for Business
description: Optical character recognition (OCR) support will detect sensitive content in images and subsequently apply data loss prevention (DLP) policies to prevent exfiltration of that sensitive data in SharePoint Online and OneDrive. This release supports key file types like JPG, JPEG, PNG, TIFF, BMP, and PDF (image-only PDF).

title: Microsoft Teams: Third-party synthetic audio and video detection in Microsoft Teams
description: Organizations can enhance meeting security with synthetic audio and video detection solutions provided by certified third-party providers. Third-party detection solutions analyze meeting media for signs of synthetic or manipulated audio and video and send detection signals to Teams, enabling integrated in-meeting experiences and controls. Important: Synthetic media detection is performed by the third-party provider. Microsoft Teams provides the platform integration and experiences for surfacing and acting on detection signals from supported providers.

title: Microsoft Teams: Impersonation Protection for Teams meetings
description: Impersonation Protection for Teams meetings helps users identify potentially deceptive participants and meeting organizers. When Teams detects a potential impersonation attempt, it surfaces warnings and risk indicators to help users recognize suspicious identities and make more informed decisions when joining or participating in a meeting.

title: Microsoft Viva: Copilot Analytics - Agent value insights in Agent 365 Dashboard
description:
Customers can now view value insights in the Agent 365 Dashboard in Microsoft Viva Insights (Copilot Analytics). These insights help business leaders and change and adoption specialists understand not only whether agents are being used, but also the estimated assisted hours agents provide and the types of work contributing to that value.

This update builds on the existing Agent 365 Dashboard adoption experience by connecting agent activity with a clearer view of the work agents support across the organization.

title: Microsoft Edge: Inline Switching for Workspaces
description: Workspaces Inline Switching manages multiple Workspaces in a single window. Selecting a Workspace swaps in its tabs, theme, and context, with an easy return to the default space.

title: Microsoft Purview: Information Protection - Sensitivity Labels for Microsoft Entra Security Groups
description: Apply sensitivity labels to Microsoft Entra cloud security groups to extend the classification and governance you already use for Microsoft 365 groups. The same labels you publish in the Microsoft Purview portal and configure for groups and sites apply automatically to cloud security groups, with no separate label configuration required.

title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Workforce Insights Agent
description: Workforce Insights (WFI) Agent in Microsoft 365 Copilot is an agent designed to help leaders, managers, and their delegates quickly understand their organization by turning complex workforce data into clear, actionable insights. With WFI Agent, leaders can quickly explore their organization’s structure, team composition, skills inventories, and flexible work patterns to move from insight to action in a single, unified experience directly in Copilot or Teams.

title: Microsoft Edge: Adding contextual nudges to the Microsoft 365 Copilot Chat icon
description: Edge for Business will soon help users quickly take contextual action on their open pages using contextual nudges attached to the Copilot icon in the toolbar

title: Outlook: Upcoming visual improvements and a more consistent Outlook experience
description: The first updates will focus on visual details, such as icons, spacing and alignment. Users of classic Outlook for Windows will begin seeing refinements to familiar mail and calendar surfaces. The initial visual updates are intended to improve clarity and consistency without changing how users perform their tasks.

title: SharePoint: AI input widget and content preview in Copilot
description: With this new capability, users of Copilot in SharePoint will be able to view saved and unsaved preview content side by side with chat. Users will also be able to interact with created HTML forms and confirm responses to send to chat.

title: Dynamics 365 Project Operations: Review financial dimensions when approving expenses on mobile
description: Approvers need access to the financial information behind an expense to make accurate approval decisions without leaving the approval experience. Dynamics 365 expense management mobile app will surface relevant financial dimensions directly within expense report approvals in the mobile app. Approvers can review financial coding in context before making a decision, helping reduce unnecessary navigation and keep expense approvals moving.

title: Dynamics 365 Project Operations: Track mileage expenses using kilometers
description: Organizations operating across different regions need to record mileage expenses using the units of measure appropriate for their employees and local requirements. Dynamics 365 Project Operations will support kilometers (km) as a configurable unit of measure for mileage expenses, in addition to miles. Organizations can configure the appropriate mileage unit for their business, helping employees record mileage expenses accurately using the measurement standard relevant to their regional requirements.

title: Microsoft Teams: Streaming switchboard for Network Device Interface (NDI) Sources
description: For Teams meetings and events, a new streaming switchboard will soon be available to easily manage and send NDI sources out to production software.

title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Copilot Chat in OneNote can create, edit, and refine content
description: Copilot in OneNote can generate new content and directly edit when in edit mode. In this mode you can create, rename, and delete pages, sections, or notebooks as well as add or edit content in pages. Copilot can bring content from across WorkIQ as well as complete actions across other workflows such as creating Word, Excel, and PowerPoint files.

title: Planner: Refreshed experience and new capabilities
description: Microsoft Planner will be updated with a cleaner, more modern interface, improved navigation, responsive layouts, and a more consistent experience across Planner in Teams and Planner for the web.

title: Dynamics 365 Project Operations: Cancel packing slips for stocked item requirements
description:
This feature supports controlled returns and packing slip cancellations for stocked item requirements originating in Finance and Supply Chain Management. You can open the Packing slip journal from the Item requirements page and cancel packing slips for eligible independent item requirements. Packing slip posting performs the physical inventory update while deferring the financial update, allowing cancellation before invoicing or finalization. Cancellation reverses the project cost, returns the item requirement to open order, and creates negative material usage and sales transactions through dual-write. Negative quantities remain blocked when entered directly in Dataverse.

This feature also enables the ability to create new item requirements for both positive consumption and negative return scenarios with product dimensions such as serial number to support returns or warranty scenarios.

The feature is off by default. To enable it, in Feature management, enable Enable packing slip cancellation for integrated deployments. It requires Enable packing slip cancellation for item requirements and Enable stocked products usage for resource/non-stock scenarios features to also be enabled.

To see the project cost posting, be sure to enable Post packing slip in ledger in Accounts receivable parameters to create the physical inventory voucher and display project cost. Fixed-price projects also require the feature Finalize uninvoiced stocked items before inventory can be financially finalized.

Turning off the integrated cancellation feature restores the previous posting behavior and removes cancellation availability.

This feature applies to the Project Operations connected with ERP deployment type.

title: Microsoft Viva: Expanded agent coverage in Agent Dashboard
description: Customers can now view reporting for agents from third-party platforms in the Agent 365 Dashboard in Microsoft Viva Insights (Copilot Analytics). This expanded coverage provides a more comprehensive view of agent activity across their organization.

title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Audio Overview updates in Copilot Notebooks
description: We're rolling out new capabilities for Copilot Notebook audio overview that make it easier to navigate longer content with topic-based episodes, new audio formats such as Critique and Debate, support enterprise information protection with sensitivity labels, and expand audio overview context to more content types.

title: Microsoft Purview: DSPM – New Microsoft Purview Data Security Posture Management Experience
description: At Ignite, Microsoft is introducing a major evolution of Purview Data Security Posture Management (DSPM) to help organizations strengthen data security and confidently embrace AI. The new DSPM experience unifies visibility and control across traditional data and AI-driven environments, delivering outcome-based guided workflows that turn insights into actionable steps—so teams can prioritize risks and remediate faster. It brings AI observability, enhanced posture reporting, and intelligent Security Copilot agents to automate tasks like triage and policy management. Plus, Purview now extends coverage beyond Microsoft data with third-party signals from partners like BigID, Cyera, OneTrust, and Varonis, giving security teams a single, streamlined view of sensitive data across clouds and platforms. Together, these innovations make DSPM the central hub for managing data security posture in the era of AI. We are also extending Data Risk Assessments to Fabric and to item-level analysis with new remediation actions like bulk disabling of overshared SharePoint links.

title: Microsoft Teams: Pro Management portal Analytics & Reports Design Refresh
description: We are refreshing the way we organize the Analytics & Reports area in the Pro Management portal to make it more user-friendly.

title: Dynamics 365 Supply Chain Management: Procurement Agent - Customize the Procurement Agent supplier follow-up criteria
description: Organizations often use business-specific data and criteria to determine when suppliers require follow-up on purchase orders. The Procurement Agent will enable buyers to extend supplier follow-up criteria using related standard, extended, and custom table data. Buyers can add table joins and use fields from those tables as filter conditions, providing greater flexibility to determine which purchase order lines qualify for supplier follow-up based on their organization’s processes and data.

title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Scheduling with Copilot
description: Users can now schedule appointments and meetings directly from chat. Simply ask Copilot to create an appointment or schedule a meeting with colleagues, and it will find available times, book rooms, draft agendas, and send invites—all within the chat experience.

title: Microsoft Copilot Studio: Discover and use shared plugins in Copilot Studio
description: Copilot Studio now connects to Microsoft's shared plugin registry, making it easier for makers to discover and use plugins, connectors, and other available capabilities. This integration provides a more consistent way to extend agents with capabilities across Microsoft's AI ecosystem.

title: Outlook: Improved SharePoint file experience in file picker in Outlook mobile apps
description: Users can more easily work with SharePoint files in Outlook by saving email attachments directly to SharePoint and searching across SharePoint sites for files from the file picker.

title: Microsoft Teams: Chat for organizers and presenters in structured meetings and webinars on Teams Rooms on Android
description: When a Teams Rooms on Android device acts as an organizer, co-organizer, or presenter in a structured meeting or webinar, you have access to the private chat for event management known as the Event Group. You can also switch to a separate chat with attendees, enabling smooth event experiences for all. Available in Teams Rooms Pro-licensed rooms.

title: Microsoft Teams: External presenter support for event group chat
description: Event group chat, the private chat for organizers, co-organizers, and presenters in an event or structured meeting, will support external presenters.

title: Microsoft Teams: Invite attendees to register
description: For an event that needs registration, send email invites to the selected people and groups who will be invited to register to the event

title: SharePoint: Governance Reviews Dashboard for Site Owners
description:
Site owners have a critical role to play in ensuring accuracy of site information, including the site's necessity, its owners, members, permissions, and sharing settings. We’re introducing the Governance Reviews Dashboard in Private Preview, a centralized view where site owners can see all pending site governance reviews (inactivity, ownership, attestation) across the sites they own.
The dashboard shows required actions, due timelines, and site enforcement status and allows site owners to take action directly from one place. Combined with consolidated policy notifications, it replaces multiple emails with a single, actionable governance surface.

title: Microsoft Edge: Enterprise New Tab Page experience
description: A modern experience for the New Tab Page (NTP) on Microsoft Edge for Business.

title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Viva Engage - Community Agent
description: Community Agent helps members get answers to questions in Viva Engage communities using community knowledge and connected sources. Community admins can choose to require human review before answers are posted or allow automatic posting.

title: Microsoft Purview compliance portal: Data Loss Prevention - Optical character recognition (OCR) support for endpoint
description: Optical character recognition (OCR) support will detect sensitive content in images and subsequently apply data loss prevention (DLP) policies to prevent exfiltration of that sensitive data on your Windows endpoint devices. This release supports key file types like JPG, JPEG, PNG, TIFF, BMP and PDF (image only PDF).
ai_summary: Microsoft Purview introduces OCR support for detecting sensitive content on Windows endpoints. This change impacts administrators managing data loss prevention on devices.

title: Microsoft Purview: Data Loss Prevention-Apply Purview network data security DLP policies to all websites, or all websites except specific cloud apps, through Entra GSA Internet Access integration
description: With this feature, admins can scope their network data security data loss prevention policies, integrated with Entra GSA Internet Access, to apply to all websites (.) or all websites except specific cloud apps, allowing them to apply protection to cloud apps and websites that are not in the Defender Cloud App Catalog.

title: Microsoft Purview: Information Protection - Apply default SharePoint library labels to data at rest
description: Enables auto‑labeling of existing SharePoint files to match the default sensitivity label configured on their document library. This helps organizations close labeling gaps for data at rest and ensure consistent, secure‑by‑default protection across SharePoint libraries—without relying on manual user labeling.

title: Dynamics 365 Project Operations: Unify product receipt and item requirement posting
description: This feature posts a purchase order product receipt and the consumption of its linked project item requirement in one transaction. It applies when automatic item consumption is enabled or when you select Consume immediately while posting the product receipt. Both updates succeed together, or the system rolls them both back when an error occurs. The posting flow prevents duplicate project posting and preserves existing behavior for batch posting and cancellation or correction flows. This combined posting can only be triggered from product receipt posting. The feature is available for public preview in version 10.0.49 and is off by default. It applies to Project Operations connected with ERP and Project Operations for manufacturing deployment types.

title: Power Apps: Model-driven applications in Business Apps in Work IQ
description: Power Apps model-driven apps are now available as Business Apps in Work IQ. They can be accessed through the Work IQ (Preview) tool in Copilot Studio or through a natural-language chat experience powered by Work IQ MCP. In either experience, natural-language prompts let users list and read records or create, update, and delete them. For create and update, Work IQ maps supplied values to the appropriate app fields. Before a change is submitted, the proposed values require explicit user confirmation.

title: Work IQ: Updating documents in Office
description: Work IQ enables agents to create and edit Microsoft Office documents using organizational context, helping users produce and update content more efficiently.

title: Work IQ: Upload
description: Enable agents to upload files and content to supported Microsoft 365 destinations.

title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft M365): Copilot Chat can now better match search results from text that appears inside images embedded in Word and PowerPoint files
description: Copilot Chat can now better match search results from text that appears inside images embedded in Word and PowerPoint files is user's working files — such as scanned contracts in Word, text from tables, text from images — content that was previously difficult to search and find.

title: Microsoft Viva: Copilot Dashboard - Targeted Audience Surveys
description: Targeted Audience Surveys let change leaders launch a Copilot Pulse survey directly from the Copilot Dashboard to all licensed or active users. Audiences update automatically using Insights data and respect existing dashboard filters like organization and job function, with privacy protected through population-level reporting only. Pair adoption metrics with employee sentiment in just a few clicks.

title: Microsoft Purview: Data Loss Prevention - Rule-based tagging and auto-resolution of alerts based on business needs of the customer.
description:
Alert auto-resolution & tagging rules let you tell DLP, in advance, how to handle predictable alerts. You define a rule once, and from then on DLP applies it automatically to every new alert:
● Resolve alerts you don't need to see - e.g., Low-severity alerts for mail sent only to your trusted partner domains, so they never reach your triage queue.
● Tag alerts so you can find and route them - e.g., label every alert from your Legal department as a “Business Process”.

title: Microsoft Purview: Insider Risk Management – Reduce temporary file noise for Endpoint activities in IRM
description: When files are opened in Windows, the operating system, and applications (for example, Microsoft Office and browsers) can create, rename, and delete temporary files as part of normal behavior. The Endpoint client audits these activities, resulting in high-volume, low-signal events that appear as “noise” for Insider Risk Management (IRM) customers. While global exclusions exist (file type, keyword, file path, etc.), some temporary file naming patterns are not easily captured with the current exclusions, leaving customers without a practical way to reduce noise without over-excluding. This feature introduces built-in filtering for well-known temporary file name patterns so that Endpoint file operations are excluded from IRM activity explorer and scoring reducing noise allowing customers to focus on the most relevant alerts. Microsoft Purview Insider Risk Management correlates various signals to identify potential malicious or inadvertent insider risks, such as IP theft, data leakage, and security violations. Insider Risk Management enables customers to create policies based on their own internal policies, governance, and organizational requirements. Built with privacy by design, users are pseudonymized by default, and role-based access controls and audit logs are in place to help ensure user-level privacy.

title: Microsoft Purview: Data Lifecycle Management – Archive SharePoint files under retention
description: We are introducing file archiving support in SharePoint Online, utilizing this feature administrators can seamlessly include archiving actions within their existing data retention policies. This means that, in addition to keeping or deleting data, admins can now leverage Purview DLM to archive files according to organizational requirements, ensuring comprehensive governance across all stages of the content lifecycle in SharePoint Online. Retention based file archiving moves inactive content to low-cost storage, lowering costs with no compromise on Compliance, keeping data discoverable and making Copilot results highly relevant.

title: Microsoft Purview: Insider Risk Management-Priority content support for Risky AI usage
description: With this update, Risky AI usage policy template will support priority content. Customers can define Sensitive Info Types (SITs), Trainable Classifiers, Sensitivity Labels as priority content, and get alerted only when the activity matches the selected priority content. Microsoft Purview Insider Risk Management correlates various signals to identify potential malicious or inadvertent insider risks, such as IP theft, data leakage, and security violations. Insider Risk Management enables customers to create policies based on their own internal policies, governance, and organizational requirements. Built with privacy by design, users are pseudonymized by default, and role-based access controls and audit logs are in place to help ensure user-level privacy.

title: Microsoft Viva: Viva Glint and Viva Insights Integration - Continuous employee engagement for leaders and managers with workplace metrics
description: Stay connected to your team’s engagement with Viva Insights Workplace Metrics, available alongside your survey results in Viva Glint. Between survey cycles, leaders and managers can use these continuous, real-time metrics to see how their team is working and evaluate whether actions they are taking to improve engagement are having the desired impact. This feature currently supports work-life balance and collaboration metrics, with more areas planned in the future.

title: SharePoint: Agent chat web part
description: This is a new web part available for modern page editors in SharePoint. The web part can be configured to use any M365 Copilot agent.

title: Microsoft Purview: Data Loss Prevention-Admin Units Support for Copilot & Cowork DLP
description: Microsoft Purview Data Loss Prevention is extending Administrative Units support to Microsoft 365 Copilot, Copilot Chat, and Cowork. This enables organizations to delegate management of supported Copilot DLP policies to administrators within their assigned Administrative Units, supporting regional, departmental, and regulatory boundaries without granting tenant-wide policy-management permissions. Existing tenant-wide policies continue to apply, and configuration is optional for organizations choosing to use Administrative Unit (AU)-scoped management.

title: Microsoft Purview: Information Protection-Auto-labeling for legacy Office files
description: Microsoft Purview server-side auto-labeling will support legacy Microsoft Office file formats, including Word (.doc), Excel (.xls), and PowerPoint (.ppt). Organizations can automatically evaluate and apply sensitivity labels to these files in SharePoint and OneDrive.

title: Visio: Desktop Model Context Protocol (MCP) Server
description: The Microsoft Visio Desktop MCP Server enables compatible AI clients to connect with the Visio Desktop application to create, read, and update Visio diagrams using natural language. It runs locally on Windows and requires a licensed Visio Desktop application.

title: Dynamics 365 Commerce: Enable MCP tools for POS returns
description:
This feature provides reusable MCP tools for Store Commerce POS returns. These tools expose Commerce return capabilities as structured actions that customers, partners, and agent developers can use to build conversational or agentic return experiences.

The tools enable agentic experiences to look up the original purchase using supported identifiers such as receipt, order, invoice, or confirmation number; retrieve matching transactions and returnable lines; identify items that are returnable, partially returnable, already returned, or not returnable; create a return using selected lines, quantities, and reason codes; determine eligible refund options for original-tender refund scenarios; and execute eligible original-tender refunds through existing Commerce return and payment logic.

The tools can also explain return eligibility, policy restrictions, and why specific lines may or may not be returnable. They can analyze prior returns and refunds to surface duplicate-refund risk, frequent-return patterns, cross-store return history, or other return-risk indicators. Tool responses provide structured data that host experiences can use to present return details, choices, summaries, and next steps in the experience they build.
Customers can use these tools from POS-embedded agents, chat-based copilots, workflow orchestrators, or other agentic surfaces.

Setup is performed by an administrator, IT owner, or implementation partner. Customers configure the host surface, authorize the agent or integration to call the tools, and maintain existing Commerce return policies, reason codes, tender rules, and payment configuration.

title: Power Apps: Manage model-driven app AI features from consolidated settings
description:
Consolidated AI settings make it easier for makers and admins to find and manage AI capabilities for model-driven apps across two complementary surfaces.

In Maker Studio, the Settings dialog in the model app form designer adds a new top-level Copilot and AI tab. Makers can see and adjust all available AI options for the app in one place instead of finding them scattered among all the other settings.

In the Power Platform admin center, model-driven app AI settings are consolidated from Environment > Settings into Copilot Hub > Power Apps. This provides a central location for settings such as Generative pages, Copilot in apps, and the in-app AI skills. The in-app skill settings are organized into these groups:

  • Data entry: Form fill assistance.
  • Summary: Row summaries.
  • Data analysis: AI-generated charts and natural-language search and filtering.

Labels and descriptions are aligned across Maker Studio and Copilot Hub so makers and admins can understand how the controls relate.

As part of this consolidation, the old model-driven app AI switches under Environment > Settings will also be retired and removed.

Availability

Field Value
Applies to Model-driven apps
Release Channel Weekly
Version 2610.3
Feature Scope Admins or makers

title: Dynamics 365 Supply Chain Management: Procurement Agent - Define custom scenarios for agent-generated supplier emails
description:
Business end-users and buyers can define and maintain their own outbound follow-up scenarios and use them wherever built-in scenarios are used today:

  1. Scenario maintenance — a dedicated setup page where users create, edit, and maintain custom follow-up scenarios. Each scenario carries its own name, the instructions that shape the email the agent writes, and the business entity it applies to.
  2. Scenario-driven configuration — follow-up configurations are built around the chosen scenario, so criteria, email content, and agent behavior all follow the scenario the user selected.
  3. Scenario-driven runtime — when the agent runs, it generates and sends messages according to the selected scenario's intent and instructions.
  4. Self-describing configuration history — scenario details are captured with each saved configuration, so the audit history of an agent configuration remains readable even if the underlying scenario definition is later changed or removed.

title: Outlook: Copilot Chat available in shared and delegate mailboxes
description: Shared mailbox users and delegates with read and manage (full access) and/or mail folder-level permission will now be able to access Copilot Chat directly from their shared and delegate mailboxes in classic Outlook, when added as a resource.

title: Power Pages: Create Power Pages SPA site from the Power Pages studio
description: Quickly get started with modern single-page application (SPA) development by creating a site directly from Power Pages Studio. Continue building and customizing your experience using your preferred development tools and frameworks.

title: Work IQ: Microsoft IQ
description: Provide a unified intelligence layer that helps agents discover, reason over, and use organizational knowledge.

title: Work IQ: REST endpoint tools
description: Enable agents to use supported REST endpoints as tools through governed Work IQ integrations.

title: Work IQ: A2A and MCP elicitation
description: Enable A2A and MCP tasks to request missing information or authorization and then resume.

title: Work IQ: A2A and MCP long running tasks
description: Enable durable long-running A2A and MCP tasks with progress tracking, later result retrieval, and cancellation.

title: Work IQ: Retrieve
description: Enable agents to retrieve relevant Microsoft 365 content and context through Work IQ.

title: Microsoft Teams: Event Chat now available for Events optimized for a large audience in GCC, GCC High and DoD
description: All users in Events larger than 1,000 users or in any Event optimized for a large audience can now chat with one another in a public event chat in GCC, GCC High and DoD.

title: Power Apps: Control information density in model-driven apps
description:
Model-driven apps now support configurable display density settings that let users choose how information is spaced throughout the application. Users can select from three density options:

  • Comfortable (default)
  • Cozy
  • Compact
    ​

Each density setting adjusts layout spacing while maintaining accessibility target-size requirements. Administrators and makers can configure default density settings at the environment and app level, while individual users can personalize the experience by selecting their preferred density. User preferences take precedence over administrator-configured defaults.
​
Display density requires the Header and Navigation Refresh experience to be enabled, and will be enabled by default for apps that have Header and Navigation Refresh enabled. Makers can disable display density for their apps using the app setting if needed.
​
Some controls and components may not yet support display density. These controls will continue to render using their standard spacing regardless of the selected density setting. Custom component developers can add support for display density by adopting Fluent design spacing tokens. Learn more in the documentation.
​
Availability

Field Value

title: Microsoft Teams: See more messages on mobile
description: We are introducing a more streamlined messaging experience that displays more content on screen while improving readability when using Teams on mobile. These updates make it easier to scan conversations and follow the discussion flow, helping users stay productive and engaged wherever they work.

title: Microsoft Edge: Upgraded Copilot new tab page
description: Search, chat, and explore the web from one search box with Copilot-suggested actions and curated work content to help your users get things done faster on the Copilot new tab page. Users will see upgraded Copilot new tab page functionality and features.

title: Microsoft Purview: Information Protection - Rights Management connector – Certificate-based authentication
description: The Microsoft Rights Management (RMS) connector is moving from shared-secret authentication to certificate-based authentication, improving its security posture. With this update, administrators configure their own Microsoft Entra app registration and certificate, then use the new PowerShell module to configure the certificate for each workload (Connector, Exchange, SharePoint, and FCI). New PowerShell cmdlets handle certificate import, registry configuration, private-key permissions, and validation. As part of this change, the connector setup no longer provisions an Entra service principal or issues a shared secret on the customer's behalf. Customers should plan to register an Entra ID application and upload a certificate before installing or upgrading the connector.

title: Microsoft Teams: Preloaded video for Teams Events and Meetings
description: Users can now upload videos directly into a Teams event or meeting from OneDrive from the "Manage view" options when an organizer has turned on Manage What Attendees See mode. This ensures a smoother high quality video playback with a more consistent experience for attendees.

title: Microsoft Purview: Endpoint Data Loss Prevention - Policy Sync & Device Health AI-Powered Investigation
description: AI agent skill to detect and alert unhealthy policy sync and device configuration.

title: Microsoft Purview: Information Protection- File Labeler and File Viewer for MacOS
description: This feature is bringing the Information Protection Filer Labeler and Viewer applications to the MacOS platform. Enabling customers to have the same capabilities available on Mac. Core functionality will be available with the exception of the Advanced label-based protection feature.

title: Microsoft Teams: AI-generated meeting memory for knowledge retention (formerly AI-generated meeting archive)
description: Teams will store AI-generated meeting memory files for meetings where Intelligent Recap was turned on, allowing Copilot (and Facilitator) to retain key insights from meetings beyond transcript retention periods and when a transcript was not saved. This enables Copilot to continue answering questions about past meetings even after the transcript expires or the meeting is over. Admins can also configure how long this AI-generated meeting memory file is stored.

title: Microsoft Purview compliance portal: Data Lifecycle Management - Retention based on Last Accessed for files in OneDrive and SharePoint
description: This creates the ability to apply Retention to each SharePoint or OneDrive item based on when it was last accessed by a user. #copilotcontrolsystem

title: Power Pages: Design studio - Enhance OpenID Connect with encrypted token support
description:
This feature adds support for token-level encryption during authentication, allowing Power Pages to accept encrypted ID tokens in addition to signed tokens. It ensures secure claim transmission, improves compatibility with advanced identity providers, and strengthens overall authentication security without changing existing sign-in flows.

Business Value:

You can integrate with more secure identity providers to meet stricter security and compliance requirements. This helps you expand into high-trust scenarios and allows your organization to confidently use Power Pages for sensitive, external-facing applications.

title: Microsoft Teams: PowerPoint Live support for webinars and structured meetings on Teams Rooms on Android
description: Participants joining webinars and structured meetings from Teams Rooms on Android can view and interact with PowerPoint Live presentations. This provides greater flexibility and accessibility while keeping room participants aligned with the active presentation.

title: Microsoft Teams: Phishing Detection in Teams Messaging
description: Microsoft Teams is introducing AI-powered phishing detection that uses conversation context to identify phishing and social engineering in higher-risk messaging scenarios, primarily external first-contact chats. Additional protection may apply in certain regions or scenarios. The capability is used only for security protection, and users may see warnings when suspicious activity is detected.

title: Planner: Planner Agent in Copilot V2 Improvements
description:
Planner Agent brings Planner’s intelligent work management directly into Copilot Chat, enabling users to create, update, and manage personal tasks and shared basic plans without switching context. Integrated across Microsoft 365, it provides insights into priorities, deadlines, and at-risk work, along with interactive task cards to help users stay organized and keep work moving.

Building on the initial launch, planned improvements include:

  • Improved context handling and support for larger plans.
  • Higher-quality responses through model upgrades, refined prompts, and better grounding.
  • Greater reliability and reduced latency for more consistent, responsive interactions.
  • Expanded task management capabilities, including broader task assignment support.
  • User experience enhancements to make managing tasks and plans in Copilot Chat more intuitive.
  • New capabilities, including scheduled task catch-ups.

title: Microsoft Purview: Adaptive Scope evaluation control with recipient and site owner lifecycle status
description: Microsoft Purview Adaptive Scopes will provide administrators with explicit control over lifecycle-state evaluation for recipients and site owners, helping ensure policy targeting and scope membership remain aligned with organizational requirements.

title: Dynamics 365 Contact Center: Out of the box real time translation on digital channels
description: With this feature, users get an out-of-the-box solution for translation services, so they don't need to bring their own web resources. Service representatives get updated feature usage with more configurations. They can tailor their conversations more accurately based on their existing skills and preferences. The feature is transparent yet modernized with new settings, making conversations easier to consume in a language of the representative's choice.

title: Microsoft Teams: Express face enrollment
description: Express face enrollment makes it easier for users to create a face profile in Teams by using their camera during eligible meetings, after they opt in. Once enrolled, users can be recognized in supported Teams Rooms experiences, helping identify who is in the room and improving downstream meeting experiences such as Copilot and recap. Admins can enable or disable the feature for their organization.

title: OneDrive: PDF annotation for sensitivity-label protected PDFs in OneDrive/SharePoint web viewer
description: We're enabling PDF annotation for sensitivity-label protected PDFs in OneDrive and SharePoint on the web. With this update, users who have the appropriate usage rights can annotate these protected PDFs in place in their browser while preserving the file's sensitivity label, encryption, and usage rights when changes are saved.

title: Dynamics 365 Project Operations: Full-screen mode on task grid
description:
Task grid full-screen mode enables project managers and team members to expand the task grid to use the available screen space. By minimizing surrounding page elements, users gain a larger workspace for viewing and managing task hierarchies, schedules, assignments, dependencies, and other task details.

Users can enter full-screen mode when they need a focused planning experience and return to the standard project view when they need access to other project information.

title: SharePoint: Copilot Search in SharePoint and OneDrive
description: Copilot Search brings AI-powered, natural-language search to SharePoint and OneDrive, combining relevant results, AI-generated summaries with source references, intuitive filters, and a seamless handoff to Copilot.

title: Microsoft Teams: Facilitator's enhanced protection skill can alert you to potential scams
description: Facilitator can help you spot suspected attempts by people outside your organization to trick you into sharing sensitive information during a meeting. When Facilitator is in your meeting, its Protection skill uses AI to check the meeting transcript for signs of possible social engineering. If it detects a suspected attempt, you'll see a warning in the meeting, with options to end or to temporarily restrict information sharing.

title: Power Apps: Prompt Columns - multiple lines of text output
description: Prompt columns can now store multilple lines of text as prompt output, enabling longer and detailed AI-generated insights to be stored in your tables.

title: Microsoft Dataverse: Prompt column values in bulk for existing records (backfill)
description: Prompt columns can now generate AI values for records that already exist in your table, not just new or updated ones. Makers can choose to apply a prompt to existing records in bulk, optionally filtered to just the rows they need, so historical data gets the same AI-generated insights as incoming data, without touching each record one at a time.
products: Microsoft Power Platform governance and administration

title: Microsoft Teams: Admin center - Intelligent insights for meeting quality
description: Gain proactive visibility into meeting quality across your organization with AI-powered insights in the Teams admin center that identify emerging patterns, highlight impacted users and locations, and surface likely causes with recommended actions. This helps IT administrators detect and address issues earlier, improve meeting quality, and stay ahead of potential disruptions.

title: Dynamics 365 Field Service: Microsoft Copilot in Field Service Mobile app
description: Microsoft Copilot in the Dynamics 365 Field Service mobile app brings conversational AI chat capabilities directly to frontline workers. Once enabled, technicians can ask natural-language questions about Dynamics 365 Field Service data and receive contextual answers based on the app experience and their organization’s Dataverse data. With standard capabilities, Dataverse Q&A supports questions such as “What is the work history of this asset?” or “Who worked on this job last?” Organizations can also extend the with custom experiences and agents available to frontline and back-office users.

title: Microsoft Teams: IntelliFrame people labels in Teams Rooms on Windows
description: Remote meeting participants know who is in the room and better follow the conversation with new IntelliFrame people labels that identify in-room participants and provide a hover-over contact card using voice and face profiles on intelligent cameras and in the cloud. Available with Teams Rooms on Windows licensed for Teams Rooms Pro.

title: Access: Rounded corners on Access form controls
description: We’re making it easier to give your Access apps a polished, up-to-date feel. With the new CornerRadius property, you can add rounded corners to form controls—bringing a softer, more modern look to your designs.

title: Microsoft Teams: Facilitator detects and answers questions
description: Facilitator now automatically detects open questions raised during a Teams meeting and offers to help answer them using web search. When a participant asks a question (e.g., “What is an LLM?”) and no one answers, Facilitator posts a prompt offering to find an answer. Participants can select “Yes” to have the agent retrieve and share the information.

title: Microsoft Edge: Watermarking Protection
description: Watermarking Protection in Microsoft Edge helps organizations visibly reinforce data protection policies by overlaying a persistent watermark on sensitive content viewed in the browser. This feature is designed to deter unauthorized sharing, support compliance efforts, and increase user awareness when handling confidential information.

title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Export Copilot metrics in the Copilot Dashboard
description: This enables users to export row-level Copilot metrics from the Copilot Dashboard for reporting and deeper analysis.

title: Dynamics 365 Project Operations: Optimize Project Operations - Create multiple budget drafts for what-if analysis
description:
How to enable the feature

This feature is applicable to Project Operations Core and Project Operations Integrated with ERP. In feature management, enable the feature Enable Multiple Project Budget Drafts.

Problem

Project managers were limited to maintaining a single draft version of a budget that had to be submitted for approval.

In real-world planning scenarios, project managers often need to evaluate multiple budget alternatives based on different assumptions such as resource mix, pricing, timelines, and cost structures. However, the absence of native support for multiple draft versions forced them to take the data outside Project Operations, perform offline analysis, and manually reconcile changes back into the system.

This approach was not only time-consuming but also introduced risks of inconsistencies, version control issues, and manual errors, ultimately reducing productivity and confidence in budget accuracy.

Solution

This feature introduces support for multiple draft budgets, enabling project managers to create, maintain, and iterate on alternative budget versions directly within Project Operations. By allowing multiple drafts to coexist, project managers can now experiment with different planning scenarios without losing prior work or overriding existing drafts. This serves as a foundational capability for more advanced budget management scenarios.

Additionally, the user interface has been enhanced to provide clear visibility into multiple draft versions, making it easier for project managers to navigate, review, and manage different budget iterations efficiently.

This capability also sets the groundwork for upcoming enhancements, including in-product comparison across draft budgets, which will further streamline decision-making and scenario evaluation. We call that what-if analysis of a project budget.

Impact

  • Enables creation and management of multiple draft budget versions within the system.
  • Eliminates the need for offline analysis and manual re-entry of budget changes.
  • Reduces the risk of manual errors, inconsistencies, and version control challenges.
  • Improves planning agility by allowing exploration of multiple budget scenarios.
  • Enhances overall efficiency and productivity for project managers.
  • Establishes a foundation for future capabilities such as draft comparison and advanced budget analytics.

Business Value:

Project managers creating project budgets, whether from estimates, contracts, quotes, or from scratch, were limited to a single draft version that had to be submitted for approval. When they needed to explore or compare alternative budget scenarios, the only option was to take Dynamics 365 Project Operations data, perform offline analysis, and manually update changes back into the system. This process was time-consuming, error-prone, and inefficient.

This feature introduces support for multiple draft budgets, enabling project managers to create and manage alternative budget versions directly within Project Operations. This lays the foundation for in-product comparison of draft budgets, which will be introduced in a subsequent release.

To support this capability, the user interface has been enhanced to allow project managers to easily view and manage multiple draft versions of a budget. As a result, this feature enables creation of multiple draft budget versions, eliminates the need for offline analysis and manual re-entry, reduces risk of manual errors, and improves efficiency and decision-making for project managers.

Enabled for:

Enabled by admins/makers/marketers for end users

title: Dynamics 365 Contact Center: Administrator experiences - Use industry templates to set up autonomous contact centers
description:
This release introduces industry-specific templates that simplify the creation and deployment of autonomous contact centers. Organizations can start with a preconfigured template in Copilot Service admin center > Service Operations Agent and deploy an autonomous customer service experience in just a few clicks, significantly reducing the setup effort required to design agents, workflows, and service journeys from the ground up.

The templates are built around common industry scenarios and best practices, helping organizations quickly establish operational autonomous contact centers while maintaining flexibility for customization as business needs evolve. Users can leverage these templates as a foundation and extend them to meet their specific customer service requirements.

These templates enable organizations to rapidly launch autonomous contact centers, reduce implementation complexity, and begin delivering AI-powered customer support with minimal configuration effort.

In this release, templates are available for the retail and telecom industries.

Business Value:

Accelerate the deployment of autonomous contact centers with prebuilt industry templates designed to help organizations get up and running in minutes rather than weeks. These ready-to-use templates reduce the complexity of designing autonomous customer service experiences from scratch, enabling businesses to quickly realize the benefits of AI-powered customer engagement, automated issue resolution, and around-the-clock service availability.

description:

The Preview automatic bank reconciliation matching results feature enables users to preview matching results during an automatic bank reconciliation matching process. By allowing users to select rules that require review and user checks, the feature ensures accurate matching and minimizes errors.

title: Dynamics 365 Contact Center: Copilot and AI innovation - Use agentic simulations to evaluate contact center setup
description:
Agentic simulations are an AI-driven capability of Service Operations Agent that enable organizations to evaluate how their contact center behaves under realistic customer conditions before those conditions occur in production.

Administrators define simulation scenarios using natural-language prompts. Agentic simulations then generate realistic synthetic conversations, runs them end-to-end through the configured contact center, and calculates the contact center KPIs.

What problems it helps solve

  • Readiness of self-service experiences: Assess how AI agents handle real customer intents, variations in behavior, and edge cases.

  • Effectiveness of assisted service flows: Validate routing, assignment logic, and service representative experience in human-assisted scenarios.

  • Confidence in scale and load readiness: Understand how configurations and operations perform under realistic volume and fix any reliability and latency issues.

  • Preparedness of service representatives: Enable safe practice and evaluation using realistic customer interactions without impacting live customers.

Key capabilities

  • Natural-language prompt interface for defining simulation scenarios
  • Simulation of varied customer intents, personas, and behaviors
  • End-to-end execution across AI agents, routing, and configurations
  • Out-of-the-box KPI dashboards and scorecards
  • Reusable and saved prompts, including canned scenarios
  • Safe, pre-production execution with no impact on live customers

Agentic simulations are currently available for the voice channel in the English language only. They support flows without Dual-Tone Multi-Frequency (DTMF)-based menu interactions and up to five conversations in a simulation.

Business Value:

Every contact center decision, such as deploying an AI agent, adjusting routing, onboarding new staff, or preparing for higher volumes, ultimately answers the same question:
“Will this work as expected when real customers arrive?”

Agentic simulations provide a clear, data-backed answer before changes reach production.

By generating realistic customer conversations and running them end-to-end through the contact center, organizations can see how their self-service, assisted service, and operational setup behave under real-world conditions. Instead of relying on assumptions, limited testing, or post-go-live corrections, teams gain measurable insight into experience quality, readiness, and scale.

This feature transforms how contact centers operate:

  • Experience quality improves because AI agents and service representatives are evaluated against realistic scenarios.
  • Operational risk decreases because configuration and routing issues are identified early.
  • Time to value accelerates because onboarding, training, and change validation happen faster.
  • Scale becomes predictable because load behavior is understood before demand increases.

Agentic simulations turn uncertainty into confidence, helping organizations ship changes faster, train teams better, and deliver consistent customer experiences at scale.

title: Dynamics 365 Sales: Seller experiences - Clone and share Sales Development agent configuration across teams
description:
As a sales leader, you can configure a Sales Development agent once, then share or clone its configuration across your organization. Distribute the agent’s playbook, guidelines, guardrails, and settings to other business units to provide a consistent experience across sales teams.

The feature supports these capabilities:

  • Export a configuration: In Teams, ask the source agent to package its configuration into a file. For example, enter Export your configuration.
  • Import a configuration: Attach the exported file to a new agent, then ask the agent to apply the configuration.
  • Create a one-time copy: The copied configuration is a snapshot, not a synchronized connection. Changes made later to the source agent aren’t automatically applied to the target agent.

Knowledge sources, such as uploaded documents, FAQs, and URLs, aren’t included in the exported configuration. Add them directly to the target agent after importing the configuration.

Business Value:

Scaling your sales operations just got easier. Instead of manually configuring each Sales Development agent from scratch, you can now set up an agent once with your organization's best practices and guardrails, then share or clone it across your entire team. This means faster deployment, consistent outreach to prospects, and more time for your sellers to build relationships instead of repetitive work. Whether you're expanding to new markets or rolling out agents across multiple business units, you'll maintain quality and compliance while reducing the time it takes to get your agent up and running.
