title: Dynamics 365 Finance: Core financials - Enhancements to subscription billing
description:
Performance improvements for subscription billing unbilled revenue

Performance is a common request within subscription billing, and we have focused on that request. This feature enhances the subscription billing unbilled revenue mass processing by introducing multithreaded execution. Multithreaded processing reduces batch execution time, minimizes system contention, and improves reliability during peak billing and close cycles. This enables customers to process large volumes of unbilled revenue records more efficiently, avoid operational bottlenecks, and confidently run concurrent batch jobs supporting scalability, performance, and overall customer satisfaction.

Performance improvements when generating sales order invoice with subscription billing

Changes are being made to improve sales order invoice generation performance, lower system load, and enhance scalability during high-volume billing runs. This leads to faster batch execution, reduced contention with parallel processes, and improved reliability of subscription billing operations for enterprise customers.

Multi-element revenue allocation logic correction during updates, termination

Correcting multi-element revenue allocation behavior during terminations prevents residual deferred revenue balances, ensures accurate financial reporting, and maintains alignment between billing events and revenue allocation logic. This reduces manual General ledger adjustments, minimizes audit risk, and improves confidence in subscription billing for customers using complex, multi-element arrangements at scale.

This feature corrects multi-element revenue allocation behavior during billing schedule updates and terminations to ensure accurate General ledger distributions. When a billing schedule is terminated, with or without credit, the system will correctly apply multi-element revenue allocation logic to clear remaining deferred contract revenue account balances. Credit transactions generated during termination will be treated like standard invoices and allocated based on SSP, while non-credit terminations automatically generate adjustment entries to fully clear deferred balances in line with multi-element revenue allocation principles.

Business Value:

These enhancements collectively strengthen subscription billing performance, scalability, and financial accuracy, addressing both operational efficiency and accounting integrity for enterprise-scale customers. The performance improvements to unbilled revenue mass processing and sales order invoice generation reduce batch execution times, lower system load, and minimize contention during high-volume billing and financial close cycles. By improving parallel processing and execution efficiency, customers can reliably process large subscription volumes, run concurrent batch jobs, and meet tight billing and close timelines with greater predictability and stability.

In parallel, the correction to multi-element revenue allocation logic during billing schedule updates and terminations ensure accurate and compliant revenue recognition across the subscription lifecycle. Deferred contract revenue balances are now correctly cleared during terminations, with or without credit, and credit transactions are allocated consistently based on standalone selling price (SSP). This eliminates residual deferred balances, reduces manual General Ledger adjustments, and lowers audit and reconciliation risk.

Together, these improvements deliver a faster, more reliable, and financially accurate subscription billing experience, reducing operational overhead, improving close efficiency, and increasing customer confidence in managing complex, high-volume subscription models.

title: Dynamics 365 Finance: Core financials - Enhancements to Invoice capture
description:
This release consolidates multiple Invoice capture enhancements into a single, cohesive capability update with a public preview in 10.0.49. Updates include:

  • AI‑based invoice header level derivation: Improves matching of invoice header level to purchase orders and procurement categories using vendor data. Continuous learning applies user corrections to future invoices, increasing touchless processing and reducing repeated manual effort.

  • Side‑by‑side invoice and purchase order view: Allows finance users to view invoice lines, the invoice PDF, and purchase order details simultaneously. This reduces context switching during manual matching, speeds up exception resolution, and lowers the risk of user error without changing existing purchase order structures.

  • Enhanced charge recognition and allocation

This feature automatically identifies and classifies header‑level and line‑level charges on vendor invoices. Charges are allocated using defined rules during transfer to Dynamics 365 Finance, preventing invoice total mismatches and reducing downstream corrections.

While the current release focuses on improving automation accuracy, exception‑handling efficiency, and usability for high‑volume invoice processing, future direction will be continued expansion of intelligent recognition, support for more complex invoice layouts such as line-level derivation, and ongoing scalability and usability improvements aligned with broader accounts payable automation investments.

Business Value:

Invoice capture is a critical capability for organizations processing high volumes of vendor invoices. Manual matching of invoice lines, limited visibility during exception handling, and incorrect handling of invoice charges increase operational effort and slow down invoice processing, especially during period‑end peaks.

This release improves invoice processing efficiency by increasing automation accuracy while simplifying manual exception handling when required. Enhanced AI‑based derivation reduces repetitive corrections, improved usability accelerates manual validation, and better charge recognition prevents posting mismatches and downstream rework. Together, these improvements increase touchless processing rates, reduce operational cost, and strengthen confidence in automated invoice processing within Dynamics 365 Finance.

Enabled for:

Enabled by admins/makers/marketers for end users

title: Dynamics 365 Supply Chain Management: Warehouse management - Integrate the Warehouse management module with external labor management systems
description:
This feature provides a standard framework for integrating the Warehouse management module in Dynamics 365 Supply Chain Management with external labor management systems. With this framework, you can connect warehouse execution data to a third-party LMS. This connection gives you advanced capabilities for labor planning, scheduling, and performance tracking. The integration supports warehouse execution with or without warehouse management processes. It also supports warehouse-only mode.

Labor management systems typically provide features like:

  • Real-time productivity monitoring and task tracking.
  • Engineered labor standards and support for time studies to establish benchmarks for task durations.
  • Predictive scheduling and dynamic labor forecasting.
  • Customizable dashboards and ad-hoc reporting.
  • Automated time and attendance tracking.
  • Incentive program management.

Business Value:

Integrating external labor management systems (LMS) with your warehouse management system (WMS) enables smarter, data-driven workforce planning and execution by delivering value across multiple dimensions.

This integration enhances operational efficiency by automating labor planning and reducing manual data entry through synchronized workforce schedules and warehouse task execution. It also provides performance visibility, offering real-time insights into labor productivity, cost-to-serve, and task-level performance to support continuous improvement.

Centralizing labor data supports compliance and auditability, streamlining regulatory processes and reducing administrative overhead. Additionally, it fosters employee engagement by enabling transparent performance tracking and incentive programs that boost motivation and retention. Finally, cross-system coordination improves communication between warehouse operations and workforce management, ensuring labor resources are aligned with real-time operational needs.

title: Dynamics 365 Project Operations: Optimize Project Operations - Improve the project quote experience
description:
The improvements to project quote provide usability enhancements designed to modernize and streamline the experience. The goal is to reduce unnecessary complexity, improve clarity, and enable users to work more efficiently when creating and managing quotes.

That protects service level and abandonment targets on the days that matter most, and it curbs the two costs that quietly compound in every contact center: paying for idle capacity in over-forecasted intervals and paying premium rates to recover from under-forecasted ones.

title: Dynamics 365 Commerce: Store Commerce - Modernize customer detail page for assisted selling in Store Commerce
description:
The Customer Data Platform panel in Store Commerce has been rebuilt using React, replacing the legacy implementation with a modern, responsive layout optimized for both desktop and mobile form factors.

What's new in the modernized CDP panel

  • Mobile-optimized layout: The panel uses a vertical scroll pattern that works naturally on tablets and handheld devices used by store associates on the floor.
  • Customer summary at a glance: Loyalty points, purchase frequency, average spend, and contact details are prominently displayed at the top of the panel.
  • Transaction history inline: Associates can view recent purchases, including items bought, channel, and location, without leaving the current context.
  • Buy-again workflow: Frequently purchased items are surfaced with a direct add-to-sale action, enabling associates to quickly rebuild a customer's basket.
  • Customer timeline: Chronological view of customer interactions, notes, and activities gives associates context for the current conversation.
  • Product recommendations: Curated or engine-driven recommendations are shown inline to support upsell and cross-sell during the interaction.

Streamlined customer creation and editing

  • Single-save workflow: Associates can create a new customer record with both customer information and primary address captured in one form, saved in a single action. This reduces the number of clicks and screen transitions required compared to the legacy multistep flow.
  • Inline address validation: Mandatory address fields are validated at the point of entry before the record is saved to help ensure compliance with fiscal requirements for markets where a complete primary address is legally required on customer records. This validation is opt-in and configured at the channel level.
  • Unified edit experience: Editing an existing customer's details and address follows the same consolidated pattern to keep associates in a single context rather than navigating between separate management screens.

Custom attributes tab

Retailers who capture custom attribute data on customer records can now find that information directly within the CDP panel via a dedicated Custom information tab. The tab is displayed conditionally and appears only when custom attributes have been configured for the customer record to keep the panel clean and uncluttered for retailers who do not use custom attributes. This allows retailers to extend the clienteling experience with their own data, such as membership tiers, fit preferences, loyalty program details, or any other retailer-defined fields, without requiring associates to leave the panel or open a separate management screen.

How associates access the feature

The CDP panel is accessible from two entry points in Store Commerce:

  1. Customer search: When an associate searches for and selects a customer, the modernized CDP panel opens directly.
  2. Active transaction: Associates can open the CDP panel from within an in-progress transaction to view customer context without interrupting the sale.

Enabling the feature

This feature is enabled via Feature management in Dynamics 365 Commerce headquarters. Once the feature flag is turned on, the modernized CDP panel is automatically available in Store Commerce for all users without additional configuration at the register or device level.

Applies to: Point of sale (Store Commerce)

Business Value:

Store associates spend valuable selling time navigating a cluttered, legacy customer detail page that wasn't designed for mobile or fast-paced retail floors. Critical information, such as purchase history, loyalty points, preferences, and product recommendations, is buried across multiple tabs and screens, slowing assisted selling and reducing the quality of in-store customer interactions.

The modernized Customer Data Platform (CDP) panel in Store Commerce delivers a lightweight, mobile-optimized clienteling experience designed for the way associates actually work. Key customer signals, such as spending summaries, recent transactions, buy-again suggestions, and a full customer timeline, are now surfaced inline without requiring associates to navigate away from the transaction. This means faster, more personalized customer conversations, higher basket value through timely product recommendations, and reduced training burden for new associates who can now act on customer context at a glance.

Creating and editing customer records has also historically required associates to navigate multiple screens and save operations, increasing the risk of incomplete records and slowing down queue-sensitive moments on the shop floor. For retailers operating in regions with fiscal requirements, where a validated primary address is mandatory for customer records, the legacy workflow offered no inline guardrails, leading to compliance gaps and post-transaction corrections.

The modernized CDP panel addresses this by consolidating customer creation and editing into a streamlined, single-save workflow. Associates can capture customer information and primary address in one form and save the complete record in a single action that reduces clicks and eliminates the back-and-forth between separate screens. Mandatory address field validation is enforced inline at the point of entry, ensuring compliance with fiscal requirements before the record is committed and removing the need for manual follow-up or administrative correction.

For retailers investing in omnichannel clienteling, this feature provides a modern, compliant foundation to deliver consistent, data-informed customer engagement at the point of sale.

title: Dynamics 365 Contact Center: Omnichannel customer experiences - Use ML-based sensitive data redaction for human interactions
description:
Dynamics 365 Contact Center introduces large language model (LLM)‑based sensitive data redaction for human‑to‑human interactions, allowing administrators to automatically redact PCI data shared during live conversations between customers and customer service representatives.

The system uses LLMs to identify sensitive data based on conversational context, not just patterns, across both voice and digital channels. When sensitive data such as a credit card number, PIN, or account number is detected, it is replaced with a standardized redaction token (for example, CreditCardNumber:Redacted) before the data is persisted.

Redaction is applied consistently across:

  • Conversation transcripts
  • Call recordings
  • Logs and diagnostic data
  • Analytics outputs derived from conversations

Administrators can configure which PCI data types are redacted, and the system enforces these policies automatically without requiring representatives to pause recordings or change their workflows. This capability helps ensure that sensitive customer data isn't stored while preserving the non‑sensitive conversation context needed for quality assurance, analytics, and operational insights.

Business Value:

Organizations in regulated industries must prevent sensitive payment data from being stored in call recordings, transcripts, logs, or analytics artifacts. Today, customers rely on manual processes or limited rule‑based masking, which increases compliance risk and operational overhead. This feature enables customers to safely use recording, transcription, and AI analytics by ensuring payment card information (PCI) data shared during live conversations between customers and customer service representatives is automatically redacted before storage. As a result, customers can reduce PCI scope, prevent compliance escalations, and confidently adopt advanced contact center capabilities without disrupting agent workflows or customer experience.

title: Dynamics 365 Contact Center: Unified routing - Handle waiting conversations when queues close or become unstaffed
description:
This capability enhances queue handling by intelligently detecting two key scenarios where conversations would otherwise remain unserved:

  • Queue transitions to out-of-operating hours: The system continuously monitors active conversations that entered a queue before closing time. If the queue transitions to out-of-operating hours while conversations are still waiting, it automatically applies admin-defined overflow actions. Customers can be guided to leave a voicemail, request a callback, or be transferred to another available queue, ensuring a smooth end-of-day experience without manual intervention.

  • No service representatives are signed in: The system evaluates real-time representative availability. If all representatives assigned to a queue are signed out, it immediately triggers the configured fallback action instead of waiting for in-queue overflow timers. This is especially valuable in scenarios such as mass logout events, unexpected breaks, or holidays not captured in operating hours.

Administrators configure both scenarios using natural language prompts in conversation orchestration, enabling fine-grained control over queue behavior. This ensures customers are always routed to the best possible outcome, even when direct support is unavailable.

Business Value:

This capability ensures customers are never left waiting when representatives aren't available. Whether a queue transitions to be out-of-operating hours or all support representatives are logged out, the system proactively routes conversations to configured fallback options such as voicemail, callback, or alternative queues.

Organizations benefit from reduced wait times and lower abandonment, improved customer satisfaction during peak load or unexpected staffing gaps, and a more predictable service experience regardless of representative availability. At the same time, this eliminates the need for manual queue draining or extended shifts, helping protect service representative wellbeing while maintaining consistent service levels.

A new visual data‑lineage view provides an end‑to‑end representation of how data flows from source records through calculations to final results, helping users understand how results roll up across organizational structures and how dimensional attributes influence calculated outcomes.

These enhancements are available automatically without additional configuration, providing consistent and defensible traceability across all calculated metrics. Users can access snapshot details and the data‑lineage view directly from calculated metrics, providing consistent traceability and audit support across all emissions calculations.

Business Value:

As sustainability data is increasingly scrutinized by auditors, regulators, and internal stakeholders, organizations need reliable point‑in‑time traceability for reported metrics. This release strengthens audit readiness by ensuring every calculated result can be traced back to its exact inputs, logic, and reference data at the time of calculation. By improving transparency and lineage, customers can respond to audits with greater confidence while reducing investigation time and reporting risk.

title: Dynamics 365 Customer Service: Workforce engagement management - Detect intraday volume spikes with workforce alerts
description:
Supervisors can create volume spike alerts that compare real-time conversation volume with the forecast linked to a shift plan. When volume remains above forecast for the configured number of intervals, selected recipients receive an in-app notification.

The capability includes the following features:

  • Administrators can enable workforce alerts in Copilot Service admin center by going to Workforce management > Intraday management > Workforce alerts.
  • Supervisors can create and manage alerts from Workforce alerts in the Copilot Service workspace site map.
  • Each alert references a shift plan and monitors the queues associated with its linked capacity plan.
  • Supervisors can specify the percentage by which actual volume must exceed forecast volume.
  • Supervisors can specify the number of consecutive intervals during which the deviation must continue before an alert is raised. The forecast determines whether an interval is 15, 30, or 60 minutes.
  • Supervisors can set an expiration date to limit an alert to a campaign, season, or known event.
  • Supervisors can select one or more notification recipients for each alert.
  • Active alerts are evaluated on a recurring schedule. Notifications are sent when the configured threshold and duration are met.
  • Recipients can select a notification to open the alert details. The details include the queue and alert name, detection time, current and forecast volumes, spike percentage, and an interval-by-interval breakdown.

Access and prerequisites

  • An administrator must install the Workforce Management for Customer Service package from Power Platform admin center.
  • Forecasting and scheduling must be configured.
  • The selected shift plan must have a linked capacity plan and forecast.
  • Real-time conversation data must be available for the monitored queues.

Business Value:

Contact centers plan staffing based on forecasted demand, but actual demand can change quickly. When conversation volume rises significantly above forecast, queues can grow and service levels can decline before supervisors have time to respond.

Workforce alerts help supervisors identify unusual intraday volume changes without continuously monitoring a dashboard. Supervisors define the deviation and duration that represent a volume spike and select who should be notified when those conditions are met.

The notification provides information about the spike, including how far actual volume is above forecast and whether the deviation is continuing. Supervisors can use this information to decide whether to shift capacity, offer overtime, or defer offline work while these actions can still help protect the customer experience.

title: Dynamics 365 Project Operations: Optimize Project Operations - Use time-zone-agnostic fields in project planning
description:
Project and project task start, and end times are saved in a date-time format. The system converts these times to GMT before saving them. When the product displays these times, it converts them back to the user's time zone. However, some integrations and customizations pull only the date from this field. This approach causes problems when the conversion to GMT changes the date. The problem happens when an integration pulls only that date from the field without converting it back to GMT.

To prevent this problem, create new fields on the entity to store the start and end date and time values without converting them to GMT. With these fields, you can confidently pull only the date without worrying about time-zone conversion causing the date to change.

Business Value:

This feature helps you avoid time zone headaches when managing project schedules. Instead of converting times to GMT, which can shift dates and create confusion, it stores start and end dates exactly as you enter them. That means fewer errors, less rework, and more accurate timelines for your team.

title: Dynamics 365 Project Operations: Optimize Project Operations - Update correction journal usability
description:
Correcting transactions after they’ve been processed can be a complicated and difficult process. Currently in Project Operations, you must select all the transactions you want to correct at the same time to create the journal, and all transactions added to the journal must be corrected in the same way. This leads to significant repeat work, where you need to create multiple journals to be able to make different corrections on different transactions. This feature updates that process with the following changes:

  • Transactions can be marked with Needs correction from the billing hub view, then once all required transactions have been marked, you can create the journal. This simplifies the journal creation process.
  • Different transactions added to the same correction journal can be corrected in different ways, reducing the number of journals that need to be created.
  • A wider set of fields is available for correction, limiting the number of transactions that need to be recalled to the draft entry state (a more complicated process) to complete the required changes.
  • Time transactions can be split across multiple projects and tasks without recalling the draft entry state.
  • A UI overhaul will be done to make the corrections process easier and simpler to follow.

Overall, these changes make corrections easier, minimize mistakes that can lead to major problems, and reduce frustration with the interface.

Business Value:

Correcting previously processed transactions is a difficult process that’s made harder by UX limitations. The changes in this feature update let you make different corrections within the same journal, correct a wider range of fields, and easily select transactions that need correction. With the new experience, a larger volume of transactions can be corrected at once to reduce repetitive work while simultaneously making the process clearer and simpler. This reduces mistakes made during the corrections process, which in turn minimizes the more costly and problematic billing errors.

title: Microsoft Teams: Near-real-time detection of malicious QR codes in messages
description: Microsoft Teams will introduce near-real-time detection of malicious QR codes shared in messages. By analyzing destinations embedded in QR codes, Teams can identify potential phishing and fraud threats and apply additional protections to malicious content, extending existing URL protection to QR-based attacks.

title: Microsoft Teams: Loop meeting notes stored in the meeting organizer's OneDrive
description: For non-channel Microsoft Teams meetings, collaborative meeting notes, including Loop-powered meeting notes and Facilitator notes, will be stored in the meeting organizer's OneDrive for Business instead of the OneDrive of the person who starts the notes. This update provides more consistent ownership and management of meeting content while preserving the existing note-taking and collaboration experience for meeting participants.

title: Microsoft Teams: Events now support up to 20,000 registrations, making it easier to reach and engage larger audiences at scale
description: Connect with more attendees than ever before with Teams Events, now supporting up to 20,000 registrations for organizers with valid Attendee packs.

title: Microsoft Teams: SharePoint app in Teams
description: When a user who has access to the SharePoint app in Teams clicks a SharePoint page or news link in Teams chat or channels, the link will open inside the SharePoint app in Teams (if available) instead of the mobile browser

title: Microsoft Purview: Insider Risk Management- IRM alerts in XDR
description:
With this feature, IRM alerts and other supporting data will be available in the following Microsoft Defender XDR experiences:

  1. IRM alerts will be surfaced in unified alert and Incident queue in Microsoft Defender XDR.
  2. IRM alerts, Indicators and enriched events will be available in Microsoft Defender XDR advanced hunting. Analysts can leverage KQL queries to identify potentially hidden risky patterns in data security related user activity.
  3. IRM alert, Indicators and enriched events will be exposed through Graph API.

This feature can be enabled through “Share data with Microsoft Defender XDR” within Microsoft Insider Risk Management settings

IRM data in Microsoft Defender XDR does not honor anonymization. This is to enable effective correlation of IRM alerts with alerts from other solutions in Microsoft Defender XDR platform (such as Defender for Endpoint, Defender for Cloud apps, etc.).

Microsoft Purview Insider Risk Management correlates various signals to identify potential malicious or inadvertent insider risks, such as IP theft, data leakage, and security violations. Insider Risk Management enables customers to create policies based on their own internal policies, governance, and organizational requirements. Built with privacy by design, users are pseudonymized by default, and role-based access controls and audit logs are in place to help ensure user-level privacy.

title: Microsoft Edge: Auto-open Copilot side pane for Outlook links
description: When users open links from Outlook, Microsoft Edge can automatically open the Copilot side pane to provide contextual insights and actionable suggestion chips based on email and destination content - such as highlighting key points, and recommending next actions - without disrupting the browsing flow. This experience helps users quickly understand content, take action with fewer steps, and get more value from Copilot while extending productive browsing time in Edge. Admins can control availability to this feature using the M365LinksAutoOpenCopilotEnabled policy.

title: Outlook: Enriching profile cards with custom, organization-specific properties
description: Customers can now customize their M365 profile cards by adding custom properties unique to their organization. These properties can be sourced from external systems like HR platforms, enriching user profiles with relevant organizational details. Tenant admins can configure these properties with a display name and icon, which will appear in the Contact Information section of the profile cards.

title: Microsoft 365 admin center: Usage reports – Microsoft 365 Copilot Connectors
description: A new usage report will be available in the Microsoft 365 admin center for Copilot Connectors in Microsoft 365 Copilot, designed to give organizations a detailed view of how connectors are being used within Microsoft 365 Copilot. This report provides insights into overall connector activity, and connector powered response patterns over time, along with detailed user-level connectors adoption data. With these analytics, admins can monitor adoption, identify usage patterns, and optimize Copilot experiences to drive greater value across their organization. #copilotcontrolsystem

title: Microsoft Viva: Engage Community feed improvements
description: Align the community feeds default experience with expected user behaviors; support triage and content review for users who want to read every message in a community.

title: Microsoft Teams: Ability to separate out the Townhall attendee invites
description: This backend change will now address the 'separation of attendee' invites from the events crew. This feature allows the organizers of Townhalls to maintain separate invites for attendees.

title: Microsoft Viva: Enhanced Microsoft Copilot in Viva Engage
description:
Introducing the Enhanced Microsoft 365 Copilot Experience in Viva Engage!

Powered by Engage MCP, this enhanced experience takes Copilot in Engage beyond catch-ups and summaries, helping users explore conversations more deeply, synthesize discussions, and uncover meaningful insights.

It's also more deeply connected across Microsoft 365. For example, you can ask Copilot to analyze feedback on a leader's post, identify key themes, and turn those insights into a reusable PowerPoint deck.

With Work IQ integration, Copilot also has a better understanding of you and your work context, connecting conversations in Engage to your broader work across Microsoft 365.

Engage MCP expands both the breadth and depth of Engage scenarios Copilot can support, making it more useful for understanding conversations and insights across your Engage network.

This update also brings Copilot in Engage closer to the broader Microsoft 365 Copilot experience, with your Microsoft 365 agents now accessible directly within Copilot in Engage.

title: Microsoft 365 app: Inventory - Update Repair
description: Update Repair helps admins identify Windows devices with Microsoft 365 Apps that are out of date or experiencing update issues. In the Microsoft 365 Apps admin center, admins can review device status and recommended actions, remotely start Online Repair for eligible devices, and follow manual remediation guidance for devices that need attention. Repair reinstalls Microsoft 365 Apps using the latest available build for the device’s configured update channel.

title: Dynamics 365 Project Operations: Complete zero-effort tasks
description:
Zero-effort task completion enables project managers and team members to mark tasks as complete even when no effort was planned or recorded. This capability supports milestones, administrative activities, checklists, and other tasks that track completion without requiring work hours.

This is for both Project Operations core and Project Operations connected with ERP deployment types.

title: Copilot Studio: Computer Use for web browsing on GitHub Copilot Harness
description: Enable Microsoft Copilot Studio agents to browse and interact with websites as a native capability powered by the GitHub Copilot Harness. Using natural-language instructions, agents can navigate web pages, extract information, and download files. Agents can then use that information and those files alongside other tools to complete end-to-end workflows, extending their reach beyond configured knowledge sources and API-based integrations.

title: Dynamics 365 Business Central: Ecommerce - [US] Match Shopify tax lines to tax jurisdictions
description:
Business Value

Reduce repetitive tax setup when you import Shopify orders that contain multiple United States tax jurisdictions. Shopify Tax Matching suggests how free-text tax lines map to configured tax jurisdictions and keeps you in control of exceptions before you create sales documents.

Details

The Shopify Tax Matching capability is available in public preview for organizations in the United States that use the Shopify connector. When standard tax-area mapping doesn't resolve an imported order, the capability uses AI to suggest tax jurisdictions based on Shopify tax-line titles and rates, configured tax jurisdictions, and limited ship-to location information.

You can review each suggestion, confidence level, explanation, and rate before approving the final mapping. Configure which matches require review and whether the capability can create missing tax jurisdictions and tax areas. Unidentified jurisdictions and rate differences always require review.

Shopify Tax Matching maps imported tax descriptions to tax setup. It doesn't calculate tax, determine tax liability, file tax returns, or replace professional tax advice.

title: Microsoft Dataverse: Add users without licenses to activity recipient fields
description:
Enable active Microsoft Entra users without Dataverse or Power Apps licenses as activity recipients. Created user records remain disabled and do not grant Dynamics 365 app access.

Documentation: https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/power-platform/admin/add-unlicensed-users-activities

title: PowerPoint: Set slide size in a modern task pane
description: Change slide size in PowerPoint from a modern task pane that keeps you in the flow of editing with real-time slide changes. Choose common slide sizes including new social media presets, or customize dimensions with a cleaner, more approachable experience.

title: PowerPoint: Set slide size in a modern PowerPoint pane
description: Change slide size in PowerPoint from a modern task pane that keeps you in the flow of editing with real-time slide changes. Choose common slide sizes including new social media presets, or customize dimensions with a cleaner, more approachable experience.

title: Microsoft Copilot Studio: Support for sensitive documents protected with Microsoft Purview Information Protection (MPIP)
description: Unblock users from upload files with Microsoft Purview Information Protection (MPIP) sensitivity labels to Copilot Studio agents deployed on the M365 channel. With this support agents can process content based on the user's/agents account permissions, with label protections enforced end-to-end.

title: Work IQ: Human in the loop
description: Allow agents and agent flows to pause for human input or approval before continuing.

title: Work IQ: Agent Policy Governance
description: Provide administrators with policy-based controls for governing agents and their capabilities at scale.

title: Work IQ: Real Time Transcripts
description: Enable applications and agents to access Microsoft Teams meeting transcripts in real time for assistance and insights.

title: Microsoft Teams: Meeting Shared Files
description: The new Meeting Shared Files feature allows users to add relevant files and links to their meeting for easy access and to automatically share that content with all meeting participants. AI in the meeting, like the Facilitator agent, uses these files for targeted grounding to answer questions and enhance skill functionality.

title: Microsoft Purview: Data Lifecycle Management - Retention capabilities based on files Last Accessed in OneDrive and SharePoint
description: Ability to apply Retention labels and policies to items on OneDrive and SharePoint based on when the items were last accessed by an user.

title: Microsoft Purview: Archive SharePoint files under retention policies
description: With the introduction of file archiving support in SharePoint Online, administrators are looking to seamlessly include archiving actions within their existing data retention policies. This means that, in addition to keeping or deleting data, admins want to now leverage Purview DLM to archive files according to organizational requirements, ensuring comprehensive governance across all stages of the content lifecycle in SPO. Retention based file archiving moves inactive content to low-cost storage, lowering costs with no compromise on Compliance, keeping data discoverable and making Copilot results highly relevant.

title: Microsoft Teams: Improved organization for muted and meeting chats
description: Microsoft Teams automatically organizes your chats with new built in sections that help reduce clutter and keep conversations easy to find. Muted chats (on by default) are grouped together in a dedicated area, while meeting chats (off by default) can be collected into a single section for quick access. You’re always in control, as each section can be turned on or off based on your preferences. The new Meeting chats section will replace the Meeting chats filter, that was previously available at the top of the chat and channel list. Updated July 20, 2026: We have temporarily rolled back this feature. We apologize for any inconvenience.

title: Microsoft Purview: Compliance Manager-Purview Compliance Manager integration with Microsoft Foundry for automated mapping of AI regulations and evaluation of Compliance controls for Foundry Agents
description: This feature in Purview Compliance Manager shall enable customers to automatically access the compliance posture of Agents created in AI Foundry. Customers can map Agents being created in AI Foundry to compliance regulations and assessments in Purview Compliance Manager and get to know the compliance status and improvement actions to be innovative and compliant.

title: Microsoft Purview: Purview SDK embedded in Agent Framework SDK
description: Purview SDK embedded in Agent Framework SDK enables developers to seamlessly integrate enterprise-grade security, compliance, and governance into the AI agents they build. This integration enables automatic classification and protection of sensitive data, prevents data leaks and oversharing, and provides visibility and control for regulatory compliance—empowering organizations to confidently and securely adopt AI agents in complex environments.

title: Microsoft Purview: Endpoint Data Loss Prevention-View-only access to device onboarding with the View-Only Device Management role
description:
Microsoft Purview Data Loss Prevention is introducing more granular, role-based access to the Devices page under Settings → Device Onboarding. Previously, viewing or managing device onboarding required broad administrative roles (such as Compliance Administrator, Global Administrator, or Security Administrator). With this update, organizations can grant access using least-privilege Purview role-based access control (RBAC) roles scoped specifically to device operations.

A new View-Only Device Management role enables users, such as auditors or security analysts, to view device onboarding status, search for devices, review configuration details, and export device data, without granting permission to change onboarding configuration or other administrative settings. Existing administrative roles continue to have full access, so current workflows are unaffected. This change helps organizations follow the principle of least privilege and simplifies granting read-only visibility into device onboarding without over-provisioning permissions.

title: Microsoft Edge: Organize and merge PDF files in the built-in PDF reader
description: Users can organize and merge PDF files in the Microsoft Edge built-in PDF reader. They can select pages to extract, delete, rotate, or reorder, and save the result as a new PDF file. They can also merge the open PDF file with other PDF files that are open in Microsoft Edge tabs or stored on their device, to create a single PDF file. Files are processed on the device, and the original files aren't modified. Admins can manage this feature using the PdfOrganizeAndMergeEnabled policy.

title: Microsoft Dataverse: Enable semantic data understanding for agentic use
description:
Give AI agents and Copilot a true understanding of your business data — not just raw schema — so they can answer questions accurately with less manual configuration.

  • Learns from the systems you already run — Automatically extracts semantic knowledge from views, forms, and metadata already defined in your Dataverse environment, reducing agent deployment from days of manual setup to near-zero effort.
  • Full visibility for makers — View generated semantic knowledge per entity — including name, description, and sample questions — directly in the Power Apps maker portal. Search for understanding gaps and enrich missing context with a built-in glossary for domain-specific terms.
  • Governance and privacy built in — Enable or disable semantic signals at the org level, or at the individual signal-type or table level, giving makers and admins granular control to meet compliance and privacy requirements without sacrificing agent quality.

No manual schema mapping. No custom query logic. No disambiguation between what your data is called and what your business actually means.

title: Dynamics 365 Customer Service: Manage intraday operations with AI agent
description:
Intraday Agent is an autonomous AI agent that helps manage intraday operational scenarios. The following are its high‑level capabilities.

Intraday queue tracking

  • Continuously monitors queue volumes in real time.
  • Detects anomalies when actual volume deviates significantly from forecasted demand.
  • Automatically reforecasts in real time to assess current demand.
  • Notifies supervisors with proactive alerts and recommendations.
  • Automates corrective actions such as adjusting schedules, rescheduling breaks, or reallocating service representatives to maintain SLA performance.
  • Supports customizable instructions to align mitigation actions with business needs.

Intraday adherence tracking

  • Monitors service representative adherence to scheduled shift activities in real time.
  • Detects deviations such as late logins, extended breaks, or early logouts.
  • Autonomously mitigates deviations through actions such as break rescheduling, shift extensions, overtime activation, or flexible channel reassignment.
  • Supports customizable instructions to align mitigation actions with business needs.

title: Microsoft Power Platform governance and administration: Multi-grader comparison
description:
Multi-grader comparison enables makers to compare the results of multiple graders applied to the same evaluation.

The experience highlights agreement, differences, and overall grading behavior.

Core capabilities

The core capabilities include:

  • Compare graders side-by-side.
  • Compare scores.
  • Review explanations from each grader.
  • Analyze grading consistency.

Results experience

Results include:

  • Comparative score view.
  • Pass / fail comparison.
  • Grader explanations.
  • Evidence supporting each evaluation.
products: Microsoft Power Platform governance and administration

title: Dynamics 365 Project Operations: Simplify the creation of recurring expenses
description: This feature enables employees to automatically generate expense entries for predictable, repeatable business expenses (for example, monthly mobile bills, internet charges, parking, and subscriptions) without manual re-entry each period. It reduces repetitive effort, improves compliance, and ensures timely and accurate expense submission, while respecting organizational expense policies and approval workflows.

title: Outlook: Teams Meeting Options
description: When you add a Teams meeting to an event in Outlook for Mac, the join link and dial-in details now appear in the invite while you're still writing it. A new Meeting Options button lets you change the Teams meeting settings right away, before you send.

title: Dynamics 365 Business Central: Data mirroring to Microsoft Fabric
description:
Connect Business Central to Microsoft Fabric to make business data available for analytics, reporting, and data integration.

Choose the Business Central companies and tables to synchronise, and make the data available in OneLake for use with Fabric IQ, Power BI, Data Factory, and other analytics experiences.

Get started quickly with ready-made sample Power BI apps, while built-in logging provides visibility into synchronisation health and helps troubleshoot issues.

title: Microsoft Teams: Pop out sign language interpreter meeting video for continuous visibility
description: Keep communication more accessible throughout your meeting. You can now pop out a sign language interpreter into a separate, resizable window that stays visible across monitors and apps. Designed to support Deaf and Hard of Hearing users, the sign language interpreter's popout video will persist while viewers are multitasking, sharing content, or changing meeting layouts.

title: OneDrive: Sync support for up to 1 million items on macOS
description: OneDrive Sync supports syncing up to 1 million items on macOS devices, helping teams manage large document libraries and shared content at scale without compromising access across devices. This preview requires the Insiders ring and that devices meet minimum hardware and configuration requirements. Devices that don't meet these requirements continue to sync at the existing 300,000-item supported limit with no disruption.

title: Microsoft Viva: Campaigns Hub in Engage and Engage in Teams mobile
description: The Campaigns Hub in Viva Engage provides a centralized mobile destination where employees can discover and participate in organizational campaigns. Available in the Viva Engage app and Viva Engage in Teams mobile, the hub highlights top and sponsored campaigns, enables users to browse active and completed campaigns, and makes it easy to view campaign details and follow the campaigns that matter to them.

title: Microsoft Teams: Facilitator Can Join Channel Meetings
description: Facilitator can now join meetings set up in Teams channels. Facilitator helps participants run more effective meetings through the ability to take live notes, manage the agenda, answer questions, and capture tasks.

title: Microsoft Viva: Copilot Analytics - Export metrics from Agent Dashboard
description:
Users can export de-identified, row-level agent metrics and attributes from the Agent Dashboard. Exported data provides detailed insights into agent usage and user-level agent interactions across the organization, with personal identifiers removed.
#copilotcontrolsystem

title: Microsoft Viva: Glint - Teams notification customization
description: Viva Glint admins can now customize the Microsoft Teams notifications sent for surveys. Admins can edit the title, message, and button label in each survey language and see their changes in a live preview. Teams and email messages stay consistent and match your organization's voice, which helps more employees see the survey and take part.

title: Dynamics 365 Project Operations: Restrict task assignments to project team members
description:
This feature strengthens assignment governance by limiting the resources displayed in the Assigned to column to members of the current project team. Project managers can assign tasks only to resources who have already been added to the project, instead of selecting from the organization’s complete resource list.
If a resource isn’t part of the project team, the resource must first be added to the team before being assigned a task. This controlled workflow keeps task assignments aligned with the project’s defined staffing model and prevents resources from being assigned outside the established project team.
This is for both Project Operations core and Project Operations connected with ERP deployment types.

title: Power Apps: Use Dataverse custom APIs in generative pages
description:
Makers can have a generative page call a Dataverse custom API to run server-side business logic, such as approving an order, recalculating a price, or validating a transaction. From either the Maker Studio generative page designer or the generative pages AI plugin, makers select a prepared API and describe when the page should call it, which input values to provide, and how to use the response.

Availability

Field Value
Release Channel Not applicable
Version Gen page v307
Applies to Model-driven apps
Feature Scope Admins or makers

title: Power Apps: Monitor generative pages with out-of-the-box Application Insights telemetry
description:
Admins and developers can monitor published generative pages with Application Insights. When an administrator configures Application Insights data export for an environment, Power Apps automatically exports completed page loads, unhandled errors, supported Data API operations, and navigation initiated from generative pages without requiring telemetry code, the Application Insights JavaScript SDK, or a connection string on the page.

Availability

Field Value
Release Channel Weekly
Version 2608.5
Applies to Model-driven apps
Feature Scope Admins or makers

title: Power Apps: Form fill assistance supports more field types
description:
We’re expanding form fill assistance in model-driven applications in Power Apps to support lookup, rich text, and multi-select choice fields, helping users complete more of their forms with AI-powered suggestions and less manual entry.

Availability

Field Value
Release Channel Monthly

title: Power Apps: Form fill assistance in apps can provide suggestions for existing values
description: We’re expanding form fill assistance in model-driven applications in Power Apps to suggest updates to fields that already contain values—not just empty fields. This helps users update existing information with ease using AI-powered skills in their apps.

title: Dynamics 365 Project Operations: Support Approver Comments for Expense Reports in Expense Management Mobile app
description:
Approvers using the Expense Management Mobile App currently have limited options to provide context when approving or rejecting expense reports. Approval decisions may require comments to provide justification, request clarification, document additional information, or communicate feedback to employees. Without this capability in the mobile experience, approvers may need to switch to the web application to complete the approval process.

This enhancement will enable approvers to add and view approval or rejection comments directly within the Expense Mobile App, providing a more consistent experience across mobile and web.

title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Sales Development Agent is now available
description: Autonomous agent that researches, qualifies, engages with leads, scaling sales capacity 24/7.

title: Microsoft Edge: Simplified Energy Saver
description: Energy saver, formerly known as efficiency mode, will have new defaults and different setting options. Edge will now support and recommend users to use the BatterySaverModeAvailability policy to manage the energy saver feature. The energy saver feature has been simplified to become enabled under two conditions: on low battery or when unplugged. The default will be for energy saver to be enabled on low battery. Energy saver will now have one mode. Users set to Balanced savings will be mapped to have energy saver enabled on low battery. Users set to Maximum savings will be mapped to have energy saver enabled when unplugged.

title: Dynamics 365 Business Central: Finance - Use batch totals for payment journals
description: The Batch Total field on the Payment Journal page enhances payment processing by enabling you to work with and review a cumulative total for a payment journal batch. By surfacing batch-level totals directly in payment journals, organizations gain better control over outgoing payments and can streamline review and approval processes.

title: Dynamics 365 Business Central: Finance - Use approvals with fixed asset journals
description: Organizations can use approval workflows with Fixed Asset Journals, which gives them the same level of control and oversight for fixed assets that's available for other journals in Business Central.

title: Dynamics 365 Business Central: Expense Agent - Use Expense Manager role center
description: The Expense Manager Role Center is updated to provide a more focused and efficient experience for managing vendor and expense-related activities. The enhancements align the workspace with typical expense management workflows, ensuring that key information and actions are readily accessible. Where relevant, other Role Centers are also updated to include access to expense management features.

title: Dynamics 365 Business Central: Expense Agent - Add an interim approver when you submit an expense report
description: This feature introduces support for a simple interim approval scenario for expense reports. When someone submits an expense report, organizations can designate an interim approver to review and approve expenses before the final approver can review and approve. Interim approver must review expense reports to confirm whether they're complete and compliant before final approver.

title: Dynamics 365 Business Central: Expense Agent - Create expense reports per trip automatically
description:
Expense Agent can automatically create expense reports based on identified business trips. You just need to configure the feature on the Expense Agent Setup page. Instead of manually collecting and organizing individual expense entries, you can use the agent to group relevant expenses and generate a dedicated expense report for each trip. Key capabilities include:

  • Administrators can specify whether the company wants to group expenses by trip and not only by period.
  • Automated expense report creation without requiring you to manually start and organize reports after a travel requisition is approved.
  • Automatic trip-based expense grouping associates eligible expenses with the correct business trip based on information in the travel requisition. The agent automatically groups not only expenses based on the location, but uses intelligence to group all expenses based on the context.
  • Non-trip related expenses keep existing period-based grouping in expense reports.

title: Dynamics 365 Field Service: Keep Project Staffing and Field Service Scheduling Aligned
description:
Deliver consistent scheduling outcomes across Dynamics 365 Project Operations and Field Service, regardless of where scheduling begins. When a project task includes resource assignments and planned effort, that demand is represented on the related work order with the same role, resource, duration, and scheduling window. Users can therefore schedule the same demand from either application and receive consistent availability and booking results. When multiple assignments exist, dispatchers can select the specific requirement they want to schedule.

When a project task does not provide assignment- or duration-based demand, the incident type on the work order continues to define the scheduling requirement. This flexibly supports an organization's scheduling needs, whether project-task-driven or incident-type-driven.

title: Microsoft Teams: AI Interpreter for Teams Events
description: AI Interpreter for Events brings real-time, AI-powered audio interpretation to Teams Town Halls and Webinars, helping global audiences follow events in their preferred language. Organizers can configure supported languages for their event, giving attendees a more natural and engaging multilingual experience beyond translated captions.

title: Microsoft Teams: Audio announcement for recording and transcription
description:
Admins can enable a policy that
plays an audio announcement when recording or transcription starts. This can be
applied tenant-wide or to specific groups. The announcement helps ensure all
participants are informed and improves accessibility awareness.

title: Microsoft Purview: Data Loss Prevention - SLA Based Alert Reporting Dashboard
description: Out-of-box MTTA/MTTD/MTTR SLA Alert Reporting dashboard showing past trends, Top SITs getting exposed via DLP alerts generated. Customers can define their custom SLAs for high, med and low severity alerts and get access to dashboard showing operational performance and SLA metrics.

title: Planner: Capabilities in Microsoft Cowork
description: You’ll soon be able to bring your Microsoft Planner into Microsoft Cowork. In Cowork, you can view, create, and update your plans, buckets, goals, and tasks without switching apps. Cowork goes a step further by helping you execute your Planner tasks across Microsoft 365, such as drafting and sending emails, scheduling meetings, posting updates to Teams, and working with files. It can then write progress back to Planner with your approval. You can move from planning your work to getting it done in one place.

title: Outlook: Mark as read improvements
description:
Mark as read will be updated to better match user expectations. When using the Unread filter, items will also be marked as read in coherence with the existing "Mark as read when using the reading pane" setting. Additionally, opening an item in a popout will now mark it as read regardless of that setting.

#newoutlookforwindows

title: Microsoft Edge: Review your PDF notes and annotations in the Notes pane
description: The built-in PDF viewer in Microsoft Edge will include a Notes pane that lists highlights, text notes, ink notes and comments in page order allowing users to quickly revisit them without finding them page by page. Users can search and filter their annotations, jump to each one in the document, and edit, delete or add comments from the pane. Available for Windows and macOS devices

title: Dynamics 365 Project Operations: Extend price overrides to category and material
description:
Project Operations price lists support three price types — role, expense category, and product/material — but only role prices currently support date-effective overrides. This feature extends date-effective price overrides to expense category and material prices, so you can schedule a future or time-bound price change for a category or material the same way you do for a role, without creating a separate, context-specific price list. The system honors the override when it prices a transaction, so the effective price reflects the override in force on the transaction date. The feature also aligns other points where the three price types diverge where feasible, with date-effective overrides as the primary deliverable. Unit-group conversions for category and material, custom pricing dimensions for category and material, and full time-phasing of prices are not included in this release.

How to enable: You configure overrides on the price list, the same way you set role-price overrides today, so pricing administrators and makers manage all three price types in one place. Overrides are stored in the existing Date-Effective Price Overrides table, so the feature is expected to reuse that mechanism; review any plug-ins or default pricing logic for category and material before you adopt it.

title: Dynamics 365 Project Operations: View resolved prices in a consolidated pricing view
description:
A new Pricing tab appears on the contract (and later the quote) and becomes the default pricing surface, replacing the Project Price List tab. Instead of listing only the price lists apply, it displays a consolidated grid of the prices that actually default for each pricing-dimension combination and date. You switch between price types, labor/role, category, and material, with a view picker, and role-price markups appear within the role view. A Date filter defaults to today and updates the grid to reflect date-effective overrides, and a Date effectivity column shows the date range each price is effective for. A Scope filter is set and locked automatically by the host record (Contract, Quote, Customer, Vendor purchase prices, or Org-unit cost prices). You can filter and sort across the pricing dimensions; grouping and frozen columns are not included in this release. Behind the grid, a unified query unions the Role Price and Date-Effective Price Overrides tables, de-duplicated and scoped to the price lists attached to the contract, and accounts for overrides at both the contract and associated customer levels.

How to enable: The Pricing tab appears automatically on the contract form once the feature is deployed and enabled via the feature control menu. Because the new tab replaces the Project Price List tab as the primary surface, review any customizations or automation built against the existing tab before you adopt it. The price lists associated with the contract or quote will now be shown on the summary tab.

title: Power Pages: SDK (Software Development Kit)
description: Build native mobile applications or kioks using Power Pages as the backend foundation with support for authentication, authorization, APIs, data access, and reusable mobile capabilities.

title: Dynamics 365 Customer Insights - Journeys: Create journeys in minutes with Journey Creation Agent
description:
You simply describe in everyday words what you want to create and the Journey Creation Agent builds the journey for you.

With Journey Creation Agent, you can:

  • Use an AI-powered, guided experience for optimized outcomes.
  • Build in minutes with no technical jargon, complex setup, or cold start. Use natural language to describe the journey you want to create.
  • Drive results–the agent interprets your goal and asks relevant follow-up questions to refine your intent and ensure accuracy.

Scenario

A campaign manager wants to re-engage inactive customers but has no time to build a journey from scratch. The manager simply types, “Send a re-engagement email to customers who haven’t purchased in 90 days, follow up with a reminder with a discount.” The journey is instantly generated, with the right audience, content, and structure.

title: Dynamics 365 Customer Insights - Journeys: Improve engagement and message timing with Outreach Optimization Agent
description:
Add the Outreach Optimization Agent to your journey, select the emails you want delivered, and let the agent handle timing and cadence automatically. With Outreach Optimization Agent, you can:

  • Start with an intelligent baseline: Outreach Optimization Agent automatically creates a baseline messaging plan for your audience by analyzing overall historical engagement patterns, producing a smart, generic plan that is designed to work well for most customers before any individual optimization kicks in.
  • Listen to incoming interactions and adapt the plan in real time: The agent continuously monitors incoming signals, including engagement and non-responsiveness, and adjusts follow-up timing and cadence, or exits the plan based on whether the goal is progressing or has been achieved.
  • Respect quiet times: The agent enforces quiet time settings as a hard constraint, ensuring that messages are never sent outside approved communication windows, even if engagement data suggests otherwise.

Scenario

A global retail brand uses Outreach Optimization Agent in a seasonal campaign to re-engage customers. Unlike previous efforts with fixed schedules and repeated reminders, the agent creates a smart baseline plan, then adjusts message timing for each customer based on their engagement. It slows or stops follow-ups when customers show interest and spaces out reminders for unresponsive customers, all while respecting quiet times and consent. This leads to better engagement and less message fatigue, with minimal manual intervention.

title: Dynamics 365 Commerce: Author Commerce receipt formats with Copilot Cowork
description:
Use natural language in Copilot Cowork to create, update, translate, and check Commerce receipt layouts using existing formats in headquarters.

The Commerce receipt format designer skill lets authorized users work with receipt layouts through natural-language requests in Copilot Cowork, using receipt configuration in Dynamics 365 Commerce headquarters. It applies to receipt formats used by Store Commerce point of sale (POS).

Users can:

  • Create and adapt formats: Start from an existing format in the modern Receipt designer representation, create a new format, or request changes to an existing target.
  • Edit receipt sections: Modify header, line, and footer content, field positions, alignment, and supported formatting.
  • Translate and personalize content: Translate static labels and add user-supplied text while preserving dynamic fields. Missing business details are identified rather than invented.
  • Check layouts without changing them: Request structural or geometry checks that identify overlaps, width violations, and truncation risks, with findings and suggested remediation.
  • Verify saved changes: Review the resulting format and changes, with saved configuration re-read to confirm the requested update. Creating a format from a source preserves that source.

The skill is available automatically to authorized Copilot Cowork users. Users describe the source format and desired outcome, resolve any source or target ambiguity, and review the results. A Commerce administrator ensures appropriate headquarters access and that the source format is available in the modern structured representation.

Structural checks do not establish visual appearance, barcode scanability, runtime values, or legal and fiscal compliance. Users review the layout in the Receipt designer and perform appropriate test printing before operational use. Assigning formats to receipt profiles or printers and printing or reprinting transactions are separate setup and operational workflows.

title: Dynamics 365 Commerce: Streamline pickup order workflows in Store Commerce
description:
Business Value
Trade counter pickups should be fast. When a business customer arrives to collect prepaid or pre-authorized orders, routing them through unnecessary screens and payment steps slows down the process. When customers want to add extra items during pickup, requiring a separate transaction introduces friction that can result in missed sales.

This feature reshapes the pickup experience to better align with trade counter operations. Associates can collect multiple orders in a single action, add extra items within the same transaction, and capture the pickup person’s name and signature for audit purposes. For orders that aren't collected, the ability to unpick lines and release inventory helps prevent stock from being held unnecessarily. Together, these improvements save time per transaction, reduce payment friction, and provide B2B operations with the audit trail they require.

Feature Details

  • Quick pickup operation: A new Quick pickup operation lets associates pick one or more orders or order lines for a single customer without navigating to the transaction screen. It is available when:
    • The customer is set up to pay on account.
    • The order is fully paid or authorized.
      ​
  • Pickup dialog enhancements: The pickup dialog includes a Pickup all action to select all eligible lines in one step, along with barcode scanning to confirm quantities. Completing the pickup invoices the selected order lines and captures any open payment authorization.
    ​
  • Adding carryout items during checkout pickup: During the checkout to pickup flow, associates can add additional carryout items to the transaction. A single payment covers both the new items and any remaining balance, so the customer isn't required to complete a separate transaction.
    ​
  • Signature and name capture: For B2B scenarios where pickups often occur without a card payment, associates can capture the pickup person’s name and signature. This information is applied to all orders selected in the same pickup session and is stored for audit purposes.
    ​
  • Unpicking order lines: When a customer doesn't collect goods, associates can unpick staged order lines. This action allows the order to be canceled and returns reserved inventory to available stock.

title: Dynamics 365 Contact Center: Unified routing - Orchestrate conversation distribution with natural language playbooks
description:
Conversation orchestration in Dynamics 365 Contact Center keeps every conversation actively managed throughout its lifecycle, from initiation through resolution. Instead of applying fixed rules at different stages of a conversation journey, conversation orchestration monitors each conversation as conditions evolve, like wait time increases, fast-filling queues, or service representatives going offline, and responds automatically with the right action. For example, administrators can define the intent using natural-language playbooks as follows: "If a premium customer waits for more than three minutes and no senior agents are available, increase their priority and offer a callback." Conversation orchestration then handles how it's run in real time.

You can configure playbooks per scenario through guided templates that keep instructions focused and reliable. Built-in validation catches conflicts before anything goes live, so that you confidently publish changes without needing to test every edge case manually.

The key capabilities are as follows:

  • Dynamic priority escalation: In traditional systems, conversation priority is typically set once, at entry, and never revisited. This means a customer who has been waiting for 10 minutes competes for the same expert as another customer who has just arrived, and a conversation that’s transferred mid-journey resets to whatever the new queue's default priority is. Dynamic priority escalation fixes this by continuously re-evaluating priority as the conversation progresses. You define the conditions such as wait time thresholds, queue transfers, customer tier, or other context and conversation orchestration adjusts priority automatically throughout the conversation lifecycle. High-value or long-waiting customers move forward without anyone watching the queue manually.

  • Overflow handling across multiple conditions: Conversation orchestration supports a broader set of business triggered overflow conditions, allowing organizations to respond intelligently as queue conditions change. Administrators can define actions when a queue is outside operating hours, when all representatives in a queue are signed out or unavailable, when queue wait time exceeds a defined threshold, or when the number of waiting conversations surpasses a specified limit. Depending on the situation, orchestration can automatically offer callbacks, route conversations to alternate queues, expand assignment eligibility, notify supervisors, or deliver contextual customer messages. This ensures customers are never left waiting without a defined path forward. Admins can also configure overflow handling for direct inward dial calls now, when reps are not available or don't accept the calls.

  • Assign to a previously engaged or preferred representative: Customers often need to repeat information when they are connected to a new representative for every interaction. Conversation orchestration helps maintain continuity by reconnecting customers with previously engaged or preferred representatives whenever possible. Assignment decisions take into account historical interactions, queue membership alignment, representative availability, and workload capacity. For asynchronous conversations, organizations can choose to honor representative presence status and active conversation limits before reconnecting customers, ensuring returning conversations are assigned only when the preferred representative has capacity to engage. When the preferred or previously engaged representative is unavailable, conversations seamlessly fall back to the next best qualified representative. This reduces customer effort, improves resolution efficiency, and delivers a more personalized support experience.

  • Bullseye routing: Finding the right representative often requires balancing expertise with response times. Bullseye routing enables organizations to gradually expand the pool of eligible representatives when a conversation isn't assigned within a defined timeframe. Administrators can define progressive routing rings that begin with the most qualified representatives and then expand to broader groups based on skills, proficiency levels, teams, or other business criteria. This approach maximizes the likelihood of connecting customers with the best-qualified representative while ensuring conversations don't wait indefinitely for a specific resource.

These capabilities are the first in a broad and growing set of orchestration scenarios that conversation orchestration will support across the full conversation lifecycle, spanning overflow management, priority handling, assignment strategies, in-conversation messaging, and escalation. Each new capability builds on the same natural-language playbook foundation, so organizations can adopt new scenarios without rebuilding what they have already configured.

Business Value:

Traditional automatic conversation distribution systems rely on complex rules and static configuration that are difficult to maintain and can't adapt as conditions change throughout the conversation lifecycle. Unified routing with its new AI-powered conversation orchestration uses the power of agentic AI to continuously monitor events throughout the entire conversation lifecycle and responds with the right action when required.

This is a shift from a static system to an orchestration layer that remains active and intelligent from the moment a conversation arrives in a queue until it's resolved. The new feature reduces administrative complexity and helps deliver more flexible customer experiences at scale, even under fluctuating demand.

title: Dynamics 365 Field Service: Optimize resource scheduling - Optimize schedules with Scheduling Operations Agent
description:
Dispatchers often spend considerable time and energy reviewing and adjusting each technician's schedule as conditions change throughout the workday:

  • A technician has one or more cancellations in the afternoon. To fill the open slots, what requirements optimally keep promise windows, prefer high-priority work, and locate work around the same neighborhoods that the technician is due to travel to?
  • A technician is running over the planned time for the current booking. As a result, they're late for the next booking, and the delay might cascade to subsequent bookings. How do you best adjust the bookings for the remainder of the day?
  • A technician recovers from illness sooner than expected and is now available for work earlier than planned. What's the best way to schedule work for them when they return?
  • A technician’s schedule contains a lot of low-priority work that isn't due for weeks. How can you improve the schedule with work that better meets desired business goals?
  • A technician’s schedule for the day is built manually or with the schedule assistant. How can you rearrange the schedule so that the resource’s travel time is reduced?

In each case, the dispatcher needs to assess the situation, determine which business goals apply, and then update the schedule manually, one booking at a time.

With this release of the Scheduling Operations Agent, dispatchers can ask Copilot to provide the best schedule for the affected technician. Within seconds, the dispatcher gets a suggested schedule for review and can apply the updates.

You can direct Copilot to optimize for the business goal you want, such as maximizing technician usage or work order priority. Copilot intelligently chooses among existing bookings and new unfulfilled work orders based on factors like skillset match, territories, and customer promise windows. Users can access the feature from the Copilot side pane anywhere within the Dynamics 365 Field Service application.

Business Value:

The Scheduling Operations Agent for Dynamics 365 Field Service enables dispatchers to quickly and easily optimize schedules for technicians as conditions change throughout the workday, so they can significantly improve their productivity. Dispatchers can ask Copilot to optimize schedules and address issues such as traffic delays, double bookings, or last-minute cancellations that often result in conflicts, gaps, or idle time in a technician's schedule. Instruct Copilot to achieve the desired business objective, such as maximizing technician usage or work order priority while considering factors like skillset match, territories, and promised time windows.
