description:
Using the AI resources provides several benefits:

  • Reduced operational overhead: Avoid the need to handle infrastructure management, updates, monitoring, troubleshooting, or maintenance of custom Azure OpenAI subscriptions. This benefit frees up resources to focus on core business operations and provides value-adding intellectual property (IP) to customers.
  • Simplified onboarding: Quickly integrate AI capabilities into your solutions without having to navigate the complexities of setting up and managing your own Azure OpenAI subscription.
  • Improved reliability: Proactive scaling, throttling, load balancing, and fault tolerance measures ensure consistent performance during peak demand.
  • Enhanced security compliance: Built-in compliance measures and governance, including robust protection from malicious and harmful content, ensure compliance with data residency requirements. This benefit reduces the burden of ensuring regulatory compliance for ISVs.
  • Streamlined experience for customers: Customers get a seamless AI resource management process without maintaining different configurations for separate ISV solutions.

This capability also provides a cohesive AI consumption tracking and billing experience for Business Central customers. Customers who use AI resources across multiple AI-enabled solutions built with Business Central customer developer tools for Copilot benefit from a unified approach to AI consumption monitoring and invoicing. They don't need to reconcile multiple invoices or metrics from separate ISVs.

For details on billing costs, see AI tools at Message scenarios.

For most publishers, the default Business Central AI resources are enough. However, if you need specific models, including fine-tuned models, that the Business Central AI resources don't provide, you can bring your own subscription for customers. In this case, the publisher is responsible for deploying, maintaining, scaling, and securing the service. The publisher also handles billing AI resources to customers.

You just need to authenticate with the SetManagedResourceAuthorization method in the AI Module AzureOpenAI codeunit. // Example of using your own Azure OpenAI subscription in AL

This AI billing model isn't designed to replace the existing Marketplace monetization pathway for publishers who create Business Central apps. title: Dynamics 365 Finance: Globalization Studio - Unified e‑invoicing integration framework
description:
The unified extensible e-invoicing integration framework extends the existing Electronic Invoicing service by introducing:

  • A unified outbound and inbound document model (based on international standards such as UBL and PEPPOL).
  • A standardized submission and response pipeline and API for e-invoicing documents and related statuses.
  • A clear extensibility model that allows external ASPs, ISVs, Microsoft partners, and customers to implement their own integrations without requiring Microsoft to build or maintain provider specific connectors.

With this framework, Microsoft defines the data (format) contract, integration pattern, and lifecycle handling, while external e-invoicing ASPs (for example, PDPs, PAs, or PACs) implement the required endpoints and data transformations on their side.

This approach enables:

  • Support for multiple service providers under a consistent integration model.
  • Faster onboarding of new providers and markets.
  • Reduced vendor lock-in for customers.
  • Better alignment with country-specific regulatory requirements without Microsoft acting as an authorized e-invoicing service provider.

Important clarifications (out of scope):

  • This feature does not make Microsoft an Authorized Service Provider (ASP / PDP / PA / PAC, PEPPOL access point).
  • The feature does not include built‑in connectivity to e‑invoicing providers.
  • Customers must continue to use third‑party e‑invoicing providers for “last‑mile” submission to tax authorities or clearance platforms.
  • Integration with a specific ASP is the responsibility of the provider, customer, or ISV, using the established integration framework.

In the initial phase, Microsoft defines the data contract and API specification and supports these in Dynamics 365 ERP and Electronic invoicing service. Microsoft collaborates with a selected set of ASPs to build integrations using this standard data contract and API specification, and to validate the integrations for a subset of countries or regions. Customers will be able to choose from these providers based on their countries or regions of operation and configure the integrations within their ERP environments.

Moving forward, we will be:

  • Extending the coverage by adding more countries or regions; and
  • Engaging with more ASPs and ISVs to expand the ecosystem.

Business Value:

This feature introduces a unified, extensible integration framework for the Electronic invoicing service in Dynamics 365 Finance, Dynamics 365 Supply Chain Management, and Dynamics 365 Project Operations, enabling Authorized Service Providers (ASPs), Independent Software Vendors (ISVs), and Microsoft partners and customers to build and maintain their own integrations between the e-invoicing service and external e‑invoicing platforms using a Microsoft‑defined unified format (data contract) and integration pipeline / API.
The framework is designed to decouple ERP from any single e‑invoicing provider, giving customers more flexibility in ASP choice while reducing the need for Microsoft‑built, country‑specific formats and “last‑mile” connectors.

title: Dynamics 365 Business Central: Copilot and agents - Envision and design AI agents in Business Central
description:
AI agents in Business Central

Business Central introduces AI agents to help users automate repetitive tasks and make business processes more intelligent and efficient. These agents act as specialized assistants that understand context, handle structured data, and collaborate with users to complete end-to-end workflows. For example, the Sales Order Agent simplifies order creation by transforming natural language or email instructions into complete sales documents, while the Payables Agent streamlines vendor invoice processing by extracting key details from incoming invoices and matching them to purchase orders—all reducing manual effort and freeing users to focus on higher-value work.

The agent runtime that powers these built-in agents provides core capabilities that enable the use of agentic AI within Business Central. AI agents are defined, configured, activated, and run directly inside the familiar Business Central environment—leveraging the same security model, administration tools, and user experience as the rest of the product. Results are displayed in-context, with intuitive navigation to related data and entities, allowing users to control the agents through the interface they already know. This consistency dramatically reduces the learning curve, builds trust, and ensures efficiency when working with AI agents.

The agent runtime ensures that every step taken by an agent is traceable and operates strictly within the access boundaries (permissions) assigned during configuration. It provides a timeline view of all agent activities, allowing users to review what happened and why—enabling a true human-in-the-loop experience. The runtime can also memorize relevant data during execution, use it in subsequent steps, and request additional instructions in natural language when user input is needed. It helps ensure that sensitive operations always require explicit user review and consent, supporting full transparency and control.

Business Central business processes are inherently multistep, stateful, and financially consequential. The agent layer must be able to interact with a broad set of ERP capabilities and data, sequence operations with a high degree of accuracy across dependent steps, handle the data respecting permissions, company, environment, and tenant boundaries, provide a contextual audit trail, and keep humans in the loop.

Business Central agentic strategy intentionally separates deep, well controlled, in-context and transparent execution within the product from cross-system orchestration. Business Central agents form the foundational layer inside the product, exposing well-defined agent capabilities that in the future will be possible to surface as MCP tools and consume by Declarative Agents in Microsoft Copilot Studio and Microsoft 365. This layered approach enables Business Central-tuned, transparent, managed execution at the ERP core processes, while allowing higher-level Declarative Agents to orchestrate end-to-end business processes across products.

Designing agents

The new in-product experience for designing agents that automate Business Central processes is made available with AI Development Toolkit for Business Central. The experience offers a low-risk environment for envisioning and prototyping new AI agents tailored to your own business scenarios—extending the same agent runtime capabilities used by built-in Business Central agents.

Built for rapid iteration, the designing experience lets you create and refine custom agents using natural language instructions, define their behavior, test agent profiles and permissions, and safely experiment with Business Central data in a sandbox environment. This approach empowers partner personas like consultants, product owners, and domain experts, as well as developers and even power users, to explore new scenarios, validate ideas, and build confidence in their agents before moving to production. Whether you aim to automate repetitive business processes, streamline data processing, or deliver proactive insights, the agent design experience gives you the tools to bring your vision to life.

Agent instructions

At the core of every agent are its goals and instructions, defined in natural language. Writing agent instructions is similar to writing prompts for large language models, so you can apply general prompt-writing best practices—and even use tools like Copilot to optimize them. The agent design experience includes a simple editor to help you define, refine, and test these instructions efficiently.

Invoking your agent

You can invoke your agent by manually creating a task for it. When doing so, you can include an additional message that provides specific details or context to complement the agent’s core instructions. Although the ability to design your own agents is in public preview, there aren't yet any built-in integrations to automatically trigger these custom agents based on incoming emails, events, or scheduled recurrences (this can be done by professional developers using the APIs available in the AI Development Toolkit). However, you can simulate these scenarios by including the email header and body in the task message to mimic incoming emails, or by manually triggering the agent to emulate event, UI action, or time-based runs.

Troubleshooting

When running the agent tasks in the designing experience, you can access detailed diagnostic views to help you understand and tune the agent execution. Since an agent’s decisions depend on its instructions, available data, and language model reasoning, you can review execution logs to see its inputs, reasoning process, and outputs. This helps you identify where uncertainty occurred and why specific decisions were made to adjust your agent instructions.

Importing and exporting agents

To make it easy to back up or move custom agents across sandbox environments, the in-product experience allows you to import and export agent definitions. These definitions are stored as simple JSON files containing properties such as agent identity, instructions, assigned profiles, and permissions. We recommend storing these files in a source control system like GitHub to track changes and maintain version history.

Responsible AI

Agents built using the agent design experience adhere to Microsoft’s Responsible AI principles, helping you ensure agent compliance, fairness, and safety.

Billing

As with the built-in Sales Order and Payables agents, custom agents consume Copilot credits as they perform their steps. Credits can be provisioned through prepaid or pay-as-you-go models, providing flexible cost management as your AI usage scales.

Business Value:

Agents in Business Central are AI-powered team assistants that go beyond traditional automation. Unlike static workflows or hard-coded AL logic, agents can interpret high-level business goals expressed in natural language and translate them into actionable steps. They reason over Business Central data, make informed decisions within defined boundaries, and collaborate with users through human-in-the-loop approvals for critical operations.

The benefits are substantial: agents reduce manual effort by automating repetitive or complex tasks, allowing users to focus on higher-value activities. They adapt to dynamic business scenarios that can't always be anticipated during development, offering flexibility that traditional automation lacks. Most importantly, agents operate transparently: every action is logged, permissions are rigorously enforced, and users remain in control at all times.

This combination of intelligence, adaptability, and accountability makes agents a cornerstone of the next generation of ERP experiences. With the agent design experience, we're taking the first steps toward enabling you to build your own custom Business Central agents.

description:

How it works:
- CMA streamlines a process that was once manual and time-consuming:
- CMA automatically runs backend APIs to generate reports such as SLM and DAG.

Preview highlights:

- Refined tooltips and issue categories
- Easier navigation across reports

Getting started:

title: Microsoft Viva: Copilot Analytics - Copilot Employee Experience Outcomes Report with Viva Glint
description: A new Power BI report in Viva Insights highlights the relationships and impact of M365 Copilot usage on employee experience sentiment outcomes in Viva Glint. This report enables robust analysis by allowing users to slice and dice data based on Copilot usage segments, different sentiment outcomes and organizational attributes. #copilotcontrolsystem
ai_summary: Microsoft Viva introduces a Power BI report that analyzes the impact of M365 Copilot usage on employee experience outcomes in Viva Glint. This report allows users to segment data for detailed insights.

title: Microsoft Purview compliance portal: Insider Risk Management- Multi selectable DLP policies as an IRM triggering event
description: Insider Risk Management is releasing the ability to select multiple Data Loss Prevention (DLP) policies as triggering events in a policy. Previously, admins could only select one DLP policy as a triggering event within Insider Risk Management policies. Microsoft Purview Insider Risk Management correlates various signals to identify potential malicious or inadvertent insider risks, such as IP theft, data leakage, and security violations. Insider Risk Management enables customers to create policies based on their own internal policies, governance, and organizational requirements. Built with privacy by design, users are pseudonymized by default, and role-based access controls and audit logs are in place to help ensure user-level privacy.
ai_summary: Insider Risk Management in Microsoft Purview now allows admins to select multiple Data Loss Prevention (DLP) policies as triggering events for policies. This enhances the ability to identify insider risks.

title: Microsoft Teams: Customize the screen in Teams Town hall through "Manage what attendees see"
description: Organizers will be able to effortlessly enhance their Teams Town hall presentations. In “Manage what attendees see” users will be able to customize their screen using select layouts, backgrounds, and name tags, resulting in a polished, high-quality, and engaging event. This feature is available with a Teams Premium License.
ai_summary: Microsoft Teams will allow organizers to customize attendee views during Town hall meetings with various layouts and backgrounds. This feature requires a Teams Premium License.

title: Microsoft Viva: Viva Glint and Viva Insights Integration - Workplace Patterns Report in Viva Glint
description: An intuitive report that highlights the relationships between employee sentiment items and the workplace patterns and drivers that shape engagement. This feature eliminates the need for custom analysis, enabling users to share out of the box actionable insights with leaders—accelerating decision-making to drive meaningful actions across the organization
ai_summary: Viva Glint integrates with Viva Insights to provide a Workplace Patterns Report that connects employee sentiment with workplace drivers. This feature simplifies sharing actionable insights for decision-making.

title: Excel: Enable "View Side by Side" on Mac
description: You can now quickly compare worksheets in the same workbook or in different workbooks by viewing them side by side with synchronous scrolling and reset window positioning on Mac.
ai_summary: Excel on Mac now supports a 'View Side by Side' feature, allowing users to compare worksheets in the same or different workbooks with synchronous scrolling.

title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Knowledge templates support for ServiceNow Knowledge Connector
description: Earlier ServiceNow Knowledge connector did not support ingestion of content for articles created using templates in ServiceNow. But now ServiceNow Knowledge connector supports ingestion of knowledge articles based on out-of-the-box templates like FAQ, How to, What is, etc. & even custom templates used by the customers in their organization.
ai_summary: The ServiceNow Knowledge connector now supports the ingestion of knowledge articles created with templates, including custom templates, enhancing content integration.

title: Outlook: Collapsible Automatic Replies on Outlook for iOS
description: Now when users receive multiple automatic replies at once, they appear collapsed in the reading pane by default. Users can then expand to see all the automatic replies if desired.
ai_summary: Outlook for iOS will now display multiple automatic replies collapsed in the reading pane by default, allowing users to expand and view them as needed.

title: Outlook: Collapsible Automatic Replies on Outlook for Android
description: Now when users receive multiple automatic replies at once, they appear collapsed in the reading pane by default. Users can then expand to see all the automatic replies if desired.
ai_summary: Outlook for Android will also show multiple automatic replies collapsed in the reading pane by default, with an option to expand for more details.

title: Microsoft Viva: Enhancement to Copilot studio agents report
description: Following further review, this feature continues in development. We apologize for any inconvenience. Enhancement to Copilot studio agents report (Preview) 1. Addition of Weekly active user count 2. Report aggregation changed to weekly to main consistency with other reports
ai_summary: Microsoft Viva is enhancing the Copilot studio agents report by adding a weekly active user count and changing report aggregation to weekly for consistency.

title: Microsoft Teams: Silent test call
description: Silent Test enables IT administrators to proactively run synthetic Teams call simulations to specific subnets, helping assess network readiness and detect potential issues before they impact users, ensuring a seamless communication experience.
ai_summary: Microsoft Teams will allow IT admins to run silent test calls to assess network readiness for Teams calls. This helps identify potential issues before they affect users.

title: Microsoft Purview Information Protection: Doc library default labeling for SharePoint Online and Copilot
description: This new capability further integrates SharePoint Online with Purview sensitivity labeling. SharePoint Online document library owners can set a new type of default label on the library, which automatically applies that label to all unprotected Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and PDF files within the library. This simplifies labeling in bulk across document libraries in an organization, enriches DLP and Copilot with signal to allow admins to monitor and restrict access to this content, and enables inheritance of sensitivity labels to output artifacts in Copilot. #copilotcontrolsystem
ai_summary: SharePoint Online document library owners can now set default sensitivity labels that automatically apply to unprotected files. This simplifies bulk labeling and enhances data loss prevention.

title: Microsoft 365: Multi-Geo In-Region Routing
description: Multi-Geo In-Region Routing (IRR) enables customers to control the routing of inbound emails. Using IRR, customers can set the geo-region that inbound mail should be routed to for specific Accepted Domains.
ai_summary: Microsoft 365 introduces Multi-Geo In-Region Routing, allowing customers to control the routing of inbound emails to specific geo-regions for accepted domains.

title: Microsoft Teams: Share apps from app bar via right click
description: Allow users to right-click and share apps directly from the app icon on hover, while using the app.
ai_summary: In Microsoft Teams, users will be able to right-click on app icons to share apps directly from the app bar. This enhances the user experience while using apps.

title: Excel: Refresh queries from Authenticated Data Sources in Excel for the Web
description: You can now refresh Power Query data from data sources that require authentication in Excel for the Web.
ai_summary: Excel for the Web now supports refreshing Power Query data from authenticated data sources, improving data management capabilities.

title: Microsoft Edge: v.144 - Copilot icon visibility
description: Users can now manage the Copilot icon in their toolbar. To hide the icon, right-click the Copilot icon and select “Hide Copilot”. This will open Settings to toggle the icon’s visibility. Admins can control whether the Copilot icon shows in the toolbar using the Microsoft365CopilotChatIconEnabled policy.
ai_summary: Microsoft Edge users can manage the visibility of the Copilot icon in their toolbar, with admins able to control this setting via policy.

title: Microsoft Edge: v.144 - Performance settings update and feature name changes
description: Efficiency mode feature name will change to energy saver and efficiency mode for PC gaming name will be renamed PC gaming boost to better describe the feature benefits.  The new names will be in browser performance settings after the update.
ai_summary: Microsoft Edge will change the names of certain performance features to better reflect their functions, impacting user understanding of settings.

title: Microsoft Purview: Data Loss Prevention- Admin units support for SharePoint Online
description: Delegate management and remediation authority for different people in different regions or organization units with role-based access control (RBAC). For example, German investigators should be able to investigate alerts and audit events for only German users. This update extends support to SharePoint for Microsoft 365.
ai_summary: Microsoft Purview extends Data Loss Prevention to SharePoint Online, allowing role-based access control for managing alerts and audit events by region or unit.

title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Generate icons for your agents using AI in Microsoft 365 Copilot
description: A picture is worth a thousand words. Before, Microsoft 365 Copilot agent builders would need to use the default icon or manually upload their own image. This process meant browsing the web for an image, asking different teams for icons, or manually drawing one. Users can now use AI to describe how the icon should look like, thus helping inform end users of the agent's function more easily, with more expression. Users can now generate icons using AI in Agent Builder. Users can enter custom prompts or use the description of the agent to generate the icon. Alternatively, users can manually upload their own icon or select from a set of pre-created icons. Icons are capped at 1 MB (192px).
ai_summary: Microsoft 365 Copilot now allows users to generate icons for agents using AI, simplifying the process of creating representative icons.

title: Microsoft Purview Compliance Portal: Data Loss Prevention: DLP to restrict Microsoft 365 Copilot processing on emails with sensitivity labels
description: Microsoft Purview Data Loss Prevention (DLP) is extended to preventing Microsoft 365 Copilot from processing emails with sensitivity labels. This feature will allow DLP policies to provide detection of sensitivity labels in emails as enterprise grounding data and restrict access of the labeled emails in Microsoft 365 Copilot chat experiences.
ai_summary: Data Loss Prevention in Microsoft Purview will now restrict Microsoft 365 Copilot from processing emails with sensitivity labels, enhancing data protection.

title: SharePoint: eSignature - Free Text Field Support
description: SharePoint eSignature users would be able to add custom free text fields to their request documents. This new eSignature field can be used to request information (such as address, full name, etc.) from signers.
ai_summary: SharePoint eSignature users can now add custom free text fields to request documents for additional information from signers.

title: Microsoft Teams: Local PTZ camera controls for Microsoft Teams Rooms on Android
description: If the camera is not currently auto-framing the room, in-room users can now control the Pan-Tilt-Zoom (PTZ) of the active camera to keep the focus where they want it.
ai_summary: Microsoft Teams Rooms on Android will allow in-room users to manually control the Pan-Tilt-Zoom (PTZ) of the active camera.

title: Microsoft Purview: Insider Risk Management - Data Security Investigation integration
description: Launch a pre-scoped Data Security Investigation (DSI) from an IRM case. When a data security admin identifies a risky user who needs deeper investigation, they can launch a pre-scoped investigation directly from an IRM case, allowing them to view content analysis related to that user and better assess post-incident data impact.
ai_summary: Data security admins can launch a pre-scoped Data Security Investigation directly from an Insider Risk Management case for deeper user analysis.

title: Microsoft Purview: Discovery of sensitive data sharing to any cloud application or website (inc. GenAI) via network layer
description:
With this update, IRM will support the discovery of sensitive files and text shared to any cloud application or website (inc. GenAI) via network layer. This capability is based on integration with 3rd party network partners (with data being captured via network layer).

Microsoft Purview Insider Risk Management correlates various signals to identify potential malicious or inadvertent insider risks, such as IP theft, data leakage, and security violations. Insider Risk Management enables customers to create policies based on their own internal policies, governance, and organizational requirements. Built with privacy by design, users are pseudonymized by default, and role-based access controls and audit logs are in place to help ensure user-level privacy.
ai_summary: Microsoft Purview will enable the discovery of sensitive data shared to any cloud application or website via the network layer, helping identify insider risks.

title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Steer your presentation length, tone, style, and images when creating with Copilot.
description: You can now adjust the length of your presentation, the tone of your narrative, the style of your slides, and leverage AI-generated images when creating with Copilot.
ai_summary: Microsoft 365 Copilot will allow users to adjust presentation length, tone, style, and use AI-generated images during creation.

title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Data source specific filters
description: We are introducing a dynamic filtering experience in Microsoft 365 Copilot search that empowers users to refine their results more precisely by leveraging data source-specific filters in the right rail. When a user selects a data source from the right rail, such as Outlook, SharePoint, Jira, or Copilot Chats, the interface dynamically presents a tailored set of filters specific to that source. These refiners allow users to narrow down results based on attributes unique to the selected data source, such as item type, status, or semantic labels.
ai_summary: Microsoft 365 Copilot will introduce data source-specific filters in search results, allowing users to refine results based on selected data sources.

title: Microsoft Purview: Data Loss Prevention - Data Loss Prevention to restrict Microsoft 365 Copilot processing on content with sensitivity labels
description: Microsoft Purview Data Loss Prevention is extended to Microsoft 365 Copilot. This feature will allow DLP policies to provide detection of sensitivity labels in enterprise  grounding data and restrict access of the content in Microsoft 365 Copilot.
ai_summary: Data Loss Prevention policies will now restrict Microsoft 365 Copilot processing on content with sensitivity labels, enhancing data security.

title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Steer your presentation length, tone, style, and images when creating with Copilot.
description: You can now adjust the length of your presentation, the tone of your narrative, the style of your slides, and leverage AI-generated images when creating with Copilot.
ai_summary: Microsoft 365 Copilot will allow users to adjust presentation length, tone, style, and use AI-generated images during creation.

title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Steer your presentation length, tone, style, and images when creating with Copilot.
description: You can now adjust the length of your presentation, the tone of your narrative, the style of your slides, and leverage AI-generated images when creating with Copilot.
ai_summary: Microsoft 365 Copilot will allow users to adjust presentation length, tone, style, and use AI-generated images during creation.

title: SharePoint: Copilot actions in SharePoint document libraries
description: When you select an item in OneDrive on the Web, the Copilot button appears, offering a range of actions you can perform on that item. The same feature and actions are coming to document library views in SharePoint and Teams.
ai_summary: Copilot actions will be available in SharePoint document libraries, allowing users to perform various actions on selected items.

title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Catch up on a summary of document comments in the top of your document
description: Copilot will have a Discussion tab in the top of your document to summarize open comments, helping you quickly understand what people have said in comments.
ai_summary: Microsoft Copilot will add a Discussion tab to documents to summarize comments, helping users quickly understand feedback. This change affects all users of Microsoft 365 who utilize Copilot.

title: Microsoft Purview: Insider Risk Management – Enhancements to variant limits and detection groups
description:
Microsoft Purview Insider Risk Management variant limit is being increased from 3 to 10 per indicator and an overall limit of 100 across all indicators. Along with this, the number of items in one detection group is being increased from 200 to 500.

Microsoft Purview Insider Risk Management correlates various signals to identify potential malicious or inadvertent insider risks, such as IP theft, data leakage, and security violations. Insider Risk Management enables customers to create policies based on their own internal policies, governance, and organizational requirements. Built with privacy by design, users are pseudonymized by default, and role-based access controls and audit logs are in place to help ensure user-level privacy.
ai_summary: Microsoft Purview Insider Risk Management will increase variant limits and detection group sizes, allowing for better monitoring of insider risks. This update impacts organizations using Insider Risk Management.

title: Microsoft Purview: Inline protection, alerting, and incident management for sensitive data shared over the network through non-Microsoft SASE integrations
description: Extend Microsoft Purview Data Loss Prevention (DLP) policies and Insider Risk Management indicators to the network by integrating with your existing non-Microsoft Secure Access Service Edge (SASE) solution. This integration enables organizations to intercept and inspect traffic inline at the network layer and enforce actions based on DLP policy conditions. It helps prevent sensitive data from being shared with untrusted cloud applications through browsers, apps, APIs, add-ins, and more - including generative AI platforms, cloud storage, and content-sharing services - while managing alerts and incidents through Purview and Microsoft Defender. If configured, these signals also inform user risk indicators in Insider Risk Management
ai_summary: Microsoft Purview will extend DLP policies to non-Microsoft SASE solutions, enabling inline protection for sensitive data shared over the network. This affects organizations using DLP and SASE integrations.

title: Microsoft Viva: Viva Glint - Export Executive Summary report in Viva Glint to editable PowerPoint slides
description: Managers will be able to export the default sections from the Executive Summary report in Viva Glint directly to editable PowerPoint slides. This enhancement allows for easier and quicker consumption of this report outside Viva Glint, compared to the previous export method which included static screenshots.
ai_summary: Managers can now export Executive Summary reports from Viva Glint to editable PowerPoint slides, improving report accessibility. This change affects managers using Viva Glint.

title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Copilot can now answer questions about opened Copilot Pages in chat
description: When using Copilot Pages side-by-side in Copilot Chat, you can now ask questions in chat about your open page, and Copilot will provide answers based on the contents of that page.
ai_summary: Microsoft Copilot will now answer questions about open Copilot Pages in chat, enhancing user interaction with the tool. This change affects users utilizing Copilot.

title: Microsoft Edge: v.144 - Tenant Restrictions v2 (TRv2)
description: New enforcement to block access from unauthorized Microsoft 365 tenants directly in Microsoft Edge for Business, helping organizations maintain strict compliance and prevent data leakage across tenant boundaries.
ai_summary: Microsoft Edge will enforce tenant restrictions to block access from unauthorized Microsoft 365 tenants, helping organizations prevent data leakage. This impacts organizations using Edge for Business.

title: Microsoft Purview: Information Protection-Email attachment Preview in Activity Explorer
description: We're enhancing Activity Explorer to provide greater visibility into sensitive data flagged in Exchange Online. Previously, only the message body was viewable, which limited insight into flagged content. With this update, admins will be able to preview email attachments directly within Activity Explorer—without needing to download the email.
ai_summary: Activity Explorer in Microsoft Purview will allow admins to preview email attachments flagged in Exchange Online, enhancing visibility into sensitive data. This update affects admins managing email security.

title: Microsoft Edge: v.144 - New WebGL software backend
description: Microsoft Edge, on Windows systems without a physical GPU, will use the Windows Advanced Rasterization Platform (WARP) rasterizer for WebGL workloads. Prior versions use SwiftShader. This scenario is most common associated with headless environments and virtual machines. On non-Windows platforms, a physical GPU will be required for WebGL moving forward.
ai_summary: Microsoft Edge will switch to a new WebGL software backend for systems without a physical GPU, affecting performance in headless environments. This change impacts users on those systems.

title: Microsoft Viva: Update storyline cover photos in Teams for iOS.
description: Users will be able to update their storyline cover photo from Teams for iOS. This is already currently supported on Teams for Android or Windows, Mac, on the web.
ai_summary: Users can now update their storyline cover photos from Teams for iOS, a feature already available on other platforms. This change affects Teams users on iOS.

title: Outlook: Outlook for Android supports PDF attachment preview
description: Users can now preview PDFs directly in the Outlook for Android app.
ai_summary: Outlook for Android now allows users to preview PDF attachments directly in the app.

title: Microsoft Edge: v.144 - Improved Autofill experience in Microsoft Edge
description: When users fill in an Address on a form, they will be prompted to choose whether to save it for future Autofill suggestions. This enhancement ensures Autofill data is saved intentionally by users and reduces unwanted entries as part of their Autofill suggestion.
ai_summary: Microsoft Edge will prompt users to intentionally save addresses for Autofill, improving data management.

title: Microsoft Purview: Information Protection-Content Explorer – Enhanced Tag (SIT, Labels) Filter at UI Layer
description: Introduces enhanced controls in Content Explorer’s UI, enabling scoped visibility and filtering of SIT and label data. This will help with content discoverability and governance.
ai_summary: Microsoft Purview enhances Content Explorer with better filtering options for SIT and label data, aiding content governance.

title: Microsoft Purview: Data Lifecycle Management-Introduction of secure workflow to bypass retention holds and delete Teams transcripts and/or Teams recordings
description: Introducing a capability to Purview compliance admins via a Data Lifecycle Management to bypass retention hold or legal holds to delete content on OneDrive or SharePoint Online such as Teams meeting transcripts and/or recordings earlier than the hold durations to comply with emerging compliance requirements. Leveraging Simulation, authoring approvals, Audit and disposition reviews to set-up and enforce defensible policies.
ai_summary: Purview compliance admins can now bypass retention holds to delete Teams transcripts and recordings earlier, improving compliance management.

title: Microsoft Viva: Focus Area simplification and enhancements
description: Beginning with this feature release, Focus Areas will be associated with survey cycles and goal periods will be retired. Users will be able to select the same Focus Area across multiple cycles. The Focus Area Overview report will be filterable to groups of interest (e.g. managers only). Draft/deleted Focus Areas will no longer be included in Focus Area calculations.
ai_summary: Microsoft Viva will simplify Focus Areas by linking them to survey cycles and allowing selection across multiple cycles.

title: Microsoft Purview Compliance Portal: Information Protection - Admin unit scoping in Content Explorer and Data Explorer
description: This feature introduces Admin Unit scoping to both Content Explorer and Data Explorer, enabling more granular visibility and control over M365 data. It ensures that data exploration respects organizational boundaries defined by Admin Units, enhancing compliance and governance.
ai_summary: Admin Unit scoping is added to Content Explorer and Data Explorer in Microsoft Purview, enhancing data visibility and compliance.

title: SharePoint: Permissions report for a given user - SharePoint admin center
description: This report, under Data access governance within SharePoint admin center, provides SharePoint admin with a list of sites where the given user has direct and indirect permissions at a site/lib/folder/file level
ai_summary: SharePoint admin center now includes a permissions report that details user permissions at various levels.

title: Outlook: People Hub improvements in new Outlook for Windows
description: In new Outlook for Windows, the People Hub offers a streamlined contacts interface with a single view of each person, automatically linking duplicates and enriching them with organizational profiles. #newoutlookforwindows
ai_summary: The new Outlook for Windows features an improved People Hub for better contact management and duplicate linking.

title: Outlook: Updated Copilot Button for Android
description: We are updating the UI for Copilot Chat so that the button is separate from the mail and event compose buttons. This feature will be available for users with a Copilot license.
ai_summary: The Copilot Chat button in Outlook for Android will be updated to a separate UI element for users with a Copilot license.

title: Microsoft Purview: Data Lifecycle Management-Auto-Archive for Exchange Online
description: A new capability called Auto-Archiving for Exchange Online will enter public preview in November 2025 (currently under private preview for selected customers). When a user's mailbox utilization exceeds 95% of its quota and archive mailbox is present, this feature automatically moves the oldest items excluding those tagged with “Never Move to Archive” from the primary mailbox to the archive mailbox to prevent mail flow disruptions by keeping usage below the safe threshold of 95% of mailbox quota.
ai_summary: Exchange Online will introduce Auto-Archiving to manage mailbox utilization by moving older items to the archive automatically.

title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): In Copilot Pages, the Chat can now be used to modify the Page
description: When a Chat and a Page are open side by side, prompts within the Chat can now be used to modify or add to the contents of the Page.
ai_summary: In Microsoft Copilot Pages, users can now use Chat prompts to modify Page content when both are open side by side. This change affects users of Copilot Pages.

title: Microsoft Purview: Endpoint DLP - Enhanced content extraction and file type coverage for DLP on Mac devices
description: With this release, the file type coverage to scan, classify and protect sensitive content on Mac devices with Microsoft Purview Data Loss Prevention policies will increase from current ~40 file types to 100+ file types.This release will make the coverage of file types on endpoint consistent with other locations such as Exchange, SharePoint and OneDrive.
ai_summary: Microsoft Purview Data Loss Prevention on Mac devices will expand file type coverage from around 40 to over 100 types for sensitive content protection. This change affects DLP policies for Mac users.

title: Microsoft Teams: Emojis in Section Names
description: Choose an emoji to accompany section names in your chats and channels list.
ai_summary: Microsoft Teams now allows users to add emojis to section names in chats and channels. This change affects all Teams users.

title: Microsoft Teams: Teams client health dashboards in Teams Admin Center
description: IT Administrators can view and monitor the health of Teams desktop clients on both Windows and Mac platforms. This feature offers comprehensive admin actionable insights into client health metrics, including client crashes and launch failures. Administrators are equipped with detailed information on issues, insights, and mitigation tools to promptly and effectively address any potential client health problems.
ai_summary: IT Administrators can now monitor the health of Teams desktop clients on Windows and Mac through the Teams Admin Center. This feature provides insights into client health metrics.

title: PowerPoint: Designer is now part of Copilot, enhanced with new template and slide Suggestions.
description: Designer is now part of Copilot. Copilot Suggestions now brings you familiar Designer slide layout and presentation template suggestions in a vertical gallery, along with new capabilities.
ai_summary: PowerPoint's Designer feature is now integrated with Copilot, offering new template and slide suggestions in a vertical gallery. This change affects users creating presentations.

title: Microsoft Teams: Ability for IT admins to customize the user notification strings for recording and transcription
description: IT admins can customize the message and privacy link used to notify implicitly or gain explicit consent from meeting participants for the use of recording, transcription during the meeting.
ai_summary: IT admins can now customize notification messages for recording and transcription consent in Microsoft Teams meetings. This change affects meeting management and compliance.

title: Microsoft Teams: Front-of-room view control for Town Hall and Webinar in Teams Rooms on Windows
description: When a Teams Rooms on Windows is invited as a meeting presenter, the front-of-room display defaults to the attendee view. Presenters always have full control from the console, including green room and off-stage management, and can switch the front-of-room display to presenter view without impacting attendees. Available in Teams Rooms Pro.
ai_summary: Teams Rooms on Windows can now default to attendee view for front-of-room displays during meetings, while presenters maintain control from the console. This change affects Teams Rooms users.

title: Excel: Post-migration Excel remediation
description: Enable the remediation of incompatible formulas and file links in formulas in Excel files after migration from other cloud platforms to Microsoft 365.
ai_summary: Excel will now support remediation of incompatible formulas and file links after migration from other cloud platforms to Microsoft 365. This change affects users migrating Excel files.

title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft365): Graph API - Copilot for Microsoft 365 usage
description: Copilot for Microsoft 365 usage will be added to the Microsoft Graph API, allowing for the creation of customized reporting and analytics. Metrics included in the Graph API will match those available in the Copilot for Microsoft 365 usage report in the Microsoft 365 admin center, including tenant-level count of enabled users and active users, as well as last activity date per user (all up and per Microsoft 365 app). #copilotcontrolsystem
ai_summary: The Microsoft Graph API will include Copilot for Microsoft 365 usage metrics, enabling customized reporting and analytics for admins. This change affects administrators managing usage data.

title: Planner: Support for Microsoft Information Protection (MIP) content sensitivity labels
description: Microsoft Information Protection (MIP) content sensitivity label support in Planner will enable encryption, restrict unauthorised actions such as copying, printing, or exporting plan contents, and add visual markings like watermarks for clear sensitivity awareness. By enforcing content-level protections, Planner will help organisations prevent data leaks, maintain compliance, and enable secure collaboration without affecting productivity.
ai_summary: Planner will support Microsoft Information Protection content sensitivity labels, allowing for encryption and restrictions on unauthorized actions. This change affects users managing sensitive content in Planner.

title: Microsoft Purview: Data Security Investigations – Introducing new AI analysis capabilities
description: Data Security Investigations (DSI) now features advanced AI analysis tools, including options to add investigative context for higher-quality results, as well as improvements in vector search relevance and content categorization to better identify risky material. Additionally, we've launched a new AI-powered search function that lets investigators use natural language to locate specific files by searching through keywords, metadata, and embeddings.
ai_summary: Microsoft Purview's Data Security Investigations now includes AI analysis tools for better risk identification and a natural language search function for locating files. This change affects data security analysts.

title: Microsoft Purview: Data Security Investigations – Introduction of both in-product cost estimator and transparency report
description: Introducing a Data Security Investigations (DSI) lightweight cost estimator designed to help analysts model and forecast both storage and compute unit costs based on specific use cases, enabling more accurate budget planning. In addition to the estimator, a new report provides granular breakdowns of billed storage and compute unit usage, empowering DSI analysts to identify cost-saving opportunities and optimize resource allocation.
ai_summary: Data Security Investigations introduces a cost estimator and a transparency report to help analysts forecast costs and identify savings. This impacts analysts working with DSI.

title: Microsoft Teams: Apply partial settings for Android devices using configuration profiles in the Teams admin center
description: In the Teams admin center, admins can now modify, review, and apply configuration settings to Android devices without overriding other settings ensuring only the desired changes are made.
ai_summary: In the Teams admin center, admins can now apply partial configuration settings for Android devices without overriding existing settings. This change affects Teams administrators.

title: Microsoft 365: Microsoft 365 Backup capabilities available in GCC
description: We are bringing Microsoft 365 Backup Service capabilities to GCC. Microsoft 365 Backup is a product offering spanning across the OneDrive, SharePoint, and Exchange Online services that provides customers with a consistent, cross product solution, to recover their M365 data from cataclysmic events such as: at scale ransomware attacks, or malicious/accidental data deletion/corruption by end users.
ai_summary: Microsoft 365 Backup capabilities are now available in GCC, allowing recovery of data across OneDrive, SharePoint, and Exchange Online. This impacts organizations using GCC.

title: Microsoft Viva: Viva Learning - Ability to view inferred skills and course recommendations
description: Learners would be able to select skills for learning, view inferred skills and courses recommendations based on inferred skills. Inferred skills are generated by taking users activity in M365 ecosystem into account.
ai_summary: Viva Learning will allow learners to view inferred skills and receive course recommendations based on their activity in Microsoft 365. This change affects learners using Viva Learning.

title: Microsoft Viva: Viva Learning - Detailed error description for SuccessFactors sync failures
description: Sync failure details pop-up will now have detailed error description and next steps.
ai_summary: Viva Learning will now provide detailed error descriptions for sync failures with SuccessFactors, helping users troubleshoot issues. This affects administrators managing these integrations.

title: Microsoft Viva: Viva Learning - Ingestion logs in Viva Learning for SAP SuccessFactors
description: This creates LMS ingestion logs for sync summary, user sync, and LRS data. Logs will help admins debug any ingestion-related issues.
ai_summary: Viva Learning will create ingestion logs for SAP SuccessFactors, assisting admins in debugging sync issues. This change impacts administrators overseeing these systems.

title: Microsoft Teams: 1080P Resolution in Teams Town Halls
description: Teams town hall will soon bring 1080P resolution to Teams town hall. This enhancement brings a sharper appearance with more visual clarity to videos, images, and other visual assets within your online events. This feature is available for town halls created by organizers with a Teams Premium license.
ai_summary: Teams town halls will support 1080P resolution, enhancing video clarity for events. This feature is available to organizers with a Teams Premium license.

title: Microsoft Teams: Open channels in a new window
description: You can now open channels in a separate window to stay on top of multiple conversations at once.
ai_summary: Users can now open Teams channels in a new window, allowing for better management of multiple conversations. This change affects all Teams users.

title: Microsoft Teams: Facilitator can help manage tasks and create documents
description: Facilitator can help users manage tasks and create documents during meetings. In addition to the tasks that the agent is automatically capturing during the meeting, users can ask Facilitator directly through the meeting chat to create, edit, and assign tasks, which sync to Planner. For tasks related to document creation, users can assign to Facilitator and it will draft the document based on the meeting discussion. Users can also ask the agent to create a draft document on a topic discussed in the meeting.
ai_summary: The Facilitator in Teams can now help manage tasks and create documents during meetings, syncing tasks to Planner. This feature affects meeting participants and facilitators.

title: Microsoft Purview: Insider Risk Management - Risky AI usage
description:
With this update, Insider Risk Management will help admins identify risky AI usage. We are adding new detections of intentional and unintentional insider risk activity on generative AI apps that can pose a risk to an organization. Activities will include risky prompts containing sensitive info or risky intent and sensitive responses containing sensitive info or is generated from sensitive files or sites.  Coverage will span across Microsoft Copilots and 3P generative AI apps. These detections will also contribute to Adaptive Protection insider risk levels.

Microsoft Purview Insider Risk Management correlates various signals to identify potential malicious or inadvertent insider risks such as IP theft, data leakage, and security violations. Insider Risk Management enables customers to create policies based on their own internal policies, governance, and organizational requirements. Built with privacy by design, users are pseudonymized by default, and role-based access controls and audit logs are in place to help ensure user-level privacy. #copilotcontrolsystem
ai_summary: Microsoft Purview Insider Risk Management will now detect risky AI usage, helping admins identify potential insider risks from generative AI apps. This affects organizations using these AI tools.

title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): [Copilot Extensibility] Customers can connect M365 Copilot with Dropbox to access and manage cloud files with Copilot Connector
description: Customers can connect M365 Copilot with Dropbox to access and manage cloud files with Copilot Connector.
ai_summary: M365 Copilot can now connect with Dropbox, allowing users to access and manage cloud files directly through the Copilot Connector. This change affects users of both M365 Copilot and Dropbox.

title: Microsoft Teams: Open Teams' apps in new window
description: Organize your work environment to fit your needs. Users can open Teams' apps, like Chat, Calls, Activity and more in separate windows, allowing users to view and interact with these apps simultaneously.
ai_summary: Microsoft Teams will allow users to open apps like Chat and Calls in separate windows for better multitasking. This change affects all Teams users.

title: Microsoft Viva: Viva Learning - Sync provider data from a specific date range
description: We are introducing flexibility on provider setup form where admins can sync data from specific dates for a provider instead of full data sync.
ai_summary: Admins can now sync provider data from specific date ranges in Viva Learning, rather than performing a full data sync. This change impacts administrators managing learning data.

title: Microsoft Viva: Viva Learning - Customer Facing Reports via Insights Integration
description: Org level breakdown of Learning metrics in Viva Insights.
ai_summary: Viva Insights will provide organization-level reports on learning metrics, giving admins better visibility into learning activities. This affects administrators using Viva Insights.

title: OneDrive: Agents in OneDrive
description: Find yourself referencing the same files using Copilot in OneDrive? We are bringing the power of agents to OneDrive, allowing you to build, use, and share your own agents using files and content stored in your OneDrive. This feature requires a Microsoft Copilot for Microsoft 365 license and will be available to customers on OneDrive Web.
ai_summary: OneDrive will introduce agents that allow users to build and share agents using their stored files, requiring a Microsoft Copilot license. This affects OneDrive users with Copilot access.

title: Microsoft Purview compliance portal: Information Protection - Enhanced Classification Support for Thai language in Exchange Online, Microsoft Teams, SharePoint, and OneDrive
description: In our continued efforts to enhance classification capabilities, we have added a new feature, Word-Breaker, to our existing Thai Language support in Classification. Words in Thai language sentences do not have spaces between them. And for classification purpose, we relied on the right keywords to be added while creating Sensitive Information Type for ensuring accurate match. However, with this feature, spaces will be added automatically in keywords which will ensure higher match accuracy across all cloud locations (Exchange, Teams, One Drive, SharePoint).
ai_summary: The Microsoft Purview compliance portal will enhance Thai language classification support in Exchange, Teams, SharePoint, and OneDrive, improving accuracy for sensitive information types. This affects compliance admins working with Thai language content.

title: Microsoft Purview compliance portal: Information Protection - Enhanced Classification Support for Thai Language in Endpoint
description: Thai Language sentences do not have spaces in between them. And for classification purpose, we relied on right keywords to be added while creating Sensitive Information Type for ensuring accurate match. However, with this feature, spaces will be added automatically in keywords which will ensure higher match accuracy in EndPoint.
ai_summary: Enhanced classification support for Thai language will also be added for Endpoint, improving keyword matching accuracy. This change impacts compliance admins managing Endpoint data.

title: Outlook: Read-only access to contacts within a PST file in new Outlook for Windows

Future releases of new Outlook will expand the support for .pst file capabilities. #newoutlookforwindows #pstfilesupport.
ai_summary: The new Outlook for Windows will support read-only access to contacts within .pst files, enhancing user experience with Outlook Data Files. This affects users of the new Outlook.

If users wish to edit the document, they will transition to the standalone Word, Excel, or PowerPoint app. PDF scenarios are not affected. The feature will begin a phased rollout in December.

ai_summary: Microsoft Viva's Copilot Dashboard will now allow users to compare their Copilot usage against internal and external benchmarks. This change affects users utilizing the Copilot feature.

title: Microsoft Purview compliance center: Insider Risk Management - Policy scoping enhancements
description: After further review, we continue rolling this out. We apologize for any inconvenience. With this release, Insider Risk Management administrators can include or exclude specific users, groups, and adaptive scopes within policies. We are also adding support for non-mail enabled Security Groups within IRM policies. Microsoft Purview Insider Risk Management correlates various signals to identify potential malicious or inadvertent insider risks, such as IP theft, data leakage and security violations. Insider Risk Management enables customers to create policies based on their own internal policies, governance and organizational requirements. Built with privacy by design, users are pseudonymized by default, and role-based access controls and audit logs are in place to help ensure user-level privacy.
ai_summary: Insider Risk Management administrators can now include or exclude specific users and groups in their policies, including non-mail enabled Security Groups. This impacts administrators managing insider risk policies.

title: Microsoft Purview compliance portal: Insider Risk Management - User analytics
description:
With this feature, insights will be generated for potentially risky behaviors at a user level and will be surfaced across the following experiences:

1) Insider risk management context in DLP alert investigation
2) Insider risk management context in Communication compliance alert investigation
3) Insider risk management context in Microsoft Defender XDR user entity page
4) Advanced hunting in Microsoft Defender XDR  

User analytics will cover all eligible users in the tenant including users not in the scope of any Insider risk management policy. Customers can enable/disable user analytics in their tenant from Insider Risk Management settings.

Microsoft Purview Insider Risk Management correlates various signals to identify potential malicious or inadvertent insider risks, such as IP theft, data leakage, and security violations. Insider Risk Management enables customers to create policies to manage security and compliance. Built with privacy by design, users are pseudonymized by default, and role-based access controls and audit logs are in place to help ensure user-level privacy.
ai_summary: User analytics for Insider Risk Management will provide insights into potentially risky behaviors at the user level across various experiences. This feature affects all eligible users in the tenant.

title: Microsoft Purview compliance portal: Insider Risk Management - User exclusion
description: After further review, we continue rolling this out. We apologize for any inconvenience. This introduces the ability to exclude users and groups from IRM policies. Microsoft Purview Insider Risk Management correlates various signals to identify potential malicious or inadvertent insider risks such as IP theft, data leakage, and security violations. Insider Risk Management enables customers to create policies based on their own internal policies, governance, and organizational requirements. Built with privacy by design, users are pseudonymized by default, and role-based access controls and audit logs are in place to help ensure user-level privacy.
ai_summary: Administrators can now exclude specific users and groups from Insider Risk Management policies, enhancing policy customization. This change impacts administrators managing insider risk policies.

title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Ticket Status updates more frequently in ServiceNow Tickets Copilot Connector
description: ServiceNow Tickets Copilot connector did not use to correctly update the ticket status because of not ingesting inactive tickets. But now, the connector updates the change in ticket status more frequently. Additionally, users can now edit the data query filter to include inactive tickets even for existing connections. By default, copilot connectors now ingest both active & inactive tickets to ensure better quality responses in Copilot connectors.
ai_summary: The ServiceNow Tickets Copilot connector will now update ticket statuses more frequently and allows users to include inactive tickets in data queries. This affects users utilizing the ServiceNow integration.

title: Microsoft Purview: Endpoint Data Loss Prevention- Mac device and device group-based policy scoping support for Endpoint DLP
description: Currently you can create Purview Endpoint DLP policy and assign to specific users or user groups. This feature will allow you to create and assign policy based on both users and machines. You can use this feature to achieve different policies for same user on different Mac devices.
ai_summary: Endpoint Data Loss Prevention policies can now be assigned based on both users and Mac devices, allowing for tailored policies. This change affects administrators managing DLP policies.

title: Microsoft Purview compliance portal: Purview in Microsoft Admin Center
description: AI and IT admins in Microsoft Admin Center can 1) gain visibility around oversharing risks and drive remediations 2) Understand how much of sensitive copilot interactions are protected and turn on Purview DLP for M365 Copilot right from there. Enables secure adoption of Copilot.
ai_summary: AI and IT admins can now monitor oversharing risks and enable DLP for M365 Copilot directly in the Microsoft Admin Center. This impacts admins overseeing data protection measures.

title: Microsoft Edge: Cross-platform policies in the Edge management service
description: Admins can now configure policies for Edge for Business across macOS, iOS, and Android devices on top of their existing Windows configurations in the Edge management service.
ai_summary: Admins can configure Microsoft Edge policies across macOS, iOS, and Android devices in addition to Windows. This change affects administrators managing Edge settings.

title: Microsoft Purview: Inline data security controls (DLP) for more unmanaged GenAI apps in Edge for Business
description: Inline protections for text and file uploads, directly integrated into for Edge for Business, can be applied to more unmanaged consumer GenAI apps. Admins can now apply Purview collection policies and Purview DLP policies to detect and protect inline against sensitive data sharing in the Edge browser by users on Intune-managed Windows devices to a selection of new unmanaged app locations.
ai_summary: Inline data security controls for unmanaged GenAI apps in Edge for Business will now be available, allowing admins to apply DLP policies for sensitive data sharing. This affects administrators managing data security.

title: Microsoft Purview: Inline data security controls (DLP) for file uploads to unmanaged GenAI apps in Edge for Business
description: Inline protections for file upload protection are directly integrated into for Edge for Business to help prevent data leakage when users upload files to consumer GenAI apps in the browser. In addition to existing text upload controls in Purview collection and DLP policies, Admins can now detect and enforce inline protections on file uploads. Policies can target file-specific conditions such as file size, file type, and sensitive information types, enabling organizations to audit or block activities for users in Edge on Intune-managed Windows devices.
ai_summary: New inline protections for file uploads to unmanaged GenAI apps in Edge for Business will help prevent data leakage. This change impacts administrators managing data loss prevention policies.

description: We're adding support in Microsoft Graph to read and write users' Working Hours and Location #MicrosoftPlaces
ai_summary: Microsoft Graph will now support reading and writing users' Working Hours and Location. This change affects users utilizing these features in Microsoft 365 apps.

ai_summary: Access to Data Loss Prevention Diagnostics is being expanded to include Compliance Administrators, Security Administrators, and Organization Management. This change affects those roles in the Microsoft Purview compliance portal.

Navigation improvements will replace "Go Back" to Reporting home page with an alternative clickable UX to enable users to go back to the last page of reporting they were in. In other words, this feature will cater to Back navigation improvements in Reporting.
ai_summary: Viva Glint Reporting will have improved navigation for users, allowing managers and leaders to easily retrace their steps in reports. This change affects users of Viva Glint Reporting.

ai_summary: Microsoft 365 Copilot can now connect to Bitbucket to query knowledge base content and pull requests. This change affects users integrating Copilot with Bitbucket.

This brings the same functionality previously available in meetings to calls, enabling users to speak and listen in up to nine supported languages. Interpreter helps eliminate language barriers and fosters seamless collaboration across global teams. For a more inclusive experience, users can also opt to have Interpreter simulate their personal voice.
ai_summary: Microsoft Teams will include real-time speech-to-speech interpretation for calls, supporting up to nine languages. This change affects users making calls in Teams.

title: Microsoft Viva: Block posts with theme moderation
description:
Theme moderation in Engage will soon offer an option to block message creation if content aligns with a theme. This change expands on the previous release to monitor and mute content based on themes.

When a theme is blocked, users will see a message explaining why their message can't be published. Users can edit or discard the message. 

Admins and corporate communicators can control where blocks happen across storylines and communities. Leaders, corporate communicators, and network/verified/Engage admins cannot be blocked regardless of theme.
ai_summary: Viva Engage will allow admins to block message creation based on themes, with users receiving notifications if their messages are blocked. This impacts corporate communicators and admins.

title: Microsoft Teams: Search for images
description: Search for images by message content, people, or where they were shared. See results as you type, filter to show only images, or explore them in the dedicated Images tab — all from the search bar.
ai_summary: Teams will now allow users to search for images by message content, people, or sharing location, with results appearing as they type. This affects all Teams users.

ai_summary: Outlook users without a Copilot license can summarize emails with a single click using Copilot chat, provided they have access to it. This change impacts Outlook users.

ai_summary: Viva Engage authors can now add multiple translations to a single post, enhancing accessibility for multilingual audiences. This affects content creators in Viva Engage.

title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): People Skills - Expanded AI inferencing for E3/E5 users
description: People Skills is expanding AI powered skill inferencing to include Microsoft 365 E3 and E5 licensed users. Previously, AI powered skill inferencing was available only to Microsoft 365 Copilot and Microsoft Viva licensed users. With this update, admins will have the option to turn on AI powered skill inferencing for Microsoft 365 E3 / E5 licensed users directly in the Microsoft 365 admin center. AI powered skill inferencing uses AI to automatically identify and update skills on users’ Microsoft 365 profiles based on their work activity from the Microsoft Graph. This control will be available to tenants with Copilot licenses.
ai_summary: AI skill inferencing is being expanded to Microsoft 365 E3 and E5 users, allowing admins to enable this feature in the admin center. This change affects E3 and E5 licensed users.

title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): [Copilot Chat] Agent Mode in Excel
description: Available for Microsoft 365 subscribers without a Microsoft 365 Copilot license. Agent Mode is releasing to Copilot in Excel for the web, Windows and Mac, enabling users to build and edit workbooks with Copilot using multi-step workflows. When you're updating budgets, creating financial models, or analyzing data, Agent Mode uses Excel's most powerful tools like tables, charts, PivotTables, and formulas to help you get the job done.
ai_summary: Excel will introduce Agent Mode for Copilot, allowing users to build and edit workbooks using multi-step workflows without needing a Copilot license. This affects Excel users.

title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Edit capability for selecting permission reading option for existing ServiceNow Knowledge & Catalog Connections
description: Earlier admins had to create new connections to adopt to the hierarchical permissions for ServiceNow Knowledge & Catalog Copilot Connectors as the edit capability was missing. Now, admins can easily edit their existing connections to switch between the permission handling option i.e. Simple vs Advanced to quickly adopt to the hierarchical permission feature.
ai_summary: Admins can now edit existing ServiceNow Knowledge & Catalog connections to switch between permission handling options, simplifying management. This change impacts admins managing these connections.

ai_summary: A new Create module in M365 Copilot will provide access to templates for Word, Excel, and PowerPoint. This affects users utilizing Copilot for document creation.

ai_summary: Users will be able to search for and select Teams Channels in the Context IQ menu while using Copilot Chat, enhancing usability. This change affects Teams users.

ai_summary: Copilot Chat will now automatically create and open a Page when it detects relevant scenarios, allowing for instant editing and sharing. This affects users of Microsoft 365 with Copilot features.

ai_summary: The camera in Clipchamp will be updated to improve recording controls and command bar options. This change affects users of Microsoft Clipchamp.

ai_summary: Outlook will add options to sort emails by flag status, due date, and start date. This change affects all Outlook users.

ai_summary: Outlook will support Auto-Expanding Archives, allowing users to exceed the 100 GB mailbox archive limit. This affects users with large mailbox archives.

description: When creating an event, you can now book a workspace directly from the location field by searching or tapping Browse Workspaces. This feature is only available if you have workspace bookings enabled in settings and by your IT admin.
ai_summary: When creating an event in Outlook, users can now book a workspace directly from the location field if workspace bookings are enabled. This affects users who manage workspace bookings.

ai_summary: Outlook Mobile will update the multi-select actions toolbar, allowing users to customize the order and placement of actions. This affects Outlook Mobile users.
