ai_summary: The compose actions toolbar in Outlook Mobile will be updated for customization of action order and placement. This affects Outlook Mobile users.

title: Microsoft Clipchamp: Advanced editing from camera
description: This aligns the capture experience in camera and editor by enabling a seamless switch to the Clipchamp editor to make videos more appealing and impactful using advanced edit capabilities.
ai_summary: Clipchamp will enhance the camera capture experience by allowing seamless switching to the editor for advanced video editing. This affects users of Microsoft Clipchamp.

title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Agent Mode in Excel for desktop apps
description: Agent Mode is releasing to Copilot in Excel on Windows and Mac enabling users to build and edit workbooks with Copilot using multi-step workflows. Eligible licenses can now select which model to use, including both Open AI and Anthropic models.
ai_summary: Agent Mode in Excel will enable users to build and edit workbooks with Copilot using multi-step workflows on Windows and Mac. This affects eligible Excel users with Copilot.

title: Microsoft Purview: Data Lifecycle Management-New cmdlet to remove retention from inactive mailboxes
description: Today, there is not a way to remove retention policies or labels (called a hold in Exchange) from items in inactive mailboxes in bulk. Now we are introducing a PowerShell cmdlet that enables retention policies or labels to be removed in bulk from these items. This removal will not affect legal holds.
ai_summary: Microsoft Purview introduces a new PowerShell cmdlet to remove retention policies from inactive mailboxes in bulk, without affecting legal holds. This change affects IT admins managing retention policies.

title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Scheduling with Copilot
description: Scheduling with Copilot: Users can now schedule meetings directly from chat. Simply ask Copilot to schedule a meeting with colleagues, and it will find available times, book rooms, draft agendas, and send invites—all within the chat experience. This feature will roll out in phases and is expected to be generally available in Copilot chat across all endpoints for users with a Microsoft 365 Copilot license in the coming months.
ai_summary: Microsoft Copilot allows users to schedule meetings directly from chat, finding available times and sending invites. This feature is for users with a Microsoft 365 Copilot license.

title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Agent Mode in Excel
description: Agent Mode lets you build and edit workbooks side by side with Copilot. When you're updating budgets, creating financial models, or analyzing data, Agent Mode uses Excel's most powerful tools like tables, charts, PivotTables, and formulas to help you get the job done.
ai_summary: Microsoft Copilot's Agent Mode in Excel enables users to build and edit workbooks alongside Copilot, utilizing Excel's tools for data tasks. This feature is aimed at Excel users.

title: Microsoft Edge: Ask Copilot from the address bar
description: When users type a search query in the Edge address bar, they will have the option to send their search query directly to Copilot for a synthesized, more targeted answer pulling from across the web (and their work content, for premium users).
ai_summary: Microsoft Edge users can now send search queries from the address bar directly to Copilot for targeted answers. This feature benefits users looking for quick information.

title: Microsoft Purview: Data Loss Prevention-UX improvements to the DLP Alerts in Purview Portal
description: We’re excited to announce UX improvements to the DLP Alerts Portal in Purview to help you triage incidents faster and more efficiently. What’s New: 1. Unified View: Events related to each alert are now available directly on the alerts page — no need to switch to new tab or drill down. 2. Faster Access: Access event details (e.g. Impacted assets) with just 1 click on the main alerts page itself, compared to 4 clicks earlier, reducing triage time significantly. 3. Enhanced Context: We've added 4 new columns - Location, DLP Rule name, DLP Policy name, Rule Action to display key alert and event attributes upfront — giving you more visibility at a glance. 4. Performance Boost: Cache improvements to ensure faster load times and a smoother experience. These updates are designed to streamline your workflow, reduce response times, and give you the context you need — all in a single, efficient view.
ai_summary: Microsoft Purview enhances the DLP Alerts Portal with a unified view and faster access to event details, improving incident triage for admins. This change affects DLP management.

title: Microsoft Teams: Shared call history in Queues app
description: Queues app now supports shared history for all missed, incoming, and outgoing calls in a queue. This new feature provides greater visibility and collaboration by allowing users to view a complete call history across the team. Shared history can be enabled by your Teams admin, who can choose to grant access to either: All members of the queue, or  Only authorized users
ai_summary: Microsoft Teams' Queues app now includes shared call history for all calls, enhancing visibility for team members. Teams admins can control access to this feature.

title: Excel: Python in Excel
description: Python in Excel allows you to bring the capabilities of Python directly into the Excel grid. As a part of this feature, users will be able to add Python formulas directly into their workbooks without any installation required. These Python formulas will be run by Excel in a secure container on the Microsoft Cloud with enterprise-level security as a compliant Microsoft 365 connected experience.
ai_summary: Excel now supports Python, allowing users to add Python formulas directly into workbooks without installation. This feature is for Excel users needing advanced data analysis.

title: Outlook: New third-party enriched properties available for customizing profile cards
description: Customers can now customize their M365 profile cards by adding new properties such as Cost Center, Role, Employee Type, Employee ID and Division. These properties will show in the Contact Information section and can be ingested from external sources like HR systems, so that users' profiles are enriched with relevant information.
ai_summary: Outlook allows customization of M365 profile cards with new properties like Cost Center and Employee ID, pulling data from external sources. This affects user profile management.

title: Outlook: Offline Support for Calendar - Create, Edit and Delete Event support
description: We are adding more offline functionality in the new Outlook for Windows. You will now be able to create, edit, and delete events in your calendar when not connected to the internet. #newoutlookforwindows
ai_summary: The new Outlook for Windows adds offline support for creating, editing, and deleting calendar events. This feature is for Outlook users who need offline access.

title: Microsoft Edge: A Refreshed Profile Flyout Experience for Better Clarity and Actionability
description: We’re updating the Microsoft Edge profile flyout to deliver a cleaner, more intuitive experience. The refreshed design makes it easier to distinguish between work and personal profiles, manage credentials, and quickly access key settings—all within a polished interface that supports modern browsing needs. With streamlined sign-in, clearer profile types, and organization branding preserved, this update enables a more efficient and trustworthy experience for customers.
ai_summary: Microsoft Edge updates the profile flyout for clearer distinction between work and personal profiles, improving user experience. This change affects all Edge users.

title: Microsoft Edge: v.145 - Navigation management for Progress Web Apps
description: Microsoft Edge has improved how a Progressive Web App (PWA) handles user navigation. When a user clicks a link, the browser will determine whether it should launch the installed PWA or open a new browser tab to give users a more seamless experience.
ai_summary: Microsoft Edge will improve navigation for Progressive Web Apps by determining whether to launch the app or open a new tab. This change affects all Edge users using PWAs.

title: Microsoft Teams: Queues app historical reporting supports 45 days of data

ai_summary: The Microsoft Teams Queues app will now support historical reporting for up to 45 days, with a default view of 7 days. This change affects Teams users utilizing the Queues app.

title: Microsoft Edge: v.145 - Adding protection against malicious sideloaded extensions

ai_summary: Microsoft Edge will now detect and revoke malicious sideloaded extensions to enhance security. This change impacts all Edge users.

New VDI solution for Teams introduces multimedia offloading and optimization solution for Microsoft Teams when running in Amazon WorkSpaces (Personal and Pools).

title: Microsoft Teams: Apps in Shared Channels for Microsoft Teams
description: Bring the apps your team relies on—tabs, bots, and message extensions—directly into Shared Channels in Microsoft Teams. ai_summary: Apps can now be added directly to Shared Channels in Teams, allowing for better collaboration without switching contexts. This affects channel owners and users.

title: Microsoft Defender for Office 365: Agentic AI Phish Submission Analysis & Response

ai_summary: Microsoft Defender for Office 365 is introducing an AI grading system for phishing submissions, providing quick and detailed verdicts with natural language explanations. This impacts users reporting phishing messages.

title: Microsoft Defender for Office 365: Auto-Remediation of Malicious Similarity Clusters in AIR

Building on that foundation, this enhancement enables AIR to automatically approve all pending remediation actions it generates—eliminating the need for manual intervention and streamlining the response process for SOC teams. This advancement significantly reduces response time and operational overhead, allowing security teams to focus on higher-priority threats.
ai_summary: Microsoft Defender for Office 365 is enhancing auto-remediation in the AIR platform to fully automate the handling of malicious similarity clusters. This change streamlines operations for security teams.

title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft M365): Review PDFs using Copilot context menu and AI actions

ai_summary: Microsoft Copilot will allow users to review PDFs more efficiently by providing explanations of selected text and customizable prompts. This feature benefits users working with PDF documents.

ai_summary: Microsoft Purview is enhancing Activity Explorer to allow admins to preview email attachments flagged for sensitive data in Exchange Online. This improves visibility for administrators.

title: Microsoft Purview compliance portal: Insider Risk Management - Administrative units support
description:
Administrative units allow admins with appropriate permissions to subdivide the organization into smaller units, and then assign specific admins or role groups that can manage only the members of those units. For example, German administrators can only create/manage policies for only German users, and German investigators can only investigate alerts and activities from only German users.

Microsoft Purview Insider Risk Management correlates various signals to identify potential malicious or inadvertent insider risks, such as IP theft, data leakage, and security violations. Insider Risk Management enables customers to create policies based on their own internal policies, governance, and organizational requirements. Built with privacy by design, users are pseudonymized by default, and role-based access controls and audit logs are in place to help ensure user-level privacy.
ai_summary: Microsoft Purview compliance portal will support administrative units, enabling specific admins to manage policies for designated user groups. This affects compliance administrators.

Administrators who have already restricted personal accounts on corporate devices can continue to manage this as before. ai_summary: OneDrive will prompt users to sign in with their personal Microsoft accounts if already signed in on corporate devices, while admins can still manage restrictions. This affects users of OneDrive on corporate devices.

ai_summary: Teams admins can control whether calls and meetings appear in users’ iPhone call logs, providing more privacy options.

title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Copilot Chat Tools Control
description: Tools acts as a lightweight entry point into high-value, task-specific Copilot features and capabilities directly from the prompt box. By selecting Tools, users get a menu where they can easily discover and trigger the right Copilot feature or capability for their current task, while also providing consistent interactions across tools.
ai_summary: Users can access task-specific Copilot features directly from the prompt box in Microsoft 365, improving task management.

title: Microsoft Purview: eDiscovery-Tenant level process report
description: The tenant‑level process report provides eDiscovery administrators and managers with a centralized view of eDiscovery processes running across cases in the tenant—or across the cases they have access to. It surfaces key details such as process type, status, duration, timestamps, and who initiated each process, enabling better operational oversight, faster issue triage, and clearer end‑to‑end visibility into eDiscovery activity.
ai_summary: eDiscovery admins can view a centralized report of eDiscovery processes across cases, improving oversight and issue resolution.

title: Outlook: Save an Event as a Draft on iOS
description: We're introducing the ability to save meeting invites as drafts on mobile. This feature allows users to begin composing a meeting and return to it later without sending the invite immediately—helping them stay organized and flexible when scheduling. Updated February 13, 2026: This item is still rolling and has not completed yet. We apologize for any inconvenience.
ai_summary: Outlook on iOS will allow users to save meeting invites as drafts, enabling better organization when scheduling.

title: Microsoft Purview: Insider Risk Management-New Microsoft Fabric lakehouse risk indicators
description: With this update, Insider Risk Management extends its risk-detection capabilities to Microsoft Fabric lakehouses (in addition to Power BI which is supported today) by offering ready-to-use risk indicators based on user activities in Fabric lakehouses. Organizations can use these new indicators in data theft and data leaks policies. Microsoft Purview Insider Risk Management correlates various signals to identify potential malicious or inadvertent insider risks, such as IP theft, data leakage, and security violations. Insider Risk Management enables customers to create policies based on their own internal policies, governance, and organizational requirements. Built with privacy by design, users are pseudonymized by default, and role-based access controls and audit logs are in place to help ensure user-level privacy.
ai_summary: Insider Risk Management now includes risk indicators for Microsoft Fabric lakehouses, enhancing data security monitoring.

title: Microsoft Purview: Data Loss Prevention-Alert Classification Property for DLP Alerts on Purview Portal
description: This feature introduces the ability to classify DLP alerts directly in the Purview portal. In addition to assigning a status, customers can now categorize alerts as True Positive, False Positive, or Benign Positive. This capability helps security teams better organize, track, and manage alerts, enabling more accurate reporting and efficient incident handling.
ai_summary: DLP alerts can now be classified in the Purview portal, helping security teams manage and report alerts more effectively.

title: Microsoft Purview: Data Loss Prevention-User based alert aggregation
description: User-Based Aggregation consolidates DLP alerts by user identity i.e. a DLP rule violations, in a specified aggregation time window, of the same rule and single user will be aggregated into a single alert enabling quicker triage and remediation. Instead of reviewing alerts containing rule match events of multiple users, DLP admin can now analyze grouped DLP rule match events per user, gaining insights into repeated policy violations and anomalous behavior.
ai_summary: DLP alerts will be aggregated by user identity, allowing admins to analyze policy violations more efficiently.

title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): SharePoint list agent
description: Enables effortless list creation for Copilot users through prompts, with intelligent schema generation and setup. This agent helps teams to quickly transform structured information and Copilot responses to Microsoft Lists.
ai_summary: Copilot users can create SharePoint lists easily through prompts, streamlining the process of managing structured information.

title: Microsoft Purview compliance portal: Insider Risk Management – Introduction of pay-as-you-go feature usage report
description: Introducing a Microsoft Purview Insider Risk Management pay-as-you-go feature usage report designed to provide transparency to the customers, enabling more accurate budget planning and policy tuning. This report provides granular breakdowns of billed processing unit usage across different data source categories and activity indicators over time, empowering IRM admins to identify cost-saving opportunities and tune their policies.
ai_summary: A new usage report for Insider Risk Management will help admins track costs and optimize policies based on usage data.

title: Microsoft Edge: v.146 - Desktop Visual Search
description: Quickly send images to Bing Visual Search from the Edge Desktop Search Bar to identify images, people, animals, and shows; extract, copy, and translate text while keeping its format. Solve questions quickly in various subjects and get trusted information to boost your knowledge. Discover products, fashion, recipes, identify a location and more. Available on Windows devices.  Admins can control availability to this feature using the VisualSearchEnabled policy.
ai_summary: Microsoft Edge will allow users to send images to Bing Visual Search for identification and text extraction. Admins can control this feature's availability using the VisualSearchEnabled policy.

title: Microsoft Purview compliance portal: Endpoint Data Loss Prevention -- Always-on diagnostics for Windows Endpoints (Phase 2)
description: Admins can retrieve diagnostic 'Always-on diagnostic' traces directly from Windows endpoints and selectively upload them to Microsoft through the Purview Portal at the time of an investigation request such as submitting a support ticket, without disrupting end users or impacting their productivity. This eliminates the need for user coordination while maintaining seamless troubleshooting capabilities
ai_summary: Admins can retrieve diagnostic traces from Windows endpoints for data loss prevention investigations through the Purview Portal, improving troubleshooting without user disruption.

title: Outlook: Customizable Oversharing dialog for DLP in New Outlook

The support will be to configure custom title, body, business justifications, and dynamic variables/tokens for matched recipients, attachment names, and labels. #newoutlookforwindows
ai_summary: New Outlook for Windows will allow customizable oversharing dialogs for Data Loss Prevention, enabling admins to configure titles, body text, and dynamic variables.

ai_summary: Admins can deploy a frontline worker pilot directly from the Teams Admin Center, facilitating the management of frontline worker capabilities.

ai_summary: SharePoint will introduce two new dark themes designed by Microsoft, enhancing visual comfort and accessibility for users in low-light environments.

It's now available in Teams Rooms on Windows licensed for Teams Rooms Pro.
ai_summary: Teams Rooms on Windows will now support an Interpreter agent for real-time translation during meetings, aiding multilingual collaboration.

By default, the folder is named "OneDrive - {organization name}," which can consume valuable path length for deeply nested files and folders. With this new policy, admins can set a shorter, organization-specific folder name — reducing path length issues and giving users a cleaner file system experience.
ai_summary: IT admins can now set a custom name for the OneDrive sync folder on users' Windows devices to reduce path length issues.

title: SharePoint: Content Security Policy Control in Tenant Administration

SharePoint will now report to administrators where are loaded from sources that have not been allowed giving administrators a way to identify those sources and take actions. Tenant Administrators can also enforce browsers to only load scripts from allowed sources. This behavior can be enabled using SharePoint Online Management Shell.
ai_summary: SharePoint Online Tenant Administrators can control script sources for modern pages and enforce security measures for loading scripts.

title: Microsoft Purview compliance portal: Communication Compliance - Advanced trainable classifiers to detect workplace safety scenarios
description: New detections are being added to Communication Compliance that enables you to build safer online environments by detecting potential hate and violence then assigning severity scores to unsafe text across languages. These classifiers are built using large language models. Microsoft Purview Communication Compliance provides the tools to help organizations detect business conduct and regulatory compliance violations (e.g. SEC or FINRA), such as sensitive or confidential information, harassing or threatening language, and sharing of adult content. Built with privacy by design, usernames are pseudonymized by default, role-based access controls are built in, investigators are opted in by an admin, and audit logs are in place to help ensure user-level privacy.

title: Microsoft 365 app: Catch Up Improvements on Web
description: Catch Up allows you to stay in sync with your collaborators in Word, Excel, and PowerPoint by showing you the latest comment activity that is directed at you and a summary of recent changes. Based on your feedback, we made improvements to the Catch Up feature. The comment activity directed at you will now persist in Catch Up between sessions for up to 28 days. New items will be indicated with a blue dot for clarity. You can also dismiss items individually if you do not wish to keep them in Catch Up.
ai_summary: The Catch Up feature in the Microsoft 365 app will improve by retaining comment activity for up to 28 days and indicating new items. This affects users of Word, Excel, and PowerPoint.

title: Microsoft Purview: DSPM data risk assessments: item-level investigation & remediation
description: Microsoft Purview Data risk assessments now support item-level investigation and remediation of SharePoint data. Item-level insights like sensitivity label and sharing links created help users identify potentially overshared items. Users are empowered to remediate overshared items by resolving, notifying, applying a sensitivity label, or removing sharing links for selected item(s). This helps organizations proactively reduce data exposure, strengthen compliance posture, and ensure sensitive data are only accessible to the right people.
ai_summary: Microsoft Purview will support item-level investigation and remediation for SharePoint data, helping users manage data exposure. This affects data compliance teams.

title: Microsoft 365: Perform granular file-level restore using Microsoft 365 Backup
description: Perform file-level browse/search and then restore using Microsoft 365 Backup. With this enhancement you will be able to browse for files across in a site from available daily restore points and apply filters to narrow results, restore at the original location by overwriting existing content or to a new place by creating a copy of the content.
ai_summary: Microsoft 365 Backup will allow file-level browsing and restoration, enabling users to restore files from daily restore points. This impacts users managing data recovery.

title: Microsoft Viva: Satisfaction Rate Metric for Microsoft 365 Copilot in Copilot Dashboard
description: Track user sentiment of Microsoft 365 Copilot. Understand how users perceive Copilot value by analyzing the breakdown of thumbs up and thumbs down ratings after Copilot interactions.  See trends over time and breakdowns by group.
ai_summary: The Copilot Dashboard in Microsoft Viva will track user satisfaction rates for Microsoft 365 Copilot, providing insights into user sentiment. This affects managers and team leads.

When sending a file or Loop component, it will be automatically provisioned to users in the chat, or you can change its permissions.
ai_summary: Microsoft Teams now allows users to share files and Loop components with external users in chats, streamlining collaboration. This change affects all Teams users engaging with external contacts.

ai_summary: Microsoft Edge will introduce a feature that provides webpage summaries from the address bar using Microsoft 365 Copilot Chat. This impacts users of Microsoft Edge for Business.

ai_summary: Microsoft 365 Copilot will allow users to generate audio overviews of Word documents from the Summary tab. This feature affects Word users utilizing Copilot.

title: Outlook: Import emails from PST file to mailbox in new Outlook for Windows
description: With this update of support for .pst files (a.k.a. Outlook Data File) in the new Outlook for Windows, users will be able to import emails from .pst file to mailbox. Future releases of new Outlook will expand the support for .pst file capabilities. #newoutlookforwindows #pstfilesupport.
ai_summary: The new Outlook for Windows will support importing emails from PST files into mailboxes. This change affects users transitioning to the new Outlook.

title: Microsoft Purview: Data Loss Prevention– Enhanced content extraction and file type coverage for DLP on Mac devices
description: With this release, the file type coverage to scan, classify and protect sensitive content on Mac devices with Microsoft Purview Data Loss Prevention policies will increase from current ~40 file types to 100+ file types. This release will make the coverage of file types on endpoint consistent with other locations such as Exchange, SharePoint and OneDrive. This will also include other enhancements like detecting label from pfile, detecting sensitive content in metadata, and detecting sensitive content in PDF forms.
ai_summary: Microsoft Purview Data Loss Prevention will enhance file type coverage on Mac devices, increasing from ~40 to over 100 file types. This update impacts users managing sensitive content on Macs.

title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Copilot can edit your document in PowerPoint
description: Copilot in PowerPoint lets you create, edit, and refine presentations through natural conversation, directly in your presentation. You can start a new presentation or build on an existing one, asking Copilot to generate slides, update content, improve layouts, and polish design—while preserving formatting, structure, and branding. Copilot connects to your brand kit so you can apply branded templates, insert brand‑approved images, and check for brand compliance. Available to Microsoft 365 Copilot–licensed users.
ai_summary: Copilot in PowerPoint will enable users to create and edit presentations through natural conversation. This feature is available to Microsoft 365 Copilot-licensed users.

title: SharePoint: Updates to News page in SharePoint sites
description: The News page renders news items in a given site. It is typically accessed via the "see all" experience of a news web part.  We are updating the user experience of this page and bringing in Copilot capabilities to licensed users. Updated February 9, 2026: GA rollout for this item is starting in late February. We apologize for any inconvenience.
ai_summary: SharePoint will update the News page user experience and integrate Copilot capabilities for licensed users. This affects users managing news content in SharePoint.

title: Microsoft Teams: App centric management for app deployment in Teams Admin Center
description: App centric management for app deployment will introduce a new admin setting to control who in the tenant has specific Teams apps preinstalled. Similar to app assignments, admins will be able to select from three options: 'Deployed to all users', 'Deployed to specific users and groups', or 'Deployed to no users'. This feature replaces the existing Installed apps section of app setup policies and provides admins with the ability to manage app deployment individually. The Installed apps section of app setup policies for existing customers will be migrated to maintain existing admin settings in the tenant.
ai_summary: Teams Admin Center will introduce app-centric management for app deployment, allowing admins to control app installations for users. This change affects Teams administrators.

title: SharePoint: OneNote usage inclusion in SharePoint site analytics
description: With this release, usage from OneNote files (.one) in SharePoint will be included in SharePoint site analytics metrices "Unique viewers" and "Site visits". You will also see OneNote files appear in the popular content section if a OneNote file is heavily used in the last 7 days. Refer to the more information link to learn more about the list of excluded file types.
ai_summary: SharePoint site analytics will now include usage metrics for OneNote files, showing their impact on site visits and unique viewers. This affects users analyzing SharePoint site performance.

title: Microsoft Purview: Role Group changes in Purview
description: We are introducing a new Microsoft Purview RBAC role—Purview Agent Deployment—and adding it to various existing built in role groups used by analysts and admins across Purview. This change enables users who use built-in role analyst groups to deploy Security Copilot Agents in Purview without needing any additional roles. If your organization prefers to limit agent deployment permissions, you can create a custom role group that does not include the Purview Agent Deployment role and assign that custom role group to analysts who should not be able to deploy agents. This update does not change default data access or expand visibility into customer content. All other permissions within each role group remain unchanged. Analysts who are assigned to custom role groups will not be able to deploy agents unless the Purview Agent Deployment role is explicitly added to those custom groups. We recommend reviewing and updating your organization’s RBAC documentation, internal processes, or onboarding guides to reflect these change We recommend reviewing and updating your organization’s RBAC documentation, internal processes, or onboarding guides to reflect these changes.
ai_summary: Microsoft Purview introduces a new role, Purview Agent Deployment, allowing analysts to deploy Security Copilot Agents without extra roles. This affects users in built-in role analyst groups.

title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Admins can create and deploy custom Model Context Protocol (MCP) connectors across Microsoft 365.

ai_summary: Admins can now create and deploy custom Model Context Protocol (MCP) connectors in the Microsoft 365 Admin Centre, enabling custom data integration in Microsoft 365 Copilot. This change affects Microsoft 365 administrators.

ai_summary: A new soft purge action is available in Data Security Investigations, allowing admins to soft-delete sensitive content during investigations while retaining it for a period. This impacts admins managing data security.

description: The Copilot Dashboard’s updated Readiness page provides IT leaders with tailored Copilot configuration recommendations. Th suggested settings are meant to streamline deployment, enhance user experience, and help users get most out of Microsoft 365 Copilot, Copilot Chat and agents. #copilotcontrolsystem
ai_summary: The Microsoft Viva Copilot Dashboard will now provide IT leaders with configuration insights to enhance the deployment of Microsoft 365 Copilot. This update is aimed at IT administrators managing Copilot settings.

title: Microsoft Purview: eDiscovery - review set limit increase
description: Review set limit per case is increased from 20 per case to 100 per case.
ai_summary: Microsoft Purview increases the review set limit from 20 to 100 per case for eDiscovery. This change affects legal and compliance teams managing eDiscovery cases.

description: Review set limit per case is increased from 20 per case to 100 per case.
ai_summary: Microsoft Purview's eDiscovery review set limit will increase from 20 to 100 per case, allowing for more extensive case management.

title: Microsoft Purview: Data Loss Prevention- Security Store now available within Purview DLP to browse, purchase, and enable partner integrations
description: Microsoft Security Store is now integrated into the Microsoft Purview DLP experience, giving admins an in‑product way to discover a curated set of integrations that extend Purview capabilities, including data security capabilities for the network. Purchasing and management are completed through Security Store, simplifying how organizations procure partner integrations.
ai_summary: Microsoft Purview DLP integrates the Microsoft Security Store, allowing admins to discover and manage partner integrations directly within the DLP experience. This simplifies procurement for enhanced data security.

title: Microsoft Purview compliance portal: Insider Risk Management- Multi selectable DLP policies as an IRM triggering event
description: Insider Risk Management is releasing the ability to select multiple Data Loss Prevention (DLP) policies as triggering events in a policy. Previously, admins could only select one DLP policy as a triggering event within Insider Risk Management policies. Microsoft Purview Insider Risk Management correlates various signals to identify potential malicious or inadvertent insider risks, such as IP theft, data leakage, and security violations. Insider Risk Management enables customers to create policies based on their own internal policies, governance, and organizational requirements. Built with privacy by design, users are pseudonymized by default, and role-based access controls and audit logs are in place to help ensure user-level privacy.
ai_summary: Insider Risk Management will allow multiple DLP policies to be selected as triggering events, enhancing risk detection capabilities.

title: OneDrive: Discover Copilot actions in File Preview
description: See what Copilot can do the moment you preview a file in OneDrive or SharePoint. Ready-to-use prompts appear alongside the Copilot button, helping you summarize documents, generate FAQs, and more — all without writing a single prompt.
ai_summary: OneDrive will show Copilot actions when previewing files, offering prompts for document summarization and FAQs. This change affects users working with files in OneDrive and SharePoint.

title: Microsoft Purview: File Creation/Modification conditions in DLP for Sharepoint/OneDrive and AutoLabelling
description: File Creation and File Modification conditions in Microsoft Purview DLP for SharePoint and OneDrive and AutoLabelling will give organizations more precise control over DLP policy definition. These conditions allow admins to configure policies based on when the files were created or last modified, enabling policies that target newly created documents, recently edited files, or older content that may require stricter governance. With these new date-based predicates, Purview DLP delivers stronger lifecycle-aware protection, improved policy accuracy, and greater flexibility in securing data across SPOD.
ai_summary: Microsoft Purview DLP now allows admins to set policies based on file creation and modification dates in SharePoint and OneDrive. This change enhances data protection for organizations.

title: Microsoft Purview: Data Security Investigations – analyze files tied to audit log activities
description: Speed up analysis of exfiltrated content by launching Data Security Investigations (DSI) from Unified Audit Log activity. In DSI, build your audit log query by specifying criteria such as time range, activities, users, and keywords. DSI then automatically pulls the associated files into the investigation (for example, UserA downloaded a file on 3/1/2026).
ai_summary: Data Security Investigations can now analyze files linked to audit log activities, allowing for quicker investigations. This affects compliance and security teams.

title: Microsoft Purview: Data Security Investigations – role-based access simplification
description: We are simplifying Data Security Investigations (DSI) roles following customer feedback and the continued integration with Data Security Posture Management (DSPM), Insider Risk Management (IRM), and Defender XDR. We added the Data Security Investigation Admin role to the Compliance Administrator role group. We added the Data Security Investigation Contributor role to the: Organization Management role group; Data Security Management role group; Insider Risk management role group.
ai_summary: Roles for Data Security Investigations are being simplified, adding new roles to existing groups for better management. This affects compliance and security administrators.

title: Microsoft Purview: Data Loss Prevention – Enable DLP Diagnostics for All Roles with Purview DLP Policy Access
description:
We’re updating permissions to ensure that all roles with access to view DLP policies in Microsoft Purview can also run diagnostics on those policies. This change enhances visibility and empowers authorized users to troubleshoot and validate policy behavior more effectively.
The following roles will now have diagnostic access:
Organization Configuration
View-Only Configuration
Compliance Admin
Security Admin
Security Reader
DLP Compliance Management
View-Only DLP Compliance Management
Insider Risk Management Admin
Information Protection Admin
Information Protection Analyst
Information Protection Investigator
Data Security AI Admin
ai_summary: Microsoft Purview is updating permissions so all roles that can view DLP policies can also run diagnostics on them. This affects various compliance and security roles.

title: Microsoft Viva: Enhanced AI governance for Glint Copilot
description: Copilot in Viva Glint will align with Microsoft's enterprise AI governance platform: enabling your IT and compliance teams to use centralized governance tools for access management and unified monitoring and reporting across all AI deployments in your tenant. This reduces governance complexity and audit burden by providing a single control plane for managing AI features across Microsoft 365. This change removes the existing Copilot toggles in the Viva Glint admin UI, making Viva Feature Access Management (VFAM) the single control plane for Copilot enablement.
ai_summary: Viva Glint's Copilot will align with Microsoft's AI governance platform, centralizing access management and monitoring for AI features across Microsoft 365.

title: Microsoft Purview Compliance Portal: Data Loss Prevention-Enforce DLP protection upon new content before its saved
description: Monitor or protect file with unsaved sensitive content from being printed or being moved to USB or network share.
ai_summary: Microsoft Purview Compliance Portal will enforce Data Loss Prevention (DLP) protections on unsaved sensitive content, preventing it from being printed or moved. This affects users handling sensitive data.

title: Microsoft Teams: Noise Suppression for Dial-In Participants in Teams Audio Conferences
description:
Microsoft Teams will soon support noise suppression for dial-in participants. This feature automatically filters out background noise (e.g., traffic, typing) for users who join meetings via phone (PSTN). It enhances clarity and reduces distractions for all meeting participants. The feature will be rolled out gradually. However, if you'd like to enable it yourself, you will be able to do so via the Teams Admin Center:
1. Go to Meeting policy 2. Navigate to the Audio & video section 3. Set Noise suppression for dial-in participants to Enabled or programmatically with MicrosoftTeamsPowerShell by setting NoiseSuppressionForDialInParticipants setting inside of CsTeamsMeetingPolicy to "Enabled".
ai_summary: Microsoft Teams will introduce noise suppression for dial-in participants, filtering background noise during audio conferences. This change affects all users joining meetings via phone.

title: Outlook: Data Loss Prevention (DLP) Policy Tips & Override for Outlook Mobile
description: Outlook Mobile now supports Data Loss Prevention (DLP) policy tips, helping users avoid accidental data leaks. When sensitive content is detected, users are alerted with inline tips or pop-ups, based on admin-configured rules. This update aligns DLP behavior across all Outlook clients for consistent compliance enforcement.
ai_summary: Outlook Mobile now includes Data Loss Prevention (DLP) policy tips to alert users about sensitive content, ensuring consistent compliance across Outlook clients. This affects all mobile Outlook users.

title: Microsoft Teams: Report a Suspicious Call in Microsoft Teams
description: Microsoft Teams now includes a capability that lets users flag calls they believe are unusual or suspicious. When a call is reported, the signal helps Microsoft strengthen security measures and reduce future unwanted or malicious call activity. This feature empowers users to actively contribute to real-time threat detection, enhancing organizational safety.
ai_summary: Microsoft Teams now allows users to report suspicious calls, contributing to security measures against unwanted call activity. This feature empowers all Teams users.

title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Access Copilot Chat in your Microsoft 365 apps
description: Easily access Copilot Chat from the side pane in your Microsoft 365 apps with a commercial Microsoft 365 license or a Microsoft 365 Copilot license.
ai_summary: Microsoft 365 apps will now include a side pane for accessing Copilot Chat for users with a commercial or Copilot license.

title: PowerPoint: Create and Edit images with the model of your choice
description: You can now choose your preferred image model including OpenAI’s GPT Image, Black Forest Lab’s Flux and Microsoft’s MAI-Image and more, for smart, dynamic selection when creating or editing images with Copilot in PowerPoint, or when generating a new presentation or page.

title: Microsoft Purview: Endpoint Data Loss Prevention - Endpoint DLP Device Status API
description: Provides access to the same device health details currently available through the export function on the device onboarding page. ​With the new device status API, customers can pull device-level information directly into their own BI tools, dashboards, and workflows, eliminating manual exports and making it easier to automate reporting at scale.
ai_summary: Microsoft Purview will provide a Device Status API for accessing device health details, allowing integration with BI tools and automating reporting. This affects admins managing device data.

title: Microsoft SharePoint: New web part for FAQs
description: After further review, we mistakenly marked the roadmap as "launched." The correct status is In Development. We apologize the inconvenience. SharePoint FAQ web part help assist content owners keep their content fresh and relevant. Powered by Microsoft 365 Copilot, this new web part can help content owner easily curate FAQ by working with agents and connected grounding data. With a Human-in-the-Loop approach, it ensures high-quality, trustworthy FAQs—without the hassle. The result? A living FAQ that evolves with your organization's needs. Updated February 24, 2026: We previously marked this item as launched when it is still in Preview. We expect to move to GA later this year. We apologize for this inconvenience.
ai_summary: The SharePoint FAQ web part, which helps content owners curate FAQs using Microsoft 365 Copilot, is still in development. This affects content managers in SharePoint.

title: Microsoft Teams: CVI support for Townhall and Webinar presenters
description: Organizations that do not currently use Microsoft Teams can now seamlessly join and present within Teams Town halls using their own video conferencing devices (VTC). By integrating Cloud Video Interoperability (CVI) capabilities into the event form, organizers and presenters receive join codes for their tenant. CVI presenters who join the call will automatically join and interact with other users in the green room prior to the event starting. This capability ensures all participants can see each other (and see the meeting video) without any limitations, providing a seamless and inclusive experience for everyone involved.
ai_summary: Teams will support Cloud Video Interoperability (CVI) for Townhall and Webinar presenters, allowing external video conferencing users to join seamlessly. This affects organizations using different video systems.

title: Microsoft 365 app: Microsoft Loop – Require Existing Microsoft 365 Group for New Loop workspaces
description: Ensure via optional IT admin policy that new shared Loop workspaces are connected to and managed by an existing Teams enabled Microsoft 365 Group.
ai_summary: Microsoft Loop will allow IT admins to require new shared Loop workspaces to be connected to existing Microsoft 365 Groups. This policy is optional for administrators.

title: Microsoft Purview: Data Lifecycle Management - DLM Retention support Microsoft Teams call logs
description:
Microsoft Teams stores call logs in several persistent locations, such as CDR logs. Currently, these logs are retained indefinitely. However, regulatory requirements in various countries specify maximum retention periods for calling-related logs. This discrepancy creates a compliance gap, as the existing retention practices may not meet regulatory obligations. 
Additionally, tenant administrators may prefer to retain data for longer periods to improve the user experience. Therefore, this solution would help organizations ensure that Microsoft Teams remains compliant with regulatory mandates while also supporting evolving product features and business needs.
ai_summary: Microsoft Teams will implement retention support for call logs to comply with regulatory requirements, addressing compliance gaps. This affects tenant administrators managing data retention policies.

title: Microsoft Viva: Feature conversations to all network members
description: The featured conversation feature in public Viva Engage communities will include the option to feature a conversation to all network members or only to community members.
ai_summary: Microsoft Viva Engage will allow featured conversations to be shared with all network members or just community members. This impacts users in public communities within Viva Engage.

title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Microsoft Graph APIs for App & Agent Inventory and Details.
description:
Microsoft 365 will introduce new Graph API endpoints designed to empower IT administrators and developers with robust programmatic access to app and agent management across Copilot, Teams, Outlook, and other MetaOS hosts. 
Key Features: 
•	Inventory API: Retrieve a comprehensive inventory of all apps and agents within your tenant, with advanced filtering by type (1P, 3P, LOB, Shared), host (Copilot, Outlook, Teams, Office), last updated date, and more. This enables bulk management, compliance checks, and streamlined governance for large organizations.  
•	Details API: Access detailed metadata for any specific app or agent, including availability, deployment status, supported hosts, creator information, version, sensitivity, categories, and capabilities (such as Graph connectors, knowledge sources, and plugin actions). This supports auditing, lifecycle management, and integration into existing IT workflows. #copilotcontrolsystem
ai_summary: New Microsoft Graph APIs will provide IT admins and developers with access to app and agent management across Microsoft 365, enhancing governance capabilities.

title: Microsoft Edge: v.148 - Shadow AI
description: Currently admins can set Purview DLP policies to protect sensitive data from being sent to any Generative AI apps, users get blocked from sending their prompts to LLM when this is triggered and stops their workflow. This new add-on to the feature shows a new UI that will give users the option to be redirected to M365 Copilot which will open and navigate to this M365 Copilot tab and allow them to send the same prompt there.
ai_summary: Microsoft Edge introduces a new UI for users blocked from sending prompts to Generative AI apps, redirecting them to M365 Copilot instead. This change affects users interacting with DLP policies.

title: Microsoft Purview: Endpoint Data Loss Prevention - Add support of hyperlinks in warn & block toast messages for Edge browser
description: With this feature, data officers can now complete their coverage story by now embedding hyperlinks within toast messages for the Edge browser. When this rule is triggered, the end user will see a toast with a customized title and message with a hyperlink. This feature is useful when organizations need to direct users to a specific resource or a repository for more specific instruction (e.g. internal policy SharePoint site).
ai_summary: Data officers can now embed hyperlinks in warning and blocking toast messages for the Edge browser in Microsoft Purview. This feature helps direct users to specific resources when data loss prevention rules are triggered.

title: Microsoft Purview: Data Loss Prevention – File Testing Against Sensitive Information Classifiers
description: A new feature will be introduced on the main Classification page, allowing users to test files against all available classifiers to identify the presence of sensitive information. Users will have the option to select a single classifier or run tests across all classifiers. This capability is designed to help users identify sensitive content within files and troubleshoot classification issues more efficiently.
ai_summary: Microsoft Purview will introduce a feature to test files against sensitive information classifiers, helping users identify sensitive content. This affects users managing data classification.

title: Microsoft Teams: Audio recap language expansion
description: Audio recap in Teams will begin supporting 8 new languages. These are (in alphabetical order) Chinese, variations across English, French, German, Italian, Japanese, Portuguese, and Spanish.
ai_summary: Teams will support audio recap in eight additional languages, enhancing accessibility for global users.

title: Microsoft 365: Modernized Access Denied Web Experience
description: We’re introducing a visual refresh of the Access Denied web experience across Microsoft 365, where users can request access to files, sites, and meeting recordings. This update features a modern Fluent design with new illustrations, animations, and clearer messaging to help users quickly gain confidence and seamlessly continue their collaboration.
ai_summary: Microsoft 365 will have a refreshed Access Denied web experience, allowing users to request access to files and sites with improved visuals and messaging. This update affects all users encountering access issues.

title: Microsoft Edge: v.148 - Password affiliation service
description: Password autofill suggestions in Edge are currently based on top-level domain matching, which means the same credentials can be suggested on sites like account.microsoft.com and office.microsoft.com. With this feature, Edge groups related domains together across various desktop and mobile properties called affiliations. When a customer visits a URL, the Edge client will query the affiliations backend to obtain “affiliated groups” for that URL. The process involves sending a hash of the visited URLs to the service, which then returns a list of affiliated URLs and ensures that the relevant credentials will be displayed in the autofill suggestions across affiliated domains. Admins can control access to this feature using the PasswordManagerEnabled policy.
ai_summary: Edge will introduce a password affiliation service to improve autofill suggestions based on related domains. This change affects users of Edge across desktop and mobile platforms.

title: Microsoft Edge: Microsoft Edge can now send work related browsing history to Copilot for more relevant work results when searching on M365 Copilot search
description: Microsoft Edge can now send IT admin selected work related browsing history to Copilot to improve search relevance. When a user searches for something on Copilot search, Copilot will also show results from browser history when relevant.
ai_summary: Microsoft Edge can now send selected work-related browsing history to Copilot to enhance search results. This impacts users who use Copilot search.

title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Copilot voice support in Word & PowerPoint.
description: Chat in Work and PowerPoint now supports voice. Users can talk and interact with Copilot to brainstorm ideas, create content, and analyze information. Same as text, voice understand documents, work and web context.
ai_summary: Microsoft 365 Copilot will support voice interactions in Word and PowerPoint, allowing users to brainstorm and create content verbally. This affects users of Word and PowerPoint.

title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Admins will be able to define rules to automate agent lifecycle management.
description:
Admins will have the ability to set up rules for various scenarios, such as -

1. Auto block risky agents.
2. Auto delete inactive agents.
3. Auto reassign ownerless agents to manager. 

. #copilotcontrolsystem
ai_summary: Admins can define rules in Microsoft 365 Copilot for automating agent lifecycle management, including blocking and deleting agents. This change impacts IT admins managing agent lifecycles.

title: Microsoft Purview: Data Loss Prevention – Enhancements to Data Security Triage Agent
description: Adding below enhancements to Data Security Triage Agent in MS Purview - Metadata supported Custom Instructions (DLP only) : Earlier the agent only supported custom instructions which are related to content (E.g. Focus on alerts related to financial information). Now we also support instructions related to metadata. (E.g. Focus on alerts related to financial information for user Adam in last 20 days) - Consolidated Agent settings : Earlier we had seperate controls for deployment configuration and triggers. We are now merging them into a single view as the settings can be altered anytime and it becomes easier for admins and analysts to change them from single view. - Support for alerts with Non content contains condition (DLP only) : Till now we were showing alerts generated from non-content contains conditions as unsupported. (E.g. Condition = RecipientDomainIs matches and triggers alert, alert is unsupported). Now we are bringing the alerts into triage capability and determining categorization for them also - Agent Identity : Now the Triage agent can be deployed with Agent's own identity generated in Microsoft Entra. There won't be a need to have the agent run using the user's identity who was setting up the agent. This provides cleaner audit capabilities.
ai_summary: Microsoft Purview is enhancing the Data Security Triage Agent by adding support for metadata in custom instructions and consolidating agent settings into a single view. This change affects administrators managing data loss prevention settings.

title: Microsoft Purview: Data Security Triage agent in DLP is generally available worldwide
description:
The Data Security Triage Agent creates an agent-managed alert queue that identifies and prioritizes the DLP and IRM alerts that pose the greatest risk to your organization. It delivers a summary and clear explanation for why each alert was prioritized, helping analysts focus on what matters most.
For this GA release, we’re introducing expanded coverage (which also includes Endpoint DLP alerts as well as alerts that leverage Custom SITs (Sensitive Information Types)) and support for Entra Agent ID.
ai_summary: Microsoft Purview's Data Security Triage agent is now available globally, helping analysts prioritize DLP and IRM alerts. This impacts security and compliance teams.

title: Microsoft Purview: Data Loss Prevention for Microsoft 365 Copilot to safeguard prompts
description: We are expanding Microsoft Purview Data Loss Prevention for Microsoft 365 Copilot to safeguard prompts containing sensitive data. This real-time control helps organizations mitigate data leakage and oversharing risks by preventing Microsoft 365 Copilot, including pre-built agents in Microsoft 365 Copilot,  from returning a response when prompts contain sensitive data or using that sensitive data for grounding in Microsoft 365 or the web.
ai_summary: Microsoft Purview Data Loss Prevention will expand to safeguard prompts in Microsoft 365 Copilot that contain sensitive data. This impacts organizations using Copilot.

title: Microsoft Purview Compliance Portal: Enhancements to variant limits and detection groups
description: Microsoft Purview Insider Risk Management variant limit is being increased from 3 to 10 per indicator and an overall limit of 100 across all indicators. Along with this, the number of items in one detection group is being increased from 200 to 500.
ai_summary: Microsoft Purview Compliance Portal will increase variant limits and detection group sizes for Insider Risk Management. This change impacts compliance officers and IT admins managing risk indicators.

title: Microsoft Purview compliance portal: Priva Privacy Management – Multicloud environments
description: Microsoft Priva Privacy Risk Management extends its overexposure policies into data contained in Azure SQL, Azure Data Lake Storage, and Amazon S3. Organizations can create privacy policies that specify which data sources, databases, or storage buckets are in scope and Priva will automatically notify data asset owners when matches are detected.
ai_summary: Microsoft Priva will extend privacy risk management policies to data in Azure SQL, Azure Data Lake Storage, and Amazon S3. This change affects data governance and compliance teams.

title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Copilot Search Matches on People's Department

ai_summary: Copilot Search will allow users to find people by their department, improving the ability to look up contacts within specific teams.

title: Microsoft Purview: Data Loss Prevention- Additional Diagnostics for Data Loss Prevention and Information Protection

ai_summary: Microsoft Purview will provide additional diagnostics for Data Loss Prevention, helping users identify sensitive information and applied policies in documents. This impacts users managing sensitive data.

title: Microsoft Purview compliance portal: Endpoint Data Loss Prevention: Expand protection to Copilot + PC devices for Recall snapshots through custom policies

Purview admins will author Endpoint DLP custom policies to integrate with Windows Copilot + PC Recall setup by Intune admins for Copilot + PC devices exclusively.
ai_summary: Endpoint DLP is expanding to include protection for Copilot and PC devices, focusing on Recall snapshots and policy enforcement. This affects Purview admins managing data protection policies.

title: Microsoft Purview: Data Security Investigations – Introducing new personal data examination

The personal data examination will identify and extract various types of personal data from the selected items including but not limited to, names, addresses, bank account numbers, and more. This addition works alongside DSI’s AI-powered content analysis features, such as categorization, AI search, and examination for risk, which help surface data security risks buried in data.
ai_summary: Data Security Investigations will introduce a focus on identifying personal data, enhancing the ability to extract sensitive information. This impacts security and compliance teams.

title: Outlook: Improved handling of disallowed and failed email reactions

ai_summary: Outlook will now properly gray out the Reactions button for disallowed email reactions and undo failed reaction attempts. This change affects all Outlook users.

title: Microsoft Teams: Video recap in Teams

ai_summary: Teams will now include video recaps of meetings, providing narrated highlights and key moments from recorded sessions. This feature affects all Teams users.

title: Microsoft Teams: Resizable Gallery in Teams Meetings
description: Resize the top video gallery in Teams meetings to see more people when content is being shared.
ai_summary: Teams meetings now allow resizing of the top video gallery, enabling users to see more participants during content sharing. This change affects all Teams meeting participants.

title: Microsoft Teams: Digital signage in Teams Rooms on Android
description: As with Teams Rooms on Windows, IT Admins can now set up Teams Rooms on Android to show dynamic signage content on the front-of-room display when the device is not in use for meetings or presentation. ai_summary: Teams Rooms on Android can now display digital signage when not in use, with configuration options available for IT admins. This affects Teams Rooms users.

title: Microsoft Teams: Create custom templates for immersive events in Microsoft Teams
description: This release brings the next evolution in immersive collaboration in Teams. title: Microsoft Teams: Easily find unsent drafts

ai_summary: Teams introduces a Drafts quick view feature that helps users find, edit, and send unsent draft messages easily.

title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): App Navigation Pane Update

ai_summary: The Microsoft 365 Copilot app will have a simplified navigation with expanded chat history and quick actions for easier access.

title: Microsoft Teams: New Organization chart in the Profile Card for Web and Desktop

ai_summary: Microsoft Teams is introducing an organization chart in the profile card, allowing users to view reports and contextualize colleagues. This change affects all Teams users.

This experience includes richer rendering, improved performance, strong security for PDF handling, and greater accessibility.
ai_summary: Microsoft Edge will introduce a new built-in PDF reader powered by Adobe's engine, enhancing PDF functionality and security.

title: Microsoft CoPilot (Microsoft 365): List email attachments in M365 Copilot
description: Users will be able to list the file attachments that they received or sent over email in M365 Copilot.
ai_summary: M365 Copilot will allow users to list email attachments they have sent or received. This feature impacts users who utilize Copilot for email management.

title: Microsoft Purview: Data Loss Prevention – Export DLP and Label Policy Configurations

The exported file can be attached to support tickets to accelerate troubleshooting.
ai_summary: Microsoft Purview introduces export functionality for DLP and label policy configurations, allowing users to download settings as a ZIP file. This feature aids IT admins in troubleshooting.

title: Outlook: Teammates Calendars in Left Nav in calendar
description: Users can now see colleagues’ and direct reports’ calendars in the left navigation by default—without manual setup. #newoutlookforwindows
ai_summary: Outlook will now display colleagues' and direct reports' calendars by default in the left navigation. This change impacts users of the new Outlook for Windows.

title: Microsoft Teams: Account Switching for Native Mac Controls via Dock and Menu Bar
description: Users will now find controls for switching between the accounts and tenants that they are signed into making it easier to navigate on Mac.

title: Microsoft Teams: Simplified Teams app bar to create a cleaner and more focused experience.

title: Microsoft Teams: Teams Phone Device user multi-line

This makes it easy to manage different roles, departments, or regional identities—all from one unified Teams experience. The result is a familiar, localized calling experience for users who work across diverse markets or with global customers.
ai_summary: Teams Phone will allow administrators to assign up to 10 phone numbers to a single user, enabling seamless calling from multiple numbers. This feature benefits users managing diverse roles or regions.

title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Now smarter with visuals: Declarative Agents leverage embedded images for richer, more accurate answers

This capability allows the agent to extract insights from visual elements like charts, diagrams, and screenshots, ensuring that answers are not only text-based but also informed by graphical context. By combining textual and visual understanding, Declarative Agents deliver more comprehensive and contextually accurate responses for complex queries.
ai_summary: Declarative Agents in Microsoft 365 Copilot can now use embedded images from documents to provide richer, more accurate answers. This change affects users relying on Copilot for complex queries.

title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): [Copilot Extensibility] Customers can connect M365 Copilot with 15Five to surface team priorities and recognition with Copilot Connector
description: Customers can connect M365 Copilot with 15Five to surface team priorities and recognition with Copilot Connector.

title: Microsoft 365: Department Billing for Microsoft 365 Backup

title: Microsoft Edge: Enterprise WebView2 runtime downgrade via Downgrade Version policy
description: Administrators can temporarily roll back specific applications to a previous WebView2 Evergreen Runtime version (N-1 or N-2) using the new Downgrade Version policy in msedgewebview2.admx. This policy allows enterprises to mitigate critical regressions by specifying per-application exe-to-version mappings. The Edge Updater installs the target version side-by-side, and the WebView2 Loader redirects targeted apps accordingly. Downgrades auto-expire with each new WebView2 release: apps pinned to N-1 remain on the same version (now N-2) and auto-update in the next release, while apps pinned to N-2 revert to the current Evergreen version. The policy applies only to enterprise-managed devices (domain-joined or MDM-enrolled).

title: Microsoft Purview: Insider Risk Management – Ability to create cases without content in IRM
description:
Insider Risk Management is providing the ability to create a case without content. With this, we will introduce a new active case limit (2000). This new functionality will allow customers to create more cases particularly when content download is unnecessary. If a case is created without content download, content download can be initiated anytime the case is active pending available content download limits. There is no change to the active content download limit (100). 

Microsoft Purview Insider Risk Management correlates various signals to identify potential malicious or inadvertent insider risks, such as IP theft, data leakage, and security violations. Insider Risk Management enables customers to create policies based on their own internal policies, governance, and organizational requirements. Built with privacy by design, users are pseudonymized by default, and role-based access controls and audit logs are in place to help ensure user-level privacy.
ai_summary: Insider Risk Management in Microsoft Purview will allow the creation of cases without content, increasing the active case limit to 2000. This change affects administrators managing insider risk cases.

This capability currently extends to Microsoft 365 Copilot and agents built in Copilot Studio that are published to Microsoft 365 Copilot.
ai_summary: Data Loss Prevention (DLP) is being expanded to protect sensitive web searches in Microsoft 365 Copilot and Copilot Chat. This change impacts organizations using these tools to prevent data leakage.

title: Microsoft Defender for Office 365: Introducing a new URL click alert in Teams via Microsoft Defender for Office 365
description: We are introducing a new URL click alert that proactively notifies security teams when a user clicks on a malicious link in Teams, helping organizations quickly identify risk and respond before further impact occurs.
ai_summary: Microsoft Defender for Office 365 will provide a new alert for Teams that notifies security teams when a user clicks a malicious link.

title: Outlook: Account Manager
description: Users can use the new Account Manager feature to learn more about their Microsoft account, display their profile picture, and add new accounts (if permitted by their organization).
ai_summary: Outlook introduces an Account Manager feature that allows users to view their Microsoft account details, profile picture, and add new accounts if allowed by their organization.

title: Microsoft Purview: Data Security Investigations – Investigation templates for common data security scenarios
description: We're adding pre-built search templates to Microsoft Purview Data Security Investigations. Templates provide pre-configured search queries for common data security scenarios, allowing investigators to scope an investigation in just a few clicks instead of manually building queries. Users select a template, provide minimal inputs (such as a user or site), and the search is configured and ready to run.
ai_summary: Microsoft Purview adds pre-built search templates for common data security scenarios in Data Security Investigations. This feature helps investigators streamline their search process.

title: Microsoft Teams: Honor Windows Do not disturb setting
description: Microsoft Teams integrates with the Do not disturb setting in Windows to help reduce interruptions. Teams notifications are paused when Do not disturb is turned on, and resume after it is turned off.
ai_summary: Microsoft Teams will now respect the Windows Do Not Disturb setting, pausing notifications when enabled. This affects all Teams users.

title: Microsoft 365 Apps: Cloud Update - Update Health
description: Use enhanced error reporting in Cloud Update for Microsoft 365 Apps updates to access clear, descriptive error messages that help you easily identify why an update did not complete successfully. Admins can review comprehensive insights across all Cloud Update-managed devices and drill down into individual devices for detailed information. This improved feature expands on the existing upgrade progress insights by grouping issues according to error codes and providing straightforward descriptions. These advancements enable admins to diagnose problems more efficiently, reduce support escalations, and take decisive corrective actions to boost monthly compliance rates.
ai_summary: Cloud Update will provide enhanced error reporting for Microsoft 365 Apps updates, offering clearer error messages for failed updates. This feature helps admins diagnose issues more efficiently.

title: Microsoft Teams: External Domains Anomalies Report
description: This new report helps admins proactively spot unusual or risky interactions with external organizations. By analyzing communication trends and detecting sudden spikes, new domains, or abnormal engagement patterns, it provides early visibility into potential data-sharing or security risks. As external collaboration grows, this report delivers actionable insights to safeguard your tenant while supporting productive cross-organization work.
ai_summary: Microsoft Teams will introduce an External Domains Anomalies Report to help admins identify unusual interactions with external organizations. This feature is designed for IT admins to monitor security risks.

title: Microsoft Teams: Meeting participants can request collaborative annotation sessions
description: In Microsoft Teams meetings, participants who are not sharing their screen can request to start a collaborative annotation session while a screen or window is being shared. The active sharer (presenter) must approve the request before annotations start for everyone in the meeting. Organizers and co-organizers can control who can start annotations via a new Meeting Options setting under Participation (Everyone (default) or Active sharer).
ai_summary: In Microsoft Teams meetings, participants can request to start collaborative annotation sessions, which require approval from the presenter. Organizers can control who can start annotations through a new Meeting Options setting.

title: Microsoft Purview: Insider Risk Management – Viewing AI interaction messages for anonymized users in IRM
description: Customers can now access and review the underlying risky prompt and response interactions generated by users during AI usage, even when user anonymization is enabled within Insider Risk Management investigations. This capability ensures that anonymized investigation workflows do not limit visibility into the contextual AI activity associated with potential risk. This enables analysts to effectively investigate detailed AI interactions across the organization. Microsoft Purview Insider Risk Management correlates various signals to identify potential malicious or inadvertent insider risks, such as IP theft, data leakage, and security violations. Insider Risk Management enables customers to create policies based on their own internal policies, governance, and organizational requirements. Built with privacy by design, users are pseudonymized by default, and role-based access controls and audit logs are in place to help ensure user-level privacy.
ai_summary: Microsoft Purview now allows access to AI interaction messages for anonymized users in Insider Risk Management, aiding analysts in investigating potential risks. This change affects organizations using Insider Risk Management.

title: Microsoft Teams: Badging updates help find messages that count in the chat list
description: Microsoft Teams displays a badge on the app bar that reflects activity across chats and channels. Now, it’s easier to find and clear the messages behind that badge. Unmuted chats show a purple indicator when they affect the badge, while mentions, followed threads, and tag mentions display a purple number indicating how many items within are unread and part of the count.
ai_summary: Microsoft Teams will now display badges on the app bar to indicate activity in chats and channels, making it easier to find unread messages. This change affects all Teams users.

title: Microsoft Teams: Enhancements to Interpreter quality and support for Traditional Chinese
description: Interpreter now delivers more accurate real-time interpretation, with improved recognition of people’s names and common industry terms. It also supports your organization’s Custom Dictionary from the Microsoft 365 admin center, so tenant-specific terms can be translated more consistently across meetings. Traditional Chinese is also now supported.
ai_summary: Microsoft Teams will improve interpreter quality and now support Traditional Chinese, enhancing real-time interpretation accuracy and consistency for meetings. This change benefits users who require interpretation services.

title: Microsoft Teams: Sensitivity label inheritance for meeting recordings
description: Meeting recordings now automatically inherit the meeting’s sensitivity label. When label inheritance is enabled in sensitivity label policies, a labeled meeting applies the same label to its MP4 recording, ensuring access controls, data handling rules, and Copilot or agent responses based on transcripts consistently respect the meeting’s sensitivity end to end.
ai_summary: Microsoft Teams meeting recordings will now automatically inherit the meeting's sensitivity label, ensuring consistent access controls and data handling. This change affects all users who record meetings.

title: Microsoft Teams: Sensitivity label inheritance for Loop meeting notes
description: Loop meeting notes now automatically inherit your meeting’s sensitivity label. When admins enable label inheritance in the sensitivity label policy, any labeled meeting applies the same label to its Loop meeting notes, ensuring protections like encryption, access controls, and data handling rules carry forward consistently. This also ensures that Copilot and agent responses based on Loop meeting notes accurately reflect the meeting’s sensitivity, keeping confidential content protected end to end.
ai_summary: Loop meeting notes in Microsoft Teams will automatically inherit the meeting's sensitivity label, maintaining consistent protections for confidential content. This impacts users who utilize Loop meeting notes.

title: Outlook: New and Improved People Hub on Web
description: In Outlook Web, the new and updated People Hub delivers a modern, multi-column contacts experience, with fast search and a streamlined interface. It provides a unified view of each person, automatically links duplicate entries, and enriches contacts with organizational profile information where available.
ai_summary: Outlook Web will feature a new People Hub with a modern interface, improved search, and automatic linking of duplicate contacts.

title: Microsoft Edge: Ground Microsoft 365 Copilot Chat in Edge for Business in your open YouTube videos
description: Get relevant answers and insights about your open YouTube videos in Copilot Chat in Edge.
ai_summary: Microsoft Edge will allow users to get insights about open YouTube videos through Copilot Chat. This change affects users of Edge for Business.

title: Microsoft Edge: Microsoft 365 Copilot Chat access to page content will soon extend to work across multiple open tabs
description: Microsoft 365 Copilot Chat in Edge will soon be able to answer contextual questions about a user's open window. This extends the existing capability which can only access the open page. All existing user settings and policies and DLP considerations will continue to be respected.
ai_summary: Copilot Chat in Microsoft Edge will soon answer questions based on multiple open tabs, enhancing its current single-page capability. This affects Edge users.

title: SharePoint: Extending AI in SharePoint using custom skills
description: Skills allow extensibility of the SharePoint AI Agent, enabling customizable solutions that adapt to unique business needs. They address gaps in out-of-the-box functionality for unique business processes and enable reusable multi-step workflows.
ai_summary: SharePoint will extend its AI capabilities with customizable skills to better meet unique business needs. This change affects users who require tailored solutions in SharePoint.

title: Microsoft Teams: Create workflows with slash commands
description: Now you can create workflows quickly and easily using slash commands directly from the Teams compose box.
ai_summary: Microsoft Teams will enable users to create workflows using slash commands directly in the compose box. This change affects Teams users creating workflows.

title: Windows 365: Windows 365 Link - Customization of the login screen
description: IT can set a custom wallpaper, company logo and name on the Windows 365 Link login screen
