ai_summary: IT admins can customize the Windows 365 Link login screen with a company logo, name, and wallpaper.

title: Outlook: Copilot Chat available in shared and delegate mailboxes
description: Shared mailbox users and delegates with Read and manage (full access), and/or mail folder-level permission will now be able to access Copilot Chat directly from their shared and delegate mailboxes in new Outlook.
ai_summary: Outlook's Copilot Chat will be accessible in shared and delegate mailboxes for users with appropriate permissions. This affects users managing shared mailboxes.

title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): PowerPoint Agent
description: PowerPoint Agent helps you build polished presentations with strong storytelling and visual structure. It streamlines research, formatting, and layout so you can stay focused on your message. Use multi‑turn chat to refine content or open the deck in PowerPoint for full editing and collaboration. Ideal for executive presentations, strategic updates, and market overviews. Available to Microsoft 365 users with or without a Microsoft 365 Copilot license.
ai_summary: PowerPoint Agent assists users in creating presentations by streamlining research and formatting. This feature is available to all Microsoft 365 users.

title: Microsoft Teams: Teams Phone Call Transfer Improvements
description: Microsoft Teams is improving the call transfer experience on desktop (Windows and Mac) with a streamlined workflow that makes transferring calls faster and more intuitive. These changes reduce the number of steps to initiate a transfer and introduce transfer suggestions to help users find the right transfer target more quickly.
ai_summary: Microsoft Teams is enhancing the call transfer process on desktop, making it quicker and more intuitive with fewer steps and transfer suggestions. This change affects all Teams users making calls.

title: Outlook: Copilot provides coaching feedback in chat as you draft, edit and format emails
description: Copilot now provides coaching feedback on email drafts via chat and can apply suggestions directly to your message in Outlook. Users have the option to choose which suggestions are applied, and Copilot updates your email in place.
ai_summary: Outlook will now feature Copilot providing coaching feedback on email drafts, allowing users to apply suggestions directly. This change impacts all Outlook users drafting emails.

title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Create PowerPoint presentations from Copilot Notebooks
description: Copilot Notebooks enables users to generate PowerPoint presentations directly from the content and references collected in a notebook. Using the notebook’s curated context, Copilot creates a structured, editable slide deck that users can open and refine in PowerPoint, helping turn research, notes, and insights into shareable presentations more quickly.
ai_summary: Microsoft Copilot will allow users to create PowerPoint presentations from Copilot Notebooks, streamlining the process of turning notes into presentations. This impacts users who utilize Copilot Notebooks.

title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Create Excel spreadsheets from Copilot Notebooks
description: Copilot Notebooks allows users to generate Excel spreadsheets using the content and references gathered in a notebook. Copilot drafts a structured spreadsheet grounded in the notebook’s context, which can be opened and edited in Excel, helping users move from ideas and source material to a ready‑to‑use spreadsheet with fewer manual steps.
ai_summary: Microsoft Copilot allows users to create Excel spreadsheets from content in Copilot Notebooks, streamlining the process of turning ideas into spreadsheets. This affects users who utilize Copilot Notebooks.

title: Microsoft Viva: Insights - New Copilot Metrics Available
description: We are bringing a set of new Copilot metrics including actions taken in Microsoft 365 Copilot app, Edge and OneNote, and more key use cases across Outlook, Word, Excel, and PowerPoint including suggested reply, translate, coach, clean data and more. This will empower customers to more deeply understand the key Copilot adoption cases in Copilot Dashboard and Advanced Analysis in Viva Insights.
ai_summary: Viva Insights will introduce new metrics for Microsoft 365 Copilot usage across various applications, helping organizations analyze Copilot adoption. This impacts users of the Copilot Dashboard and Advanced Analysis.

title: Microsoft Purview: Insider Risk Management-AI app selection for Generative AI apps indicators
description: Customers can precisely choose which AI app they should use to detect any of the Generative AI apps indicators. This is applicable to the following indicators: "Entering risky prompts in Copilot", "Receiving sensitive responses from Copilot", "Entering risky prompts in enterprise AI apps", and "Receiving sensitive responses from enterprise AI apps". Microsoft Purview Insider Risk Management correlates various signals to identify potential malicious or inadvertent insider risks, such as IP theft, data leakage, and security violations. Insider Risk Management enables customers to create policies based on their own internal policies, governance, and organizational requirements. Built with privacy by design, users are pseudonymized by default, and role-based access controls and audit logs are in place to help ensure user-level privacy.
ai_summary: Microsoft Purview allows customers to select specific AI apps for detecting indicators of risky behavior related to Generative AI. This change affects organizations using Insider Risk Management to monitor potential insider threats.

title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Explain slide selection during PowerPoint Live
description: This feature enhances the PowerPoint Live meeting experience by using Copilot to let attendees select slide text and get explanations for the content.
ai_summary: Microsoft Copilot will enhance PowerPoint Live by explaining selected slide text during meetings. This feature impacts users participating in PowerPoint Live sessions.

title: Microsoft Edge: Validate Edge builds early with enterprise preview
description: Enterprise preview provides a simpler way for admins to flight pre-release Edge builds to their users. To reduce friction and bolster usage, users will receive pre-release builds directly inside of their Stable Edge application. Admins can allow users to easily opt-out of the preview experience, using built-in rollback to switch between their pre-release and stable channels with ease. Microsoft 365 admin center users can configure the feature, view their flighting population, and receive personalized recommendations all in one place.
ai_summary: Microsoft Edge will offer an enterprise preview for admins to flight pre-release builds to users, simplifying the testing process. This affects IT admins managing Edge.

title: Microsoft Edge: Extensions monitoring in the Edge management service
description: The Microsoft Edge management service now allows admins to gain visibility into extensions installed across their managed users. From the extensions monitoring page, admins can see which extensions have been installed as well as manage user requests for blocked extensions.
ai_summary: Admins can now monitor installed extensions across managed users in Microsoft Edge, allowing them to manage user requests for blocked extensions. This change affects IT admins managing Edge.

title: Microsoft Purview: Apply sensitivity labels with user-defined permissions in Office for the web in Microsoft 365
description: Office for the web in Microsoft 365 supports the application of sensitivity labels with user-defined permissions.
ai_summary: Office for the web will support applying sensitivity labels with user-defined permissions, enhancing data protection. This change affects users managing sensitive information.

title: Microsoft Teams: Teams room builder in the Pro Management portal
description: The Teams room builder is a user-friendly, visually engaging tool to help IT managers design and configure Teams Rooms traditional, signature, and flex meeting spaces. This feature, available in the Teams Rooms Pro Management portal, enables faster design, standards creation, and rollout.  With a variety of equipment options and helpful criteria filters, device and license selection and purchase is simplified. Available with Teams Rooms Pro.

title: Microsoft Purview compliance portal: Communication Compliance - Adaptive policy scope
description: Adaptive policy scopes enable your organization to create scopes that automatically updates which users to include in your policy based on geography, group, or another user attribute. The policy will automatically update to match the criteria defined in the scope instead of you constantly needing to update the static list of users in your policies.
ai_summary: Adaptive policy scopes will allow automatic updates to user inclusion in Communication Compliance policies based on defined criteria.

title: Microsoft Purview | Communication Compliance: Support for adaptive policy scopes
description: Adaptive policy scopes enable your organization to define user scopes for policies based on criteria such as geography, group, or other Azure Active Directory attributes. With adaptive policy scopes, policies are automatically updated to include users that match defined risk criteria rather than requiring admins to repeatedly update static lists of users to include in the policy scope. Microsoft Purview Communication Compliance provides the tools to help organizations detect regulatory compliance violations (e.g. SEC and FINRA obligations), such as inappropriate sharing of sensitive or confidential information, harassing or threatening language and sharing of adult content. Communication Compliance enables customers to create policies based on their own internal policies, governance and organizational requirements. Built with privacy by design, usernames are pseudonymized by default, role-based access controls are built in, investigators are opted in by an admin, and audit logs are in place to help ensure user-level privacy.
ai_summary: Microsoft Purview Communication Compliance introduces adaptive policy scopes, allowing automatic updates to user policies based on defined criteria. This reduces the need for manual updates by admins.

title: Microsoft Purview compliance portal: Communication Compliance - Policy insights
description:
The Communication
Compliance homepage will provide two columns that offer a quick overview of
policy performance: the first column shows the number of scanned parent items
in real time, giving visibility into scanning progress; the second column keeps
you informed about parent items that meet policy conditions, ensuring you stay
updated on potential issues requiring attention and maintaining control over
communication compliance. This item is no longer accurate and is being removed from the roadmap.  We apologize for the inconvenience.
ai_summary: The Communication Compliance homepage changes are being removed from the roadmap. No further updates will be provided.

title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Create Word documents from Copilot Notebooks
description: Copilot Notebooks allows users to generate Word documents using the content and references gathered in a notebook. Copilot drafts a structured document grounded in the notebook’s context, which can be opened and edited in Word, helping users move from ideas and source material to a ready‑to‑use document with fewer manual steps.
ai_summary: Microsoft Copilot will enable users to generate Word documents from Copilot Notebooks, facilitating the transition from ideas to structured documents. This affects users working with Copilot Notebooks.

title: Microsoft Teams: Apps in Private Channels for Microsoft Teams
description: Bring the apps your team relies on—tabs, bots, and message extensions—directly into Private Channels in Microsoft Teams. This update lets channel owners add apps to a specific private channel, so everyone collaborating there (including invited collaborators from other teams or organizations, subject to admin policy) can work in one place without switching contexts.
ai_summary: Microsoft Teams will allow apps to be added to Private Channels, enabling collaboration without switching contexts. This change affects channel owners and participants in private channels.

title: Microsoft Purview compliance portal: Copilot Prompt Gallery in Data Security Posture Management
description: The Data Security Posture Management (DSPM) Copilot Prompt Gallery is a curated collection of prompts and promptbooks created to help users engage more effectively with the Security Copilot experience in DSPM. It acts as a centralized hub where users can explore, search, and leverage prompts that streamline workflows and improve productivity. Designed to support a range of roles and use cases within Data Security, the Prompt Gallery is a powerful resource that enables users to quickly access relevant prompts, accelerate task completion, and unlock the full potential of the Copilot experience.
ai_summary: The Data Security Posture Management will feature a Copilot Prompt Gallery to help users find and use prompts for better security workflows.

title: Microsoft Teams: Workplace check-in via Wi-Fi allows easy coordination in the office
description: Workplace Check-in via Wi-Fi acts as an extension of existing capabilities to check in to a building or a reserved desk, providing more flexibility and ease of use to help coordinate with co-workers. When users connect to their organization's Wi-Fi, Teams will soon be able to update their work location to reflect the building they're working from. This feature will be off by default. Tenant admins will decide whether to enable it or not and end-users always have the choice to opt-in or opt-out of sharing this information.

title: Outlook: Account Selector in Outlook Copilot Side Pane
description: When users have more than one Copilot-enabled account added to new Outlook, the Copilot side pane in Calendar will include an account dropdown that makes it clear which Copilot-enabled account you’re using and lets you switch accounts without relying on Outlook UI’s account context.
ai_summary: Outlook adds an account selector in the Copilot side pane for users with multiple accounts, simplifying account management. This change affects users with multiple Copilot-enabled accounts.

title: Microsoft Viva: Unlocking Deeper Copilot Insights with Enhanced Power BI Filtering
description: Enable Global and Insights admins to turn on additional attributes as filters in Power BI reports, including reserved attributes and your organization’s custom attributes. Users who have access to Power BI reports can then use these newly enabled filters to tailor reports to their business needs.
ai_summary: Global and Insights admins can enable additional filters in Power BI reports for tailored insights in Microsoft Viva. This change affects users generating reports with Power BI.

title: Microsoft Purview: Data Security Investigations – AI analysis enhancements
description: Data Security Investigations (DSI) now further enhances its AI analysis tools, including the ability to choose between a standard categorization for potential time and/or cost savings or a more advanced categorization to include AI-generated topics. Additionally, we are making the DSI workflow faster by automatically preparing data for AI analysis as it is being added to the investigation, saving critical investigation time.
ai_summary: Data Security Investigations in Microsoft Purview enhances AI analysis tools for faster categorization and data preparation. This change affects security teams conducting investigations.

title: Microsoft Purview: Azure AI Foundry integration with Microsoft Purview for AI
description: Purview enablement in AI Foundry, allows Foundry admins to activate Microsoft Purview on their subscription. Once enabled, AI interaction data from all apps and agents flows into Purview for centralized compliance, governance, and posture management of AI data.
ai_summary: Microsoft Purview will integrate with Azure AI Foundry, enabling Foundry admins to activate Purview for centralized compliance and governance of AI data.

title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Work IQ APIs – Remote MCP Server Support
description: Supports connecting to remote MCP servers through the Work IQ endpoint, enabling agents to securely invoke external tools and services beyond the local runtime for richer, distributed agent orchestration.

title: Planner: Planner Agent chat
description: Introducing built-in Planner Agent chat with natural language Q&A, smart task discovery, and in-plan task management.
ai_summary: Planner introduces a built-in chat feature for natural language Q&A and task management. This impacts users who manage tasks in Planner.

title: Microsoft Teams: Live transcription in Teams Rooms on Android
description:
View and control live transcription during a meeting from a Teams
Rooms on Android device. The real-time transcript includes speaker names and
timestamps. You can adjust settings such as spoken language, translated
language, and whether both original and translated transcripts are displayed
side by side on the front of room display. This feature is available in Teams Rooms Pro.
ai_summary: Teams Rooms on Android will support live transcription during meetings, including speaker names and timestamps. This feature is available for Teams Rooms Pro users.

title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Planner Agent in Microsoft 365 Copilot
description: Planner agent in Microsoft 365 will help you plan, organize, and manage work more efficiently. We’re starting with core task and plan management features to simplify project tracking and will introduce additional advanced project management capabilities over time. Updated May 21, 2026: We previously launched in Preview and GA is expected in June. We apologize for any inconvenience.

title: Microsoft Teams: Restart your Town hall event
description: Teams town hall producers can now restart a live event while the event is active in order to address technical issues that might arise during the execution of an instance. Whether technical, network, or other issue, this feature enables those managing the event to quickly resolve problems for attendees. This feature is designed to prevent the need for scheduling entirely new events.
ai_summary: Teams town hall producers can now restart live events to address technical issues without scheduling new events. This feature is relevant for event managers.

title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Web Link as a Reference in Copilot Notebooks
description: Add web links as references in your Copilot Notebooks.
ai_summary: Microsoft Copilot will allow users to add web links as references in Copilot Notebooks. This change affects users utilizing Copilot for note-taking.

title: Microsoft Teams: Add Breakout Room Participants in Bulk Using CSV
description: Support for bulk breakout room participant assignment using a CSV file, helping organizers save time when setting up breakout rooms.
ai_summary: Microsoft Teams will allow bulk assignment of breakout room participants using a CSV file, streamlining the setup process for organizers. This feature is relevant for Teams meeting organizers.

title: Microsoft Purview: Data Security Investigations – Introducing new custom examination
description: Data Security Investigations (DSI) is introducing the ability to create custom examination focus areas. This feature will empower admins to tailor examination to their specific needs depending on the type of investigation being performed and the information they are most concerned with. This addition works alongside DSI’s AI-powered content analysis features, such as categorization, AI search, and examination for risk, which help surface data security risks buried in data.
ai_summary: Data Security Investigations in Microsoft Purview introduces custom examination focus areas, allowing admins to tailor investigations based on specific needs. This impacts admins managing data security investigations.

title: Microsoft Viva: Organizational Data in Microsoft 365 is now available in GCC-Moderate
description: We’re excited to announce that Organizational Data in Microsoft 365 is now available in the GCC-Moderate (GCC-M) environment! Organizational Data in Microsoft 365 provides a secure, compliant, and scalable platform for ingesting organizational data into Microsoft 365. With this release, government cloud customers can now leverage the same powerful data ingestion capabilities previously available only in commercial environments.
ai_summary: Organizational Data in Microsoft 365 is now available in the GCC-Moderate environment, allowing government cloud customers to use data ingestion capabilities. This change affects government organizations using Microsoft 365.

title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): [Copilot Extensibility] [AdminX]  Pre-setup guides, editability, actionable errors & alerting support available for Connector admins
description: Pre-setup guides, editability, actionable errors & alerting support available for Connector admins.
ai_summary: Connector admins will receive pre-setup guides, editability options, actionable errors, and alerting support for Microsoft 365 Copilot. This change specifically impacts Connector admins.

title: Microsoft Viva: Viva Glint - Custom confidentiality statements
description: This feature enables Company Admins to customize the default Microsoft Viva Glint confidentiality statement. Admins can choose to turn off the default statement and instead define confidentiality messaging tailored to their specific program settings, such as whether responses are configured to be confidential.
ai_summary: Company Admins can customize the default confidentiality statement in Microsoft Viva Glint, allowing tailored messaging for their programs. This change impacts Company Admins managing Viva Glint.

title: Microsoft Viva: Viva Glint - Survey Designer Role
description: To empower organizations to run additional employee listening programs, like AI transformation or change management cases, we are creating a dedicated Survey Designer role. This role grants a user just enough permissions to run a Viva Glint survey without full access to platform settings and sensitive data, thus creating a more democratized platform.
ai_summary: A new Survey Designer role in Viva Glint allows users to run surveys without full access to platform settings, promoting a more democratic approach.

title: Microsoft Teams: Context preservation in Teams
description: When you return to a conversation within a short duration of time, your selected tab, opened side panel, and layout are restored automatically, so you can keep working without resetting your workspace. In addition, returning to a Quick View within a short duration will restore your previously selected message.
ai_summary: Teams will automatically restore your workspace layout and selected messages when returning to a conversation shortly after leaving. This change affects all Teams users.

title: Microsoft Viva: Viva Glint - New Permissions
description: Adding new, more granular permissions for Viva Glint administration. These areas include Advanced Configuration, Nudges, General Settings, and Viva Integrations. Updating the name of the highest privileged role in Viva Glint to “Viva Glint Service Admin”, and for increased security, restricting the ability to assign new Viva Glint Service Admins to the MAC only.
ai_summary: Viva Glint will introduce new granular permissions for administration and rename the top role to 'Viva Glint Service Admin'. This affects administrators managing Viva Glint settings.

title: Microsoft Teams: User reported security signals in Teams admin center
description: This update brings end user security reporting into Teams Admin Center. Admins can now view and download signals from messages users report as a security concern or not a security concern within TAC Protection reports, helping them identify trends and fine tune policies and responses.
ai_summary: Microsoft Teams now includes user-reported security signals in the admin center. Admins can view and analyze these reports to improve security policies.

title: Outlook: LDAP directory support for S/MIME in New Outlook
description: The new Outlook now supports LDAP (Lightweight Directory Access Protocol) directories for sending S/MIME encrypted emails. This allows users to add an LDAP directory in the new Outlook and use it to fetch recipients’ certificates from the configured directory when sending S/MIME encrypted messages. #newoutlookforwindows
ai_summary: Outlook now supports LDAP directories for S/MIME encrypted emails, allowing users to fetch recipient certificates from the configured directory. This change affects users of the new Outlook for Windows.

title: Outlook: Support for Storing S/MIME Certificates in Contacts in New Outlook
description: The new Outlook will now allow users to store S/MIME encryption certificates within their Contacts. This enables users to save certificates directly in contact entries and use them to send S/MIME encrypted emails to the contacts. #newoutlookforwindows
ai_summary: The new Outlook will enable users to store S/MIME encryption certificates in their Contacts, allowing for easier encrypted email communication. This change affects users of the new Outlook.

title: Microsoft 365 app: Microsoft Loop - Departed user content workflows for user-owned Loop workspaces
description: Manage retention and deletion workflows for user-owned Loop workspaces like Copilot Pages when users leave the organization. Notify and provide temporary access to other employees or administrators to save important data before deletion policies take effect.
ai_summary: The Microsoft 365 app will manage retention and deletion workflows for user-owned Loop workspaces when users leave, affecting workspace management.

title: Microsoft Edge: Intune MAM Protected Downloads
description: The protected downloads feature for Intune MAM will now save downloaded files to the Documents > Microsoft Edge > Downloads folder in OneDrive.

title: Microsoft Purview: Insider Risk Management - Microsoft Fabric, Cloud storage, cloud service activities as triggers
description:
With this update, the indicators belonging to cloud storage apps (Box, Dropbox, Google Drive), cloud services (Azure, Amazon Web Services) and Microsoft Fabric (Power BI, Lakehouse) will be supported as triggers in Data leaks policy. With triggers, customers can define the conditions for bringing the user into the scope of a policy while the respective indicators are used to determine risk score.

Microsoft Purview Insider Risk Management correlates various signals to identify potential malicious or inadvertent insider risks, such as IP theft, data leakage, and security violations. Insider Risk Management enables customers to create policies based on their own internal policies, governance, and organizational requirements. Built with privacy by design, users are pseudonymized by default, and role-based access controls and audit logs are in place to help ensure user-level privacy.
ai_summary: Microsoft Purview Insider Risk Management will now support triggers from cloud storage apps and services, allowing customers to define conditions for user risk assessment. This affects organizations using these cloud services for data security policies.

title: Microsoft Purview: Information Protection - Sensitivity label support in Engage
description: Organizations can now manually apply Purview Information Protection sensitivity labels in Engage. Allowing admins to create labels and configure label publishing policies to determine which users and groups can manually label content in Engage communities. End users in Engage will be able to then manually apply labels to communities and in turn classify and protect their sensitive data via privacy and external user access controls.
ai_summary: Organizations can now manually apply sensitivity labels in Microsoft Engage, allowing admins to control labeling policies for sensitive data protection.

title: Microsoft Purview: Information Protection - Policy sync status for M365 Label publishing policies
description: Admins can now see the sync status of sensitivity label publishing policies directly in the Purview portal. This provides clear confirmation that label policy changes have been fully applied across Microsoft 365 workloads, reducing guesswork, speeding troubleshooting, and increasing confidence during large scale label deployments.
ai_summary: Admins can now view the sync status of sensitivity label publishing policies in the Microsoft Purview portal. This helps confirm that policy changes are applied across Microsoft 365 workloads.

title: Microsoft Purview: Information Protection - Sensitivity label inheritance for Teams meeting artifacts
description: Teams meeting artifacts, including recordings, transcripts, and Loop notes, can now be configured to automatically inherit the sensitivity label from the meeting. This ensures content generated during meetings is consistently protected without requiring manual labeling, reducing risk and simplifying protection at scale.
ai_summary: Teams meeting artifacts like recordings and transcripts can now automatically inherit the meeting's sensitivity label. This change simplifies content protection for all meeting-generated materials.

title: Microsoft Purview: Information Protection - Exclude modern groups / include dynamic security groups support for sensitivity label policies
description: To provide more flexibility, admins can now exclude modern Microsoft 365 groups and scope sensitivity label policies to dynamic and non-mail enabled security groups—expanding policy targeting beyond individual users and mail enabled groups.
ai_summary: Admins can now exclude modern groups and include dynamic security groups in sensitivity label policies. This change impacts IT admins managing data protection policies.

title: Microsoft Teams: Catch up on conversations in Microsoft Teams mobile
description: Catch up in Teams mobile provides a unified view of all directed and followed conversations across chats, meeting chats, channels and threads. The mobile-optimized card view supports swipe actions, helping you quickly review and triage lists of important items.
ai_summary: Microsoft Teams mobile will provide a unified view of conversations, allowing users to easily catch up on chats and threads, impacting mobile users.

title: Microsoft Teams: One-time email passcodes for external presenters in Teams events
description: One-time email passcodes provide an easy way for tenant administrators and event organizers to verify anonymous, external presenters invited to their events. Anonymous external presenters will be shown with a "Verified" tag once completing the process. Based on admin settings, the event organizer will also have a set of options available to them that applies to all external presenters, providing the ability to control who is admitted to the meeting or allowing uninvited users with the link to be admitted from the lobby.
ai_summary: Microsoft Teams will implement one-time email passcodes for verifying external presenters, impacting event organizers and tenant administrators.

title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Copilot Prompt Gallery - Company-wide prompt publishing
description: Organizations can build their own collections of prompts that are tailored to their business needs and workflows and distribute these to all users within the tenant.
ai_summary: Microsoft Copilot will allow organizations to create and share custom prompt collections across all users in their tenant. This change affects all users utilizing Copilot features.

title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Agent Mode in Word for Enhanced document editing
description: Copilot supports document editing in Word through chat-based interactions with Agent Mode. Users can initiate edits, share clarifying directions, and review a summary of changes within the document.
ai_summary: Copilot will support enhanced document editing in Word through chat-based interactions, allowing users to manage edits more effectively.

title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Frontier and Microsoft agent user request approval flow in Microsoft 365 admin center
description: For Admins, agents in the Frontier program can be managed through the Microsoft 365 Admin Center. They are listed under the agents & connectors tab in Copilot Control System, where you can view all agent inventory for your organization. Agents built by Microsoft and available in the Frontier program will be displayed in the Agent Store. This feature will support users to request these agents if blocked by organizational policies. Admins will have the opportunity to further approve and reject these user request. #copilotcontrolsystem
ai_summary: Admins can now manage agents in the Frontier program through the Microsoft 365 Admin Center, including approving user requests for blocked agents. This affects admin control over agent access.

title: Outlook: Import calendars and contacts from PST file to mailbox in new Outlook for Windows
description: With this update of support for .pst files (a.k.a. Outlook Data File) in the new Outlook for Windows, users will be able to import calendars and contacts from .pst file to mailbox. Future releases of new Outlook will expand the support for .pst file capabilities. #newoutlookforwindows #pstfilesupport.
ai_summary: Users can import calendars and contacts from PST files into their mailbox in the new Outlook for Windows. This feature will benefit users transitioning from older Outlook versions.

title: Outlook: Import calendars and contacts from PST file to mailbox in new Outlook for Windows
description: With this update of support for .pst files (a.k.a. Outlook Data File) in the new Outlook for Windows, users will be able to import calendars and contacts from .pst file to mailbox. Future releases of new Outlook will expand the support for .pst file capabilities. #newoutlookforwindows #pstfilesupport.
ai_summary: Users can import calendars and contacts from PST files into their mailbox in the new Outlook for Windows. This feature will benefit users transitioning from older Outlook versions.

title: Outlook: Read-only access to contacts within a PST file in new Outlook for Windows
description: With this update of support for .pst files (a.k.a. Outlook Data File) in the new Outlook for Windows, users will be able to browse and read contacts within a .pst file. Future releases of new Outlook will expand the support for .pst file capabilities. #newoutlookforwindows #pstfilesupport.
ai_summary: The new Outlook for Windows will allow users to browse and read contacts within a PST file, with future updates planned for expanded support.

title: Outlook: Import emails from PST file to mailbox in new Outlook for Windows
description: With this update of support for .pst files (a.k.a. Outlook Data File) in the new Outlook for Windows, users will be able to import emails from .pst file to mailbox. Future releases of new Outlook will expand the support for .pst file capabilities. #newoutlookforwindows #pstfilesupport.
ai_summary: Users can import emails from PST files into their mailbox in the new Outlook for Windows. This feature will assist users migrating from older Outlook versions.

title: Microsoft Viva: Copilot Analytics - Insights in Cowork and WorkIQ spend and usage
description: Insights into AI spend (Copilot credit usage) at a group or team level will be available in Viva Insights as a dashboard and in Advanced insights. The services in scope of this release are Cowork and Work IQ API. The dashboard experience is available to managers with at least 5 direct reports (scoped access), the Insights analysts, and Global administrators and is enabled by default to ensure immediate access to usage-based cost insights. For users to be able to use Cowork or WorkIQ API, your tenant must have usage-based billing setup via Cost Management in the Microsoft 365 admin center. Leader access to tenant-wide data is out of scope for this release. The same insights will be available for Insights Analysts and Global Administrators in Advanced Insights.

title: Microsoft Purview: eDiscovery – Enhancement of Loop and Copilot Pages in Review and Export
description: Improves eDiscovery workflows for Loop and Copilot pages by enabling full indexing of page content for keyword search within review sets and adding HTML format support for export from search.

title: Microsoft Purview: Data Security Investigations – notification and improved search capabilities
description: We're introducing notification capabilities and search improvements to Microsoft Purview Data Security Investigations. Investigators will receive notifications when key investigation events occur, such as when AI jobs complete or when new data is added to scope. Search improvements include enhanced query building to more easily identify potentially impacted data
ai_summary: Microsoft Purview enhances Data Security Investigations with notification capabilities and improved search functions. Investigators will receive alerts on key events and benefit from better query building.

title: SharePoint: Updates to SharePoint home sites
description: SharePoint home sites are getting the following new updates - A resources web part, a new UX to customize the SharePoint app (Viva Connections) experience for Teams desktop and mobile and ability to set up a new home site in the SharePoint admin center. Additionally, the Announcements web part and a new layout for News web part will be available in all sites.
ai_summary: SharePoint home sites will receive updates including a new resources web part and customization options for the Viva Connections experience. This affects SharePoint site administrators.

title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Copilot connectors are available for U.S. Department of Defense environment
description: Copilot connectors enable organizations to integrate content from  other external data sources into Microsoft Graph, improving Copilot’s intelligence, contextual responses, and content discoverability
ai_summary: Copilot connectors will be available for the U.S. Department of Defense environment, allowing integration of external data sources into Microsoft Graph. This change affects organizations in that environment.

title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Surveys Agent and Copilot Chat in Microsoft Forms
description: Microsoft 365 Copilot Chat is now integrated in Microsoft Forms, including enabling the Surveys Agent from within Forms. Surveys Agent provides specialized capabilities to help with your form - from recommending and applying improvements to your form or quiz, to helping draft and send invitations, to analyzing your results. Surveys Agent is available to users with a Microsoft 365 Copilot license, and can be accessed by clicking the "Copilot" icon in Forms.
ai_summary: Microsoft Forms now includes Copilot Chat and the Surveys Agent, which assists users in improving forms and analyzing results. This feature is available to users with a Copilot license.

title: SharePoint: Microsoft 365 Archive in GCC-L
description: Microsoft 365 Archive is designed to help organizations manage their inactive data efficiently. It allows you to move inactive SharePoint sites into a cold storage tier, which reduces storage costs while maintaining the same searchability, security, and compliance standards as active data. This feature is already available in Production and is now being released to GCC-L cloud.
ai_summary: Microsoft 365 Archive is now available in GCC-L, allowing organizations to move inactive SharePoint sites to cold storage while maintaining searchability and compliance. This impacts organizations using SharePoint in GCC-L.

title: Microsoft Purview: Insider Risk Management-Insider risk management for agents
description: As AI agents become deeply embedded in enterprise ecosystems, they are evolving beyond simple tools or workflows into a digital workforce. These agents can interpret intent, access and manipulate enterprise data, execute actions and even make real-time decisions. In many ways, they operate like human insiders only with machine-speed data processing capabilities. To govern and protect these agents effectively, Microsoft Purview Insider Risk Management is being expanded to agents, with specific indicators and insider risk score built for agents based on agentic activities. Microsoft Purview Insider Risk Management correlates various signals to identify potential malicious or inadvertent insider risks, such as IP theft, data leakage, and security violations. Insider Risk Management enables customers to create policies based on their own internal policies, governance, and organizational requirements. Built with privacy by design, users are pseudonymized by default, and role-based access controls and audit logs are in place to help ensure user-level privacy. Updated January 30: This feature is still in development with a planned release of April 2026. We apologize for the inconvenience.
ai_summary: Microsoft Purview will expand Insider Risk Management to include AI agents, allowing for monitoring and risk assessment of agent activities. This affects security and compliance administrators.

title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Admins can manage access more precisely with support for nested permissions in Jira, Confluence, and ServiceNow
description: Support for hierarchical ACLs for SNOW, Confluence, Jira connectors.
ai_summary: Microsoft Copilot will allow admins to manage access with nested permissions for Jira, Confluence, and ServiceNow. This change affects IT admins managing these integrations.

title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Engage private content in M365 Copilot
description: Engage content from private communities and events will be used as grounding source for M365 Copilot. When a user queries in M365 Copilot, they will only be able to see content they are privileged to access.
ai_summary: M365 Copilot will now use content from private communities and events, ensuring users can only access information they are authorized to see. This affects users utilizing M365 Copilot.

title: Microsoft 365 admin center: Organizational Messages now supports Action Segments
description: Action Segments empowers IT Admins to target Organizational Messages using dynamic, pre-defined usage segments. This behavior-based targeting approach goes beyond existing static group definitions, ensuring messages reach the most relevant users.
ai_summary: The Microsoft 365 admin center now allows IT admins to target Organizational Messages using dynamic, pre-defined usage segments. This change enhances message targeting for admins.

title: Outlook: add attachments while offline in the new Outlook for Windows
description: We are adding more functionality to offline mode in the new Outlook for Windows. You will now be able to add attachments while drafting your email without an internet connection. #newoutlookforwindows
ai_summary: The new Outlook for Windows will allow users to add attachments while offline when drafting emails. This change affects all Outlook users.

title: Microsoft Purview compliance portal: Data Loss Prevention for endpoints - Optical character recognition (OCR) support for embedded images in endpoint
description: This release will extend OCR support from standalone images (JPEG, JPG, PNG, BMP, TIFF, and PDF) to images embedded inside the following files and file types: Office files (XLSX, DOCX, PPTX), container files (zip, rar, 7z, and more), and PDF files. Image-only PDF files are already supported, and this this release will support hybrid PDF files containing images and searchable text. Updated May 20, 2026: We have paused rollout and will resume soon. Thank you for your patience.

title: Microsoft Purview: Data Security Investigations – Introducing OCR support
description: Microsoft Purview Data Security Investigations (DSI) is extending our investigations by adding optical character recognition (OCR), extracting text from images and incorporating it into investigation data. This enables AI-powered deep content analysis to uncover data security risks that are often hidden within visual content.

title: Microsoft Teams: Report external users for security concerns in Teams
description: Users can now report suspicious external users directly within Teams, alongside existing block actions. Reports are surfaced in the Teams admin center, giving admins visibility into potentially risky interactions and enabling them to investigate and take appropriate actions. This enhancement helps organizations respond faster to phishing, impersonation, and other external threats while leveraging end-user signals as an additional layer of protection.
ai_summary: Microsoft Teams now enables users to report suspicious external users directly, with reports visible in the Teams admin center for admin follow-up. This change impacts all Teams users and admins.

title: Microsoft Purview: Endpoint Data Loss Prevention - Add support of hyperlinks in warn & block toast messages for Edge browser
description: With this feature, data officers can now complete their coverage story by now embedding hyperlinks within toast messages for the Edge browser. When this rule is triggered, the end user will see a toast with a customized title and message with a hyperlink. This feature is useful when organizations need to direct users to a specific resource or a repository for more specific instruction (e.g. internal policy SharePoint site).
ai_summary: Microsoft Purview adds hyperlink support in toast messages for Edge, allowing data officers to direct users to resources when DLP rules are triggered. This change affects data officers managing DLP policies.

title: Microsoft Purview: Information Protection-Content Explorer – Enhanced Tag (SIT, Labels) Filter at UI Layer
description: Introduces enhanced controls in Content Explorer’s UI, enabling scoped visibility and filtering of SIT and label data. This will help with content discoverability and governance.
ai_summary: Microsoft Purview's Content Explorer now has enhanced filtering controls for SIT and label data. This improves content discoverability and governance for admins.

title: Outlook: Emails marked with External to be supported as Rules conditions
description: The External tag on an email, set by the ExternalInOutlook feature, will now be usable as a condition in Outlook Inbox Rules. This change also makes available the ability to create or modify these Rules on the new Outlook for Windows, Outlook Web, and Outlook for Mac.

title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): SharePoint list support in Agent Builder
description: Agent Builder now supports using a SharePoint list as a knowledge source for agents in Microsoft 365 Copilot. Makers can ground an agent in structured list data so users can ask questions and get responses based on information stored in a selected SharePoint list. For this release, each agent can reference one SharePoint list with up to 20,000 items, alongside other knowledge source types. Support for list attachments and lookup columns is not yet available.

title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Find meetings based on topics and keywords
description: Copilot will be able to find meetings based on topics or keywords from relevant data like meeting body, chat and transcription.
ai_summary: Microsoft Copilot will help users find meetings based on topics and keywords from meeting data like chat and transcription. This feature is useful for users managing multiple meetings.

title: SharePoint: Microsoft 365 Archive file-level archiving
description: This introduces archiving at the file level for Microsoft 365 Archive.
ai_summary: SharePoint introduces file-level archiving for Microsoft 365 Archive. This change impacts users who manage archived files.

title: Microsoft Purview: Data Loss Prevention to prevent Microsoft 365 Copilot processing content with sensitivity labels supports all storage locations
description: The Microsoft Purview Data Loss Prevention policy to restrict Microsoft 365 Copilot processing sensitive files in Word, Excel, and PowerPoint will now apply regardless of file storage location.
ai_summary: Microsoft Purview's Data Loss Prevention policy will now prevent Microsoft 365 Copilot from processing sensitive files in Word, Excel, and PowerPoint, regardless of where the files are stored. This change affects all users utilizing Copilot with sensitive content.

title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Declarative agents with Actions available in GCC High and DoD
description: Declarative Agents with Actions enable Microsoft 365 Copilot to take real-world actions by invoking APIs, plugins, and enterprise workflows directly within the chat experience. Using custom actions, declarative agents can call external systems, execute operations, and retrieve or update data, moving beyond Q&A to full task completion. These actions are powered through API plugins, MCP tools, and enterprise connectors, allowing seamless integration with line-of-business applications and services. The Copilot platform dynamically reasons over available actions and selects the appropriate tool to fulfill user intent, enabling multi-step workflows such as creating records, submitting requests, or triggering business processes within a single conversational flow

title: Microsoft Teams: Shared & Delegate Mailbox Scheduling for Events
description: Empower Chiefs of Staff and delegated roles to efficiently organize events on behalf of leaders or teams using shared or delegated mailboxes. By sending trusted invites from the chosen mailbox, this capability ensures consistent identity, improved trust, and smoother event setup.

title: Microsoft Teams: Save your event as template to reuse event configurations
description: Organizers for Teams events instances will now be able to reuse their event configurations in the Events app in Teams. Organizers can save these configurations as a template in the Events app to use again for future Teams events.

title: Microsoft Teams: Room availability signal for Teams events
description: In the Events app in Teams, Teams events organizers will now be able to see if the chosen room or space they have selected for their event is available at the designated time or not. This feature is available for any Teams event organizer with a Teams Enterprise license.

title: Microsoft Purview: Data Loss Prevention – Enrich Defender alerts Graph API with DLP event data
description: Enhance current API infrastructure to provide easy and simple way for customers to export data to integrate with SIEM tools, create automated workflows and generate customizable reports. Today alert data is present in Graph API and DLP rule match event details are present in Management API. This work enriches the graph API with DLP event data to make correlation and integration easy for customers.
ai_summary: Microsoft Purview will enhance the Graph API to include Data Loss Prevention event data, making it easier for customers to integrate with SIEM tools and automate workflows. This affects users relying on data export for security.

title: SharePoint: Admin policy for expiring "People in your organization" links
description: Administrators can now set organization-wide policies to automatically expire "People in your organization" sharing links after a specified period. This helps organizations maintain tighter control over internal content sharing by ensuring links don't remain active indefinitely. Configure expiration timeframes that align with your organization's data governance requirements—whether that's 30 days, 90 days, or a custom period.
ai_summary: Administrators can now set policies to automatically expire 'People in your organization' sharing links after a specified period, enhancing data governance. This impacts all users sharing internal content.

title: Microsoft Teams: Proximity join support for presenters in Teams events from Teams Rooms on Windows and Android
description: Presenters can take advantage of proximity join with Teams Rooms on Windows or Android for fast, effortless connection to nearby room systems during Teams events, such as town halls, webinars, and structured meetings. This feature enables seamless live presentations.

title: Microsoft Teams: Camera view switching in multi-camera Teams Rooms on Windows
description: When in a meeting with another Teams Rooms on Windows that has multiple cameras, you can switch camera views in that room via the participant panel on the console, or video tile on a touch board, to optimize your views.
ai_summary: Teams Rooms on Windows can now switch camera views during meetings using the participant panel or video tile. This feature enhances the meeting experience for users in Teams Rooms.

title: Microsoft Teams: Branded Meeting Reactions
description: With new branded reactions, organizations can now extend their visual identity directly into meetings. IT admins simply upload custom reaction icons reflecting brand elements or event themes, and these instantly become available for meeting participants.  A simple way to create more cohesive, on-brand meeting experiences.
ai_summary: Microsoft Teams will allow organizations to upload custom branded meeting reactions for participants. This change affects meeting experiences by enhancing brand visibility during meetings.

title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): [Copilot Search] [Copilot Search] Copilot Chat available when using Copilot Search
description: Copilot Chat will be available for Microsoft 365 Copilot users from the side pane on the right-hand side when using Copilot Search in the Microsoft 365 Copilot app. This allows users to engage with Copilot while browsing universal search without switching pages or losing context.
ai_summary: Copilot Chat will be available in the Microsoft 365 Copilot app while using Copilot Search, allowing users to interact with Copilot without losing context. This affects Copilot users.

title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Seamless Search and Chat Integration
description: Microsoft 365 Chat brings the power of conversational AI directly into Microsoft 365 Copilot Search, enabling users to move effortlessly from finding information to acting on it. Search results become the foundation for contextual chat, allowing you to ask follow-up questions, synthesize insights, and generate content—all in one unified experience. This integration reduces workflow fragmentation, accelerates decision-making, and delivers a more intuitive way to interact with your organization’s knowledge.
ai_summary: Microsoft 365 Chat will integrate conversational AI with Copilot Search, allowing users to interact seamlessly with search results and chat. This affects users engaging with knowledge management.

title: Microsoft Viva: Insights for GitHub Copilot spend and usage
description: AI spend and usage insights for GitHub Copilot will be available on Viva Insights for managers with at least 5 direct reports (scoped access), Global analysts and Microsoft Global administrators. They can track spend and make data-driven decisions for AI spend and usage in GitHub Copilot. The dashboard is enabled by default to ensure immediate access.

title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Admins can now edit user mappings and query filters for ServiceNow Connector
description: Support connection edit of user mapping, query filter for ServiceNow
ai_summary: Admins can now edit user mappings and query filters for the ServiceNow Connector, enhancing administrative control over connections.

title: Microsoft 365: New profile cards for buildings, rooms and desks
description: Buildings, rooms and desks that are added to the Places directory will have new profile cards, accessible from Copilot Chat and across other Microsoft 365 entry points.
ai_summary: New profile cards for buildings, rooms, and desks will be accessible from Copilot Chat and other Microsoft 365 entry points. This change impacts users interacting with the Places directory.

title: Microsoft Teams: Manage Built-in Teams agents in the Teams admin center
description: Admins will be able to manage Teams built-in agents across core Teams experiences, including chats, channels, and meetings, through a dedicated experience in the Teams admin center. From a centralized location, admins can control agents’ availability for users and groups. These agents will be enabled by default for licensed users and managed independently from org-wide Microsoft app settings.

title: Microsoft Purview: Data Loss Prevention - Enriched Audit Data for Matched Rules
description: When DLP rules detect policy violations in Exchange Online, they generate audit records that administrators rely on for compliance monitoring, incident investigation, and policy tuning. Previously, these records only showed Sensitive Information Type matches. This feature aims to extend that to sender domain, subject keywords, attachment type, or recipient information. Now they will be visible in alerts and Activity Explorer providing data enrichment to the administrators.

title: Microsoft 365 admin center: New dedicated License Requests page in Microsoft 365 Admin Center
description: We are introducing a new dedicated License Requests page in the Microsoft 365 Admin Center to help admins more easily discover, review, and manage Microsoft 365 Copilot license requests submitted by users.
ai_summary: Microsoft 365 Admin Center will have a new License Requests page for admins to manage Microsoft 365 Copilot license requests more easily. This change affects all Microsoft 365 administrators.

title: Microsoft Viva: New Overview experience in Agent Dashboard
description: Customers can now view and understand their agent landscape through the new Overview page that will be included as part of the Agent Dashboard in Microsoft Viva. This experience will provide customers with key at-a-glance insights on adoption in their organizations and visibility into who’s creating agents used in their organization.

title: Microsoft Purview: Insider Risk Management- Data Security Triage Agent in IRM Enhancements
description:
The Data Security Triage Agent in Insider Risk Management is deploying enhancements such as improved user risk and activity explorer pattern summaries to support improved investigation accuracy, context, and decision quality. 

Microsoft Purview Insider Risk Management correlates various signals to identify potential malicious or inadvertent insider risks, such as IP theft, data leakage, and security violations. Insider Risk Management enables customers to create policies to manage security and compliance. Built with privacy by design, users are pseudonymized by default, and role-based access controls and audit logs are in place to help ensure user-level privacy.
ai_summary: Microsoft Purview's Insider Risk Management will enhance the Data Security Triage Agent for better investigation accuracy, affecting security teams.

title: Outlook: Delimiter setting admin policy
description: Admins will be able to define a tenant‑wide default value for the Mail Compose and Reply setting that controls whether commas are used to separate recipients. Updated June 2, 2026: We are in the process of correcting an issue with setting the policy. We expect to complete in mid-June. Thank you for your patience.

title: Microsoft Teams: Admin setting for simpler meeting passcodes (numeric‑only)
description: Tenant admins can enable a meeting policy setting that generates 8 digit numeric-only passcodes for meetings organized by selected users/groups. Because numeric-only passcodes increase the risk of unauthorized access, enabling the setting displays a warning and requires explicit confirmation.
ai_summary: Admins can enable a setting in Teams to generate numeric-only passcodes for meetings, with a warning about potential security risks. This impacts tenant admins and meeting organizers.

title: Microsoft Viva: Engage Communities in Microsoft Teams
description: Your Viva Engage communities will now be available in Teams along side teams, chats and channels. Engage communities in Microsoft Teams make it simple to connect, share, and learn across your organization. This new experience brings discoverable, asynchronous conversations and leadership engagement into Teams—helping employees explore ideas and perspectives beyond project-based collaboration.
ai_summary: Viva Engage communities will now be accessible within Teams, facilitating connection and collaboration across the organization. This change affects all Teams users.

title: Microsoft 365: M365 Archive Search
description: M365 Archive will introduce new search capabilities that allow end-users to easily identify archived content. This feature aims to improve productivity by making archived data searchable by end users so they can identify which site needs to be reactivated.
ai_summary: M365 Archive will add new search capabilities for end-users to easily find archived content. This update impacts users who need to access archived data.

title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Referenced sources are cited in drafted content
description: When drafting content using the inline canvas Copilot experience that's based on referenced sources, Copilot includes citations in the text it generates, indicating references to information in the content.

title: Microsoft Teams: User uploaded custom background images for the new VDI solution for Microsoft Teams
description: With this new feature, users on the new VDI solution for Teams can blur their background, choose a Teams virtual background, or replace their background entirely with any image they want by uploading it through the "Video effects and Settings" option.
ai_summary: Users on the new VDI solution for Teams can now upload custom background images for video calls. This change affects users using Teams on VDI.

title: Outlook: Clear & Flag Actions in New Outlook
description: We’re introducing new rule actions in the new Outlook for Web and Windows to give users greater flexibility and control. This includes Clear Categories, Clear Flag, Complete Flag, and Flag Message, enabling more precise automation of message organization and follow‑up workflows. #newoutlookforwindows
ai_summary: The new Outlook will introduce additional rule actions for message organization, including options to clear and flag messages. This affects users managing emails in the new Outlook.

title: Outlook: Expanded Conditions for Conditional Formatting in the New Outlook for Web and Windows
description: The new Outlook for web and Windows now offers expanded Conditional Formatting options, allowing you to highlight emails based on size, read/unread status, presence of attachments, flag settings, categories, or importance. These enhanced rules make it easier to identify critical messages at a glance and visually organize your folders. #newoutlookforwindows
ai_summary: The new Outlook will offer expanded Conditional Formatting options to highlight emails based on various criteria, aiding users in organizing their inboxes. This change affects all Outlook users.

title: Microsoft Edge: v.151 - Passkey Sync for Enterprise Users
description: Microsoft Edge is introducing support for passkey synchronization for enterprise users, enabling secure, passwordless authentication across devices. Passkeys created in Edge can now be synced seamlessly, improving sign-in experience while maintaining strong security standards.

title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Simplified design for the Microsoft 365 Copilot app
description: A refreshed design for the Microsoft 365 Copilot web and desktop app simplifies the user experience to drive engagement with Copilot. This includes updates to the chat home screen, chat response layout, and navigation pane.

title: Microsoft Teams: Events in Meet app in Teams
description: Users can now use the Teams Meet app to discover events across their organization, track what important events are upcoming, and plan and organize their own professional events.
ai_summary: The Teams Meet app will allow users to discover and organize events within their organization. This change affects all Teams users.

title: Microsoft Teams: Searchable keyboard shortcuts from the dialog in Teams
description: Easily find keyboard shortcuts with a new searchable experience in Microsoft Teams. Search by shortcut name or enter part of a key combination directly in the dialog.

title: Microsoft Teams: Interpreter - Simultaneous mode enhancements
description: We’re raising the bar on clarity and control with Interpreter. Admins can fully disable voice simulation via PowerShell when needed. Each speaker is automatically assigned a distinct voice, making multi-speaker conversations easier to follow. We’re reducing distractions by showing shimmer effects only to Interpreter users. We’ve added audio notifications to confirm activation, and we’ve introduced in-product feedback mechanisms so users can easily share their input.

title: Microsoft Teams: Queues app on Teams mobile
description: Manage call queues and engage with customers wherever work takes you. The Queues app on Teams mobile enables on the go workers to stay connected and responsive when handling customer calls. Calling representatives and supervisor leads can view assigned queues, opt in or out of a queue's call routing, and review their call history—all from their mobile device. Supervisor leads can also bulk manage queue participation for their teams. With seamless mobile access, the Queues app helps teams respond faster, handle calls more smoothly, and deliver a better customer experience anytime, anywhere.
ai_summary: The Queues app will be available on Teams mobile, enabling call representatives to manage call queues and customer interactions on the go. This change affects mobile Teams users handling calls.

title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Reference an attached PowerPoint deck’s style when creating a new presentation with Agent Mode in PowerPoint
description: When creating a presentation with Copilot in PowerPoint using Agent Mode, you can reference an existing PowerPoint file, so Copilot applies its theme and styles to the new deck, keeping the design consistent. Updated June 5, 2026: This feature is still in development and will begin rolling out mid-June 2026. We apologize for the inconvenience.

title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Reference an attached PowerPoint deck’s style when creating a new presentation with Agent Mode in PowerPoint
description: When creating a presentation with Copilot in PowerPoint using Agent Mode, you can reference an existing PowerPoint file, so Copilot applies its theme and styles to the new deck, keeping formatting consistent. Updated June 5, 2026: This feature is still in development and will begin rolling out mid-June 2026. We apologize for the inconvenience.

title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Reference an attached PowerPoint deck’s style when creating a new presentation with Agent Mode in PowerPoint
description: When creating a presentation with Copilot in PowerPoint using Agent Mode, you can reference an existing PowerPoint file, so Copilot applies its theme and styles to the new deck, keeping formatting consistent. Updated June 5, 2026: This feature is still in development and will begin rolling out mid-June 2026. We apologize for the inconvenience.

title: Microsoft Teams: Voice tethering
description: The voice tethering feature builds on the recent introduction of Sign Language Mode. It ensures that when an interpreter voices for a D/HH signer, captions and transcripts attribute the spoken content to the signer rather than the interpreter. This provides accurate representation in meetings and makes it clear who is contributing to the conversation. It also improves downstream meeting intelligence such as Copilot so that notes, summaries, action items, and insights are attributed to the correct participant.
ai_summary: Microsoft Teams introduces voice tethering to ensure captions and transcripts attribute spoken content to the correct signer during meetings. This change affects users who rely on sign language interpretation.

title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Use voice for Q&A during Read Aloud in Word
description: Interact in real time with read aloud in Word with Copilot. While your document is being read aloud, you can ask questions with your voice—such as “What does this mean?” or “Summarize this section”—and get answers instantly. No need to pause and search manually. This keeps you in context, reduces interruptions, and helps you understand and act faster.
ai_summary: In Word, users can now use voice commands to ask questions during the Read Aloud feature, allowing for real-time interaction without interruptions.

title: Microsoft Teams: New SlimCore-based optimization for Microsoft Teams in VDI - support for MacOS on Citrix and Azure Virtual Desktops/Windows 365
description: This feature allows MAC endpoints to optimize Microsoft Teams in VDI environments with the new SlimCore-based media engine, providing an expanded feature set and multiple improvements in quality, reliability and performance.
ai_summary: Microsoft Teams will optimize performance in VDI environments for MacOS using a new media engine, improving quality and reliability. This change affects Mac users in VDI setups.

title: Outlook: Import support for data files in Outlook
description: This feature adds support for importing PST files into Outlook for Mac.

title: OneDrive: New Shortcuts folder option when adding shortcuts
description: OneDrive makes it easy to add shortcuts to the files and folders you use most. Now you can choose to keep those shortcuts neatly together in one place instead of mixed in with everything else. When you add a shortcut, you can send it to a dedicated "Shortcuts" folder rather than your OneDrive root. The folder is created automatically the first time you use it and is easy to spot, with a distinct color and building icon. The Shortcuts folder behaves like any other folder—move it, rename it, share it, or remove it whenever you like.

title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Outlook Emails in Copilot Notebooks
description:
Outlook Emails as References in Copilot Notebooks bring email content into the notebook experience, enabling users to ground Copilot in the conversations, decisions, and context that drive their work. 
By adding emails as knowledge sources, users can connect context from their emails directly to their projects, enriching notebooks beyond files alone and improving downstream outputs like presentations and briefs. Available in Copilot Notebooks across Microsoft 365.

title: Microsoft Purview: Role groups UI enhancements
description: The Role groups page in the Microsoft Purview compliance portal now allows admins to look up permissions by roles and memberships.

title: Microsoft Purview: Data Loss Prevention for Microsoft 365 Copilot to safeguard prompts for government clouds
description: We are expanding Microsoft Purview DLP for Microsoft 365 Copilot to safeguard prompts containing sensitive data. This real-time control helps organizations mitigate data leakage and oversharing risks by preventing Microsoft 365 Copilot and Copilot Chat from returning a response when prompts contain sensitive data or using that sensitive data for grounding in Microsoft 365 or the web.

title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Vision in Microsoft 365 Copilot can analyze content shared on desktop screen and through mobile camera
description: Vision in Microsoft 365 Copilot helps you make faster, more informed decisions by understanding context from what you share on screen or camera. Copilot can analyze visual inputs from shared desktop screens and provide detailed insights about the content. You can also use  vision on mobile during a real-time voice session to share your device camera, front or back, and ask questions about what is in front of you. Copilot analyzes the live camera feed or desktop screen in real time and provides spoken, context-aware answers grounded in work and web data.

title: Microsoft Viva: Viva Glint - Export Heat Map report in Viva Glint to editable PowerPoint slides
description: Managers will be able to export the default sections from the Heat Map report in Viva Glint directly to editable PowerPoint slides. This enhancement allows for easier and quicker consumption of this report outside Viva Glint, compared to the previous export method which included static screenshots.
ai_summary: Managers can now export Heat Map reports from Viva Glint to editable PowerPoint slides, improving report accessibility. This change affects managers using Viva Glint.

title: Microsoft Viva: Viva Glint - Configure data retention policy for Viva Glint
description: This feature will introduce the capability for Glint service administrators to configure a data retention policy for their Glint instances based on the organizational policies. Any past survey cycles including engagement surveys, always-on surveys, lifecycle surveys and 360s will be retained/deleted based on this data retention configuration period.
ai_summary: Glint service administrators can now configure data retention policies for various survey types based on organizational policies. This impacts admins managing Glint data retention.

title: Microsoft Purview: Data Loss Prevention – Block External Domain/User action in DLP for SharePoint/OneDrive
description: Block External Domain/User action in Microsoft Purview DLP for SharePoint and OneDrive, gives organizations stronger control over who can access sensitive files. With this enhancement, admins can configure DLP policies that block file access for specific external domains or individual users. This capability helps prevent unintended exposure by external users and supports enterprise compliance requirements.
ai_summary: Microsoft Purview DLP will allow admins to block access to sensitive files for specific external domains or users in SharePoint and OneDrive, enhancing data security. This impacts compliance administrators.

title: Microsoft 365 Apps: Cloud Update - Simplified Channel Management
description: Use device selection criteria in Cloud Update to assign profiles using Microsoft Entra ID groups and streamline the onboarding process. Admins can combine channel and profile assignment in a single step, making it easier to move devices between update channels and maintain consistent update management across the organization.
ai_summary: Admins can now use device selection criteria in Cloud Update to streamline profile assignments and update channel management. This change simplifies the onboarding process for Microsoft 365 Apps.

title: Microsoft Purview: Data Security Posture Management-Data Security Posture Agent in DSPM
description: The Data Security Posture Agent is designed to expand the capacity of data security admins as they proactively work to stay on top of a dynamic data and risk landscape within their organization. Its primary job is to help discover sensitive data across your data estate. This agent is designed to analyze and search documents, emails, and messages that match the natural-language discovery intent requested by the user and assess associated risks. By moving beyond traditional keyword and information-type analysis and harnessing the power of LLMs, this agent enables organizations to identify risks based on the actual purpose and context of the content and take appropriate action.
ai_summary: The Data Security Posture Agent in Microsoft Purview helps data security admins discover sensitive data and assess risks using advanced analysis. This affects data security teams.

title: Microsoft Teams: Teams shared display mode and peripheral detection available for DoD environments
description: Shared display mode in Teams is now available in government DOD environments, enabling more seamless and private meeting hosting from your PC. Additionally, peripheral detection for bring-your-own-device spaces is available for inventory management and reporting through the Pro Management portal.

title: Microsoft Teams: Queues app for Microsoft Teams in GCC High and DoD
description: We’re excited to announce that the Queues app is now available in the GCC High and DoD clouds. This Teams-native app helps organizations manage customer engagements more efficiently by bringing advanced call queue and auto attendant capabilities directly into Teams. Queues app is a Teams Premium feature. For more information about Queues app, including licensing information, please see Manage Queues app for Microsoft Teams in your organization.

title: Teams Meetings in Copilot Notebooks
description:
Meetings as References in Copilot Notebooks bring Teams meeting content into the notebook experience, enabling users to ground Copilot on the discussions, decisions, and context that drive their work. By adding meetings as knowledge sources, users can connect transcripts, notes, chats, and shared content directly to their projects, enriching notebooks beyond files alone and improving downstream outputs like presentations and briefs. 

Available in Copilot Notebooks across Microsoft 365.
ai_summary: Teams meeting content can now be integrated into Copilot Notebooks, allowing users to reference discussions and decisions directly in their projects. This feature enhances the notebook experience for users across Microsoft 365.

title: Microsoft Teams: Efficiency Mode
description: Teams efficiency mode improves performance and responsiveness on hardware constrained devices by applying a reduced resource configuration by default, helping maintain meeting quality and responsiveness during collaboration.
ai_summary: Teams will have an efficiency mode that reduces resource usage on low-performance devices, improving meeting quality. This change affects all Teams users on constrained hardware.

title: Microsoft Teams: Test your microphone before you join
description: Before joining a meeting on your pre-join screen, you can test your microphone and speaker to make sure others will hear you clearly. Select Test mic and speaker to record a short audio clip and play it back. This helps you confirm that the right devices are selected and that you’ll be heard—and hear others—once the meeting starts.
ai_summary: Microsoft Teams will allow users to test their microphone and speakers before joining a meeting. This feature helps ensure audio clarity for participants.

title: Microsoft Teams: Room health signals and notifications in Teams Rooms on Windows
description: When critical issues impact room functionality, users see a banner notification on both the front-of-room display and console in Teams Rooms on Windows.  Room health signals help get issues resolved quickly and ensure productive meetings. Available with Teams Rooms Pro.
ai_summary: Teams Rooms on Windows will display notifications for critical issues affecting room functionality, helping users resolve problems quickly. This feature is available for Teams Rooms Pro.

title: Microsoft 365 admin center: Agents usage report
description: A new agents usage report will be available in the Microsoft 365 admin center.
